d13.action: SQUEEZE into the tunnel to the west
d13.result: The narrow tunnel curves and winds down into the earth. The darkness finally gives way to a glowing green chamber. Go to cave 097.

d14.result: Return to the cave location from which you originally entered the dungeon.

d15.result: Return to the cave location from which you originally entered the dungeon.

d16.result: Return to the cave location from which you originally entered the dungeon.

d17.result: Return to the cave location from which you originally entered the dungeon.

d18.result: Return to the cave location from which you originally entered the dungeon.

d19.result: Return to the cave location from which you originally entered the dungeon.

d36.result: You exit the cave, your eyes adjusting to daylight. You can either head north around the hill to 195 or traverse the marsh to the south to 190.

d42.action: SQUEEZE through a back panel into another room
d42.result: You eavesdrop on some sentients in the assassin’s guild as you approach from the shadows. Gain 1 boost. You may exit to city 041; if you do, continue with the help-OFFER action there with the cost reduced by 2.

d43.action: ENTER east into a glowing door
d43.result: You step into an elevator, and the door slides closed behind you. The elevator ascends slightly toward the surface, opening within an underground city. Go to city 041.

d43.action: EVADE north around the nest and the worms to proceed through the dark tunnel
d43.result: Your augsuit catches on the nest as you maneuver north, and the baby centipedes shriek in unison. Go to cave 044.

d44.action: DODGE west around the tail of the sand centipede as it whips forward (if the sand centipede is no longer an obstacle, reduce this cost to 1)
d44.result: You squeeze into a nook and hope the beast doesn’t notice you. Like other underground animals, it uses touch and sound more than sight. After several heart-stopping moments, it slithers away. You lean back in relief… and the soil collapses behind you. Go deeper into the planet to cave 040.

d45.action: EVADE north around the sand centipede (if the animal is no longer an obstacle, reduce this cost to 1)
d45.result: You scrape through some glowing sediment and tumble into a hidden chamber. Go deeper into the planet to cave 040; if this action’s cost was not reduced to 1, also gain 1 morale.

d46.action: PUSH east through the glowing sediment
d46.result: Falling forward, you find yourself in a bright chamber. Go deeper into the planet to cave 040.

d46.action: SQUEEZE north forward into the darkness
d46.result: You follow some voices, which grow louder as you approach. Go to cave 047.

d47.action: DODGE north around the sand centipede and climb the staircase in the rear of the cave (if the animal is no longer an obstacle, reduce this cost to 1)
d47.result: The centipede is massive but lumbering, and a well-timed dash takes you to the safety of the glowing stairwell. Go deeper into the planet to cave 040.

d49.result:
As you walk, the entire cave begins to vibrate and move. Choose one:

Grab a spike and hold on

Despite the wild movements of the cave—which you now realize is a rather large creature—the inside is surprisingly stable. That is, until the beast reaches the surface, propelling you skyward. Your fall is cushioned by palm trees and phlegm. Gain 1 boost and go to 758.

Reverse course and dash south out of the cave

As you run, a sudden gust of moist wind hurtles you out of the cave. Lose 1 health and go to cave 044.

d49.action: WALK south out of the cave
d49.result: The cave jerks under your feet as you walk, and you stumble out to cave 044.

d50.result: Even with a running start, you barely manage to clear the gap. Move deeper into the planet to cave 079.

d76.result: As you race forward, the floor gives out from under you and you tumble into a pit. Lose 1 health and go to interior 799.

d78.result: You try not to look down as you descend the tower. Go to 347 and gain 1 morale.
The wind presses you against the tower as you make the steep descent. Go to 176 and gain 1 morale.
The tower has few handholds, but you’ve trained with less. Go to 346 and gain 1 morale.
You feel like you’re on top of the world as you slide down the side of the tower. Go to 345 and gain 1 morale.

d79.action: DODGE boulders as you proceed down toward the central pillar
d79.result: Inside the pillar is a narrow, dark staircase that leads you even deeper into the planet. Go to cave 046 and gain 1 morale.

d80.action: DASH north past the sentient (if the sentient is no longer an obstacle, reduce the cost to 1)
d80.result: You crash through a thin wall in the rear of the cavern. Advance deeper into the planet to dungeon 014; keep this location for reference.

d81.result: Several wires lead through a cramped passage that thankfully widens after a brief moment of panic. Advance deeper into the planet to dungeon 015; keep this location for reference.

d82.result: Confident on the ice, you break off a piece of the crystal as you glide past it. Gain item 1160. The frozen stream slopes downward, leading you deeper into the planet. Go to cave 047.

d83.action: PUSH north through some glowing sediment in the rear of the cavern
d83.result: Your hands are caked with dirt as you stumble into a narrow passage. Advance deeper into the planet to dungeon 016; keep this location for reference.

d85.action: EXIT north out of the sweaty arena
d85.result: You stink of sweat, smoke, and spilled booze by the time you reach the far side of the room. Advance deeper into the planet to dungeon 019; keep this location for reference.

d86.result: If you aim your long leap at the crystal perfectly by paying 1 look or 1 boost, you land on top of it, breaking off a piece (gain item 1162). Either way, you follow the passage on the far side of the magma, barely avoiding increasingly large shards that protrude from the cave walls. Advance deeper into the planet to cave 049.

d87.action: SCALE north up the scaffolding toward an exit
d87.result: At the top, you find a narrow, unguarded passage that leads even deeper into the planet. Go to cave 049.

d88.action: PUSH east through the soft, glowing sediment
d88.result: The soil gives way, and you emerge even deeper into the planet to dungeon 017; keep this location for reference.

The roots are endless, and there is a moment when you wonder if you’ve gone too far. It’s then that you see a staircase spiraling around the massive roots. You follow it up into a bustling city. Go to city 519 and gain 1 morale

d89.action: EXIT the cavern, careful not to trigger the lasers
d89.result: The laser array is set up to prevent someone from entering the cave, but not necessarily someone who is trying to leave. Go to cave 029.

d90.action: EXIT north through the golden doorway
d90.result: You climb a narrow flight of stairs, at the top of which are some overgrown bushes. Pushing them aside, you emerge in the middle of some ancient ruins. Go to interior 548.

d91.action: SNEAK north past the serpent (if the serpent is no longer an obstacle, reduce this cost to 1)
d91.result: With great care, you tiptoe past the serpent toward a narrow passage. Go deeper into the planet to dungeon 594; keep this location for reference. If this action’s cost was not reduced to 1, also gain 1 morale

d92.action: SWIM north through one of the rear openings to proceed deeper into the cave
d92.result: After a short swim, you bizarrely pull yourself out horizontally through a wall of water into an open cave. Advance deeper into the planet to cave 049.

d93.action: TREK north over the top of the maze
d93.result: The journey feels endless, as no path leads directly to the far exit. Finally you reach the light at the end of the tunnel. Go deeper into the planet to cave 043 and gain 1 morale

d94.action: HIKE north through the hollow mountain
d94.result:
You hug the steel walls of the cave as you move around the city. Choose one:

Move deeper into the planet

Go to dungeon 595. Keep this location for reference.

Find a back entrance to the city

Roll 3 skill dice and keep all look results. If you pay 1 look, go to city 041. Otherwise, go deeper into the planet to dungeon 595 and keep this location for reference.

d95.result: You head north, trying to avoid stepping on any eggs. Roll 2 skill dice and gain all move results. Unless you pay 1 move, you accidentally crush one of the eggs, and their parent swipes at you (lose 1 health). Proceed deeper into the planet to dungeon 596; keep this location for reference.

d96.action: EVADE the dragon (if the animal is no longer an obstacle, reduce this cost to 1)
d96.result: The dragon must not be hungry, as it shows no interest in chasing you, even after you exit the tunnel into its vast golden grotto. Advance deeper into the planet to cave 045.

d97.action: DASH north through the glowing door in the rear of the cavern (if the noxious gas is no longer an obstacle, reduce this cost to 1)
d97.result: You bolt through the nauseating miasma, and soon it thins out enough to be unnoticeable. Advance deeper into the planet to dungeon 598; keep this location for reference.

d98.action: LEAP north from one root to the next
d98.result: Skipping the labyrinthian staircases, you soar directly to the glowing exit. Go deeper into the planet to cave 044.

d99.result: Deep in the cavern, you discover a narrow passage. Advance deeper into the planet to dungeon 599; keep this location for reference.

d100.action: TRAILBLAZE north through gaps in the trees
d100.result: The moss is pleasant under your feet as you trailblaze through the dense forest. Go to 105.

d100.action: WADE west toward a top-heavy boulder
d100.result: You hope your water-soaked toes will dry before you start getting blisters. Go to 410.

d101.action: CHASE away the animal to clear a path north (if the animal is no longer an obstacle, reduce this cost to 1)
d101.result: You make yourself big, spooking the animal. Gain 1 morale; you may go north to 106.
A menagerie of forest creatures stares at you as you float past them downstream. Go to 472.

d102.action: WADE north, using the shallow stream as a trail
d102.result: The stone rings along the stream look both crafted and natural at the same time. Go to 107.

d102.action: TRAILBLAZE south around the outskirts of a city
d102.result:
The pleasant cacophony of the brightly colored birds here reminds you of an orchestra warming up. Choose one:

Enter the city from the north

Go to city 526.

Steer clear of the city, heading into the shallows of a sea after you break free of the jungle

Go to 473.

d103.result:
Choose one:

Follow the stream north as it winds around the hill

Go to 108.

Pay 1 take and place your palm on the door in the hill

The stone slides to the side, exposing a gaping cavern. Go to cave 095.

d103.action: WADE south out into open water
d103.result: You push through the foliage and step into the vast sea beyond. Gain ability 1489 and go to 474.

d104.result: A large animal bathing in the waterfall doesn’t notice you as you hike by. Go to 475.

d105.result: You follow a flash of pink that stands out from the green of the dense jungle. Go to 100.
At each water crossing, you have renewed gratitude for the lack of mosquitoes on this expedition. Go to 411.

d106.result: You breathe sparingly as you trailblaze in case inhaling the mushrooms’ spores causes any nasty side effects. Go to 107.

d106.action: CLIMB north up the wet cliff
d106.result: The stone surface is slippery, but you make it to the top of the waterfall. Go to 111.
Do you hear something skittering on the jungle floor, or is it just the branches you’re pushing out of your way? Go to 101.

d107.result: The thick jungle vines assist you as you ascend the slippery waterfall. Go to 112.
The rhythmic sloshing around your ankles lulls you into a sense of serenity. Go to 102.
Your progress is slow, and you hope your crew is having an easier time. Go to 106.

d108.result: Oddly, you glimpse other animals heading the same direction as you. Go to 109.
The bright reflections off the shield and the water make you wish your sunglasses survived the crash. Go to 103.

d109.action: SNEAK north past the sentient (if the sentient is no longer an obstacle, reduce this cost to 1)
d109.result: It’s hard to avoid making noise while carrying your gear. You wish you had some help. Go to 114.

d109.action: TRAILBLAZE west through the dense forest
d109.result: The thick ceiling of leaves keeps you safe from sunburn… you just hope there’s no poison ivy. Go to 108.

d110.result: The first rock is easy to climb, but each successive boulder is significantly larger than the last. You finally emerge at the edge of a lake. Go to 115.

d111.result: You are remarkably successful at telling yourself not to worry about whatever broke that orb! Go to 112.

d111.action: DESCEND south down the waterfall to an ancient grove
d111.result: Following the water downstream should lead to the coast eventually, right? Go to 106.

d112.action: CLIMB north up the slippery cliff
d112.result: The constant spray of the waterfall makes the rocky cliff face difficult to grip, but you manage to reach the top; as you pull yourself over the ledge, you notice an elegant bird watching you silently. Go to 117 and gain 1 morale.

d112.action: DESCEND south down a small waterfall using vines for leverage
d112.result: The vines are slick from the water, but so plentiful that you have no trouble finding handholds. Go to 107.
You keep telling yourself that the bizarre life forms are out to get you. Go to 111.

d113.action: CLIMB north up the slippery cliff
d113.result: At the top of the cliff, you’re greeted by a view of the surrounding area. View page 41 in the Book of Vantages and gain 2 boost, then go to 118.

d114.action: HIKE north up the hill or DESCEND into the depths of the well
d114.result:
HIKE

You climb the steep hill and then walk back down to a shoreline on the far side. Go to 119.

DESCEND

The slick stones lining the interior of the well provide weak footing at best, and you tumble into the darkness. Go to cave 095.

d115.action: LEAP east across the gaps in the bridge
d115.result: With a running start, you clear the first gap by a comfortable margin but the second, longer gap by so little that when you land your foot breaks off a piece of stone that falls into the river below. Go to 116 and gain 1 morale.

d115.action: SWIM north to the far shoreline
d115.result: Besides natural stones, you also see chunks of masonry in the water beneath you. Go to 120.

d115.action: DESCEND south over the cliff’s edge
d115.result: As you head south, you find yourself facing a series of broad, steep boulders. Go to 110.

d116.result: The water flows directly through the surrounding hills, as if in a trough. Go to 111.
Though you’re careful of the turbulent water, your pace quickens with anticipation! Go to 115.

d117.action: LEAP north from stone to stone
d117.result: As you hop along the stones, you notice that the wide-beaked bird perched on one of them bears an uncanny resemblance to the frogmouths of Old Earth. Go up the river to 122.
As you gently lower yourself over the edge of the slick escarpment, you notice there’s something familiar about the dignified-looking bird watching you descend. Go to 112 and gain 1 morale.

d118.result: Leaving the animal’s territory, the beams of light piercing the sky catch your attention. Go to 123.

d118.action: DESCEND south down a slippery cliff
d118.result: The base of the cliff gives way to a vast jungle. Go to 113.

d119.action: HIKE north toward the metallic building
d119.result: The organic fragrance of the blooms quickly fades as the metal facade looms closer. Go to 124.

d119.action: HIKE south down the hill toward a well
d119.result: The steep grade of the hill is brutal on your knees, and you’re happy to find a wishing well at the bottom. Go to 114.

d120.result: The best reason to swim toward a volcano is that the warm water is almost like visiting a spa. Go to 481.

d120.action: SWIM south through the warm waters
d120.result: You don’t like the look of that eruption and decide to put more distance between it and you. Go to 115.
The whole area seems to be shaking, so you head off to explore what hasn’t been damaged yet. Go to 414.

d121.result: What a tranquil scene! Surely nothing hectic could happen on a day such as this. Go to 482.

d122.result: You make a mental note to look for more transmission towers; they could prove useful. Go to 483.

d122.action: LEAP south across a series of stones
d122.result: You haven’t played hopscotch since you were a kid. Never thought it would come in handy… go figure. Go to 117.

d123.result: The wind and shadows seem to move in odd bursts that don’t match the lazy clouds in the sky. Go to 118.

d124.action: ENTER the building to the north through the front door or TREK north around the building
d124.result:
ENTER

Shocked by your insolence, a guard tries to shove you backwards, which you use as an opening. Roll X dice; if at least 1 result is look, the guard falls for your feint and you go to interior 554. If not, gain 1 boost and continue.

TREK

You try to stay in the metal sentients’ good graces and keep a respectful distance. Go to 485.
The structure is reminiscent of a face with unblinking, unnerving eyes. Go to 119.

d125.result: Roll 2 skill dice and gain all look results. Then suffer 1 heat damage unless you pay 1 look to spot and avoid the molten cracks in the ground. Go to 130.

d125.action: SWIM south across a narrow strait
d125.result: The air shimmers in the heat and you back away before it saps any more of your strength. Go to 376.

d126.action: CLIMB east up and over the sheer rock wall
d126.result: The rock wall is hot to the touch, reminding you of the particularly high cost of falling during this ascent. You manage to pull yourself over the top and lower yourself into a comparatively hospitable canyon. Go to 127 and gain 1 morale.
You feel exposed to the elements… and any watching eyes. Go to 131.

d126.action: SWIM south across the warm waters
d126.result: Swimming is great for your cardiovascular system that’s still adjusting to the alien air. Go to 377.

d127.action: WADE south toward a group of merchants
d127.result: You head toward the vendors, eager to see if they have anything you can use. Go to 378.

d127.action: CLIMB west up and over the sheer rock wall
d127.result: As you crest the rock wall, you see a shallow pool of lava that makes the west side of the wall much less inviting than the east side you just came from. Go to 126 and gain 1 morale.

d128.action: LEAP east from stone to stone
d128.result: The difference between running away and tactical maneuvering is just timing. Go to 129.

d128.action: EVADE north around the sentient and wade through the water (if the sentient is no longer an obstacle, reduce this cost to 1)
d128.result: You stay on rocks wherever possible, and in the shallowest water when necessary. Go to 133.

d128.action: LEAP south over lava after crossing a narrow strait
d128.result: Roll 5 skill dice and gain all look results. Then suffer 1 heat damage unless you pay 1 look to avoid a scalding stone. Go to 379.

d129.action: LEAP south from stone to stone
d129.result: Watching your footing constantly takes so much mental focus you almost forget your mission. Go to 380.

d129.action: LEAP west over the water using the stones
d129.result: Seeing the rocks float makes you wonder if you can defy gravity too. Go to 128.

d130.action: SNEAK north past the gambling sentients (if the sentients are no longer an obstacle, reduce this cost to 1)
d130.result: You take a last furtive glance at the rolling dice, one of the few familiar objects in this strange realm. Go to 135.

d130.action: WALK south across the lava fields
d130.result: Roll 2 skill dice and gain all look results. Then suffer 1 heat damage unless you pay 1 look to spot and avoid the molten cracks in the ground. Then go to 125.

d131.result: The steep cliff leads east to the edge of a lake. Go to 132.

d131.action: DESCEND north down the steep drop
d131.result: The drop off is so steep that you question why anyone would pitch a tent right on the ledge. Go to 136 and gain 1 morale.

d131.action: HIKE south toward some glowing boulders
d131.result: The bright red shapes in the distance make it easy to keep your bearings. Go to 126.

d132.action: SWIM north toward the ice-capped mountains
d132.result: The water is frigid and choppy, leaving your extremities almost numb by the time you pull yourself ashore. Go to 137, gain 1 morale, and suffer 1 cold damage.

d132.action: CLIMB west up to an encampment
d132.result: You’re out of breath from the elevation gain, but the view is worth it. Go to 131.

d133.action: BALANCE north along the mossy path
d133.result: The lush moss is so pleasant to walk on compared to the abundance of rocks. Go to 138.
Is this a friend or foe? You hope for the best but prepare for the worst. Go to 128.

d134.action: BALANCE north along a narrow string of boulders jutting out of the water
d134.result: You turn the task into a game by pretending you’re on the balance beam in the Galactic Olympics. Go to 139.

d135.action: HIKE east through the tall grass
d135.result: The grass snags your outfit as you hike east. Go to 136.

d135.action: HIKE north along the rocky shoreline
d135.result: You don’t see the Traveler move at all, yet even after leaving them behind, they’re right back in front of you when you arrive. Go to 140.

d135.action: WADE west to a tiny island
d135.result: Maybe you can find more items on the outskirts of the crumbling buildings. Go to 406.

d136.action: CLIMB south up the steep cliff
d136.result: You catch a glimpse of what looks like a red tent at the top of the cliff. Go to 131 and gain 1 morale.
You wade through the waist-high grass to ruins that no longer offer much shelter but still offer a great view of the coastline. Go to 135.

d137.action: SWIM south across the frigid lake
d137.result: The water is shockingly cold, even by the standards of glacial lakes. Go to 132, gain 1 morale, and suffer 1 cold damage.

d138.action: HIKE north through the rolling hills
d138.result: You try to think of a reason why there would only be a single lotus on the hillside. Go to 143.

d138.action: BALANCE south along a narrow string of mossy boulders
d138.result: You try to convince yourself otherwise, but you’re secretly beginning to enjoy your time on the planet. Go to 133.

d139.result: The gentle water feels nice between your toes as you head north to 144.

d139.action: BALANCE south along a mossy path
d139.result: The bones in the grass look ominous enough to seek out a different path. Go to 134.

d140.action: HIKE south along the rocky shore
d140.result: As you hike along the shore, you pass by the ruins of a large building at the top of the seaside cliff. Go to 135.

d140.action: WADE west toward a similar rock structure
d140.result: The concept of energy being sent through rock formations makes you wonder what else is possible here. Go to 407.

d141.result: The bones add a sense of adventure during your tour of this new world. Go to 146.

d142.action: TREK north toward the smell of saltwater
d142.result: The metallic scent is quickly replaced by a pleasant ocean breeze wafting up from the shore. Go to 147.

d143.action: HIKE south across the rolling hills
d143.result: A piece of wreckage could have served as a toboggan on the grass, were it not for the rust. Go to 138.

d144.action: HIKE north up the steep, slick hill
d144.result: You’ve never seen such green grass! It would be great for a picnic if you had the time. Go to 149.

d144.action: LEAP south from one mossy rock to the next
d144.result: The moss is exceptionally springy. Go to 139.

d145.action: LEAP east off the cliff into the water
d145.result: Roll 2 skill dice and gain all look results. Then lose 1 health unless you pay 1 look to avoid a sharp rock on your way down. Go to 146.
The waves seem to stretch on forever, but eventually you pull yourself up on a verdant shoreline. Go to 471 and gain 1 morale.

d146.action: SWIM north across the vast sea
d146.result: After an exhausting swim, your muscles ache, but the view of a glistening waterfall pouring into the forest below lifts your spirits. Go to 472 and gain 1 morale.
The bird calls fade as you leave the shore, and the quiet offers a time for reflection. Go to 141.

d146.action: CLIMB west up the steep cliff
d146.result: You struggle to maintain your grip on the slick, concave cliff wall, but finally you pull yourself over the overhang and onto the soft grass. Gain ability 1468 and 1 morale; go to 145.

d147.action: SWIM east toward a shadow under the waves
d147.result: Unless you have item 1232, as you splash into the water, a colossal beast rises from the sea, surveying its fresh prey. Roll 2 skill dice and gain all overpower results. Then lose 1 health unless you pay 1 overpower. Go east to 148.
The small flock of seabirds follows you on your exhausting swim north across the sea, as if cheering you on. Go to 473 and gain 1 morale.

d147.action: HIKE south toward some rusty wreckage
d147.result: The water looks too vast to cross at the moment, but the debris you saw may prove useful. Go to 142.

d148.action: TREK north along the beach before wading across an inlet
d148.result: Your feet leave footprints in the sand as you trek north and slowly ease into the shallows. Go to 474.

Unless you have item 1232, as you splash into the water, a colossal beast rises from the sea, surveying its fresh prey. Roll 2 skill dice and gain all overpower results. Then lose 1 health unless you pay 1 overpower. Go west to 147.

d149.action: HIKE south down the steep hill
d149.result: The hike is grueling on your thighs as you head downhill. Go to 144.

d150.action: SWIM north to the next island
d150.result: The currents and crosscurrents make the swim even longer than it looked from shore. Go to 155 and gain 1 morale.

d150.action: DODGE fireballs to move south around the volcano
d150.result: The volcano never ceases to erupt as you circumnavigate it. Go to 481 and gain 1 morale.
You splash through the warm water. Go to 416.

d151.result: The formation gives you a strong reminder of the old “duck or rabbit” optical illusion. Go to 156.

d151.action: SWIM south around a burning city
d151.result: A recent eruption of a nearby volcano has left the city a smoldering pile of rubble. You head toward the sounds of people just to the south of the ruins. Go to 482.

d152.action: LEAP north from rock to rock
d152.result: The little island is strangely compelling. Go to 157.

As you stroll toward some boulders off the shoreline, you pass a piece of your ship wreckage. It’s part of the propulsion system and could become flightworthy with a bit of work. You may either go south to 483 or continue with a help--REPAIR action (then read the next result only).

Continue

After patching a small portion of the shattered spaceship, you realize just how big of a task you’ve created for yourself. Gain 1 boost and destiny 1605 (place it in the center). You may either stop (go south to 483) or continue with a help--REPAIR action to weld the pieces into something more cohesive yet still unfunctional (then read the next result only):

Continue

You step back and admire your work. This part of the spaceship is airtight, but the most difficult job remains. For the spaceship to be even semi-operational, you must rewire it and fix the power supply. Gain 1 morale and 1 help. You may either stop (go south to 483) or continue with a help--REPAIR action to obtain a partial spaceship (then read the next result):

Continue

The lights flicker on, and your heart sings as the ship hovers off the ground. Gain vehicle 1434 and go south to 483.

d153.result: The amulet dominates your thoughts as you swim. Go to 158.
You think you’ll get more help from science than magic. Go to 484.

d154.action: SWIM east toward some towering rock formations
d154.result: You’re not sure your gear could withstand volcanic heat. Go to 438.
You think you can find a part of the shore that is protected from lava. Go to 159.

d154.action: SWIM south to some distant rocks jutting out of the water
d154.result: You struggle a bit against the current as the water is pulled toward the seismic cracks. Go to 485.

d155.result: Crossing lines dominate the northern sky. Are those contrails from other ships? Go to 160.

d155.action: SWIM south to a small island
d155.result: The swim is long, but eventually you pull yourself ashore on an island that is empty save for an improbably balanced igneous rock formation. Go to 150 and gain 1 morale.

d156.action: WADE north to the nearby island
d156.result: The flashes of light up ahead remind you of the fireworks you avoided as a child. Go to 161.
The rock formations make it impossible to travel in a straight line. Go to 151.

d157.action: WADE north across the shallow sea
d157.result: The air in front of you seems to vibrate and sweat starts to bead on your forehead. Go to 162.

d157.action: LEAP south across the rocky inlet
d157.result: Staying above the water reminds you of playing “the floor is lava” in your childhood home. Go to 152.

d158.result: As you hike north, you notice a dark cave to your right. You may either enter it (go to cave 039) or go north to 163.
The sea life is so intriguing you wish you had a mask and snorkel. Go to 153.

d159.action: LEAP north over the lavafall and past the sentients
d159.result: You know better than to follow the sentients into the lava. Go to 164.
The lava entering the water behind you makes a cloud of steam that’s hard to see through. Go to 154.

d160.action: SWIM south with the tide to another island
d160.result: This archipelago comprises dozens of little islands. You swim past a few until you find one that looks intriguing. Go to 155.

d161.action: DODGE the lava bursts, making your way north
d161.result: You’re sweating profusely, but you make it through with only minor singed spots on your clothes. Go to 166.

d161.action: WADE south toward some odd rock formations
d161.result: Escaping the heat becomes your top priority. Go to 156.

d162.action: WADE north through the warm water
d162.result:
The water warms to the temperature of a pleasant bath as you near the incandescent city. Choose one:

Enter the city

Go to city 525 and gain 1 random skill.

Wade north past the city

Go to 167.

d162.action: WADE south across the shallow sea
d162.result: The giant rune on the rock above the city will be a good landmark for your navigation. Go to 157.

d163.result: Acknowledging the Traveler’s warning, you still press north. Go to 168.

d164.result: Dodging the molten puddles takes all your concentration. Go to 159.

d165.result: Seeing a piece of your ship reminds you how lucky you are to have survived. Go to 170.

d166.action: WADE north through the warm water
d166.result: As you pass the wind chimes, you’re eerily reminded of the jangling of hollow bones. Go to 171.

d166.action: HIKE south toward a glowing sentient
d166.result: Music at your back and lights up ahead—it’s like you’re at a party! Go to 161.

d167.result: The fire sentient’s glow is so faint as you pass that you worry for its health. Go to 172.

d168.action: EVADE north past the elemental (if the elemental is no longer an obstacle, reduce this cost to 1)
d168.result: Mercifully the monumental fire elemental seems too busy with the fire-breathing insects circling it to notice you slowly circumnavigating it from a great distance. Go to 173; if this action’s cost was not reduced to 1, also gain 1 morale.

d168.action: WADE south toward a large animal
d168.result: Surely the animal’s instinct to stay away from the elemental’s home is a good one. Go to 163.

d169.result: You swim to the north a respectful— and, you hope, safe—distance away from the towering monument. Go to 174 and gain 1 morale.

d170.result: It looks like rough terrain, but you’ll be grateful for dry land again. Go to 250.
That piece sticking out of the water looks awfully familiar… Go to 165.

d171.result: The north looks less volcanic; will it have other dangers instead? Go to 251.

d171.action: WADE south through the warm water
d171.result: The lava that solidified in the water makes for a very uneven surface. Go to 166.

d172.result:
When you reach the shore, choose one:

Stroll west along the shoreline

Go to 251.

Hike north up the steep mountain

Lose 1 time and go to 252.
The trek makes you long for the gorp you nibbled on during childhood strolls with your parents. Go to 167.

d173.action: SWIM north through the warm bay
d173.result: Who (or what) receives the enhanced signal beaming into the sky? Go to 253.

d173.action: SNEAK south past a fiery elemental (if the elemental is no longer an obstacle, reduce this cost to 1)
d173.result: You’ve picked a tactically questionable place to cross the sea, but the elemental maintains its gaze to the south and doesn’t notice your approach. Go to 168; if this action’s cost was not reduced to 1, also gain 1 morale.

d174.action: HIKE north across the slippery rocks
d174.result: Nodding deferentially to the sentient as you pass, you’re eager to press on. Go to 254.
As you swim through the volcanic archipelago, you spot a towering lavafall pouring from an opening in a small mountain. Go to 169 and gain 1 morale.

d175.action: EVADE north past the swift sentient (if the sentient is no longer an obstacle, reduce this cost to 1)
d175.result: You’re probably not fast enough to outrun the winged sentient, but you bolt through the plains to the north until you spot a breezier sentient relaxing in another tent. Go to 180; if this action’s cost was not reduced to 1, also gain 1 morale.

d176.action: DANCE north into and around the twisters
d176.result: You were expecting to go north, but you’re surprised to feel the grip of the sentients’ hands in yours as they dance with you, delighted that you’d join in their revelry. A tingling sensation runs up your spine. Eventually you bid farewell and go to 181. Also gain 1 morale and 1 boost.

d177.action: WALK north across the field of flags
d177.result: Sentients jeer at you for stomping on their sacred field. Gain curse 1387 and 1 boost; go to 182.

d178.action: EVADE north past the sentient (if the sentient is no longer an obstacle, reduce this cost to 1)
d178.result: You weave between the sentient and the towering blooms, ignoring the copious airborne pollen and dust, and bolt to the north. Go to 183; if this action’s cost was not reduced to 1, also gain 1 morale.

d178.action: TRUDGE south across the sand dunes
d178.result: You briefly consider trying to slide down the dunes on a huge flower petal before dismissing the idea. Go to 348.

d179.action: SNEAK north past the blissfully unaware sentient (if the sentient is no longer an obstacle, reduce this cost to 1)
d179.result: The flowers looming overhead are downright Seussian. Go to 184.
Thankfully the huge flowers provide relief from the desert sun. Go to 349.

d180.action: SNEAK south around a busy sentient (if the sentient is no longer an obstacle, reduce this cost to 1)
d180.result: Sentients seem to be all around you; you wonder if they know each other. Go to 175.

d181.action: DASH north past the sentients (if the sentients are no longer an obstacle, reduce the cost to 1)
d181.result: The sentients tighten their hold on the chest but make no effort to stop you as you go to 186.
The wind tugs at your clothes, gear, and anything else it can find. Go to 176.

d182.action: EVADE north past the sentients, jumping to your feet and racing ahead (if the sentients are no longer an obstacle, reduce this cost to 1)
d182.result: You dodge the sentients and sprint north across the open prairie. Go to 187; if this action’s cost was not reduced to 1, also gain 1 morale.

d182.action: WALK south across a field of flags
d182.result: A sentient angrily informs you this is sacred ground. Gain curse 1387 and 1 boost; go to 177.

d185.result: You stick close to the ruins, both for a barrier to the wind and to admire the sculpted flourishes. Go to 190.

d186.result:
You resist the urge to tilt at the windmills. Choose one:

Enter the town

Go to city 518.

Trek north past the town

Go to 191.

d188.action: WADE north across the shallow bay
d188.result: Passing the windmill on your way to the water makes you wonder if the planet also utilizes hydropower. Go to 193.

d189.action: LEAP north from one sandbar to the next
d189.result: You make a game out of hopping along the path of banners on the few dry patches you can find. Go to 194.

d190.action: TREK north across the wetlands and up the hill
d190.result:
Your feet are slick with mud as you begin to trek up the slope. You pass by the entrance to the cave, the mouth of which is much larger than it appeared from a distance. Choose one:

Proceed around the hill to the north

Go to 195.

Perform a look--EXPLORE in the mouth of the cave

As your keen eyes adjust to the darkness, you reach a barrier that requires further attention. Go to cave 036.

d191.action: WADE north across the muddy water
d191.result: You consider taking a piece of the shredded tapestry to use as a towel, but you never know who’s watching. Go to 196.
Move either into the town (city 518) or around the town (location 186).

d193.action: WADE south across the shallow bay
d193.result: As you descend the hill, you see several objects in motion across the water. Go to 188.

d194.action: EVADE the twister as you head north (if the twister is no longer an obstacle, reduce this cost to 1)
d194.result: The gale-force winds leave you unsteady on your feet at first, but you sprint without stopping until you reach (much more tranquil) foothills to the north. Go to 199 and gain 1 morale.
You pick up a family of leeches from the muck, but you eventually arrive at the far shore. Lose 1 health and go to 189.

d195.action: ENTER the gate to the north; you may pay $2
d195.result: Green lights scan your body as you pass through the gateway. If you paid $2, gain 2 health—the gateway provides a health benefit for those willing to pay. Whether or not you paid, go to 225.

d195.action: TREK south down the hill and across the shallow water
d195.result: The music fades into the distance but keeps playing in your head for quite a while. Go to 190.

d196.action: HIKE north over the mountain pass
d196.result: The rainbow beam of light calls to you on a deeper level than you understand. Go to 226.
No use dwelling on the crash; it’s in the past but you have to look ahead. Go to 191.

d197.action: EVADE north past the sentient, losing them in the mountain pass (if the sentient is no longer an obstacle, reduce this cost to 1)
d197.result: You slow down once you’re sure the sentient isn’t following you and soon find yourself at the top of an escarpment. Go to 227; if this action’s cost was not reduced to 1, also gain 1 morale.

d198.result: You marvel at the orb’s narrow perch, taking care not to veer too far off the ridge. Go to 228.

d199.action: SNEAK north past the oblivious sentient (if the sentient is no longer an obstacle, reduce this cost to 1)
d199.result: A circular rock formation in the distance looks like a window to the sky. Go to 229.

d199.action: EVADE south around the twister (if the twister is no longer an obstacle, reduce this cost to 1)
d199.result: The whipping winds of the tornado keep you off-balance and the palpable static electricity leaves your hair standing on end. Go to 194 and gain 1 morale.

d200.action: TREK north through the misty valley
d200.result: You descend into the opaque fog below, where the poor visibility and rugged terrain together make navigation all but impossible. Roll 6 skill dice and gain all look results. You may pay 2 look to go to interior 563. Otherwise, go to location 205. Either way, also gain 1 morale.
You barely make a harrowing leap over an icy gorge, then descend the mountain only to find a hulking, magnetic elemental. Go to 393 and gain 1 morale.

d201.result:
Choose a direction for your leap:

Leap over the gap to the left

Go to 206.

Leap over the gap to the right

As you do, the sentient flies up to you and performs a routine inspection. If you have any weapons, they admonish you and tell you to report to the King of Thieves. Either way, go northeast to 207.
Amazed at the flying sentient, you long to rise into the air yourself. Go to 712.

d202.result: Floating machines, hovering sentients… you start to wonder if you can defy gravity too. Go to 203.

d202.action: EVADE north around the sentient (if the sentient is no longer an obstacle, reduce this cost to 1)
d202.result: The sentient shrugs and returns to their job as you leave them in your wake. Go to 207.

d202.action: LEAP south across the gap after finding a gap in the mountains
d202.result: Clouds drift across the crevice. Go to 718.

d203.action: TREK north across the frozen expanse
d203.result: If the brutal cold becomes any more forgiving as you descend into the snow-covered, rocky valley below, you don’t notice it. Gain ability 1505 and 1 morale; go to 208.
Not entirely trusting the floating stones, you are surprised to find them a sturdy launching point. Go to 202.

d204.action: LEAP north from one floating lodestone to the next
d204.result: Each lodestone shifts under your weight as you leap, and you’re relieved when you finally reach solid ground again. Go to 209.

d204.action: TREK south past a gloomy mine
d204.result: You wonder what prevents the lodestones from becoming magnetized and causing chaos as they float. Go to 730.

d205.action: HIKE north up the steep slope
d205.result: A cruel wind whipping through the frozen canyon makes an already miserable ascent even colder and slower. Go to 210 and gain 1 morale.

d205.action: TREK south through the cloud cover to an outlook
d205.result: You descend into the soupy fog filling the valley, where the uneven ground and thick mist together make navigation all but impractical. Roll 6 skill dice and gain all look results. You may pay 2 look to go to interior 563. Otherwise, go to 200. Either way, also gain 1 morale.

d205.action: HIKE west up the slippery slope
d205.result: Careful to avoid the lotuses, you head for something reflective at the top of the ridge. Go to 394.

d206.action: DESCEND east down the steep cliff toward a meditating sentient below
d206.result: A cruel crosswind makes gripping the icy handholds even harder. Go to 207 and gain 1 morale.

d206.action: CLIMB north toward the narrow bridge
d206.result:
You suspect this freezing city doesn’t draw many tourists. Choose one:

Enter the city

You stop your journey short of the distant bridge and instead enter the city. Gain 1 time, 1 morale, and 1 move; go to city 522.

Climb north past the city

Gain ability 1468 and 1 morale; go to 211.

d207.result: A clever thief bumps into you on your way up, lightening your purse. Lose $1 and go to 212.
You’re glad to leave with all your belongings (but you still check your pockets). Go to 202.

d207.action: CLIMB west up the steep mountain
d207.result: The few handholds you can find are slick with ice, but you manage to pull yourself over the snowy ledge at the top of the cliff face. Go to 206 and gain 1 morale.

d208.action: HIKE north toward the glowing pyramid
d208.result: Each peak of these mountains seems to hide another marvel. Go to 213.

d208.action: HIKE northeast toward the mysterious staircase
d208.result: The staircase winds up the mountain and through a dark passage, and ends at the base of a narrow path. Go to 214.

d208.action: TREK south through the misty mountains
d208.result: Long into your exhausting trek, you pass through a thick layer of clouds, making the pinnacles to your north look like islands in an endless white sea. Gain ability 1505 and 1 morale; go to 203.

d209.result: Maybe the animal’s territory isn’t very big and you can find a way around. Go to 416.

d209.action: CHASE away the animal (if the animal is no longer an obstacle, reduce this cost to 1)
d209.result: You make yourself big, spooking the animal. Gain 1 morale; you may go north to 214.

d209.action: LEAP south from one floating lodestone to the next
d209.result: The stones aren’t fixed in space; they jostle around as you land on them. Go to 204.

d210.action: EVADE the magnetic pull of the object to move north
d210.result: Feeling the unmistakable metallic pull, you give the monument a wide berth. Go to 215.

d210.action: DESCEND south down the steep slope
d210.result: The fierce wind snaking through the narrow gorge below tests your already tenuous grip on the steep rock wall. Go to 205 and gain 1 morale.

d211.action: SNEAK north under the bridge and past the sentient (if the sentient is no longer an obstacle, reduce this cost to 1)
d211.result: The wind funnels under the bridge, making it even colder and muffling the sound of your travel. Go to 216.

d211.action: DESCEND south down the steep slope
d211.result:
The numbing cold doesn’t become any more sufferable and you descend toward a cliffside and a towering city of metal built along it. Gain ability 1491 and 1 morale; choose one:

Remain outside of the city

Go to 206.

Enter the city as you approach

You shimmy along the edge of the cliff until you find a narrow, trash-filled alley. Go to city 522.
Go to 210. If you have any item of value $10 or higher, the sentient smites you for not selling it to them (gain curse 1391) but follows you west out of curiosity (gain sentient 1336).

d212.action: EVADE the animal to proceed north (if the animal is no longer an obstacle, reduce this cost to 1)
d212.result: As you head north, you catch a hearty whiff of the large lotus on the right. Gain 1 health; you may also lose 1 curse. Then go to 217.
Is it your imagination or do you see a rainbow ahead of you? Go to 207.

d213.result: You exploit a blind spot in the sentinels’ predictable route. Either go north to 218, or suffer 1 heat damage and go to interior 513.

d213.action: HIKE southeast toward a moving red glow
d213.result: You can’t take your eyes off the erratic red object, like a cat with a laser pointer. Go to 209.
Your breath should become fog at this temperature, but the air is too thin to hold moisture. Go to 208.

d214.action: BALANCE north precariously across the narrow path
d214.result: You have to think about every step (gain ability 1501), but you make it safely to cave 034.

d214.action: DESCEND east off the steep, icy path
d214.result: A staircase leads down to the edge of the sea. Go to 417 and gain 1 morale.

d214.action: HIKE southwest down a staircase toward a glowing orb
d214.result: The sphere grows from the size of a marble to taller than a person as you get closer. Go to 208.

d215.result: You leave the metal city toward a structure with entirely different architecture. Go to 216.
The view of the city’s underside is a maze of wires, lights, and metal. Go to 220.

d216.result: Passing fragrant flowers and animal remains, you’re amazed at life’s adaptability. Go to 221.
From soft lines to harsh angles, the difference in structures is jarring. Go to 215.

d217.action: CLIMB north up and over one of the rocky outcroppings that break up the fence
d217.result: The fence is relatively easy for you to bypass… but is that a good idea? Go to 222.

d218.action: SNEAK south around a fortified location
d218.result: Even knowing what the Traveler told you about the stone, it’s hard to leave it behind. Go to 213.

d219.result: The icy road is narrow, and the weather only seems to worsen the further you walk. Gain ability 1505 and go to 224.

d219.action: DESCEND southeast toward the salty sea breeze
d219.result: An impassable rocky ridge rises directly to the south of here, so you head southeast instead. Go to 417.

d219.action: EVADE west around the sentient (if the sentient is no longer an obstacle, reduce this cost to 1)
d219.result: While the Traveler distracts the guard, slip around them to 218.

d220.result: The slick ice gives you a chance to have fun and see how far you can glide. Go to 601.

d220.action: HIKE south across the frozen turf
d220.result: The ice is behind you now, but what looks like a jagged iceberg looms ahead. Go to 215.

d221.action: EVADE the mechanical hydra (if the animal is no longer an obstacle, reduce this cost to 1)
d221.result:
You bend and twist to avoid the beast; choose one:

Go to cave 022

If this action’s cost was not reduced to 1, also gain 1 morale.

Climb north to location 602

Gain 1 boost and 1 move when you notice that the hydra only really cares about guarding the cave.

d221.action: HIKE south past a majestic building
d221.result: You leave the steep mountain passes for more civilized environs. Go to 216.

d222.result: The snow resting on tree branches reminds you of cozy winter mornings. Go to 223.

d222.action: TRUDGE north through the deep snow
d222.result: The frigid snow field soon yields to a (still frigid) expanse of opaque ice. Gain ability 1496 and go to 603.

d222.action: CLIMB south up and over one of the rocky outcroppings
d222.result: Whatever the barricade was meant for, it’s no match for you. Go to 217.

d223.result: The cold doesn’t abate, and snowdrifts hinder your steps. Go to 604.
Despite the frigid temperature, you see signs of abundant wildlife. Go to 222.

d224.result: You see hunched shapes through the snow. Go to 605.
You press against the ridge, as far from the sheer drop as you can get. Go to 420.
Following the well-defined path seems to be the safest route. Go to 219.

d225.action: DESCEND north down the steep cliff
d225.result: The rocky cliff face offers fewer fingerholds than you’d hoped for, but you eventually make your way down into the slight but noticeable glow of the dense swamp below. Gain ability 1491 and 1 morale; go to 230.

d225.action: WALK south toward a gate in the ridge with blinking red lights
d225.result:
Choose how to proceed when you reach the gate:

Pay $2 in coins

The gate’s lights turn to green and you walk through. Gain 2 health and go to 195.

Proceed through the gate

A shock ripples through you, causing your muscles to spasm. Lose 2 health and go to 195.

Stop

You find a coin on the ground. Gain $1 and continue with a move action in a different direction.

d226.result: Your legs ache from the long descent, but your curiosity about the source of the glimmering helix of light below sustains your motivation. Gain ability 1491 and 1 morale; go to 231.

d226.action: HIKE south through the mountain pass
d226.result: What looks to you like an iridescent maypole has lifted your spirits. Go to 196.

d227.action: DESCEND north down the steep cliff
d227.result: Climbing down the sheer cliff leaves your muscles aching, and at the bottom your feet sink slightly into the boggy mud of the swamp. Gain ability 1491 and 1 morale; go to 232.

d228.result: Leaving the tower’s elevated position, the sky is quickly obscured by a forest canopy. Go to 233.
The landscape abruptly changes on the other side of the hill. Go to 198.

d229.action: DESCEND north down the steep cliff
d229.result: The slope of the rocky cliff face on the north side of the curiously shaped mountain is unforgiving, but eventually you make your way into a dense swamp punctuated by glowing lights. Gain ability 1491 and 1 morale; go to 234.

d230.result: Sunlight barely penetrates the foliage, so thank goodness for the mysterious lanterns. Go to 235.

You kick off as much muck from your feet as you can and steadily pull yourself up the sheer rock face, only to find an improbably located campsite at the top of the cliff. Go to 225 and gain 1 morale.

d231.action: WADE north through the mysterious swamp
d231.result: Encountering the gauntlet rattled your thoughts. Go to 236.
Enough handholds in the otherwise sheer rock face make the ascent manageable if tiring. Go to 226 and gain 1 morale.

d232.action: WADE or TRAILBLAZE north through the shimmering muck
d232.result:
WADE

Several energy sentients curse you for the disrespect. Gain curse 1395 and go to 237.

TRAILBLAZE

Roll 1 challenge die from the pool (if none are available, refresh a die from the center); if the result is 1 time, lose 1 time and place the die in the center (otherwise, refresh the die). Then go to 237.
The glow of countless lamps in the swamp below helps illuminate the nearly vertical rock wall, and eventually you pull yourself over the grass ledge at the top. Go to 227 and gain 1 morale.

d233.result: You don’t want to get lost, but the hazy light up ahead lures you closer. Go to 238.

d233.action: CLIMB south up the cliff-side tower
d233.result: Rising above the dense layer of trees feels like coming up for air. Go to 228.

d234.result: Unless you’ve been warned to avoid the lily, lose 1 health as the plant smashes against you, leaving welts on your skin. Go north to 239.
The peculiar geometry of the mountain makes an already challenging ascent exhausting. Go to 229 and gain 1 morale.

d235.result: The Traveler’s observation about feeling energized keeps your spirits up. Go to 230.

d236.result: The metal giving a purple glow is a stark contrast to the wood and yellow ambient light. Go to 241.

d237.result: Go to 232 and gain curse 1395 for disrupting a birth.

d238.result:
Despite that it’s visible from a great distance, the city is silent except for the occasional electrical discharge or clang of a lantern. Choose one:

Enter the city

Go to city 520 and gain 1 random skill.

Wade north past the city

Go to 243.

d239.result: The structure above you looks like the best treehouse a child could want. Go to 244.

d239.action: WADE south through the swamp toward a large flower
d239.result: Lose 1 health as the plant smashes against you, leaving welts on your skin. Go south to 234.

d240.action: TRAILBLAZE north through the dense trees
d240.result: The tree trunks are impressively sturdy to support those chains. Go to 245.

d241.action: TRAILBLAZE north through the thick woods
d241.result: It looks easy, but you have a feeling not to pass through the opening in the stone. Go to 246.
To avoid getting lost in the swamp, you head for something that doesn’t look like the rest of the trees. Go to 236.

d242.action: EVADE north past the elemental (if the elemental is no longer an obstacle, reduce this cost to 1)
d242.result: Even from the careful distance of your circuitous hike around the monstrous elemental, a sense of creeping discouragement weighs on you. Go to 247; if this action’s cost was not reduced to 1, also gain 1 morale.

d243.result: You’re careful not to get stuck in the mud along with the device. Go to 248.
The bright yellow lights of a city belie its eerie silence. Move either into the city (520) or around the city (238).

d244.action: TRAILBLAZE north through the dense forest
d244.result: Look up ahead! Is that a break in the endless trees? Go to 249.

d245.action: WADE or LEAP north through the wetlands
d245.result:
WADE

The reeds sting as you walk past. Lose 1 health and go to 661.

LEAP

You hop over some inhospitable-looking reeds. Go to 661.

d245.action: TRAILBLAZE south through the dense trees
d245.result: If those flowers have roots, there must be SOME solid ground to stand on. Go to 240.

d246.action: TRAILBLAZE north around the pond through the bushes
d246.result: The bushes look like a deliberate line, almost a hedge. Go to 662.

d246.action: TRAILBLAZE south through the foggy forest
d246.result: Visibility decreases rapidly as you head into the trees. Go to 241.

d247.action: SNEAK north around the sentients (if they are no longer an obstacle, reduce this cost to 1)
d247.result: You stay behind the runestones, just in case. Go to 663.

d247.action: SNEAK south past a hulking elemental (if the elemental is no longer an obstacle, reduce this cost to 1)
d247.result: As you sneak among the dense thicket of trees, you feel a sense of wilting demoralization that you can’t quite shake. Go to 242; if this action’s cost was not reduced to 1, also gain 1 morale.

d248.action: WADE north across the river and beyond
d248.result: You admire the flocks of birds high in the sky as you leave the swampy wetland for the pleasant grassland to the north and the forest beyond. Go to 664.

d248.action: TRAILBLAZE south through the dark forest
d248.result: The pattern on the tree has elements of paint, light, and lichen. Go to 243.

d249.action: WADE north across the shallow river
d249.result: The river looks ideal for irrigation. Go to 665.

d249.action: TRAILBLAZE south through the dense forest
d249.result: The unadorned tree trunks look plain after the patterns you just left. Go to 244.

d250.result: The water looks more appealing than the sand right now. Go to 170.
Of course deserts aren’t always hot; even so, the drop in temperature was bracing. Go to 421.

d251.result: Are those… teeth at the center of the indentation? Go to 256.
You ponder tying your gear to one of the floating rocks, to take the weight off your shoulders. Go to 171.

d252.action: TREK east toward a treasure chest
d252.result: Maybe the desert heat has weakened the chest. Go to 253.
The slow sentient doesn’t attempt to stop you. Go to 257.

d252.action: DESCEND south down the plateau and swim across the water
d252.result: It’s out of the frying pan and into the fire: No sooner is the desert at your back than an erupting volcano looms in front of you, and you swim to the south side of the inlet to keep your distance. Go to 172 and gain 1 morale.

d253.action: SWIM south through the warm bay
d253.result: You feel more buoyant in this planet’s water than in the oceans at home. Go to 173.

d253.action: TREK west toward a large nest
d253.result: If those are birds up ahead, they’re like none you’ve ever seen before. Go to 252.

d254.action: HIKE south to a slippery, rocky shoreline
d254.result: Your departure adds to the distinct indentations in the red soil. Go to 174.

d256.result: The smoking bones aren’t enough warning to deter you from pressing deeper into the heat. Go to 261.

d257.result: You still can’t find any shade but maybe the figure can offer another kind of help. Go to 258.

d257.action: DASH north past the beasts (if the birds are no longer an obstacle, reduce this cost to 1)
d257.result: You’d rather not have any chance of being trapped in this environment. Go to 262.

d258.action: EVADE north around the peddler (if the sentient is no longer an obstacle, reduce this cost to 1)
d258.result: You haven’t seen many animals here, so where did the peddler get so many bones? Go to 263.

d258.action: TREK west toward a sentient in trouble
d258.result: Unlike the peddler, the sentient ahead looks decidedly out of their element. Go to 257.

d259.action: LEAP east over a gap in the mesa
d259.result: The mesa abruptly ends here, but you clear the gap. Go to 444.

d260.action: EVADE north around the animal (if the animal is no longer an obstacle, reduce this cost to 1)
d260.result: The 8-armed animal attempts to pull you close, and you barely escape. Go to 265; if this action’s cost was not reduced to 1, also gain 1 morale.

d262.result: There must be a way out of this desert! Go to 263.

The bony architecture of the city is magnificent but a little unsettling. Choose one:

Enter the city

Go to city 524 and gain 1 random skill.

Enter the cave behind the city

Go to cave 027.

Walk north past the cave

Go to 267.

d263.result: An odd noise akin to damp laundry flapping in the wind is getting louder. Go to 268.

Continue

Continue

Continue

Trudge south around the city

Enter the city to the south through a back entrance

Accept the ride

Remain in open water

Go to 058.

Go to 476.

Go to 453.

Go to 368.

e54.result:
A consortium of merchants welcomes you aboard with open arms… if you have coins to spare. You may lose 1 card to gain its value. Then, if you have at least $1, continue reading. Otherwise the merchants throw you overboard (go to 647, ignoring hypoxia damage upon arrival).

You have at least $1

One merchant offers you information (pay $1 to gain 2 boost); another raves about a seaweed smoothie (pay $1 to gain 1 health); yet another peddles a warm sticky bun (pay $1 to gain 1 morale). You may choose any/all of them if you can afford it (if you buy anything, then go to 647, ignoring hypoxia damage upon arrival), or you can ignore them and listen to some more elite merchants at the upper tiers of the ship (decide to buy or proceed before reading further).

Proceed

As you ascend higher into the ship, a toothy vendor offers to sell you a steel fox (pay $3 to gain animal 828) or a gossamer spider (pay $3 to gain animal 819); a willowy sentient also tries to open your purse with offers to sell you the rare drakeleaf (pay $5 to gain flora 1081) or a maelstrom agave (pay $6 to gain flora 1046). You may choose any/all of them if you can afford it (if you buy anything, then go to 647, ignoring hypoxia damage upon arrival), or you can ignore these offers too and go to the very top of the ship for one final offer from the captain (decide whether to buy or proceed before reading further).

Proceed

As you reach the bridge, an old sentient welcomes you and reveals that they are hoping to retire. “Years ago, I converted an old galleon to this roving market. I think it’s time to ground the market, but the ship is yours for $30.” If you accept, gain vehicle 1016, then roll a skill die and go to where the tides take you: move (063); look (058); engage (478); help (451); take (366); or overpower (426). If not, the captain wishes you well and pushes you off the ship (go to 647, ignoring hypoxia damage upon arrival).

e85.result:

Before you begin the tournament, you may bet on any number of fighters ($1, $2, or $3). If you win a first-round bout, gain the amount you bet on that bout. If a fighter on whom you bet wins the entire tournament, gain the amount you bet times the coin multiplier noted on that fighter. For all other bets, lose the amount you bet. After the tournament, lose card 797.

e114.result: Gain sentient 1326, 1 time, and 1 engage.

e115.result: The cartographers will happily buy any maps in your possession for their value. They can also sell you a map of the world’s most prominent flora (1257) for $6 or an elixir (864) for $2. e116.action: CONSULT with the Traveler about escaping this planet
e116.result: The Traveler’s tone grows somber. “If you must leave, consider mastering the portals of this world; there is one to the south of here.” Gain 1 boost and destiny 1604 (place it in the center).

e117.action: ASK a local sentient about the crystal
e117.result: A stone sentient lumbers over to you.
