e362.result: The act of talking to a flower is strange but also meditative, and you feel better afterward. Gain 2 morale.

e363.action: CONSULT with the Traveler about your mission
e363.result: “If you’re trying to collect a menagerie of local fauna, follow the bubbles to a rare fish that can provide you with oxygen underwater. Please don’t harm it.” Gain 1 boost and continue.

e364.result: A beam of bright light bursts from the top of the runecaster. Nothing happens for a few minutes, then a sentient appears. “I saw your signal—how can I help?” they ask. Gain sentient 1358 with a “when placed” benefit of only 1 boost (instead of 2).

e365.action: HAIL a ride from any passing boat
e365.result:
You’re hard to spot in the angry sea, but a keen-eyed fisherman hauls you onto the deck and suggests you head south away from the storm. Gain 1 boost and choose one:

Pay $2

The fisherman agrees to venture north onto the ocean surface with you on board (go to 063).

Don’t pay

The fisherman is happy to transport you southeast to the Traveler on 507, south to a tower peeking out of the ocean on 506, or southwest to a gold sentient on 505.

e366.result: You and another player may refresh all challenge dice from any 1 column in each of your grids. Until end of turn, you may place challenge dice on cards in that crewmate’s grid. Continue.

e367.result: With a satisfying click, the lock pops open. Roll 6 skill dice; you may reroll each die once. If you have at least 3 of a kind, gain item 924. Instead, if you have at least one pair, gain item 1164. Otherwise, gain $4.

e368.result:
A flat-bottom boat drifts over to you, and the captain offers you a ride. Choose one:

Don’t pay anything

The sailor warns you about the elemental to the northwest. Gain 1 boost.

Pay $1

Gain 1 boost, and you may go northwest under the ocean to 655 (ignore hypoxia damage upon arrival), northeast to a talkative tree on 666, southeast to a glowing marsh on 245, or southwest to a defenseless animal on 508.

Pay $2

Gain 2 boost and go northwest onto the ocean surface to 060 or stay in shallow waters (go northeast to a talkative tree on 666, southeast to a glowing marsh on 245, or southwest to a defenseless animal on 508).

e369.result: The elemental fills your mind with visions of grandeur and an intense compulsion to release it. Centuries ago, the sentients of this world banded together to tether this elemental—and others of its kind— preventing them from freely roaming and ravaging the planet. Gain 1 boost and 2 help; you may continue.

e370.result: Another player gains 1 random skill, refreshes 1 challenge die on a card in their grid, or gains 1 boost. Gain 1 morale and continue.

e371.result: The act of talking to a flower is strange but also meditative, and you feel better afterward. Gain 2 morale.

e372.action: GREET other sentients gathered at the water’s edge
e372.result: Other travelers return the greeting, a few of them grumbling about how they’re unable to hop from one green lilypad to the next—apparently this is the only way to safely cross the creek. Gain either 1 help or 1 overpower; you may continue.

e373.action: MIMIC the animal’s grunts and chortles
e373.result: The mammoth pauses its grooming to learn more about its new friend. Gain animal 841.

e374.action: MIMIC the sound of the animal’s constant chittering
e374.result: The creature halts its advance, curious and confused by your mimicry. It chitters back and quickly warms to you. Gain animal 838.

e375.action: HAIL a ride from the boat’s captain
e375.result: The young couple aboard the ship is happy for the company. You may hitch a ride northwest to an old fort on 304, northeast to some lava-covered lorestones on 125, southeast to a burning building on 357, or southwest to a piece of your spaceship’s wreckage on 355.

e376.result:
The owner of the building offers to hatch an egg for you. Choose one:

If you have an egg

Hatch the egg and gain 1 morale.

If you don’t have an egg

The sentient describes the heat required to accelerate the hatching process. Gain 1 boost.

If you want to buy the building

The sentient wasn’t planning to sell their home workshop, but they’re willing to part ways with it for $35. If you pay, gain items 860, 870, and 978, and structure 1691. If you don’t pay, gain 1 boost.

e377.result: The act of talking to a flower is strange but also meditative, and you feel better afterward. Gain 2 morale.

e378.result: The merchants are fiercely competitive, so once you choose one, the others ignore you. Pay $3 to gain one of the following: an explosive (879), a shovel (900), armor (946), a red flower (1069), an orange crystal (1162), or a runecaster map (1255). If you don’t pay, they toss you $1 in pity.

e379.result: Another player gains 1 random skill, refreshes 1 challenge die on a card in their grid, or gains 1 boost. Gain 1 morale and continue.

e380.action: TALK to the animal in a soothing voice
e380.result: The creature can barely turn its head to acknowledge you, but its whimpers tell you that it hears you. Gain 1 help and continue.

e381.action: HAIL an underwater ride from the turtle
e381.result:
The sea turtle taxi can safely transport you underwater for a fee. Choose one:

Lose 1 boost from a flora or food card (or lose the card itself)

The turtle nibbles on it and gestures for you to board the vessel. Gain vehicle 1013 with 1 boost on it, then dive underwater either northeast to 632 or east to 631.

Pay nothing

The turtle shrugs and waits for the next passenger. Gain 1 boost.

e382.result: You and another player may refresh all challenge dice from any 1 column in each of your grids. Until end of turn, you may place challenge dice on cards in that crewmate’s grid. Continue.

e383.result: The sentient timidly emerges from behind the tree, apologizing for their hesitation. “I run the lighthouse to the east, so I… I don’t often see people face to face. I come down here sometimes to relax in the hammock and smell these fragrant flowers. Would you like one?” Gain flora 1068.

e384.result: With a satisfying click, the lock pops open. Roll 6 skill dice; you may reroll each die once. If you have at least 3 of a kind, gain item 1214. Instead, if you have at least one pair, gain item 1165. Otherwise, the chest clamps onto your fingers and won’t let go (end your turn).

e385.action: WHISPER to a passing sentient, keeping your voice low out of respect in case the ruins are a sacred place
e385.result: The sentient says that these ruins were once a great hall for sentients to gather and celebrate the changing seasons. Now it’s just a place for weary adventurers to hang their hats for the night. Gain 1 boost and continue.

e386.action: ASK a sentient about the lotus
e386.result: The sentient seems surprised that you’re not familiar with the composition of the common lotus. “This innocent-looking flower giveth and taketh away. Be careful if you choose to partake in its whims.” Gain 1 boost and continue.

e387.action: HIRE a sentient to build a structure in the valley
e387.result:
The sentient offers their construction services to you for a $5 fee. Choose one:

If you pay

Gain a barn (1266), winery (1272), windmill (1273), stables (1279), hatchery (1285), hunting tower (1286), crystal mine (1287), garden (1288), or greenhouse (1291).

If you don’t pay

The sentient gives you a few tips about the construction process instead (gain 1 boost, $2, or ability 1488).

e388.action: TRADE for safe passage across the bridge
e388.result: If you pay $2, go to 780. If you don’t pay, the guards refuse to grant you entry (gain 1 boost and continue).

e389.action: SHOUT at a sentient to the east about the flowers
e389.result: The stone sentient encourages you to leave the flowers alone. Gain 1 boost and continue.

e390.action: CONSULT with the Traveler about escaping this planet
e390.result: The Traveler’s tone grows somber. “If you must leave, with enough effort you could repair your spaceship. There is wreckage to the north of here.” Gain 1 boost and destiny 1605 (place it in the center).

e391.action: BEFRIEND a fellow traveler who claims to know a secret entrance
e391.result: The sentient leads you to the south and shows you an opening concealed by bushes, but they refuse to proceed without payment. If you give them $1, go southwest to 787. If you don’t pay, gain 1 boost and continue.

e392.action: ASK a passing sentient about the berries and the wall
e392.result: An old sentient just around the bend seems happy to catch their breath before continuing up the path. They pop a berry in their mouth before explaining that they come to the capital city once every few days to visit the museum. Pulling a tattered map out of their pocket, they show you that the museum is part of the pavilion. Then, with a wave, they carry on their way. Gain 1 boost and view page 8 in the Book of Vantages.

e393.result: The elemental fills your mind with visions of grandeur and an intense compulsion to release it. Gain 1 boost and 2 help; you may continue.

e394.action: LINK to the ship’s nutritional system
e394.result: Your augsuit eagerly links to the spaceship, extracting the ample backup storage of food paste. Gain 2 health.

e395.action: ASK some passing sentients about the objects
e395.result: The objects are “repelling rods,” placed there by metal sentients, whose homeland is to the east of here. The rods annoy all other types of sentients. Gain 1 boost and either 1 help or 1 overpower; you may continue.

e396.action: PERSUADE a guard to let you look through the telescope (you may pay $X to decrease this cost by X)
e396.result: You feel a surge of homesickness as you peer into the stars. With such interest in the stars, perhaps the circuit sentients could help you escape this planet. Gain 1 morale and destiny 1606 (place it in the center).

e399.action: CONSULT with the Traveler about the sentients in this area
e399.result: The Traveler points to the red flags in the distance. “Wind sentients placed those flags, which they use to mark boundaries, monitor the wind, and plant seeds. Leave those flags in place. Beware the circuit sentients to the east—they will not hesitate to prove their superiority.” Gain 2 boost.

e400.action: HAIL a ride from the balloon
e400.result: You yell, you dance, you even yodel to the best of your ability… and when it’s almost too late, the balloon veers off course and swings by to pick you up. The driver points in a few directions to ask your destination of choice. Gain 1 morale, and you may go northwest to a lantern-lit swamp on 234, northeast to the elemental monster on 616, southeast to a metal sentient on 606, or southwest to a treasure chest on 199.

e401.result: The device isn’t compatible with your augsuit, of course, but a few adjustments allow for a smooth conversion. You’re hit with a burst of cold and an influx of data, far more than you can comprehend. You filter it by proximity and learn that there is an elemental to the east and a trial directly north of it. Gain 2 boost.

e402.action: HIRE a passing sentient to build a structure
e402.result:

The sentient gives you some loose change as an investment (gain ability 1488, $2, or 1 boost).

e403.result: You convince the guard to let you into the mainframe. Go to interior 581.

e408.result: The doorman lets you inside the safehouse, not asking questions, but also not letting you out of their sight as you eat a fresh meal (gain 2 health). If you pay 1 move, you slip away at the first opportunity (go to interior 559).

e409.action: CONSULT with the Traveler about escaping this planet

e410.action: GREET the occupants of the house when they’re available

Share a story with the sentients

Release the spirit

Absorb the spirit

e591.result: A distracted sentient rounds the corner, and they jump into the ceiling when you surprise them. When they collect their composure, they grab the sword, leap onto the flying carpet, and sail away. Gain item 990 and exit west to 787.

e592.action: ASK the sentient what they’re doing
e592.result: The startled sentient steps away from the beam of light, clutching a mace in one hand and a small vial in another. They relax upon seeing you. “Sorry, you surprised me. I’m just collecting an incoming memory—a young water sentient’s parent expressed how proud they are. I’m glad for memories that don’t need any adjustments.” They explain further by teaching you about memory magic; gain lesson 1430 and exit to 287.

e597.result:
The sentient is surprised to find you inside, but you swiftly set them at ease with some good nautical humor. Choose one:

Spend a few minutes chatting with the sentient, learning about maritime trade among the cities of the world

Gain 1 boost, then exit to 305.

Sell something to them

The sentient happily accepts your offer. Lose 1 card and gain its value plus $1, then exit to 305.

Pay $2 to buy an oil torch

Gain item 1085, then exit to 305.

Pay $7 to buy a pair of binoculars

Gain item 972, then exit to 305.

e601.result: The act of talking to a flower is strange but also meditative, and you feel better afterward. Gain 2 morale.

e602.result: With a satisfying click, the lock pops open. Roll 6 skill dice; you may reroll each die once. If you have at least 3 of a kind, gain item 1090. Instead, if you have at least one pair, gain item 1165. Otherwise, gain $4.

e603.action: COAX the animal over to you
e603.result: The skittish animal isn’t easily convinced, but it’s intrigued by the wiring of your augsuit. Gain animal 820.

e604.action: ASK the sentient if they’re okay
e604.result: The sentient pauses, their shoulders slumped, their eyes on the snow. “No,” they reply, “I’m not okay. But… I don’t want to talk about it. Not yet.” You assure them that you won’t ask again, yet you have the feeling that they could use some company. You may spend 1 morale to gain sentient 1312 and go west to 603, or you may continue.

e605.action: ENTERTAIN the sentients with a song
e605.result: The hunters are easily amused, and they’re soon singing along to music they’ve never heard before. Afterwards they invite you to join them by the fire for a meal. Regain any health lost from the cold on this location, then gain 1 morale and continue.

e606.action: PERSUADE the sentient into letting you pass (you may pay $X to decrease this cost by X)
e606.result: The sentient points you to the cave they’re guarding (go to cave 021).

e607.action: COAX a calf over to you
e607.result: Without fear, they amble toward you and smell your hand. Heat radiates from its small body. Gain 2 health and continue.

e608.result: Information pours into your implant. It seems to be a way for sentients to connect with each other, not unlike the internet. You randomly click a link. Visit orb.stonemaiergames.com and enter 244, 618, or 704.

e609.result: With a satisfying click, the lock pops open. Roll 6 skill dice; you may reroll each die once. If you have at least 3 of a kind, gain item 1215. Instead, if you have at least one pair, gain item 1163. Otherwise, gain $4.

e610.result: The creature grunts back as if to say, “We’re good.” You can either hitch a ride on it and enjoy the view as it transports you to the cold-but-clear southwest (gain 1 look and go to 604, ignoring cold damage upon arrival) or just enjoy the camaraderie (gain 1 morale and 1 health).

e611.action: CONSULT the Traveler about the obelisk
e611.result: “I can’t confirm that the legend is true—I suspect this area would be frozen with or without a magical shard. However, there is magic within the obelisk if you look hard enough.” Gain 1 boost and continue.

e612.action: HIRE a passing sentient to build a structure
e612.result:
The sentient offers their construction services to you for a $4 fee. Choose one:

If you pay

Gain a castle (1265), cabin (1283), cottage (1289), or air supply dome (1290).

If you don’t pay

The sentient gives you a few tips about the construction process instead (gain ability 1488, $2, or 1 boost).

e613.result: A beam of bright light bursts from the top of the runecaster. Nothing happens for a few minutes, but then a door opens in the nearby building. You may go to interior 580.

e614.action: ASK the sentient about the legends
e614.result: The sentient chuckles, saying that the legends are fantastic stories—though in this case they also happen to be true. To demonstrate, they extend the gift of vision to you. Gain lesson 1426.

e615.action: CONSULT with the Traveler about runecasters
e615.result: “A long time ago, the circuit, fire, and metal sentients worked together to harness the power of the runes found organically across this world. The result of their collaboration is runecasters like this one, which appears to have been in the process of charging.” Gain 2 boost.

e616.result: The elemental fills your mind with visions of grandeur and an intense compulsion to release it. Centuries ago, the sentients of this world banded together to tether this elemental—and others of its kind—preventing them from freely roaming and ravaging the planet. Gain 1 boost and 2 help; you may continue.

e617.result: Plugging your augsuit into the tall circuit board, you’re flooded with information about cities of the world. Gain item 1193.

e618.action: BOAST of your accomplishments to the masked entities
e618.result:
Choose one characteristic to boast about:

Boast of your intelligence

The masks challenge you to head northwest to the Trial of Memory. Gain 1 boost and 1 engage.

Boast of your communication skills

The masks are particularly intrigued by your ability to stay connected to your crew via wireless technology. Gain 1 morale. They offer you their assistance in departing this planet if you help them untether. If you agree, gain destiny 1606 (place it in the center). The circuit sentients direct you to the northeast, where you can find vehicles that push the limits of their technology.

Boast of your physical strength

The masks challenge you to head west to prove your strength against an infamous circuit elemental. Gain 1 health and 1 overpower.

e619.result:
The sentient has a number of questions about who you are and how you came to this planet. Choose one:

Divulge the information

The sentient pays well for the information, though you have immediate concerns of how it may be misused. Lose 1 morale and gain $8.

Don’t divulge the information

Disappointed, the sentient returns to their task. Refresh up to 1 challenge die from your grid and continue.

e620.action: GREET the sentient in a gentle tone
e620.result: After hearing only a few words in your language, the sentient is able to comprehend and respond. “Help me,” they say. “The circuit sentients have trapped me here.” Gain 1 boost and continue.

e621.action: PERSUADE the judges (you may pay $X to decrease this cost by X)
e621.result: The judges welcome you to participate in the trial. Continue with the look-MEMORIZE action.

e622.result: Maintaining eye contact, you connect one of the main cords extending from the sentient with your augsuit. Their expression changes to one of joy as they receive a wave of data about you—the connection is immediate. “Welcome, dear friend,” they say. “I hope you’ll stay for a while, perhaps in the City of Spires to the north? Or attempt the Trial of Memory to the west?” Gain 2 boost and continue.

e623.result:
Despite the Traveler’s warning, you interact with the hologram. It howls with glee. “Now you must answer my riddle! How many orange circles do you see in my ivy grove? Choose a number:

19 orange circles

The hologram bows to you respectfully; gain lesson 1421.

20 orange circles

The hologram pities you; gain 1 boost.

21 orange circles

The hologram bows to you respectfully; gain lesson 1421.

22 orange circles

The hologram pities you; gain 1 boost.

e624.result: You center yourself, becoming one with the light. It speaks to you, revealing the next step in your journey. Roll X skill dice. Gain all skills of 1 type from the results. You may continue with an action matching the result.

e625.action: SYNC to the crystal by connecting a wire to your augsuit
e625.result: You instantly have your first tangible, tactile experience with your soul, which until this point you had never really thought about. But you can feel it now just as well as you can feel your own skin. You also gain a sense that there’s an even more powerful possibility. Gain 2 morale and quest 1663 (add it horizontally to your supply). You may continue.

e626.action: TRADE information with a factory worker
e626.result: A departing sentient entertains your offer to exchange information. You answer their question about what lies beyond this planet, and they inform you that the easiest way inside is to extract a loose panel. Gain 1 boost and 1 take; you may continue.

e627.action: ASK a passerby about the city
e627.result: A sentient headed out of the City of Spires recommends the hackerspace and the memory uploader. They’re surprised that your fragile frame is able to withstand the cold temperatures here; they urge you to get out of the cold by heading north. Gain 2 boost; you may continue with the move-BALANCE action.

e628.result: A proud farmer shaves off a sample for you; gain item 1161 and continue.

e629.action: COAX the animal to lay down on the snow
e629.result: The creature has no energy to resist, and it gently unfolds on the ground before you. You pet one of its necks, and it hums with appreciation. Gain 1 morale and continue.

e630.result: Seemingly acting of its own accord, the vehicle responds to your plea and lands gently in the snow. It provides a few destination options down into the valley a few clicks to the north: Gain 1 boost and you may go northwest to an ancient bridge on 495, north to a snow-covered lotus on 496, or northeast to a warehouse on 497.

e631.result: Another player gains 1 random skill, refreshes 1 challenge die on a card in their grid, or gains 1 boost. Gain 1 morale and continue.

e632.result: You center yourself, becoming one with the weeds. It speaks to you, revealing the next step in your journey. Roll X skill dice. Gain all skills of 1 type from the results. You may continue with an action matching the result.

e633.action: COAX the animal over to you
e633.result: The fish is shy, but when you start blowing bubbles, it instantly warms to you. Gain animal 806.

e634.action: HIRE a passing sentient to build an underwater structure
e634.result:
The sentient offers their construction services to you for $6. Choose one:

If you pay

Gain a casino (1271), well (1275), theater (1276), tavern (1277), school (1280), or training grounds (1293).

If you don’t pay

The sentient gives you a few tips about the construction process instead (gain ability 1488, $2, or 1 boost).

e635.action: CONSULT with the Traveler about your mission
e635.result: “If you’re trying to escape your past, you’ll need to turn off the signal I activated in my old spaceship to the north. Or you could transmit more signals to attract aid from your fleet.” Gain 1 boost and destiny 1598 (place it in the center).

e636.action: PLEAD for aid from water sentients
e636.result: Several water sentients begrudgingly pull the sentient from the funnel, dumping them in your arms. Gain (a very thankful) sentient 1347.

e637.result: The act of talking to a flower is strange but also meditative, and you feel better afterward. Gain 2 morale.

e638.action: ASK a sentient about the lotus
e638.result: The sentient seems surprised that you’re not familiar with the composition of the common lotus. “This innocent-looking flower giveth and taketh away. Be careful if you choose to partake in its whims.” Gain 1 boost and continue.

e639.action: CONSULT with the Traveler about escaping this planet
e639.result: “If you must leave, with enough effort you could repair your spaceship. There is wreckage to the southeast of here.” Gain 1 boost and destiny 1605 (place it in the center).

e640.action: PERSUADE a guard that you should be on the list (you may pay $X to decrease this cost by X)
e640.result: The guard isn’t easily persuaded, especially with their companion nearby. Gain ability 1463 and go either north to 641 or to interior 582.

e641.action: ASK a passerby about the city
e641.result: A sentient heading out of the City of Waves recommends the armory and, after looking at you, the air supply store. Gain $1 and 2 boost.

e642.result: The creature drifts over to you and opens its mouth, which is void of water and occupied by several other sentients. Gain 1 boost, and you may hitch a ride northwest to a remote island home on 476, northeast to a hovering device on 478, southeast to an underwater arena on 647, or southwest to a deep-sea flower on 635. Upon arrival, ignore the hypoxia damage (if any).

e643.action: MIMIC the animals, letting your clothes flutter in the current
e643.result: Your imitation delights the animals, and one of them nudges you to follow them close to the waterspout. Just as you feel the funnel pulling you in, the animal offers you a handhold and tugs you to safety. Go north to 644.

e644.action: LINK to the ship’s nutritional system
e644.result: Your augsuit eagerly links to the spaceship, extracting the ample backup storage of food paste. Gain 2 health.

e645.result: The sentient demands to know what brings you to this part of the ocean. You tell the truth—you’re an explorer from a distant planet, and you crash-landed here. Thankfully, the sentient believes you, as they’ve seen some of the wreckage to the south. They offer you a trade—a piece of your tech in exchange for theirs: If you have your starting item (gained previously through your character card’s EQUIP action), you may lose it to gain item 1038. Otherwise, gain 1 boost. The sentient strongly suggests you travel any direction but north.

e646.action: TRADE for information from the creature
e646.result:
The creature is disappointed by your lack of respect, but they begrudgingly accept your offer. Choose one:

Pay $2

The sentient gives you directions to a mech suit. Gain 1 boost, 1 move, and quest 1656 (add it horizontally to your supply).

Pay 1 boost

You tell a story to the sentient about the oceans on your home planet. The sentient appreciates the information and offers you directions to a mech suit. Gain 1 move and quest 1656 (add it horizontally to your supply).

Pay nothing

The sentient curses your insolence. Gain curse 1385 and 2 boost.

e647.action: PERSUADE the judges (you may pay $X to decrease this cost by X)
e647.result: The judges welcome you to participate in the trial. Continue with the overpower-FIGHT action.

e648.action: LURE the sharks away from your desired path
e648.result: On a hunch, you cut open a nearby plant, and a blood-like substance oozes out of it into the water. You swim away as the liquid sends nearby sharks into a frenzy. Gain 1 boost; you may go to any adjacent location (north is 478).

e649.action: PICK the lock on the captain’s cabin
e649.result: With a satisfying click, the lock pops open, revealing a treasure. Roll 6 skill dice; you may reroll each die once. If you have at least 3 of a kind, gain item 979. Instead, if you have at least one pair, gain item 1153. Otherwise, gain $6.

e650.result: Your feeble attempts at underwater humor bring a smile to the sentient’s face, though they say that the real cure to their sadness is an antidote found in the possession of their leaf friend to the east. They beg you to travel into the forest and listen carefully to their friend. Gain 1 boost, 1 look, and quest 1655 (add it horizontally to your supply).

e651.action: COAX the animal with a gentle gurgle
e651.result: It takes incredible effort to pacify the animal, especially underwater and in front of its pod, but you eventually convince them you’re not a threat. Gain animal 850 and 1 morale.

e652.action: PERSUADE the guards to grant you entry (you may pay $X to decrease this cost by X)
e652.result:
You sidle over to the nearest guard and offer them some coin compensation if they convince the others to turn their backs for a few minutes.

Pay $5

The guard agrees, and inside the pit you find a sentient who is eager to escape with you (gain sentient 1356).

Pay nothing

The guard mentions that there’s a treasure chest nestled into the coral to the north. Gain 1 boost and continue.

e653.result: With a satisfying click, the lock pops open. Roll 6 skill dice; you may reroll each die once. If you have at least 3 of a kind, gain item 1161. Instead, if you have at least one pair, gain item 885. Otherwise, a trap springs out of the chest, knocking the air from your lungs (suffer 1 hypoxia damage).

e654.result: You center yourself, becoming one with the anemones. They speak to you, revealing the next step in your journey. Roll X skill dice. Gain all skills of 1 type from the results. You may continue with an action matching the result.

e655.action: HIRE a passing sentient to build an underwater dome
e655.result:
The sentient offers their construction services to you for a $5 fee. Choose one:

If you pay

Gain structure 1290.

If you don’t pay

The sentient gives you a few tips about the construction process instead (gain ability 1488, $2, or 1 boost).

e656.action: PERSUADE a local water sentient to tell you about the cave (you may pay $X to decrease this cost by X)
e656.result:
Decide whether you would like to sweeten the deal with a small payment of $1. Choose one:

If you pay

The sentient gives you a pep talk about the dangerous cave. Gain either 1 take or 1 overpower; then refresh all challenge dice from 1 row in your grid. You may continue.

If you don’t pay

The sentient wishes you luck with the nearly indestructible barrier inside the cave; gain 1 take or 1 overpower.

e657.result: The elemental fills your mind with visions of grandeur and an intense compulsion to release it. Centuries ago, the sentients of this world banded together to tether this elemental—and others of its kind— preventing them from freely roaming and ravaging the planet. Gain 1 boost and 2 help; you may continue.

e658.action: CONSULT with the Traveler about your mission
e658.result: “If you’re trying to kill an elemental, head south and resist the urge to help the monster. Or you could find a safer way to achieve legendary acclaim.” Gain 1 boost and destiny 1603 (place it in the center).

e659.action: CONSULT with the Traveler about your mission
e659.result: “Water sentients like this sentry are well known for their fighting prowess. If you seek to leverage the people of this world to gain an advantage on your home planet, water sentients could make for a powerful ally. You could try to earn their respect through an ancient dueling tradition.” Gain 1 boost and destiny 1603 (place it in the center).

e660.action: COAX the animal with a playful gesture
e660.result: The creature responds with glee, gliding over to you while blowing bubbles. Gain animal 848.

e661.action: HAIL a ride from the turtle on the other side of the waterfall
e661.result:
Choose one:

If you have flora or food

The turtle nibbles on it and gestures for you to board the vessel. Gain 1 boost, and you may hitch a ride northwest to a shoreside treasure chest on 448, northeast to a quiet ceremony on 667, southeast to a glowing device on 246, or southwest to a piece of spaceship wreckage on 509.

If you don’t have flora or food

The turtle shrugs and waits for the next passenger (gain 1 boost).

e662.action: PICK the lock on a side window
e662.result: You slip quietly into the lodge and immediately discover that the owners have decorated the interior with an unsettling number of bones. Go to interior 584.

e663.result: You center yourself, becoming one with the lorestone. It speaks to you, revealing the next step in your journey. Roll X skill dice. Gain all skills of 1 type from the results. You may continue with an action matching the result.

e664.action: GREET a sentient who emerges from the gateway
e664.result: Out of thin air, a heavily muscled sentient with a long, bony beak emerges from the gateway. They weren’t expecting anyone—they explain that they were doing their part to protect the previous portal in the network. Gain sentient 1334.

e665.action: ASK the building’s owner if any homes are available
e665.result: A stumpy sentient wearing a universal translator, the resident of the biggest cottage, replies that they have several vacancies among their luxury hillside condos. They offer you one for the discounted price of $29. If you pay, gain structure 1701. If you don’t pay, the landlord subtly suggests that they wouldn’t mind if you “took care of” the elemental to the northeast, as it’s hurting the property values (gain quest 1693; add it horizontally to your supply).

e666.result: You introduce yourself to the tree, and the tree replies in a gnarled voice that they do not yet have a name. They were in the process of being carved into a sentient when the Carver was interrupted, and they haven’t returned. The tree begs you to find the Tools of Creation to the northeast and return here. Gain 1 boost and quest 1640 (add it horizontally to your supply).

e667.action: ENTERTAIN the sentients with a celebratory, joyful song
e667.result: The sentients turn toward the source of the noise, utterly baffled by the interruption. It would appear music is not part of their tradition. Seeing your good intentions, though, they laugh and wave you over to the foot of the bridge, over which they soon cross. One of them is rather fascinated by you and offers to join you for a short stroll before the next part of the ceremony. Gain sentient 1362 with a “when placed” benefit of only 1 boost (instead of 2).

e668.action: MIMIC the animal by imitating the movement of its front claws
e668.result: The creature delights in the familiar patterns and nuzzles against your hand. Gain animal 853.

e669.action: ASK a passing sentient about the mushrooms
e669.result: A short sentient waddles over to inspect the fungi. “Yes yes, this is a tasty batch, I tell you. There’s a very good chance none of these are poisonous.” Gain either 1 take or 1 overpower; you may continue.

e670.result: You center yourself, becoming one with the rune. It speaks to you, revealing the next step in your journey. Roll X skill dice. Gain all skills of 1 type from the results. You may continue with an action matching the result.

e671.action: CONSULT with the Traveler about escaping this planet
e671.result: The Traveler’s tone grows somber. “Why not settle down in this lush forest? Haven’t you always wanted to live in a treehouse? Check out Treetrunk Village to the northeast before you make any decisions you’ll regret.” Gain 1 boost and destiny 1601 (place it in the center).

e672.result:
The sentient offers you a bevy of options. Choose one:

  • Pay $4 to gain a fishing pole (921).

  • Sell the sentient an item, animal, or flora (lose the card from your grid or reserve to gain its value).

  • Exchange information to gain the company of the sentient (pay 1, 2, or 3 skills to gain sentient 1361 with 1, 2, or 3 boost on them, respectively).

  • Gain 1 boost.

e673.action: ASK the sentient about this place
e673.result: The sentient explains that they’re standing outside the shop of a local shoemaker, who is rumored to have created a pair of flying shoes. The shoemaker isn’t in their workshop right now, but they should be back soon. Gain 1 boost; you may continue with the move-SNEAK action.

e674.result: It’s difficult to catch the animal’s attention from behind it, so you run into its path. It stops and hands you a piece of fruit. Gain item 1224.

e675.result: With a satisfying click, the lock pops open. Roll 6 skill dice; you may reroll any/all dice up to 2 times. If you have at least 3 of a kind, gain item 973. Instead, if you have at least one pair, gain 1 random card from the Skirm spoiler pack (place it in your reserve, where your entire Skirm collection counts as only 1 reserved card. You can use this type of card from your reserve during overpower-DUEL actions, which have further instructions). Otherwise, gain $4.

e676.action: ENTERTAIN the sentient with a little dance to cheer them up
e676.result: A smile briefly appears on their face before they resume crying. Through their tears, they recommend that you check out the embassy. You may either gain 1 boost and continue, or go to interior 585.

e677.action: ASK the nearby sentient about the city behind them
e677.result: The sentient waiting in front of Treetrunk Village recommends the mask shop, the shipwright, and their own tavern, of course. Gain 2 boost.

e678.action: ASK the sentient about the pleasant sensation you’re feeling in this grove
e678.result: The random question from a complete stranger puzzles the sentient, but they shake off the confusion and point to the torch grass growing nearby. They pluck a stalk that’s already fading, leaving the still-growing plants to flourish. Gain flora 1060.

e679.action: INTERACT with the orb or the animal
e679.result:
Choose one:

Interact with the orb

The outside of the orb is a message board. You may read what other travelers have posted about this area and help other wayward travelers by visiting orb.stonemaiergames.com; gain 1 boost.

Interact with the animal

You approach the animal with caution, holding out your hand for it to smell. One of its many tendrils brushes against you. The animal seems satisfied with the result, as it teeters closer to you. Gain animal 843.

e680.action: COAX the animal over to you
e680.result: The animal is timid but also eager to please. Gain animal 854.

e681.action: LURE the web’s creator by gently plucking a strand (or, if the beast is no longer a threat, choose another action)
e681.result:
You jump back as a huge spider-like beast skitters down the center tree. It hisses at you but doesn’t attack. Gain 1 boost and choose one (or continue with a move action to the east, south, or west):

move--DASH through the leftmost gap in the trees

Lured from its hunting perch, the spider isn’t in a position to grab you as you run past. Go north to 686.

overpower--ATTACK the spider

You have the upper hand, even against such a dangerous creature. Gain item 1164; you may go north to 686 or take a move action to go in a different direction.

e682.action: GREET the occupants of the house
e682.result:
The sentient at the door is joined by several others who peer out the windows. Choose one:

Share a story with the occupants

The family of sentients is eager to hear more tales of your adventure, and they invite you inside for dinner. You weave a tale that eventually puts them to sleep. Gain 1 health and go to interior 586.

Persuade the sentients to let you buy their house and its contents (pay $35; you may later repeat this action for this option only if you don’t choose it now)

Gain items 916, 995, and 997, and structure 1689; you may place each of these items in your reserve or your grid.

e683.action: GREET the sentient with a cheer
e683.result: The sentient stoically nods at you, gesturing for you to approach. Communicating through scent, they introduce themselves as a resident of this treetop village. They ask that, if you’re interested, you travel northeast and reactivate some ancient portals there. Gain quest 1657 (add it horizontally to your supply).

e684.action: CONSULT with the Traveler about escaping this planet
e684.result: Your question bewilders the Traveler. “How can you even consider leaving without your cats? I think I see them to the north of here. Then maybe you could think about building a new ship.” Gain 1 boost and destiny 1607 (place it in the center).

e685.result: The act of talking to a flower is strange but also meditative, and you feel better afterward. Gain 2 morale.

e686.action: HIRE a passing sentient to build a structure
e686.result:
The architect offers their services to you for a $4 fee. Choose one:

If you pay

Gain a casino (1271), well (1275), theater (1276), tavern (1277), school (1280), or training grounds (1293).

If you don’t pay

The sentient gives you a few tips about the construction process instead (gain ability 1488, $2, or 1 boost).

e687.result: Another player gains 1 random skill, refreshes 1 challenge die on a card in their grid, or gains 1 boost. Gain 1 morale and continue.

e688.action: TRANSMIT a signal to your homeworld
e688.result: The early days of basic training finally prove useful as you apply the fundamentals of radio signals to the tower. You tap into the tower’s system to send a quick burst that your homeworld should recognize if anyone’s listening. Your rescuers will need to triangulate the signal to find you, but this is a good start. Gain destiny 1598 if you do not already have it. Either way, add 1 signal token to that destiny.

e689.action: COAX the cats down to you
e689.result: At the sound of your voice, both cats begin purring, and the sound only grows louder as they inch their way down the branches. They’re confused and disoriented but happy to see you. Gain animal 827.

e690.result:
If you have spell 1369

The portals spring to life. Four of them show glimmers of distant locations; a small altar in front of the center portal suggests that you can choose another destination in exchange for a small sacrifice. Rotate quest 1657 and add it to your grid.

If you don’t have spell 1369

You’re able to improve the accessibility of the gateways, but to activate them, some amount of sorcery is required. Gain 1 look and quest 1657 (add it horizontally to your supply). You may continue.

e691.action: ASK a local about this place
e691.result: A local sentient replies in a hushed, reverent tone. “This is the Heart of the Forest, the home of the Lifestone. It enables the trees in this area to become people like me, if the proper tools are used.” Gain 1 boost and 1 help; you may continue.

e692.action: COAX the animal over to you
e692.result: When the animal sees your eagerness to greet them, they bound toward you and lick your cheek. You scratch behind their ears and then their belly as they roll around in the grass. Gain animal 841.

e693.action: PERSUADE the judges (you may pay $X to decrease this cost by X)
e693.result: The judges welcome you to participate in the trial. Continue with the move-SCALE action.

e694.action: WHISPER to a passing sentient, keeping your voice low out of respect in case the ruins are a sacred place
e694.result: The sentient explains that this temple was a place of peaceful meetings among sentients. As technology developed and tensions grew, such meeting places fell out of favor. These gateways are now used as a way to exit and enter the land of the wood sentients, and travelers often leave items here for others to pick up. The last time they checked, there was even a large egg inside the ruins. Gain 2 boost and continue.

e695.result: The farmer, wheezing from overexertion, explains that their entire herd broke free last night. They beg you to search the surrounding area to find them and steer them back here. Gain 1 look and quest 1702 (add it horizontally to your supply).

e696.action: ASK a sentient about the lotus
e696.result: The sentient seems surprised that you’re not familiar with the composition of the common lotus. “This innocent-looking flower giveth and taketh away. Be careful if you choose to partake in its whims.” Gain 1 boost and continue.

e697.action: LINK to the ship’s nutritional system
e697.result: Your augsuit eagerly links to the spaceship, extracting the ample backup storage of food paste. Gain 2 health.

e698.action: PERSUADE a local to tell you about the cave (you may pay $X to decrease this cost by X)
e698.result: The sentient wishes you luck with the puzzle trap barrier inside the cave. They also give you a pep talk about the take challenge you face inside. Gain 1 morale and 1 boost; you may continue.

e699.action: HIRE a passing sentient to build a structure along the path
e699.result:
The sentient offers their construction services to you for a $5 fee. Choose one:

If you pay

Gain a cartographer (1270), embassy (1274), tower (1281), or outpost (1292).

If you don’t pay

The sentient gives you a few tips about the construction process instead (gain ability 1488, $2, or 1 boost).

e700.result:
Placing your hand on the skull, you breathe with intention, eyes closed. The animal appears in your mind, staring at you with an intense calm. Choose one:

Release the spirit

With gratitude, the animal departs into the darkness. Gain 1 morale and 1 health.

Absorb the spirit

With acceptance, the animal steps forward into your mind. Gain ability 1483.

e701.action: CONSULT with the Traveler about escaping this planet
e701.result: The Traveler’s tone grows somber. “If you must leave, you could use or create a portal to teleport across the galaxy. I’m wary of this particular portal, though.” Gain 1 boost and destiny 1604 (place it in the center).

e702.action: COAX the animal from behind the lotus
e702.result:
Shy but curious, the animal skitters over to you. When it sees that you’re friendly, it nudges a round rock to your feet and steps back, poised to chase. You toss the rock down into the valley, and the animal gleefully trots after it. While it’s gone, you may pluck the lotus from the ledge. Read the following based on your choice.

You plucked the lotus

When the animal returns with the rock in its mouth and sees the lotus in your hands, it cries out in anguish. Gain flora 1159.

You didn’t pluck the lotus

When the animal returns with the rock in its mouth, it’s eager to join you. Gain animal 838.

e703.result: The goliath returns your deep bow with a slight nod of their head. “You can call me the King of Souls.” They explain that they are seeking to be the first to complete the trials of all 12 types of sentients, and they show you on a map that their next target is to the east. View page 18 of the Book of Vantages (the sentient indicates that their destination is the trial in region J), then gain 2 boost and continue.

e704.result: The outside of the orb is a message board. You may read what other travelers have posted about this area and help other wayward travelers by visiting orb.stonemaiergames.com; gain 1 boost.

e705.action: COAX the animal over to you
e705.result: It doesn’t take much urging to coax the animal over to you, as it seems eager for company. Gain animal 838.

e706.result: Unaccustomed to hearing this song from someone like you, all four flying whales drift toward you, the chase forgotten. One dips toward you, offering you a perch on its back. Gain animal 840.

e707.result: You center yourself, becoming one with the valley. It speaks to you, revealing the next step in your journey. Roll X skill dice. Gain all skills of 1 type from the results. You may continue with an action matching the result.

e708.result: The sentient collapses to their knees, sobbing. In a rough voice they explain that they were spelunking to the north, but their child got stuck. If you will help, gain 3 move and go north to 709; otherwise gain 1 boost.

e709.action: SHOUT to see if someone is at the other end of the rope
e709.result: Sure enough, you hear a relieved voice from within the crystal column. A spelunking sentient is stuck and needs help. Gain 2 help and continue.

e710.result: Another player gains 1 random skill, refreshes 1 challenge die on a card in their grid, or gains 1 boost. Gain 1 morale and continue.

e711.action: CONSULT with the Traveler about escaping this planet
e711.result: The Traveler’s tone grows somber. “Instead of deserting this place, why not make it your home? There are ample opportunities in the capital city to the far west.” Gain 1 boost and destiny 1601 (place it in the center).

e712.result: A beam of bright light bursts from the top of the runecaster. Nothing happens for a few minutes, but then a sentient emerges from the mist. Their attention is more on you than the runecaster, though before they leave, they demonstrate that you can push a button on the device. When you do, you feel invigorated. Gain 2 skills matching the rune and continue.

e713.action: LINK to the ship’s nutritional system
e713.result: Your augsuit eagerly links to the spaceship, extracting the ample backup storage of food paste. Gain 2 health.

e714.result: The sentient pauses their cloudcrafting to talk to you in a rumbling voice. “My sibling has been taken hostage by metal sentients, most likely to the north. Please help me!” Gain 1 boost, 1 help, and quest 1652 (add it horizontally to your supply).

e715.action: PERSUADE the sentient to join you for a stroll (you may pay $X to decrease this cost by X)
e715.result: The sentient is hesitant to leave their post, but they admit they haven’t taken a vacation in years. Gain sentient 1348.

e716.result: A beam of bright light bursts from the top of the runecaster. Nothing happens for a few minutes, then a sentient appears. “I saw your signal—how can I help?” they ask. Gain sentient 1328 with a “when placed” benefit of only 1 boost (instead of 2).

e717.action: ASK a passing sentient about the location
e717.result:
An old sentient pauses to dip their toes in the water. Choose one:

Ask about the hot spring

The sentient smiles as they enjoy the warmth of the water. “This was my favorite place to swim in my younger years. It never failed to cheer me up. And when I was feeling really adventurous, I’d swim down to the bottom, though it’s pretty deep.” Gain either 1 move or 1 take; you may continue.

Ask about the flora

The sentient gently runs their hand through the leaves. “This is chalcedonic myrtle, a rare flora, even in these parts. In its raw form, it’s known to cause great mirth. But if you process the petals, they become a powerful acidic paste.” Gain either 1 help or 1 overpower; you may continue.

e718.result:
The sentient speaks frantically at first, but you help them focus and relax. They explain that they are a cloudtalker—they can read and even manipulate the weather. Because of their abilities, however, they were targeted for a tragic act of theft. Choose one:

If you’re willing to help

Gain sentient 1345 and quest 1654 (add the quest horizontally to your supply).

If you have higher priorities

Gain 1 boost, 1 look, and 1 help.

e719.action: SHOUT at the hostel in case someone is still inside
e719.result: At first the only sound is that of your voice echoing throughout the mountains. Then you hear a response not from the cottage but from the south; someone yells that you’re disturbing their class and that you need to quiet down. Gain 1 boost and continue.

e720.result:
Placing your hand on the skull, you breathe with intention, eyes closed. The animal appears in your mind, staring at you with an intense calm. Choose one:

Release the spirit

With gratitude, the animal departs into the darkness. Gain 1 morale and 1 health.

Absorb the spirit

With acceptance, the animal steps forward into your mind. Gain ability 1474.

e721.action: PERSUADE the judges (you may pay $X to decrease this cost by X)
e721.result: The judges welcome you to participate in the trial. Continue with the look-CALCULATE action.

e722.action: ASK a local sentient if this is a safe crossing
e722.result: The gray-skinned sentient not only confirms that the crossing is safe, but also explains that it is a special place to honor someone you cherish by taking a “leap of faith.” Gain 1 help and continue.

e723.result: You center yourself, becoming one with the lorestone. It speaks to you, revealing the next step in your journey. Roll X skill dice. Gain all skills of 1 type from the results. You may continue with an action matching the result.

e724.result: With a satisfying click, the lock pops open. Roll 6 skill dice; you may reroll each die once. If you have at least 3 of a kind, gain item 936. Instead, if you have at least one pair, gain item 1165. Otherwise, gain $4.

e725.action: ASK a passing sentient about the sign
e725.result: A stone sentient explains that this sign marks the beginning of the Path, a pilgrimage for sentients traveling in this area. Gain 1 boost, 1 move, and quest 1673 (add it horizontally to your supply).

e726.action: PERSUADE the creature to let the sentients pass unharmed (you may pay $X to decrease this cost by X)
e726.result: The small sentients are grateful for your generosity, and they ask you to join them on the final stage of their pilgrimage. If you agree, gain 1 move and go northeast to 411. Otherwise, gain 1 morale.

e727.action: ASK a passerby about the city
e727.result: A sentient heading out of the City of Stone recommends a visit to the adventure academy followed by the spa. Gain $1, 2 boost, and 1 move.

e728.action: ASK the sentient not to jump
e728.result: The sentient waves off your concern, explaining that they’re practicing for a much more dangerous leap to the west. You’re welcome to join them if you’d like, though. If you agree, gain sentient 1347 and go west to 722. If not, they request that you look for their lost pet, a hovertail that recently flew off to the east (gain quest 1650; add it horizontally to your supply).

e729.result: The elemental fills your mind with visions of grandeur and an intense compulsion to release it. Centuries ago, the sentients of this world banded together to tether this elemental—and others of its kind— preventing them from freely roaming and ravaging the planet. Gain 1 boost and 2 help; you may continue.

e730.action: PERSUADE a guard to tell you about the cave (you may pay $X to decrease this cost by X)
e730.result: The guard lowers their voice and shares a tip about the weighted puzzle trap in the cave tunnel barrier. Gain 1 boost and 1 help; go to cave 020.

e731.action: LINK to the ship’s nutritional system
e731.result: Your augsuit eagerly links to the spaceship, extracting the ample backup storage of food paste. Gain 2 health.

e732.action: ASK the Traveler about the origins of this ship
e732.result: The Traveler gathers their thoughts. “We were a small crew on a terraforming vessel, leading the way for a colony ship. The chrono technology was still in the experimental stage—you will discover it in another 100 years or so. It mostly worked as intended: We arrived at a barren planet, jumped back in time a few hundred million years, seeded the planet with the origins of life, then jumped forward to see the results. Sometime during that final jump the chrono tech failed, and most of the crew died in the crash. I was the lone survivor, though only thanks to the ship’s life support system. My brain and body remain inside the ship, with this hologram free to roam the world.” Gain 3 boost and destiny 1608 (place it in the center).

e733.action: ASK a sentient about this area
e733.result: A leaf sentient whispers that this is the Pearl. It appeared at the same time as the person you know as the Traveler, the origin of life on this planet. Touching it will ignite the magic inside of you. Gain 1 boost and either 1 move or 1 look; you may continue.

e734.result:
To your surprise, someone yells back. “What’s the future like?” they ask. You describe your surroundings, and after a few seconds, they make an offer. If you toss some coins through the rift, they will invest the money in real estate that should gain great dividends in the future, which they will stash under the bridge. Do you accept?

yes (pay between $1 and $10)

roll a skill die. If it’s engage, triple your investment. If it’s take, lose your investment. For any other roll, double your investment.

no

Gain 1 morale.

e735.result: You tap on the glass, and the sentient lowers their hands. They then step through the glass without impediment. You convince them to join you for a journey, and they suggest heading anywhere but the scalding deserts to the north. Gain sentient 1341.

e736.action: ASK a passing sentient about this field of glass
e736.result: The sentient—a large blob of sand with a slow cadence—explains that this is a graveyard. Most sand sentients can live for hundreds of years, their granules split across multiple hosts. But when they break the law—past, present, or future—they are punished in a ceremony that instantly turns them to glass, which is shattered and scattered here. The sentient shudders and departs. Gain 2 boost, or pay 1 boost to continue.

e737.action: GREET the occupant of the island when they’re available
e737.result:
When you’re within earshot, choose one:

Share a story with the occupant

They’re eager to hear more tales of your adventure, but there’s something weighing on them. They reveal that their partner was recently murdered inside the home, and they cannot rest until the mystery is solved. If you can find the culprit, it will give them closure. Gain 1 look and quest 1645 (add it horizontally to your supply).

Negotiate with the resident to buy their house and its contents (pay a discounted price of $25 due to the murder recently committed inside the house; you may later repeat this action for this option only if you don’t choose it now)

Gain items 880, 888, and 898, and structure 1692; you may place each of these items in your reserve or your grid.

e738.action: INTERACT with the orb or a passing sentient
e738.result:
Choose one:

Interact with the orb

The outside of the orb is a message board. Read what other travelers have posted about this area by visiting orb.stonemaiergames.com; gain 1 boost.

Interact with a sentient

A sentient heading out of Galleon Village recommends the tour guide and the healer. Gain 2 boost.

e739.action: BOAST of your feats in case anyone is listening
e739.result: Sure enough, three pirates emerge from the jungle and share their own daring stories and close calls. One declares that they had their wish granted by a magical well to the west; another says they tamed a serpent in a cave to the southeast. The last pirate says they stole the mech suit found on the island to their back, but they’ve never gotten it to work. You may either pay 2 boost to gain vehicle 984, or gain 2 boost.

e740.result:
You stride into the clearing, intentionally tripping over a small stick and comically falling toward the group. The sentient stops shouting and rushes over to help you to your feet. Choose one:

If you have item 1020

The sentient notices the seeds spilling from your pocket. They are very excited by this, and they beg you to plant the seeds here, walk through the time portal to the north, and find the future version of this location. If you accept, lose item 1020 to gain sentient 1364 and quest 1699 (add the quest horizontally to your supply). Otherwise, gain 3 boost.

If you don’t have item 1020

The sentient is shouting about an important tree that was growing here—it seems to have disappeared overnight, and it will take 100 years to grow another. They speak of the rarity of the tree’s seeds and mention that they are found in a cave to the southeast. Gain 2 boost and 1 move.

e741.action: ASK a local about the gateway
e741.result: The sentient explains that this is a time anomaly that allows you to travel 100 years into the future. Those who enter the gateway will have a limited range due to the immutable laws of chrono-science, but it’s still worth a quick trip. They recommend that you hide something nearby before entering, then dig it back up in the future. Gain 2 boost; you may choose an item to hide nearby (select an item in your reserve or transfer an item card from your grid to your reserve). You may continue.

e742.action: ASK how the sentient survives and thrives in the desert
e742.result: The sentient reveals that the shell-like structure nearby is actually a flowering plant called the desert maw that contains refreshing nutrients. Gain flora 1057.

e743.result: The sentient halts their approach and then doubles over laughing. “Oh, that’s good, very good. You would make an excellent soldier.” They give you directions to the City of Waves to the southwest. Gain item 1251 and 1 boost; the sentient highlights your current location (view page 9 in the Book of Vantages; you are in region L, and the City of Waves is the city in region P).

e744.action: ASK the sentients about island life
e744.result: Both sentients quickly begin boasting about their biggest catch, and they challenge you to catch an even bigger fish in the ocean. They give you an oxygen mask to aid this endeavor. Gain item 964 and quest 1660 (add the quest horizontally to your supply).

e745.action: HAIL a ride from the boat’s captain
e745.result:
The captain offers you a ride. Choose one:

If you pay $1

Gain 1 boost, and you may hitch a ride northwest to a jungle grove on 740, northeast to an elemental monster on 752, southeast to a destructive kraken on 750, or southwest to a seaside city on 738.

If you don’t pay

The captain gives you a fresh fish and bids you farewell (gain 1 health).

e746.action: HIRE a sentient to build a structure
e746.result:
The sentient offers their construction services to you for a $7 fee.

If you pay

Gain an armory (1267), apothecary (1268), blacksmith (1269), tailor (1278), shipyard (1282), or market (1284).

If you don’t pay

The sentient gives you a few tips about the construction process instead (gain ability 1488, $2, or 1 boost).

e747.action: COAX the animal over to you
e747.result: You slowly scratch behind its ears, feeling it purr as it leans against you. Gain animal 834.

e748.action: ASK a passerby about the city
e748.result: A sentient heading out of Sandstone Village recommends the glassblower and the sand centipede bait supply depot. Gain 2 boost.

e749.action: ASK a sentient about the lotus
e749.result: The sentient seems surprised that you’re not familiar with the composition of the common lotus. “This innocent-looking flower giveth and taketh away. Be careful if you choose to partake in its whims.” Gain 1 boost and continue.

e750.action: INTIMIDATE the kraken to return to the depths
e750.result: It takes great courage to face down a beast like this octopod, and when you do, the locals express their gratitude with a generous gift. Gain item 899, 1 morale, and 1 engage.

e751.action: HIRE the sentient as a guide for a grand adventure
e751.result: If you pay $1, the child carefully inspects the coin before accepting this important job, with the condition that their loyal dust mouse can accompany you (gain animal 835 and quest 1643; add the quest horizontally to your supply). If you don’t pay, the child shrugs and says they’ll hire you instead (gain $1 and quest 1643; add it horizontally to your supply).

e752.result: The elemental fills your mind with visions of grandeur and an intense compulsion to release it. Centuries ago, the sentients of this world banded together to tether this elemental—and others of its kind— preventing them from freely roaming and ravaging the planet. Gain 1 boost and 2 help; you may continue.

e753.result: A rider tells you to hop on, and you grip onto their warm, metallic waist as they ride north. Go to 754.

e754.action: PERSUADE the judges (you may pay $X to decrease this cost by X)
e754.result: The judges welcome you to participate in the trial. Continue with the move-SPEED action.

e755.action: ASK the sentient about the ship that crashed here
e755.result: Through the sentient’s sobs you manage to learn more details than you ever want to know about crafting a ship from ancestral trees. Just when you think they have nothing more to say, they launch into an in-depth explanation of nautical terms, followed by an account of the ship’s maiden—and final—voyage that ended with an unfortunate encounter with a kraken. Gain 1 boost, 1 move, and 1 help.

e756.action: PICK the lock on the treasure chest
e756.result: With a satisfying click, the lock pops open. Roll 6 skill dice; you may reroll each die once. If you have at least 3 of a kind, gain item 1189. Instead, if you have at least one pair, gain item 1162. Otherwise, gain $4.

e757.action: SHOUT for assistance along the shore
e757.result: A sentient emerges from behind a waterfall and mentions the solid metal barrier inside the cave. Gain 1 boost and 1 take; you may continue.

e758.action: COAX the animal with outstretched arms
e758.result: The creature responds by swallowing you whole. All goes dark until it spits you out. Lose 1 health and go to cave 048.

e759.result: Mildly annoyed by the interruption but even more annoyed by their current student, the teacher accepts your offer. If you pay $2, gain sentient 1343. If not, the sentient waves their hand to heal you and sends you on your way; gain 1 health.

e760.action: PERSUADE a guard to hire you to protect the castle (you may pay $X to decrease this cost by X)
e760.result: The guard mutters something about mercenary inflation but can’t afford to refuse your offer. Gain $5 and quest 1659 (add it horizontally to your supply).

e761.action: PERSUADE a guard to let you enter (you may pay $X to decrease this cost by X)
e761.result: You eventually convince the guard that you aren’t a bandit. Gain ability 1463 and go north to 762.

e762.result: The sentient is incredibly excited to converse with an alien, and you soon learn that the Founder’s Temple to the north contains a new egg that will take 100 years to hatch. Gain 1 boost and quest 1637 (add it horizontally to your supply).

e763.action: PERSUADE the guards to allow you inside (you may pay $X to decrease this cost by X)
e763.result: You smooth-talk the guards into believing that you have an amazing—but top secret—offering for someone they keep calling the “Founder.” Gain ability 1463 and go to interior 589.

e764.result: You don’t understand what you’re saying, but the camaraderie feels good after being alone on this planet. Gain 1 morale and 1 boost.

e765.action: BEFRIEND an attendant so you can take something from the lost-and-found pile
e765.result: Roll 3 skill dice. If you have at least a pair, gain item 1042. Otherwise, gain 1 random card from the Skirm spoiler pack (place it in your reserve, where your entire Skirm collection counts as only 1 reserved card. You can use this type of card from your reserve during overpower-DUEL actions, which have further instructions).

e766.action: HAIL a ride from the voyagers
e766.result: The Traveler advocates for you, and soon the balloon makes an abrupt turn in midair as if the sentient at its helm could control the wind itself. This sorcery turns out to be real, and the sentient teaches you the basics of wind magic. Gain spell 1379 and go either northwest to a fluttering animal on 461 or northeast to a windswept tower on 346.

e767.action: ASK a passerby about the city
e767.result: A sentient headed toward the capital city recommends the forge district just northeast of the entrance and the Founder’s Temple to the northwest. Gain 2 boost.

e768.result:
The sentient cheerfully greets you and offers you a sample of some freshly fried street food. Choose one:

Spend at least $1

You can buy a full dish for $1 (gain 2 morale) and/or buy a map of the city for $3 (gain item 1154).

Don’t spend anything

The sentient takes pity on you and gives you $1.

e769.action: HIRE the sentient to be your bouncer
e769.result:
The sentient considers your offer and finally settles on the fee of $3. Choose one:

Pay $3

Gain sentient 1330.

If you don’t pay

The sentient strolls through the tavern with you, during which you hear locals talking about rock climbing and pets. The bouncer can’t stop talking about some wind sentients who didn’t pay for their birthday party and they jetted north. If you can find them, you can keep the fee they should have paid. Gain quest 1653 (add it horizontally to your supply).

e770.result:
The vessel’s owner is hesitant to part with their prized possession, but they agree to sell it to you for $10. Choose one:

Pay $10 to the owner

Gain vehicle 1156.

If you don’t pay

They seem relieved—they love this boat. Instead, they offer to accompany you. Gain sentient 1341.

e771.action: TRADE with the captain for ownership of the galleon
e771.result: The captain offers to sell you the ship for $30. If you pay, gain vehicle 1016. If not, the captain offers you a swig of ale and a hearty slap on the back (gain 1 morale and continue).

e772.result: Standing on the shore to the left of the ship, you talk to the sentient about why they’re preventing the ship from passing. They explain that the contraband Spor has been entering the city at escalating rates, and they’re suspicious of landwalker ships like this one. With the ship’s captain assuring you that they’re not involved, you promise the sentient that you’ll hunt down the source. They give you some food for your journey. Gain 1 health and quest 1666 (add it horizontally to your supply).

e773.action: PLEAD for sentients on the parapet to help you up the wall
e773.result:
A few sentients chuckle at you and continue their stroll along the wall, but one takes pity on you and lowers a rope when no one is looking. They pull you up and welcome you to the capital city. Go north to 774; you may tip the sentient $2 for their assistance:

If you pay $2

The sentient nods knowingly. “I knew you’d reward my act of kindness. Thank you!” Gain sentient 1342.

If you don’t pay $2

The sentient smiles to themselves. “No worries—I knew there was no reward at the end of the rope.”

e774.action: PERSUADE the sentient to travel with you (you may pay $X to decrease this cost by X)
e774.result: The sentient asks for your assurance that you won’t travel to cold lands east of the city, and when you confirm, they agree to join you. Gain sentient 1315.

e775.action: HIRE the bulky sentient as your bodyguard
e775.result:
The sentient is open to the opportunity, but they don’t work for free. Choose one:

If you pay $2

Gain sentient 1334.

If you don’t pay

The sentient offers to join you after you complete a quest for them (gain quest 1635; add it horizontally to your supply).

e776.result:
The vendor presents a few options. Choose one:

If you pay $5

Buy your choice of a robe to keep you cool (966) or a coat to keep you warm (922).

If you don’t pay

The vendor says that they’ll fill your purse if you deliver a package to the northwest; you may either gain item 1034 and quest 1638 (add it horizontally to your supply) or gain 1 boost and continue.

e777.action: ASK the sentry about the building
e777.result: In a monotone metallic voice, they explain that this is the Council of Elders, and that you’re welcome to join the session if you’re unarmed. Set any weapons aside temporarily and go to interior 583 (reclaim any weapons when you exit).

e778.action: ENTERTAIN nearby sentients with a juggling act
e778.result: You grab a few pieces of fruit and soon have the crowd clapping along. They toss you a few coins before dispersing. Gain $5.

e779.action: CONSULT with the Traveler about escaping this planet
e779.result: The Traveler’s tone grows somber. “Instead of leaving, why not make a home for yourself in a city like this?” Gain 1 boost and destiny 1600 (place it in the center).

e780.action: GREET the occupants of one of the apartments surrounding the garden
e780.result: The sentient who answers the door is richly dressed—this is expensive property. They complain that the vagrants who bathe in the nearby waterfall are at fault for attracting vermin to the garden. They shoo you away; you can hear the lock click behind you when they close the door. Gain 2 boost.

e781.result:
You emerge from the bushes, placating both sentients and mediating a healthy discussion about a stolen object. Choose one:

Side with the thief (on the right)

They thank you for supporting their culture. Gain $2 and 1 morale.

Side with the owner (on the left)

They thank you and offer their services as a guide. The thief bumps against you as they leave, and your purse feels a little lighter afterward. Lose $2 and gain sentient 1344.

e782.result: The sentient shushes you and ducks behind a log, pulling you down with them. Despite their fear, they convey a desire to give you some money. If you accept, gain $5. If not, gain 1 boost and continue.

e783.action: PERSUADE the sentient to join you for a stroll (you may pay $X to decrease this cost by X)
e783.result: The sentient intended to only take a short break from work, but sensing the opportunity to chat about one of their favorite topics— money—they take you up on the offer. Gain sentient 1322 and 1 boost on your character.

e784.action: WHISPER to a passing sentient, keeping your voice low out of respect in case the ruins are a sacred place
e784.result: The sentient appreciates the honorific tone, but they say that this was simply a commercial area a long time ago. They mention the numerous glass vials at the closest entrance; that portion of the ruins was probably an apothecary. Gain 2 boost and continue.

e785.action: SHOUT up to those on the bridge

e1645.result:
Each suspect knew the victim and was seen in the area around the time the crime was committed. You ask why they were here and receive the following answers:

  • Shipwright: “I swear it wasn’t me. Why would I kill the best mechanic in the area? I drifted by here this morning so Timber could take a look at the motor I’m fiddling with. Damned thing is so loud, and even Timber couldn’t get it to quiet down!”

  • Fisherman: “I can’t believe they’re gone. Just yesterday we went fishing together in the bay, and Timber caught a big ‘ole pike. Hey, a pike—ironic how that was also the murder weapon! They couldn’t stand the sight of blood, so I cleaned the fish and dropped it off this morning.”

  • Recruiter: “I’m offended that my integrity is being called into question—I’m here to solve the murder, too! Timber was one of my top recruits. We had a friendly sparring session the last time I was here, but it was all in good fun. In fact, I left my bone sword here. You can see there isn’t a speck of blood on it.”

h40.action: SHARE the artifact with the world
h40.result: Something this beautiful needs to be shared with others, not hidden in the depths of the world. You blink, and when your eyes open, you’re back on the surface with the crystal in your hands. Gain item 1000 and go to 157; if you have a previous location card for reference, return it to the box.

h41.action: OFFER to help at the assassin’s guild
h41.result:
A dagger whizzes past your head as you walk into the assassin’s guild. A small but deadly sentient giggles and invites you to join them for a drink. Choose one:

Praise the sentient for their ability to control metal with such accuracy

Gain spell 1375.

Offer to handle a contract job

Gain quest 1635 (add it horizontally to your supply).

Sharpen the dagger

Gain item 1231.

Build a new life for yourself in the city

Seeking a job, you ask the sentient whether they know of any opportunities for employment here. The market is hiring; gain structure 1284.

h42.result: The issue seems to be more about the remote camera than the monitor or the local mainframe. You rewind the footage until it reveals an image of a sandstone room filled with precious objects, one of them an ornate blue ring. Suddenly the entire back wall of the room is reduced to rubble by a massive animal, a centipede with teeth the size of your forearm. The last thing you see before the footage ends is the beast swallowing the contents of the room. You hear a gasp behind you—the watchman has returned, and they are deeply embarrassed by the secret you’ve discovered. They plead for your help in recovering the ring. Gain sentient 1323 and quest 1704 (add the quest horizontally to your supply). Then exit to city 041.

h43.action: FEED treats to one of the worms
h43.result: If you have flora or food, let the animal nibble on part of it, then gain animal 832. If not, the animal nuzzles against you (gain 1 morale).

h44.result: As the hulking creature roars, you realize that it’s a roar of pain and anguish, not hunger. A pikestaff is wedged deep between its scales. You remove it, and the sand centipede gives you a terrifying kiss before retreating down the dark tunnel. Gain item 1210 and 1 morale.

h45.action: RESCUE the sentient from their plight
h45.result: With all your strength, you pull the sentient from the beast and wait for their eternal gratitude. Instead, they shout at you for separating them from their steed. You don’t understand the entire tirade, but you catch something about the taxi service they provide. You offer to help them find another sand centipede, and they begrudgingly agree. Gain sentient 1340.

h46.action: RELAX within this cocoon of earth
h46.result: Refresh X challenge dice in your grid (you may not refresh dice placed during this action). Then, if there are no challenge dice in your grid, gain 1 health, and you may continue.

h47.result: When the sand centipede finally loses the struggle, the hunters clasp you on the shoulder in appreciation. Gain $3. They invite you to attempt the Trial of the Hunt, and they offer to take you there now. If you accept, go to 261 (you may perform the overpower-HUNT action there on a future turn); otherwise, stay here and gain 1 boost.

h48.action: ASSEMBLE a staircase leading to the ceiling of the cavern, far above the animal in case it returns
h48.result: As you admire the view from your newly created perch, you notice a bright light beaming through the sediment. You peer inside to see a stunning crystal. Gain ability 1506 and go deeper into the planet to cave 040.

If either result is engage or overpower, you manage to secure the sentient (gain sentient 1324). Otherwise, gain 1 of the skill results. Either way, then roll a skill die and go to where the tides take you: move (054); look (051); engage (479); help (450); take (365); overpower (427).
