h77.action: PRAISE the sentient on the left
h77.result: The sentient is surprised by your presence, but their fluttering wings betray their pleasure at your compliment. When they finish the game, they offer to take you on a tour of the top level. Gain sentient 1309 and go to interior 078.

h78.result: The tired sentient welcomes your aid. They explain that they are kept here against their will by the Spormonger. If you have the Spormonger (sentient 1309), you may lose them to gain sentient 1319. If not, you may simply gain sentient 1319. Either way, exit to 346.

h79.action: ASSEMBLE a connected line of boulders
h79.result: You nudge rotating boulders at just the right angles so they wedge into each other, forming a natural bridge down to the central pillar. Gain ability 1506 and go deeper into the planet to cave 046.

h80.action: ASSIST the sentient with their task
h80.result: The sweltering sentient welcomes your assistance, and you make small talk about safecracking while you melt the gold. Gain sentient 1339 and $1; you may continue.

h81.action: CRAFT a bauble from some loose wires
h81.result: Weaving together the pliable strands is a mindless but oddly satisfying task. Gain item 1098 and 1 morale.

h82.action: CRAFT an item from the ice
h82.result: At best, you’re a novice ice sculptor, but you manage to create something mildly pleasant. Gain item 1100.

h83.action: CRAFT a trinket from the gateway
h83.result: Out of curiosity, you break off a loose piece of the gateway and mold it into a trinket. Gain item 1097 and continue.

h84.action: ASSEMBLE a proper guardrail and bridge on the precipitous ledge
h84.result: Just as you finish the assembly process, you turn to see a sentient lurch out onto the rock. They would have tumbled off the edge were it not for the newly constructed railing. Recognizing your workmanship, they pledge their loyalty to you. Gain sentient 1311 and go deeper into the planet to cave 048.

h85.result: If you don’t pay, the sentient remains a spectator, confiding in you that it’s for the best (gain 1 morale). If you pay $3 to the fight club on behalf of the sentient, they embrace you in a sweaty hug and promise to bring back the grand prize; seconds later they’re carted out of the arena, leaving their sword in your hands. Gain item 887 and continue.

h86.action: CRAFT an item using the pliable magma
h86.result: All you can create is a fairly useless doodad, but it has potential to be much more. Gain item 1101.

h87.result: While some of the miners are here of their own will and accord, others are not. You quietly unchain one sentient at a time, gesturing toward the exit. One wood sentient refuses to leave your side. Gain sentient 1362 and either go toward the surface to cave 027 or go deeper into the planet to cave 049.

h88.result: You curl up in the bedroll within the nook. Refresh X challenge dice in your grid (you may not refresh dice placed during this action). Then, if there are no challenge dice in your grid, gain 1 health, and you may continue. Also gain the bedroll (1040).

h89.result: As you describe your vantage, the group feels a sense of camaraderie. Each player may gain 1 random skill. If the random skill you gain matches that of any other player, you gain 1 morale. If not, gain destiny 1599 (place it in the center).

h90.action: CRAFT a zamazingo from a lump of gold
h90.result: Your mind wanders as you craft, and you’re surprised to see what your subconscious creates. Gain item 1099.

h91.action: CRAFT a simple gold item from a loose intaglio on the chest
h91.result: As you remove the golden decoration from the treasure chest, you realize that what’s inside the chest could be far more valuable than the simple trinket you intended to craft. You may either continue with the take-DISMANTLE action with a cost reduced by 3 or use the gold to craft a simple zamazingo (gain item 1099).

h92.action: RELAX in the serenity of the underwater cave
h92.result: Refresh X challenge dice in your grid (you may not refresh dice placed during this action). Then, if there are no challenge dice in your grid, gain 1 health, and you may continue.

h93.action: CRAFT a glider to fly over the maze
h93.result: Using spare parts, you patch together a glider. Gain vehicle 957; you may go deeper into the planet to cave 043.

h94.action: ASSIST a sentient heading toward the city
h94.result: They have a magical blue haze around their head, and you help to steer them into the city, where they march into the first door on your left. Gain 1 morale and go to city 041.

h95.action: HONOR the nest by steering clear of the eggs
h95.result: Recognizing your deliberate effort, the mother of the eggs emerges from the shadows and guides you to a passage in the rear of the cavern. Proceed deeper into the planet to dungeon 596; keep this location for reference.

h96.result:
Choose one:

If you have an animal, feed it to the dragon

The dragon eats the sacrificial offering with a single chomp and greedily begs for more. Lose the animal, then gain animal 807.

If you don’t have an animal or have one but don’t want to feed it to the dragon

The dragon strikes at you again. Roll 4 skill dice and gain all move results. Lose 1 health unless you pay 1 move.

h97.result: You touch one of the runecasters (there is one for each skill), and a pulse of light ripples outwards from its center seam. Each player gains 1 skill matching the rune you chose. You also gain 1 morale.

h98.action: CRAFT a curio from the easily pliable roots
h98.result: Your mind wanders as you carve, and you’re surprised to see what your subconscious created. Gain item 1094.

h99.action: PRAISE the tour guide for their knowledge of ancient glyphs
h99.result: The pink sentient seems to glow a little brighter at the compliment. They confide in you that they have a theory about the Great Collision that resulted in the origins of life on this world—they think it was aliens from outer space who crash-landed in the archipelago to the southeast of here. Gain ability 1480, 1 morale, and 1 boost.

h100.action: PRAISE the sentient for their clothing
h100.result: After an uncomfortable silence, the sentient compliments your clothing with even more effusive praise. They offer you some pointers on how to give better compliments. Gain ability 1480, 1 boost, and 1 random skill.

h101.result: If you have flora or food, let the animal nibble on part of it, then gain animal 853. If not, you smile as the animal nuzzles against your hand (gain 1 morale).

h102.action: CRAFT a simple gold item from a loose intaglio on the chest
h102.result: As you remove the golden decoration from the treasure chest, you realize that what’s inside the chest could be far more valuable than the simple trinket you intended to craft. You may either continue with the take-DISMANTLE action with a cost reduced by 3 or use the gold to craft a simple zamazingo (gain item 1099).

h103.result: You’re impressed that such diminutive creatures were able to construct such a home, but it could still use a makeover. After making some structural improvements, you hear the animals chirp appreciatively. Gain animal 845.

h104.action: CRAFT an item from the small tree
h104.result: As you reach for a branch, the animal vanishes into thin air. You have a few seconds to study the details of your current location before there’s a flurry of movement in the grove, then the trap door slams shut. Go to 511 and continue.

h105.result: If you have flora or food, let the animal nibble on part of it, then gain animal 803. If not, the animal presents you with a warm, squirming grub from the roots (gain 1 health).

h106.action: BUILD an agricultural establishment in the grove
h106.result: You sketch out a few ideas of what you might make. Gain blueprint 1296.

h107.result: A pulse of light ripples outwards from the center seam of the runecaster. Each player gains 1 skill matching the rune. You also gain 1 morale.

h108.action: HONOR the sanctity of the shield
h108.result: It’s clear to you that this is a sacred place—not to mention one that is probably well-guarded. You bow deeply toward the shield and step away. As you do, a mushroom rolls toward your feet as if of its own accord. Gain flora 1082 and 1 morale.

h109.action: OFFER your support to the sentient
h109.result: The sentient seems incredibly uncomfortable that you would offer them your support, but they eventually consent to you accompanying them on their journey south. They insist upon paying you. Gain $3, then you may gain sentient 1350; if you do, go south to 104.

h110.action: CREATE a truly exceptional flower arrangement for the judges that delights from every angle (only if you have been welcomed as a participant in this trial; otherwise choose another action)
h110.result: Find card 1135, place it on the table, and begin. You must arrange 4 different types of flowers (four stalks of each type) into a grid. All stalks of each type of flower are the same height (1–4). Proceed to fill the grid with up to four stacked tokens per square so that (a) there is only one of each stack height (1–4) in every row and column and (b) specific rows and columns have an exact number of visible flowers when viewed from straight-on angles as indicated by the numbers adjacent to them around the edges (e.g., when looking at the bottom row from the 2 position, only 2 flowers may be visible). Keep in mind taller flowers completely block any shorter flowers behind them. When you are ready to present your flower arrangement, declare the heights of the green squares from left to right. See entry 110 in the Book of Secrets for the solution.

h111.action: CRAFT a simple glass item from the broken orb
h111.result: You craft a simple but charming glass trinket. Gain item 1091.

h112.result: If you have flora or food, let the animal nibble on part of it, then gain animal 851. If not, you gain some emotional support as the animal begs for attention by rolling around in the stream (gain 1 morale).

h113.action: BREW a mild tincture from the lotus roots
h113.result: You grind the roots into a pulp with makeshift equivalents of a mortar and pestle—plus a hearty wad of saliva—resulting in a sparkling substance. Gain item 867.

h114.result: Gain animal 1119, 2 morale, and 1 help.

h115.result: The cartographers inside the keep are fascinated that you come from the stars, and they have dozens of questions about their star charts. In exchange for your help, they give you an elixir. Gain item 864.

h116.result: The ancient bridge is falling apart—it’s a hazard for any visitor. Using local wood and stone, you patch it up to the best of your ability, much to the gratitude of local leaf sentients. They give you a book in appreciation. Gain item 1192 and either go west to 115 or continue.

h117.result: As you describe your vantage, the group feels a sense of camaraderie. Each player may gain 1 random skill. If the random skill you gain matches that of any other player, you gain 1 morale. If not, gain destiny 1599 (place it in the center). You may continue with the take-EXTRACT action.

h118.result: If you have flora or food, let the animal nibble on part of it, then gain animal 804. If not, the animal signals to you that there is darkness to the west and beauty to the north (gain 2 boost).

h119.result: It only takes a few petals for you to create a pleasant novelty. Gain item 1096.

h120.action: CRAFT a simple item from the salt-soaked wood on the dock
h120.result: You contemplatively whittle away. Gain item 1094.

h121.result: In appreciation of your unsolicited effort, the owner gives you a big hug and a few coins. Gain $2 and 1 morale.

h122.result: You clean out the device and get it working again. You send a quick signal burst that your homeworld should recognize if anyone’s listening. Your rescuers will need to triangulate the signal to find you, but this is a good start. Gain destiny 1598 if you do not already have it. Either way, add 1 signal token to that destiny.

h123.result: As advanced as the technology is, you identify a few key areas of the interstellar communication device that could be improved. As you tinker, some curious engineers observe and take notes. They express their appreciation by presenting you with a beautiful bouquet of flowers. Gain flora 1074.

h124.action: PRAISE the guard for the impressive security system
h124.result: The guard puffs out their chest and launches into a detailed explanation that you could now exploit, if you were inclined to hack your way into the building. Gain 1 boost and 3 take; you may continue.

h125.action: HONOR the entrance by offering a cultural exchange
h125.result: The sentients are amazed to see an alien like you in their midst. They admire your augsuit and present you with a precious artifact. As you try to use it, though, it doesn’t work. If you pay 3 boost, you activate the scepter (gain item 998 and perform no other location actions here). If not, the mystery of the artifact remains unsolved, and it vanishes from your grasp; gain 1 boost.

h126.action: CRAFT a simple gold item from a loose intaglio on the chest
h126.result: As you remove the golden decoration from the treasure chest, you realize that what’s inside the chest could be far more valuable than the simple trinket you intended to craft. You may either continue with the take-DISMANTLE action with a cost reduced by 3 or use the gold to craft a simple zamazingo (gain item 1099).

h127.result: Following the Traveler’s lead, you center yourself among the lorestones and bend the knee. Even without runes, their power runs into you. Gain all 6 skills (1 of each).

h128.action: HONOR the sentient by offering a cultural exchange
h128.result: The sentient doesn’t seem all that impressed by you, but they give you an opportunity to earn their respect — and perhaps the blade they wield — by solving the mystery of the artifact. Gain 1 boost and continue with the look-SOLVE action.

h129.action: HONOR the ancient script on the spire
h129.result: As if the runes recognize your restraint and respect, you feel a purifying wave wash over you. Lose 1 curse and gain 1 morale.

h130.action: EXPOSE one of the sentients for cheating
h130.result:
Choose the cheater:

Left sentient

The bigger sentient checks the dice, and you’re correct! Gain ability 1499 and $5.

Right sentient

The smaller sentient checks the dice, and you’re wrong. Gain 1 boost.

h131.action: OFFER to assist the sentient in their journey
h131.result: The occupant of the tent, a circuit sentient, chokes over their words as they try to admit that they need help. They are suffering from a virus that they believe can only be cured by a healing spell that can be learned by studying the green spires to the east, but this far in their journey they’re too weak to move off the ledge. They give you a fire-cooked meal to prepare you for your journey. Gain 1 boost, 1 look, and quest 1683 (add it horizontally to your supply).

h132.result: From your vantage, the sword is trapped in the stone, and it’s up to you to rescue it. Gain item 889.

h133.result: The green energy seeping through the spires reaches toward you. Seconds later—or perhaps hours—your augsuit is functioning at top capacity. Lose 1 time, and gain 1 morale, 1 health, and 1 boost.

h134.result: A pulse of light ripples outwards from the center seam of the runecaster. Each player gains 1 skill matching the rune. You also gain 1 morale.

h135.action: HONOR the previous occupants by staying away
h135.result: As if the ruins recognize your restraint and respect, you feel a purifying wave wash over you. Lose 1 curse and gain 1 morale.

h136.result: As you patch up the masonry around the base of the tower, its occupant thanks you for your help but admits they’re more interested in traveling the world than sitting in this tower all day. They give you their gun and the tower itself. Gain item 1153 and structure 1286.

h137.action: CRAFT a basic item from a bone
h137.result: Your mind wanders as you carve away at the ivory, and you’re pleased to create a charming bauble. Gain item 1092.

h138.action: BREW a mild tincture from the lotus roots
h138.result: You grind the roots into a pulp with makeshift equivalents of a mortar and pestle—plus a hearty wad of saliva—resulting in a sparkling substance. Gain item 867.

h139.result: Practice your ability to leap (gain ability 1486), cleave (gain ability 1493), or scavenge (gain ability 1510). You may continue with the action matching that ability.

h140.action: BUILD a business along the shore
h140.result: You sketch out a few ideas of what you might make. Gain blueprint 1298.

h141.action: CRAFT a basic item from a bone
h141.result: Your mind wanders as you carve away at the ivory, and you’re pleased to create a charming bauble. Gain item 1092.

h142.action: CRAFT a device from spare circuitry
h142.result: From the ship’s wiring and microchips, you cobble together a universal translator. Gain item 891.

h143.result:
After patching a small portion of the shattered spaceship, you realize just how big of a task you’ve created for yourself. Gain destiny 1605 (place it in the center) and 1 boost. You may either stop or continue with a help--REPAIR action to weld the pieces into something more cohesive yet still nonfunctional (then read the next result only):

Continue

You step back and admire your work. This part of the spaceship is airtight, but the most difficult job remains. For the spaceship to be even semi-operational, you must rewire it and fix the power supply. Gain 1 morale and 1 help. You may either stop or continue with a help--REPAIR action to obtain a partial spaceship (then read the next result):

Continue

The lights flicker on, and your heart sings as the ship hovers off the ground. Gain vehicle 1434.

h144.result: The sentient is slow to accept your aid, but they acknowledge that their task is bigger than them. The elemental to the northeast is disrupting the balance of nature, and they seek to quell the threat. Gain either item 861 or sentient 1352.

h145.result:
The sentient offers either to heal you or to distribute their healing powers to your friends. Choose one:

Heal yourself

Gain 3 health.

Heal your crewmates

Each other player gains 1 health and you gain 1 morale.

h146.result: The sentient begs you to recover their beloved dustmouse. Gain $1 and quest 1627 (add it horizontally to your supply). If you pay 1 boost, also gain sentient 1329.

h147.result: Refresh X challenge dice in your grid (you may not refresh dice placed during this action). Then, if there are no challenge dice in your grid, gain 1 health, and you may continue.

h148.result: As you describe your vantage, the group feels a sense of camaraderie. Each player may gain 1 random skill. If the random skill you gain matches that of any other player, you gain 1 morale. If not, gain destiny 1599 (place it in the center).

h149.result: You sketch out a few ideas of what you might make. Gain blueprint 1297.

h150.result: If you have flora or food, let the animal hungrily peck a piece of it from your palm. Gain animal 814. If not, you gain a little warmth thanks to the animal as it flies against you (gain 1 health).

h151.result: Refresh X challenge dice in your grid (you may not refresh dice placed during this action). Then, if there are no challenge dice in your grid, gain 1 health, and you may continue.

h152.result: It only takes a few petals for you to create a pleasant novelty. Gain item 1096.

h153.action: HONOR the sanctity of the amulet
h153.result: It’s clear to you that this is a sacred place—not to mention one that is probably well-guarded. You bow deeply toward the amulet and step away. As you do, the six large birds nearby swoop down and land in your path, returning your bow in unison. One of them plucks a flower and drops it at your feet. Gain flora 1078 and 1 morale.

h154.result: Refresh X challenge dice in your grid (you may not refresh dice placed during this action). Then, if there are no challenge dice in your grid, gain 1 health and you may continue.

h155.result: As you describe your vantage, the group feels a sense of camaraderie. Each player may gain 1 random skill. If the random skill you gain matches that of any other player, you gain 1 morale. If not, gain destiny 1599 (place it in the center).

h156.action: BUILD an agricultural establishment at the confluence
h156.result: You sketch out a few ideas of what you might make in this nutrient-rich soil, and you’re surprised to see the large insect inspecting them as if they can help you. Gain blueprint 1296.

h157.result: It’s a peaceful, meditative place to let your mind wander while you craft. You’re pleased by how pretty the result is. Gain item 1096.

h158.action: CRAFT a vehicle with the sentient
h158.result: The sentient explains that their crash left them too depressed to build anything. Without pushing, you patiently offer to help gather materials, and you soon find yourself building a sand skimmer. The sentient indicates that you can keep it for yourself (gain vehicle 1022) or help them bring it to the next race (gain sentient 1340 and quest 1628; add the quest horizontally to your supply).

h159.action: ASSIST the sentients with their task
h159.result: The sentients appreciate the gesture, explaining that they were born of this volcano, and every day they spend some time trying to keep it alive. They show you how to craft the lava into new creations, and you realize that skill might be quite useful in solving a major problem. Gain item 1101 and quest 1695 (add the quest horizontally to your supply).

h160.action: CRAFT an item to impress the proprietor
h160.result: The head blacksmith is mildly amused by your makeshift creation, and they challenge you to make something more difficult. Gain quest 1644 (add it horizontally to your supply).

h161.result: They try to push you away, but not before you remove them from the lava. As the lava cools, they angrily explain that they were trying to free their mother—the volcano itself—from its confines, and you’ve significantly set them back. Gain curse 1394 and 1 boost; you may continue.

h162.action: ASSIST a sentient heading toward the city
h162.result: They eagerly accept your assistance, and they chatter nonstop about runecaster design and repairs. Gain 1 morale and go to city 525.

h163.result: If you have flora or food, let the animal nibble on part of it, then gain animal 813. If not, you gain a little comfort thanks to the animal as it nuzzles against you (gain 1 morale).

h164.action: HONOR the sanctity of the eye
h164.result: It’s clear to you that this place is sacred. You bow deeply toward the eye and step away. As you do, a sentient emerges from the lava and greets you with a hearty laugh. Gain sentient 1319.

h165.result:
After patching a small portion of the shattered spaceship, you realize just how big of a task you’ve created for yourself. Gain destiny 1605 (place it in the center) and 1 boost. You may either stop or continue with a help--REPAIR action to weld the pieces into something more cohesive yet still nonfunctional (then read the next result only):

Continue

You step back and admire your work. This part of the spaceship is airtight, but the most difficult job remains. For the spaceship to be even semi-operational, you must rewire it and fix the power supply. Gain 1 morale and 1 help. You may either stop or continue with a help--REPAIR action to obtain a partial spaceship (then read the next result):

Continue

The lights flicker on, and your heart sings as the ship hovers off the ground. Gain vehicle 1434.

h166.action: RELAX to the pleasant sound of the wind chimes
h166.result: Refresh X challenge dice in your grid (you may not refresh dice placed during this action). Then, if there are no challenge dice in your grid, gain 1 health, and you may continue.

h167.result: The tired fire sentient collapses on the ground before you, the fire in their chest barely a spark now. Their life is in danger. You notice some water on their husk, which you dry off with your shirt as you gently fan the flames back to life. The sentient will need some time to recover, but they’re eternally grateful. Gain sentient 1316.

h168.action: RELEASE the elemental from its tether
h168.result: Without its tether, the elemental imprints onto you instead. Gain elemental 1400; if you have it, lose the matching elemental curse.

h169.result: You notice several sentients wading toward the fixture, each dropping an object into the scalding lava. You realize that all of the objects are weapons. You may lose 1 weapon; if you do, gain spell 1367 and 1 health. Otherwise, simply kneel and gain 1 morale. Either way, continue.

h170.action: REPAIR the gouge in the arch
h170.result: You patch up the thin lava tubes, which resemble heating coils. Inspired by the artistry, you create a trinket from some excess tubing. Gain item 1101.

h171.action: AID a sentient in need based on a plea illuminated on the orb’s surface
h171.result: The outside of the orb includes requests for help from sentients in the area, each promising a generous reward. One such request is to free some enslaved miners to the north. Gain 1 boost and quest 1671 (add it horizontally to your supply).

h172.result: You spring into action, high-stepping through the waves, throwing yourself onto the deck, and taking hold of the till. The leaf sentient crewmembers thank you heartily and give you a choice: Join them on their northward journey (gain quest 1671; add it horizontally to your supply), or drop them off on the northern shore and keep the boat (gain vehicle 1156).

h173.result: A pulse of light ripples outwards from the center seam of the runecaster. Each player gains 1 skill matching the rune. You also gain 1 morale.

h174.result: The judges cheer and welcome you to participate in the trial. Continue with the take-ENDURE action.

h175.action: ASSIST the sentient with their task
h175.result: The wind sentient gruffly points you to the barrels to the right and asks you to carry them under the hut. In return, they offer you a choice: Gain $2 or sample the sparkling substance (gain item 867).

h176.action: RESCUE the helpless sentients from the twister
h176.result: You pull the closest sentient out of the reach of the small tornado, and they tumble on top of you, bewildered by your unsolicited aid. “How dare you disturb the Dance of Dust!” they admonish you. You quickly apologize and explain the misunderstanding. They nod and jump back into the fray. Gain 1 boost and continue.

h177.result: Nearby sentients see your act of respect and express their gratitude that you did not tread on their sacred land. In appreciation they teach you a lesson in magic. Gain lesson 1419.

h178.result: The sentient’s aggression softens as they see you caring for the drooping flowers. They explain that these are weeping asterace, so they’re supposed to look sad—just not this sad. Something has plagued them, and they request that you help find a cure. Gain 1 boost and quest 1629 (add it horizontally to your supply).

h179.result: It only takes a few petals for you to create a pleasant novelty. Gain item 1096.

h180.action: OFFER to help the sentient with a task
h180.result: The sentient brightens at the prospect of your aid, and they ask you to place some flags in the area so they can more easily see the wind patterns from a distance. Gain 1 help and quest 1669 (add it horizontally to your supply).

h181.action: PRAISE the guards for doing their job
h181.result: The sentients stand up a little taller, your compliments well received. “We’re the best in the business at protecting the sacred seed,” one of them says. Gain 1 boost and 1 random skill; you may continue.

h182.action: HONOR the sentient’s culture with a deep bow
h182.result: The sentient is pleased that you would pay such respect to their culture, particularly with the sacred field to the south: Few outsiders know not to walk through that field. They offer to show you around if you’re venturing west; if so, gain sentient 1309 and go to 181. If not, gain 1 boost.

h183.action: ASSIST the sentient in perfecting the dance
h183.result: The sentient describes the combination they’re trying to perfect, and you point out any missteps (and praise them for every perfect set of moves). In gratitude for your help, they offer to join you. Gain sentient 1305.

h184.action: ENLIVEN the queen with your performance art (only if you have been welcomed as a participant in this trial; otherwise choose another action)
h184.result: The queen declares, “Dance for me!” You must think on your feet for the full trial. Roll 2 skill dice to represent some dance moves that come to mind; select and place 1 of them as part of your routine (placed dice cannot change). Then again roll 2 skill dice, select 1, and place it adjacent to the previously placed die. You may never place the same icon in the same row or column (rows and columns extend over empty spaces). Continue rolling 2 skill dice and placing 1 adjacent to the previously placed die. If you ever roll doubles, you may reroll either or both dice. The goal is to have at least 1 die showing each icon and connect back to the first die, completing the dance; you earn $1 for every die you place (succeed or fail; minimum 4 dice and maximum 12 dice). Read entry 184 in the Book of Secrets for the results.

h185.action: BUILD a structure from the framework of the ruins
h185.result: Examining what remains of the ancient floorplan, you sketch out a few ideas of what you might make. Gain blueprint 1295.

h186.action: ASSIST a sentient heading toward the city
h186.result: The sentient shares that they’re heading to the trading post in town, and they appreciate the help. Gain $1 and 1 morale; go to city 518.

h187.action: HONOR the artifact by offering a cultural exchange
h187.result: The sentients are amazed to see an alien like you in their midst. They admire your augsuit and present you with a precious artifact. If you pay 3 boost, you successfully play music from the horn; gain item 1003 and perform no other location actions here. If not, the mystery of the artifact remains unsolved, and it vanishes from your grasp; gain 1 boost.

h188.result: The gears are clogged with sand, so you take them apart, clean them, and put them back together. The machine’s owner is absolutely overjoyed, and they offer you the choice between a special gem (gain item 1168) and a lesson that could help you earn the Horn of Destiny to the west (gain 1 boost and 2 engage).

h189.action: CRAFT some wetland shoes from the flag
h189.result: The footwear may not look pretty, and they may not keep your feet dry, but they are technically “shoes.” Gain item 933; you may go north to 194.

h190.action: CRAFT a simple stone item from the rubble at the mouth of the cave
h190.result: Gain item 1095. Up close, the cave doesn’t look as daunting as it did from a distance. If you dare, you may gain 1 look and continue with the look-EXPLORE action.

h191.result: A pulse of light ripples outwards from the center seam of the runecaster. Each player gains 1 skill matching the rune. You also gain 1 morale.

h192.action: PRAISE the sentient for their work
h192.result: The sentient is placing and adjusting flags with precision, and they’re clearly pleased by the compliment. Gain ability 1480 and 1 morale.

h193.action: BUILD a structure on the hill
h193.result: You sketch out a few ideas of what you might make. Gain blueprint 1297.

h194.result: You grab the sentient from the tornado, energy surging from them into you. “Thank you,” they say, taking their biological equivalent of deep breaths. “This duel has gone on much longer than I anticipated! I’m going to play dead until they leave.” Grateful for your aid, they offer either to teach you wind magic (gain spell 1379) or to give you a powerful grenade (gain item 860).

h195.action: BUILD a business near the gateway
h195.result: You sketch out a few ideas of what you might build. Gain blueprint 1298.

h196.result:
After patching a small portion of the shattered spaceship, you realize just how big of a task you’ve created for yourself. Gain destiny 1605 (place it in the center) and 1 boost. You may either stop or continue with a help--REPAIR action to weld the pieces into something more cohesive yet still nonfunctional (then read the next result only):

Continue

You step back and admire your work. This part of the spaceship is airtight, but the most difficult job remains. For the spaceship to be even semi-operational, you must rewire it and fix the power supply. Gain 1 morale and 1 help. You may either stop or continue with a help--REPAIR action to obtain a partial spaceship (then read the next result):

Continue

The lights flicker on, and your heart sings as the ship hovers off the ground. Gain vehicle 1434.

h197.action: ASSIST the sentient in finding the perfect position for the flags
h197.result: Your assistance proves to be a huge help for the sentient, who is able to gauge the perfect position for this and other nearby flags, instructing you to shift a little to the left or right while they hover at a short distance. “You have brought a great honor to my people,” they say. “I’m happy to reward you with your choice of the wind emblem or my service.” Gain item 1239 or sentient 1307; also, if you have it, lose the wind curse.

h198.action: AID a sentient in need based on a plea illuminated on the orb’s surface
h198.result: The outside of the orb includes requests for help from sentients in the area, each promising a generous reward. One such request is to overthrow a tyrant; the instructions say to meet up with a few energy sentients to the northeast of here. Gain 1 morale and 1 boost.

h199.result: The sentient insists that they don’t need your help, encouraging you simply to enjoy the view of Moonstone Mountain to the north. But they seem to appreciate you handing them tools during the process of picking the lock—some treasure chests are traps, and they want to give this one their full attention. When the chest opens to reveal a large mace, they offer you the choice of becoming their apprentice (gain sentient 1338) or gaining the weapon (gain item 1036).

h200.action: RELAX in the crisp mountain air
h200.result: Refresh X challenge dice in your grid (you may not refresh dice placed during this action). Then, if there are no challenge dice in your grid, gain 1 health, and you may continue.

h201.action: PRAISE the sentient for their service
h201.result: As if well-accustomed to receiving compliments from travelers, the sentient squares their shoulders and flies away. Gain 1 boost.

h202.action: OFFER to help the sentient with their job
h202.result: The sentient scoffs at the offer—they’ve spent years training to maintain and repair runecasters, and you think you can just waltz in and help them? As if sensing your naivete, they explain that runecasters help sentients around the world to increase the efficiency of basic tasks. They demonstrate how to activate the nearby device and give you a map to find others like it. Gain item 1255; the sentient highlights your current location (view page 12 in the Book of Vantages; you are in region F).

h203.action: PRAISE the sentient for staying alert
h203.result: “Just doing my job,” the sentient replies, but you can tell from their posture that they appreciate the compliment. “Captives aren’t going to guard themselves!” they say with a wink. Gain 1 boost and continue.

h204.action: REPAIR the exterior of the house
h204.result: The occupants appreciate your unsolicited aid and toss you some coins. Gain $5 and continue.

h205.action: BREW a mild tincture from the lotus roots
h205.result: You grind the roots into a pulp with makeshift equivalents of a mortar and pestle—plus a hearty wad of saliva—resulting in a sparkling substance. Gain item 867.

h206.action: ASSIST a sentient heading toward the city
h206.result: They’re struggling to carry two large paintings that they proudly stole and would like to present to the grand museum of Ingot Town. A little conflicted, you provide a steadying pair of second hands. Gain $2 and go to city 522.

h207.result: He cheers and welcomes you to participate in the trial. Continue with the take-BYPASS action.

h208.action: AID a sentient in need based on a plea illuminated on the orb’s surface
h208.result: The outside of the orb includes requests for help from sentients in the area, each promising a generous reward. One is to free a hostage just south of here. Gain 1 boost and quest 1652 (add it horizontally to your supply).

h209.result: If you have flora or food, let the animal nibble on part of it, then gain animal 828. If not, you gain back a little warmth thanks to the animal as it nuzzles against you (gain 1 health).

h210.action: PRACTICE evasion techniques around—but not too close—to the magnetic object

h211.action: OFFER to find a precious item for the sentient
h211.result: “Thank you, little one. The item I covet is the Eye of the Ancient. I know exactly where it is—far northeast of here—but my attempts to acquire it have all failed.” Gain 1 boost and quest 1658 (add it horizontally to your supply).

h212.result: Keeping a safe distance from the animal, you pluck a few petals from the nearby lotus. The scent seems to make the animal dizzy, and it topples onto its back and rolls around. Gain animal 829.

h213.result: The flying sentient appreciates the offer, but they’re guarding something far too precious to let a stranger help. Instead they show you a clever way to craft a silly item from energy itself. Gain item 1097.

h214.action: CRAFT a simple stone item from the rubble along the path
h214.result: Gain item 1095. Up close, the cave doesn’t look as daunting as it did from a distance. If you dare, you may gain 1 look and continue with the look-EXPLORE action.

h215.action: OFFER to help a drunk sentient
h215.result: It’s hard to understand their wild gesticulations, but they seem to want you to find an enchanted forest to the east of here—they even have a picture to share. Gain quest 1700 (add it horizontally to your supply).

h216.result: The museum docent eagerly accepts your help, telling you to keep an eye on an important exhibit. Go to interior 564.

h217.action: ASSEMBLE a set of stone steps over the fence
h217.result: Some other travelers applaud the effort and give you some spare snow gear in appreciation, saying you’ll need it in the cold north. Gain item 928; you may go north to 222.

h218.action: CRAFT an advanced device from one of the lodestones
h218.result: You pry off a floating shard, and with great ingenuity—if you may say so yourself—you craft a powerful pair of goggles. Gain item 935.

h219.action: SHARE your observations of potential threats with the sentry
h219.result: Whether they’re true or false, you spin a web of stories for the sentry, informing them of what you’ve seen in the surrounding area. Gain $4 and continue.

h220.action: PRACTICE on the sturdy, thick ice
h220.result: Practice your ability to forage (gain ability 1487) or cleave (gain ability 1493). You may continue with an action matching that ability.

h221.result: If you have flora or food, let the animal nibble on part of it, then gain animal 808. If not, you gain back a little warmth thanks to the animal as it nuzzles against you (gain 1 health).

h222.result: If you have flora or food, let the animal nibble on part of it, then gain animal 810. If not, you gain back a little warmth thanks to the animal as it nuzzles against you (gain 1 health).

h223.result: You trudge through the snowfall. Gain ability 1496.

h224.action: BUILD a structure in the valley
h224.result: You sketch out a few ideas of what you might make. Gain blueprint 1297.

h225.action: OFFER to assist the sentients in their journey
h225.result: The campers are two siblings on a journey to find the source of the blight that has stricken so many in their village to the southwest, including their fathers. Gain $2 and quest 1667 (add it horizontally to your supply).

h226.action: PRACTICE how to descend safely and consistently
h226.result: There’s a ledge just a few meters below you before a much longer descent, and it’s the perfect place to practice your skills. Gain ability 1491; you may continue.

h227.action: RELEASE the device from its tethers
h227.result: Nothing happens. The vehicle isn’t intelligent—it relies on a pilot to steer it. Gain 1 boost and continue.

h228.result: You tell the sentient how you came to be on this planet. They encourage you to post your story on the message boards in the orb to the south; they offer to accompany you there. Gain sentient 1325.

h229.result: You can’t imagine a better place to settle down, so you consider your options for lodging. Gain blueprint 1295. You may lose 1 time to wait for the moon; if you do, gain lesson 1432.

h230.action: BUILD an agricultural establishment at the water’s edge
h230.result: You sketch out a few ideas of what you might make. Gain blueprint 1296.

h231.action: BREW a potion from the nearby lotus in the hopes it will unlock the secrets of the gauntlet
h231.result: You drink the potion; gain item 867. A burst of clarity reveals that you must perform the look-SOLVE action to gain the gauntlet.

h232.action: ASSIST the light by dipping your hand into the water
h232.result: There is an exchange of energy that you can barely explain. You simultaneously feel like a piece of yourself has entered the light and you feel like part of the sentient being that forms is part of you. Gain 2 health.

h233.result: The judges cheer and welcome you to participate in the trial. Continue with the look-TRANSLATE action.

h234.action: OFFER to help the timid sentients
h234.result: When they see that you mean them no harm, the trio hovers over to you and quickly adapt to your language. “We were once forced to provide energy for an evil tyrant to the northeast. Will you help us overthrow them?” Gain $2 and quest 1647 (add it horizontally to your supply).

h235.result: The Traveler is grateful you replied to their signal. “By the way, it’s probably best to turn it off now… if, that is, you can find what’s left of my ship to the far southwest of here.” Gain mission 1596, then either keep it and lose your original mission or lose this new mission.

h236.action: CRAFT a dingsbums from the energy surging through the tower
h236.result: As you try to weave the tower’s energy into something pleasant, you realize that you could instead manipulate the same energy to send a signal to your homeworld. You may either continue with the engage-TRANSMIT action with a cost reduced by 3 or use the energy to gain item 1097.

h237.result: The sentient quickly picks up on your language and replicates it. “I’m reading messages from other geolocators in this orb, but no one seems to be able to find a place called Moonstone Mountain. Can you help?” Gain 1 look and quest 1678 (add it horizontally to your supply).

h238.action: ASSIST a sentient heading toward the city
h238.result: The sentient is carrying a bundle of paper lanterns, the kind designed to float on water. When some of the lanterns almost spill into the swamp, you catch them and return them to the sentient. In gratitude, the sentient leads you into the city before heading over to the funeral home. Gain $2 and go to city 520.

h239.action: PRAISE the craftsmanship of the building’s owner
h239.result: You poke your head into the building, where a few ethereal sentients are exchanging pleasantries. Clearing your throat, you catch their attention, and you use the moment to compliment them on the many beautiful lanterns inside. The store owner beams— quite literally—and invites you inside. Gain ability 1480 and go to interior 565.

h240.action: AID a sentient in need based on a plea illuminated on the orb’s exterior
h240.result: The outside of the orb includes requests for help from sentients in the area, each promising a generous reward. One such request is to cure a blight; the instructions say that sentients at a campsite south of here are seeking aid. Gain 1 morale and 1 boost.

h241.result: With the energy of the purple crystal enhancing your senses, you practice the science of either careful, calculating study (gain ability 1492) or deliberate extraction (gain ability 1516). You may continue.

h242.action: RELEASE the elemental from its tether
h242.result: Without its tether, the elemental imprints onto you instead. Gain elemental 1402; if you have it, lose the matching elemental curse.

h243.result: A loose panel reveals that the levitation core of the runecaster is disconnected. While you have access to the inside, you pair the device to your augsuit. Gain item 1028.

h244.action: ASSIST the sentient inside the orb
h244.result: You tap on the glass, and a luminous pink head emerges from within. You ask whether you can help in any way, but they explain that they’re just charging up the orb for other travelers to use. They appreciate the offer, though, and they warn you of the electric fence to the east. Gain 1 morale and 1 boost.

h245.result: The plant lashes out at you, but you manage to harness its energy to create a simple dingsbums. Gain item 1097.

h246.result: A pulse of light ripples outwards from the center seam of the runecaster. Each player gains 1 skill matching the rune. You also gain 1 morale. The Traveler advises you, “Similarly to how you can send a signal via runecasters like this, you can use towers to manipulate interstellar signals.” Gain 1 boost and destiny 1598 (place it in the center).

h247.action: HONOR the sentients as you seek an alliance between your world and theirs
h247.result: They stop arguing and turn their full attention to you. You spend the next hour answering questions about your world, and you make significant progress toward diplomatic relations. Gain 1 morale and 1 boost.

h248.action: BREW a potion using the bark of the tree
h248.result: The bark yields a greenish tincture. Gain item 861.

h249.result: If you have flora or food, let the animal nibble on part of it, then gain animal 823. If not, you gain a little strength thanks to the animal as it nuzzles against you (gain 1 health).

h250.action: HONOR whoever placed the box intentionally among the thorns by leaving the box alone
h250.result: You leave the box alone, not letting your curiosity get the best of you. Gain 1 morale.

h251.action: ASSEMBLE a railing around the pit
h251.result: Some other travelers applaud the effort and give you a vented jacket in appreciation, saying you’ll need it to the north. Gain item 967; you may continue.

h252.result: You ask the sentient for permission to use an unwanted bone to craft a bauble, and they agree, offering you a few pointers along the way. Gain item 1092; if you pay 2 engage, also gain sentient 1331.

h253.action: CRAFT a simple gold item from a loose intaglio on the chest
h253.result: As you remove the golden decoration from the treasure chest, you realize that what’s inside the chest could be far more valuable than the simple trinket you intended to craft. You may either continue with the take-DISMANTLE action with a cost reduced by 3 or use the gold to craft a simple zamazingo (gain item 1099).

h254.action: BUILD an agricultural business to enliven this desolate landscape
h254.result: You sketch out a few ideas of what you might make. Gain blueprint 1296 and continue.

h255.result: Your offer overjoys the sentients, and they say that it would be a pleasure to hunt by your side. After all, they typically hunt in groups of three. One of them scouts ahead while the other walks with you. Gain sentient 1333 and quest 1649 (add the quest horizontally to your supply).

h256.action: CRAFT a basic item from a bone
h256.result: Your mind wanders as you carve away at the ivory, and you’re pleased to create a charming bauble. Gain item 1092.

h257.result: Despite the danger presented by the animals and the apparent shame your assistance brings upon the sentient, you manage to break them free of the cage. They insist upon returning the favor. Gain sentient 1354.

h258.action: REPAIR a broken item for the sentient
h258.result: The release mechanism is jammed in a bone-crafted harpoon, so you fix it and give it back to the sentient. They admit they’ve been having trouble selling a fishing instrument in the middle of the desert, so they give it to you in appreciation and recommend that you head southeast, where water is more abundant. Gain item 959 and 1 morale.

h259.result: You encourage the animal to eat some of the nearby desert flora you pluck as you approach. The dry snout of the beast rubs against your hand like sandpaper. Gain animal 824.

h260.result: If you have flora or food, let the animal nibble on part of it, then gain animal 825. If not, you gain a warm fuzzy feeling thanks to the animal as it nuzzles against you (gain 1 morale).

h261.result: The judges cheer and welcome you to participate in the trial. Continue with the overpower-HUNT action.

h262.action: ASSIST a sentient heading toward the city
h262.result: Fresh from a hunt, they’re juggling weapons and bones in both arms, and they appreciate your assistance. Gain $2 and go to city 524.

h263.result: As you share some of your water, the entire plant uproots itself, emerging from the ground with eight legs and petals for a head. You stumble backwards, and to your surprise, the plant catches you and embraces you in a big hug. Gain flora 1052 and 1 morale.

h264.action: HONOR the previous occupants by staying away
h264.result: As if the ruins recognize your restraint and respect, you feel a purifying wave wash over you. Lose 1 curse and gain 1 morale.

h265.result: You cut the sentient free and force the bounty hunter to run away. Gain sentient 1314 and curse 1392.

h266.action: PRACTICE the dueling card and dice game everyone seems to be playing in the casino
h266.result: Gain ability 1499 and 1 boost; you may continue.

h267.result: The sentient pauses their work to thank you for the offer. They were expecting the aid of a leaf sentient from the south, but they never showed up. You’re put to work in the garden for a pittance. Gain ability 1476 and $2.

h268.result:
Choose a sentient to assist:

Assist the leaf sentient

You wrest the ambassador away from the prince’s grasp. As the sinew bully wanders off in search of easier targets, the leaf sentient expresses their deepest gratitude. Gain item 1248 (also, if you have it, lose the leaf curse).

Assist the sinew sentient

You pin down the leaf sentient’s wings, leaving them to the whim of the prince. Eventually he tires of toying with his prey and decides to accompany you. Gain sentient 1332 and curse 1388.

h269.action: PRACTICE your skills under these unpredictable conditions
h269.result: What better chance to hone your abilities? Practice your ability to evade (gain ability 1485), balance (gain ability 1501), or push (gain ability 1502); you may continue.

h270.result: As you remove the golden decoration from the treasure chest, you realize that what’s inside the chest could be far more valuable than the simple trinket you intended to craft. h272.result: You sketch out a few ideas of what you might make. Gain blueprint 1295.

h275.action: BREW a mild tincture from the lotus roots
h275.result: You grind the roots into a pulp with makeshift equivalents of a mortar and pestle—plus a hearty wad of saliva—resulting in a sparkling substance. Gain item 867.

h276.action: PRAISE the rightmost sentient for their strategy
h276.result: The gold sentient is hesitant to accept your compliment, but you convince them of your sincerity. After their game, they offer to coach you (gain sentient 1322) or steer you toward an amazing landmark (gain 2 move and quest 1630; add it horizontally to your supply).

h277.result: The creature has been chained to this wall and trained to fight anything that tries to pass through. It deserves to be free, but it doesn’t know your intentions, and it struggles against your efforts. Finally you break through the chains. Gain animal 836.

h278.action: HONOR the purpose of the wall by moving elsewhere
h278.result: You bow to the wall, then turn and walk away. Gain 1 morale and go either east to 279 or west to 277.

h279.result: The sentient waves off your attempt to help them, explaining that the outside of orbs like this display requests for help from sentients in the area, each promising a generous reward. The sentient highlights a nearby request to assemble a broken bridge to the north. Gain 1 boost and quest 1632 (add it horizontally to your supply).

h280.result: In a soft voice, the sentient reveals that they’ve never entirely felt at home in their body. They ask if you would consider venturing to the Memory Palace with them so they can feel what it’s like to occupy a different skin. Gain 2 move and quest 1697 (add it horizontally to your supply).

h281.action: ASSEMBLE a trap at the entrance to the building
h281.result: You suspect that someone is inside the building, so you lay your trap and furtively wait a few minutes. Sure enough, a small sentient wanders out of the building directly into your cleverly concealed snare. On them you find a stolen talisman, which you return to the cathedral in the spirit of helping. The clerics inside bless you with the knowledge of basic magic. Gain lesson 1424 and 1 boost.

h282.action: CRAFT a basic item from a bone
h282.result: Your mind wanders as you carve away at the ivory, and you’re pleased to create a charming bauble. Gain item 1092.

h283.result: A pulse of light ripples outwards from the center seam of the runecaster. Each player gains 1 skill matching the rune. You also gain 1 morale.

h284.action: HONOR the sanctity of the crystal
h284.result: It’s clear to you that this is a sacred place—not to mention one that is probably well-guarded. You bow deeply toward the crystal and step away. As you do, the three treasure chests nearby pop open, sharp-tooth guardians emerging from each. They line up in front of you… and return your bow. One of them hands you a beautiful bar of soap and gestures for you to leave. Gain item 1207.

h286.action: OFFER to settle the sentient’s debate
h286.result: After a brief conference, the sentient agrees that it would be helpful for you to travel east, then north to find a special constellation. With a sprinkle of sand, you can see it in your mind’s eye. Gain 1 boost, 1 move, and quest 1651 (add it horizontally to your supply).

h287.action: HONOR the sacred place by adhering to tradition and waiting for a memory
h287.result:
Gain 1 boost, then gain 1 random skill and read the matching result:

move

You are a wind sentient dancing in the prairie with a new love, your senses heightened by a powerful elixir. Continue.

look

You are an energy sentient learning a new language for the first time, a foreign tongue opening your heart to other cultures. Continue.

engage

You are a gold sentient playing Skirm with your child, reliving the joy of discovering your favorite game through their eyes. Continue.

help

You are a leaf sentient giving away your favorite pet to an elderly person, experiencing the pride of putting someone else’s need before your own. Continue.

take

You are a metal sentient stealing from the rich to give to the poor, delighting in the thrill of the heist. Continue.

overpower

You are a sinew sentient making your first kill, honoring the animal’s journey to the next world by burying its soulstone below it. Continue.

h288.result: If you have flora or food, let the animal nibble on part of it, then gain animal 834. If not, the animal tugs on your pants, leading you to the west (you may go west to 287).

h289.action: ASSEMBLE a bridge across the gap
h289.result: Some other travelers applaud the effort and give you a spare bedroll in appreciation, saying you’ll need it in the north. Gain item 971; you may go north to 294.

h290.action: CRAFT a basic item from a bone
h290.result: Your mind wanders as you carve away at the ivory, and you’re pleased to create a charming bauble. Gain item 1092.

h291.result:
If you have flora or food, you may drop a piece of it into the pit:

If you do

The entire pit closes and disappears under the sand. Gain 1 morale; you may go north to 296.

If you don’t

Nothing happens. Gain 1 boost and continue.

h292.action: PRACTICE fighting techniques near the oasis
h292.result: Inspired by the skull-and-crossbones warning, you refine your fighting prowess. Gain ability 1504.

h293.action: BUILD an agricultural structure next to the oasis
h293.result: It seems like the perfect place for growth and prosperity, so you sketch out a few ideas of what you might make. Gain blueprint 1296.

h294.result: The campers groggily emerge from their tents, surprised to see a friendly face instead of a bandit. They’re climbers heading to the Memory Palace to the southwest of here. In gratitude for your assistance, they give you a spare rope. Gain item 902.

h295.action: ASSIST the sentient with their work
h295.result: The sentient appreciates your silent assistance. Gain item 1258 and $3; the sentient highlights your current location (view page 15 in the Book of Vantages; you are in region D).

h296.result: Your feet sink into the fine-grained sand, making your walk more of a trudge. Gain ability 1496.

h297.result: As you describe your vantage, the group feels a sense of camaraderie. Each player may gain 1 random skill. If the random skill you gain matches that of any other player, you gain 1 morale. If not, gain destiny 1599 (place it in the center).

h298.result: You trek a large circle around the levitating lorestones. Gain ability 1505.

h299.action: CRAFT a dingsbums from the energy surging through the tower
h299.result: As you try to weave the tower’s energy into something pleasant, you realize that you could instead manipulate the same energy to send a signal to your homeworld. You may either continue with the engage-TRANSMIT action with a cost reduced by 3 or use the energy to gain item 1097.

h300.result: Your ability to heal the creature is greatly hindered by its sheer unwillingness to allow you within its circle of trust. Roll 6 skill dice and gain all move results. Lose 1 health unless you pay 1 move. You finally manage to remove a large thorn from the animal’s head. Gain animal 841.

h301.action: HONOR the creature by kneeling before it
h301.result: The sentient interprets your gesture as an invitation to glide over to you, and you feel a slight tug from within your chest. It leaves you instantly tired, but the sentient glows brighter than before. “Thank you, groundwalker,” they say. “I recognize your language from a vessel I’ve seen in pieces around the world. You’ll find one piece a ways north of here, and another to the southwest. Travel well!” Gain 1 morale and destiny 1605 (place it in the center).

h302.result: Refresh X challenge dice in your grid (you may not refresh dice placed during this action). Then, if there are no challenge dice in your grid, gain 1 health, and you may continue.

h303.result: You kneel before the largest stone and touch your forehead to the circle’s center. Three distinct icons fill your mind’s eye. You may choose to focus on one of the three. If you choose the green icon, gain spell 1236. If you choose the pink icon, gain spell 1237. If you choose the blue icon, gain spell 1238.

h304.action: ASSIST the one-eyed guard as they fire shots at the approaching pirate ship
h304.result: The ship steers away. The guard slaps you on the back and offers you some hardtack and a glider in gratitude. Gain vehicle 957 and 1 health.

h305.action: BREW an adhesive from the flowers dotting the shoreline
