h652.result: You perfectly time your rescue attempt when the guards’ attention is elsewhere. Inside the pit is a feeble sentient who follows your lead. Gain sentient 1356. You may pay 1 boost to go to an adjacent location other than north; otherwise, continue.

h653.action: CRAFT a simple gold item from a loose intaglio on the chest
h653.result: As you remove the golden decoration from the treasure chest, you realize that what’s inside the chest could be far more valuable than the simple trinket you intended to craft. You may either continue with the take-DISMANTLE action with a cost reduced by 3 or use the gold to craft a simple zamazingo (gain item 1099).

h654.action: PRACTICE possible approaches to clearing the anemones
h654.result: Gain the navigate ability (1464), squeeze ability (1507), or cut ability (1508). You may continue.

h655.result: The flat ledge and abundance of sunken supplies creates a great opportunity to construct a refuge from the lack of oxygen below the surface. Gain structure 1290 and continue.

h656.action: CRAFT a simple stone item from the rubble at the mouth of the cave
h656.result: Gain item 1095. Up close, the cave doesn’t look as daunting as it did from a distance. If you dare, you may gain 1 look and continue with the look-EXPLORE action.

h657.action: RELEASE the elemental from its tether
h657.result: Freed from its tether, elemental imprints onto you instead. Gain elemental 1406; if you have it, lose the matching elemental curse.

h658.result: A glowing head appears from the dark depths, and the sentient motions their gratitude. Gain sentient 1318.

h659.result: You kneel at the edge of the graveyard. As you do, a tendril of light drifts from the bones into your chest, and you have a feeling of renewal. Gain 1 health. You may go north to 660, south to 658, or west to 653; if you do, don’t suffer hypoxia damage upon arrival. Otherwise, continue.

h660.result: If you have flora or food, let the animal nibble on part of it, then gain animal 848. If not, gain 1 health if you suffered hypoxia damage this turn.

h661.result: The turtle-like taxi saunters over to you and gestures to its cracked glass shell. You seal a few gaps and climb aboard. Gain vehicle 1013 with 2 boost on it.

h662.action: ASSIST the hunters with skinning their prey
h662.result: In gratitude, the hunters give you a spare pair of climbing shoes (963) and recommend that you hunt for giant huskroaches to the northeast.

h663.action: PRACTICE an ability that might be helpful in the surrounding area
h663.result: Gain the ask ability (1470), steal ability (1482), or build ability (1488).

h664.action: BUILD a business in the field
h664.result: You sketch out a few ideas of what you might make. Gain blueprint 1294.

h665.action: VOLUNTEER to fix up some of the cottages
h665.result: The overworked landlord is grateful for your assistance. The hovels are built into the hill, and rainstorms have left the ceilings soggy. Gain $10 and continue.

h666.result: The tree explains that they are so close to being brought to life as a wood sentient, but the Carver forgot about them. They weep thick, sappy tears and implore you to use the Tools of Creation. Gain 1 help and quest 1640 (add it horizontally to your supply).

h667.action: HONOR the sentients’ traditions by quietly waiting until the right moment and then offering a gift
h667.result:
The newlyweds soon cross the bridge, solidifying their union. Choose one:

Give them each a good-luck coin (pay $2)

The sentients are touched by this gift from a total stranger, and they insist that you join them for their first meal as a new couple. Gain 2 health.

Give them your well wishes

The sentients are surprised to hear from a stranger, but they’re happy to celebrate with anyone and everyone. They give you a big hug. Gain 1 morale.

h668.result: If you have flora or food, let the animal nibble on part of it, then gain animal 853. If not, the animal deposits a shiny coin in your palm, proud to have stolen it from some unsuspecting traveler (gain $1).

h669.action: BREW a mushroom into an ointment
h669.result: The bulbous fungus yields a greenish salve. Gain item 868.

h670.action: BREW a mild tincture from the lotus near the rune
h670.result: You grind the roots into a pulp with makeshift equivalents of a mortar and pestle—plus a hearty wad of saliva—resulting in a sparkling substance. Gain item 867.

h671.result: As you describe your vantage, the group feels a sense of camaraderie. Each player may gain 1 random skill. If the random skill you gain matches that of any other player, you gain 1 morale. If not, gain destiny 1599 (place it in the center).

h672.action: OFFER to help the fisherman with an errand
h672.result: The fisherman laments a special crate they lost at sea that contained something priceless to them. They give you a fresh bite of fish as a token of their gratitude. Gain 1 health and quest 1634 (add it horizontally to your supply).

h673.action: SHARE information with your crewmates or the sentient
h673.result:
Choose one:

Share with your crewmates

As you describe your vantage, the group feels a sense of camaraderie. Each player may gain 1 random skill. If the random skill you gain matches that of any other player, you gain 1 morale. If not, gain destiny 1599 (place it in the center).

Share with the sentient (pay 1 boost)

You tell a story of your travels to the sentient, who is delighted by your exploits. In turn, they recommend that you speak with the sentient to the north. Gain 1 move and 1 engage.

h674.action: SHARE some food with the creature
h674.result:
Choose one:

If you have a food card and pay 1 boost from it

You stand in the creature’s path, palm outstretched. It accepts the gift tenderly, as if this were the first time anyone had ever done this. Gain animal 846.

If you don’t pay a boost from a food card

The animal shares some fruit with you instead. Gain item 1224.

h675.action: CRAFT a simple gold item from a loose intaglio on the chest
h675.result: As you remove the golden decoration from the treasure chest, you realize that what’s inside the chest could be far more valuable than the simple trinket you intended to craft. You may either continue with the take-DISMANTLE action with a cost reduced by 3 or use the gold to craft a simple zamazingo (gain item 1099).

h676.result: The sentient’s tears soak into your augsuit, and they beg you to deliver an antidote to a dear friend—a water sentient—to the west. Gain item 865 and quest 1655 (add the quest horizontally to your supply).

h677.action: ASSIST a sentient waiting in front of the city
h677.result:
The sentient says that they’re waiting for the Gatherer of the Forest to return from the southeast with a fresh harvest for their tavern. They ask you to wait for the Gatherer and then bring the harvest to them.

If you agree to wait

Gain quest 1636 (add it horizontally to your supply).

If you don’t agree

Go to city 519.

h678.result: The sentient continues to pace back and forth as they rant about a pair of vicious alien beasts that reign terror over the woodlands to the northeast. If you dare, gain quest 1668 (add it horizontally to your supply). If not, gain 1 boost.

h679.action: AID a sentient in need or the animal
h679.result:
Choose one:

Aid a sentient in need based on a plea illuminated on the orb’s surface

The outside of the orb includes requests for help from sentients in the area, each promising a generous reward. One such request is from a metal sentient trying to find the end of a rainbow to the east. Gain 1 move and quest 1703 (add it horizontally to your supply).

Aid the animal

Behind the animal are dozens of others like it; this one seems to be their representative. It doesn’t seem to understand your words, so you kneel and let it approach you. It extends a tendril and brushes it against your arm, and after a moment’s contemplation, it seems satisfied by your intentions. Gain animal 843.

h680.result: If you have flora or food, let the animal nibble on part of it, then gain animal 854. If not, you gain a little morale thanks to the animal as it nuzzles against you (gain 1 morale).

h681.action: PRACTICE your skills in the clearing before proceeding
h681.result: Gain the defend ability (1478), trailblaze ability (1484), squeeze ability (1507), or cut ability (1508). You may continue.

h682.action: REPAIR the exterior of the house
h682.result: The occupants appreciate your unsolicited aid, saying that they’ve tried to maintain this place they call Ole Hollow. Either gain $5 or invite yourself inside (enter interior 586).

h683.result: The leaf sentient deflects the compliment, but you can tell from how they flutter their petal-like shoulders that they take pride in their appearance. They offer you some tea and an activity recommendation. Gain 1 health, 1 boost, and quest 1657 (add it horizontally to your supply).

h684.result: You quickly realize that the hummingbats aren’t attacking you—they’re acting like a dangerous predator is in their midst. Then you see it: a massive beetle, nearly invisible against a tree trunk. You almost walked right by it. You act as a shield between the beast and the bats, and the beetle skitters away down the tree. The hummingbats nuzzle against you in appreciation and steer you up the staircase; gain 2 morale, and you may go north to 689.

h685.result: It only takes a few petals for you to create a pleasant novelty. Gain item 1096.

h686.action: BUILD a business using the abundance of trees
h686.result: You sketch out a few ideas of what you might make, whittling absentmindedly at a stick as you do. Gain item 1094 and blueprint 1298.

h687.result: As you describe your vantage, the group feels a sense of camaraderie. Each player may gain 1 random skill. If the random skill you gain matches that of any other player, you gain 1 morale. If not, gain destiny 1599 (place it in the center).

h688.action: CRAFT a dingsbums from the energy surging through the tower
h688.result: As you try to weave the tower’s energy into something pleasant, you realize that you could instead manipulate the same energy to send a signal to your homeworld. You may either continue with the engage-TRANSMIT action with a cost reduced by 3 or use the energy to gain item 1097.

h689.result: If you have flora or food, let the cats nibble on part of it, then gain animal 827. If not, you may instead use 2 boost to gain animal 827.

h690.result: You’re able to improve some the structural integrity of the gateways. To repair them fully, however, some amount of sorcery is required. Gain quest 1657 (add it horizontally to your supply). You may continue.

h691.action: HONOR the sanctity of the monument
h691.result: It’s clear to you that this is a sacred place—not to mention one that is probably well-guarded. You bow deeply toward the monument and step away. As you do, five heavily armed warriors emerge from the roots, returning your bow in unison. One of them gives you a basket of fruit. Gain item 1224 and 1 morale.

h692.result: If you have flora or food, let the animal nibble on part of it, then gain animal 841. If not, the animal feeds some treats to you, shaking some blue and red berries from within its leafy mane (gain 1 health).

h693.result: The judges cheer and welcome you to participate in the trial. Continue with the move-SCALE action.

h694.action: HONOR this ancient place by staying away
h694.result: As if the ruins recognize your restraint and respect, you feel a purifying wave wash over you. Lose 1 curse and gain 1 morale.

h695.action: OFFER to help the owner of the farm
h695.result: The farmer, a wood sentient, explains that their entire herd broke free last night. They beg you to search the surrounding area to find them and steer them back here. Gain 1 move and quest 1702 (add it horizontally to your supply).

h696.action: BREW a mild tincture from the lotus roots
h696.result: You grind the roots into a pulp with makeshift equivalents of a mortar and pestle—plus a hearty wad of saliva—resulting in a sparkling substance. Gain item 867.

h697.result:
After patching a small portion of the shattered spaceship, you realize just how big of a task you’ve created for yourself. Gain destiny 1605 (place it in the center) and 1 boost. You may either stop or continue with a help--REPAIR action to weld the pieces into something more cohesive yet still nonfunctional (then read the next result only):

Continue

You step back and admire your work. This part of the spaceship is airtight, but the most difficult job remains. For the spaceship to be even semi-operational, you must rewire it and fix the power supply. Gain 1 morale and 1 help. You may either stop or continue with a help--REPAIR action to obtain a partial spaceship (then read the next result):

Continue

The lights flicker on, and your heart sings as the ship hovers off the ground. Gain vehicle 1434.

h698.action: CRAFT a simple stone item from the rubble at the mouth of the cave
h698.result: Gain item 1095. Up close, the cave looks even more inviting than it did from a distance. If you dare, you may gain 1 look and continue with the look-EXPLORE action.

h699.action: ASSEMBLE a bridge across the gully
h699.result: Nearby travelers applaud the new bridge and give you a spare toothbrush in appreciation, saying it’ll result in friendlier conversations in the capital city to the north. Gain item 1208; you may go north to 779 (if you do, also gain 2 help from the runecaster on the far side of the gully).

h700.action: CRAFT a basic item from a bone
h700.result: Your mind wanders as you carve away at the ivory, and you’re pleased to create a charming bauble. Gain item 1092.

h701.result:
Choose a specific animal, sentient, flora, or item from your grid or reserve to place inside the box:

Animal

The animal disappears and doesn’t return. Lose the animal and gain 1 boost. Continue.

Sentient

The sentient disappears and doesn’t return. Lose the sentient and gain 1 boost. Continue.

Flora

The flora just sits in the box—nothing happens. Gain 1 boost and continue.

Item

The item just sits in the box—nothing happens. Gain 1 boost and continue.

h702.action: BREW a mild tincture from the lotus roots
h702.result: The creature lurking behind the lotus lashes out, making a simple brew a considerably more difficult challenge. Having fended off the beast, you grind the lotus roots into a pulp with makeshift equivalents of a mortar and pestle—plus a hearty wad of saliva— resulting in a sparkling substance. Gain item 867.

h703.result: The energy in their joints sizzles appreciatively, and they toss a map case at your feet. “With the trials almost complete, I don’t need this anymore.” Gain item 1261; the sentient highlights your current location (view page 18 in the Book of Vantages; you are in region J).

h704.action: AID a sentient in need based on a plea illuminated on the orb’s surface
h704.result: The outside of the orb includes requests for help from sentients in the area, each promising a generous reward. One such request is to recover a stolen soulstone; the instructions (from a sentient to the northeast of here) say that the stone was taken to a bandit hideout to the north of this orb. Gain 1 boost and quest 1654 (add it horizontally to your supply).

h705.result: If you have flora or food, let the animal nibble on part of it, then gain animal 838. If not, the animal still seems content to enjoy some friendly company for a moment (gain 1 morale).

h706.result: You scare away the animal’s pursuers, and the exhausted animal eases to the ground nearby, nuzzling into your palm. Gain animal 840.

h707.result: As you describe your vantage, the group feels a sense of camaraderie. Each player may gain 1 random skill. If the random skill you gain matches that of any other player, you gain 1 morale. If not, gain destiny 1599 (place it in the center).

h708.result: The stone sentient is almost inconsolable, but you manage to understand that their child needs some help to the north. If you will help, gain 1 move and go north to 709; otherwise gain 1 boost.

h709.action: RESCUE the person or people at the other end of the rope
h709.result: You find a young sentient wedged within a crack in the column. After you wiggle them free, you lower them to the ground and give them a big hug. Gain sentient 1346 and ability 1513.

h710.action: ASSEMBLE a zipline to connect the ledge to the area below
h710.result: A nearby traveler applauds the effort and gives you a spare pair of translating glasses in appreciation, saying you’ll need it in the capital city to the west. Gain item 925; you may go north to 711.

h711.result: Having remained alone in one place for so long, the lizard was in dire need of a little care and attention. You soothe its stress and inject some revitalizing meds between the cracks of its stone-like skin. Gain animal 837.

h712.result: A pulse of light ripples outwards from the center seam of the runecaster. Each player gains 1 skill matching the rune. You also gain 1 morale.

h713.result:
After patching a small portion of the shattered spaceship, you realize just how big of a task you’ve created for yourself. Gain destiny 1605 (place it in the center) and 1 boost. You may either stop or continue with a help--REPAIR action to weld the pieces into something more cohesive yet still nonfunctional (then read the next result only):

Continue

You step back and admire your work. This part of the spaceship is airtight, but the most difficult job remains. For the spaceship to be even semi-operational, you must rewire it and fix the power supply. Gain 1 morale and 1 help. You may either stop or continue with a help--REPAIR action to obtain a partial spaceship (then read the next result):

Continue

The lights flicker on, and your heart sings as the ship hovers off the ground. Gain vehicle 1434.

h714.result: The sentient is grateful for the offer, explaining that their sibling recently wandered too far from home and was captured by enterprising metal sentients to the far north. Gain $2, 1 move, and quest 1652 (add it horizontally to your supply).

h715.result: The sentient waves away your respect, but you can tell they appreciate the gesture. “This is my family business,” they say. They offer to identify and bestow your soul upon you. Roll a skill die and gain a crystal matching the resulting color (blue: 1160; purple: 1161; orange: 1162; green: 1163; yellow: 1164; red: 1165). If you already have that exact crystal, the Soulkeeper nods knowingly and instead offers you some insight into using that crystal (gain 2 skills matching its color).

h716.action: CRAFT a simple stone item from the rubble at the mouth of the cave
h716.result: Gain item 1095. Up close, the cave doesn’t look as steep as it did from a distance. If you dare, you may gain 1 look and continue with the look-EXPLORE action.

h717.action: BREW using some fresh water and the nearby flora
h717.result: The orange petals of the flower dissolve into the water, then quickly thicken into an acidic paste. Gain item 859.

h718.result: The sentient’s voice sounds like rocks grinding together as they explain that a group of bandits—metal sentients—stole their soulstone and took it to the west. Gain 1 take and quest 1654 (add it horizontally to your supply).

h719.action: BUILD a castle in the clouds from the framework of the ruins
h719.result: This peak provides a fortified position for you to settle down and make a home in these mountains. Gain structure 1265.

h720.action: CRAFT a basic item from a bone
h720.result: Your mind wanders as you carve away at the ivory, and you’re pleased to create a charming bauble. Gain item 1092.

h721.result: The judges cheer and welcome you to participate in the trial. Continue with the look-CALCULATE action.

h722.action: HONOR someone you love by performing a leap of faith
h722.result:
Trusting the low gravity in this region of the world, you gather your courage and step off the path into the clouds. As you do, close your eyes and think of someone specific to honor (friend, family member, pet, etc.): It feels like you’re floating forever. As you do, the thing you value most about your honoree comes to mind. Choose one:

It’s their heart

Gain 2 health. When you open your eyes, you’re on the opposite path. Gain 1 morale and go north to 723.

It’s their personality

Gain 2 morale. When you open your eyes, you’re on the opposite path. Gain 1 morale and go north to 723.

It’s their wisdom and wit

Gain 2 boost. When you open your eyes, you’re on the opposite path. Gain 1 morale and go north to 723.

h723.action: PRACTICE an ability that might be useful here or in the surrounding area
h723.result: Gain the leap ability (1486), scale ability (1503), or force ability (1512). If you choose the scale ability, you may continue with a move-SCALE action.

h724.action: FEED treats to the glowing animal
h724.result: If you have flora or food, let the animal nibble on part of it, then gain animal 837 and continue with the engage-PICK action at a cost reduced by 2. If not, the animal wanders away from the treasure chest; gain 1 engage.

h725.action: BUILD an agricultural establishment in this well-traveled area
h725.result: You sketch out a few ideas of what you might make. Gain blueprint 1296.

h726.result: You stand between the travelers and the giant, warding it away while the sentients escape. Gain 1 morale.

h727.action: ASSIST a sentient heading toward the city
h727.result: The sentient appreciates the help carrying cartons of medical gear toward the hospital. Gain $3 and go to city 523.

h728.action: TEACH the sentient how to fall without injuring themselves
h728.result: Your mandatory space cadet safety training comes in handy from time to time! The sentient is appreciative of your advice, and they invite you to watch them attempt the famous Leap of Faith. If you agree, gain sentient 1347 and go west to 722. If not, they request that you look for their lost pet, a hovertail that recently flew off to the east (gain quest 1650; add it horizontally to your supply).

h729.action: RELEASE the elemental from its tether
h729.result: Without its tether, the elemental imprints onto you instead. Gain elemental 1405; if you have it, lose the matching elemental curse.

h730.action: CRAFT a simple stone item from the rubble at the mouth of the cave
h730.result: Gain item 1095. Up close, you realize the mine is better lit than you originally thought. If you dare, you may gain 1 look and continue with the look-EXPLORE action.

h731.result:
After patching a small portion of the shattered spaceship, you realize just how big of a task you’ve created for yourself. Gain destiny 1605 (place it in the center) and 1 boost. Continue

The lights flicker on, and your heart sings as the ship hovers off the ground. Gain vehicle 1434.

h732.result:
After patching a small portion of the decaying spaceship, you realize just how big of a task you’ve created for yourself. Gain destiny 1605 (place it in the center) and 1 boost. You may either stop or continue with a help--REPAIR action to weld the pieces into something more cohesive yet still nonfunctional (then read the next result only):

Continue

The further you get into the repairs, the more you’re fascinated by this particular ship. It’s similar to your vessel, but some of the technology is slightly more advanced, yet the overgrowth on the ship indicates that it crashed here long before yours. Gain 2 boost. You may either stop or continue with a help--REPAIR action to fire up the thrusters.

Continue

You step back and admire your work. This part of the spaceship is airtight, but the most difficult job remains. For the spaceship to be even semi-operational, you must rewire the navigational system. Gain 1 boost and 1 morale. You may either stop or continue with a help--REPAIR action to obtain a partial spaceship (then read the next result):

Continue

The lights flicker on, and your heart sings as the ship hovers off the ground. Gain vehicle 1434.

h733.action: HONOR the sanctity of the pearl
h733.result: It’s clear to you that this is a sacred place. You bow deeply toward the pearl and step away. Sentients in the area are pleased by the gesture of respect, and they reward you with some local ointment. Gain item 868 and continue, as the sentients assure you it’s perfectly fine to go touch the pearl.

h734.result: You have absolutely no idea what you’re doing, as your training did not include healing rifts in spacetime. With your instincts and intuition as your only guides, you find a way to fold the rift into itself as if it were quantum pizza dough. When you’re finished, you have a heightened sense of understanding of the universe. Gain lesson 1433.

h735.action: ASSIST the sentient with their work
h735.result: The sentient lowers their hands and peeks out of the orb, explaining that they’ve been trying to get it to levitate. They give you a pair of goggles linked to their own so they can see what you see (gain item 941) and ask you to scout the floating rocks to the northwest (gain quest 1675; add it horizontally to your supply).

h736.result: The task is a nice distraction from the heat. Gain item 1091 and continue.

h737.result: The sentient appreciates the gesture. “I can’t believe my dear Timber is gone,” they say. “And just days before the annual fishing challenge—they haven’t lost in years! Would you like to come inside for a few minutes? I can make tea.” Gain 1 boost; you may go to interior 588.

h738.result: The sentient appreciates the assistance as they load their boat. They steer you into the city; gain $2 and go to city 527.

h739.action: HONOR the sanctity of the island
h739.result: It’s clear to you that this is a sacred place to the pirates—not to mention one that is probably well-guarded. You bow deeply toward the island and step away. As you do, several pirates swing into the water from the jungle and return your bow. They share a flagon of ale with you and recommend you visit the spaceship wreckage to the southwest. Gain 1 morale and 1 boost.

h740.action: OFFER to help with the problem
h740.result:
The sentient says their family has been growing a tree here for the last 100 years to use for a magnificent vessel. The tree was here just a week ago, and now it’s gone! The only hope is to find the rare seeds in a cave to the southeast and somehow accelerate the growth of the tree. Choose one:

If you have item 1020

The sentient notices the seeds spilling from your pocket. They are very excited by this, and they beg you to plant the seeds here, walk through the time portal to the north, and find the future version of this location. If you accept, lose item 1020 to gain sentient 1364 and quest 1699 (add the quest horizontally to your supply). Otherwise, gain 3 boost.

If you don’t have item 1020

Gain 1 boost and 1 move.

h741.action: BUILD a business in front of the gateway, assuming this is an important junction for travel and commerce
h741.result: You sketch out a few ideas of what you might make. Gain blueprint 1298.

h742.action: SHARE your memories with the sentient
h742.result: The sentient places a floppy hand on your forehead, soaking in your knowledge and history. As a token of their appreciation, they give you a special map. Gain item 1264; the sentient highlights your current location (view page 21 in the Book of Vantages; you are in region H).

h743.action: OFFER to help, gesturing toward the sentient on the shore
h743.result: The water sentient explains that the frantic person on the shore has been accused of murder in a small vacation home to the west. They suspect foul play, so before alerting the authorities, they request your help with the investigation. Gain sentient 1359 and quest 1645 (add the quest horizontally to your supply).

h744.action: ASSIST a sentient as they debone freshly caught fish
h744.result: The sentient is grateful for the help. Before you depart, they give you a fish trap and challenge you to bring back an even bigger fish from the depths of the ocean. Gain item 910 and quest 1660 (add the quest horizontally to your supply).

h745.result: In appreciation of your unsolicited effort, the owner gives you a big hug and a few coins. Gain $2 and 1 morale.

h746.result: You sketch out a few ideas of what you might make. Gain blueprint 1294.

h747.result: You snap off a brittle piece of the nearby flora, its sap dripping down your hand. The thirsty animal laps up the liquid. Gain animal 834.

h748.action: ASSIST a sentient heading toward the city
h748.result: Their hands are full of glassblowing instruments, and they reluctantly appreciate the help. Gain $3 and go to city 531.

h749.action: BREW a mild tincture from the lotus roots
h749.result: You grind the roots into a pulp with makeshift equivalents of a mortar and pestle—plus a hearty wad of saliva—resulting in a sparkling substance. Gain item 867.

h750.result: You assumed at first that the kraken was the antagonist, but then you see how the villagers vilify the creature and throw stones at it without provocation. The kraken could have attacked them long ago, yet it didn’t. You give it permission to go to shore and live up to the reputation unfairly given to it. After the kraken returns to the sea, you find a totem among the damaged beach huts. Gain item 899 and 1 help.

h751.action: SHARE your rations with the child and their pet
h751.result: As the child munches on the food, they invite you on a grand adventure they’ve been planning for ages. Gain 1 morale, 1 boost, and quest 1643 (add it horizontally to your supply).

h752.action: RELEASE the elemental from its tether
h752.result: Without its tether, the elemental imprints onto you instead. Gain elemental 1404; if you have it, lose the matching elemental curse.

h753.result: The beautiful creature is dehydrated and exhausted; you direct some nutrients from your augsuit directly into it. The rider is grateful beyond words, and they offer to guide you to the Trial of Speed. They give you a saddle (gain item 958) and transport you north (go to 754).

h754.result: The judges cheer and welcome you to participate in the trial. Continue with the move-SPEED action.

h755.action: CRAFT a rowboat from the wreckage to give to the sentient
h755.result: With the sentient’s permission, you use some of the scrap wood from the wreckage to cobble together a small boat. The sentient offers some tips while you work, and eventually they join you. It’s a humble vessel compared to what the ship must have looked like, but it’s seaworthy. Gain vehicle 1014 and 1 morale.

h756.action: CRAFT a simple gold item from a loose intaglio on the chest
h756.result: As you remove the golden decoration from the treasure chest, you realize that what’s inside the chest could be far more valuable than the simple trinket you intended to craft. You may either continue with the take-DISMANTLE action with a cost reduced by 3 or use the gold to craft a simple zamazingo (gain item 1099).

h757.action: CRAFT a simple stone item from stones rubbed smooth by the waterfalls
h757.result: You fashion an uncomplicated doodad from the rocks. Gain item 1095.

h758.result: The beast resists your calm approach, but eventually it’s paralyzed by pain. It breathes a sigh of relief as you dislodge a bone from its throat. Gain animal 832.

h759.action: OFFER your services to the sentients
h759.result: The sentients don’t particularly want your help, but they say that if you have time to spare, you could do them a favor and protect the besieged fortress to the north. Gain $3 and quest 1659 (add it horizontally to your supply).

h760.result: The invaders offer no explanation for the battle; they simply hand you a shield and send you to war. Gain item 939 and quest 1694 (add the quest horizontally to your supply).

h761.action: ASSIST a sentient heading into the city
h761.result: The sentient is carrying a basket of assorted items—”gifts for the Founder!” they say. They give you a hug in appreciation for the help. Gain 1 morale and go north to 762.

h762.action: TEACH the sentient the nuances of your language
h762.result: The sentient is excited by the opportunity to communicate with an alien like you, and they join you on your journey. Gain sentient 1328.

h763.result: If you lose 1 item, gain 2 morale as nearby sentients praise your generosity and guide you inside the towering building (go to interior 589). If you don’t lose an item, gain 1 morale and continue.

h764.result: The sentient leans their wings against you while staggering off the street onto a bench, where you wait patiently for them to sober up. In the meantime they ask if you can help them with a task. Gain item 1158 and quest 1641 (add the quest horizontally to your supply).

h765.action: ASSIST the ground crew with a stubborn knot
h765.result:
The crewmembers are grateful for your strong fingers, and they invite you to join them for a drink at a local tavern a little south of here. Choose one:

Accept the invitation

You don’t understand much of what the sentients say, but the drinks are good and the camaraderie is a nice change of pace. Gain 1 morale. You step away for some fresh air and find yourself alone in the stables. Go to interior 590.

Politely decline the invitation

The sentients give you some pointers and bid you farewell. Gain 1 move and $2.

h766.action: PRAISE the integrity of the vessel and its passengers
h766.result: The sentient and the Traveler wave at you in gratitude before drifting away. Gain 2 morale.

h767.action: ASSIST a sentient heading toward the city
h767.result: The sentient is struggling to balance a heavy barrel of liquid and a large metal bird, so you lend a hand. Gain $3 and 1 morale.

h768.action: ASSIST the disoriented sentient to the right
h768.result: The sentient thanks you for your help but laughs off the concern—they were waiting for a friend who hasn’t shown up. You offer to accompany them instead. Gain sentient 1360.

h769.action: VOLUNTEER to help with an undesirable task
h769.result: The bulky sentient smirks and leads you to the stables, where they point at a pile of manure, flick a coin at you, and leave you alone. Gain $1 and go to interior 590.

h770.result: In appreciation of your unsolicited effort, the owner gives you a big hug and a few coins. Gain $2 and 1 morale.

h771.action: OFFER to help the crew load the ship
h771.result: The crew is happy for an extra pair of hands, and when the job is done, they offer you a choice of $3 or a barrel (gain item 1158). You may continue.

h772.action: AID the ship’s attempt to leave the bay
h772.result: Bullies tend to stand down when others stand up against them, and that’s the case here. The captain expresses their gratitude by inviting you aboard. Gain vehicle 1015.

h773.action: ASSEMBLE a crude ladder from the nearby trees
h773.result: The assembly process takes longer than you hoped, but you’re pleased with the result. Gain 1 morale and go north to 774.

h774.action: OFFER to run an errand for the sentient
h774.result: The sentient complains of vagrants slipping through the lax bridge security and robbing them in the night. They and their friend, the smelter, are desperate for protective measures, and they ask whether you could guard the bridge for the night. They toss you a few coins and speak of a greater reward later. Gain $2 and quest 1680 (add it horizontally to your supply).

h775.action: SHARE some water with the sentient
h775.result: The sentient nods appreciatively and takes a hearty swig. They comment on a piece of your armor and, after sizing you up, they ask whether you’d walk with them out of the city. If you accept, gain sentient 1334 and go southwest to 768.

h776.result: You can either learn some crafting tips from the vendor (gain ability 1462) or you can deliver a package for them (gain item 1034 and quest 1638; add the quest horizontally to your supply). Either way, they appreciate your eagerness to help, and they offer you a discounted price on a robe; you may pay $4 to gain item 966.

h777.action: OFFER your services to the structure’s occupants
h777.result: The sentient salutes your assistance and offers to pay you to keep watch while they take a break. You may either gain 1 boost and continue, or lose 1 time to gain $5.

h778.result: You clear the tree of dead branches and rotten fruit. A local juice vendor notices the effort and gives you a half-empty barrel in gratitude. Gain item 1158.

h779.result: As you describe your vantage, the group feels a sense of camaraderie. Each player may gain 1 random skill. If the random skill you gain matches that of any other player, you gain 1 morale. If not, gain destiny 1599 (place it in the center).

h780.action: CRAFT a simple wood curio while enjoying the background noise of rushing water
h780.result: Your mind wanders to and from the crafting process, so the end result is a surprise even to you. Gain item 1094.

h781.action: CONSOLE the sentient on the left
h781.result: The sentient sobs about the loss of an item that they crafted as a gift, but the kindness of a stranger is uplifting to them. Gain sentient 1344; you may offer to join them on a calming stroll through the gardens to the south (go to 780).

h782.result: The sentient appears ashamed to accept your aid, but they reluctantly agree. They are being chased by the sentient lurking in the background, and they need an armed escort to the east. Gain sentient 1353 and quest 1665 (add the quest horizontally to your supply).

h783.result: You sense that something is weighing on the gold sentient’s bulky shoulders. They lower their voice to admit that they’re not supposed to leave their post at the bank’s vault before their replacement arrives, and now they’re worried that no one is guarding the treasure inside. Gain 2 boost. “Would you mind checking for me?” they ask. If you accept, go to cave 030.

h784.action: BUILD a structure from the framework of the ruins
h784.result: Examining what remains of the ancient floorplan, you sketch out a few ideas of what you might make. Gain blueprint 1294.

h785.action: VOLUNTEER your support those on the bridge
h785.result: The guards atop the bridge look at each other and nod in agreement. As they pull you up, they share that budget cuts to the city watch have resulted in waves of thieves crossing the bridge at night. Gain $1 and quest 1680 (add it horizontally to your supply).

h786.result: The three broad-shouldered guards chuckle at your offer, assuring you that your services would be better employed elsewhere. In fact, they mention that the bridge to the south could use some help. Gain 1 engage and quest 1680 (add it horizontally to your supply). You may continue.

h787.result: Refresh X challenge dice in your grid (you may not refresh dice placed during this action). Then, if there are no challenge dice in your grid, gain 1 health, and you may continue.

h788.result:
All the sentient requests is that you serve as a distraction for the other vendors in the square for 5 seconds—that’s all it’ll take for them to rob each of them, and they’ll split the proceeds with you. Choose one:

Agree to the heist

You pretend to faint with as much dramatic flair as you can muster. When the crowd finally realizes you’re okay, you meet the sentient off to the side, and they commend your effort. Gain ability 1481 and $5.

Snitch on the thief

You announce the sentient’s intentions to the other vendors, who drive away the thief, but not before they curse you for your betrayal. Fortunately, the vendors share their appreciation with you. Gain curse 1391, 1 morale, and 1 health.

h789.action: OFFER to find a rare item for the sentient
h789.result: The sentient gestures to the far north, requesting that you obtain an aether lantern for them. It’s being held indoors by energy sentients. Gain 1 move and quest 1648 (add it horizontally to your supply).

h790.action: BUILD a better stand for the book
h790.result: Such an important book deserves a truly impressive pedestal. The author of the book takes notice and decides to put a better copy of the book on the stand; they give you the older copy. Gain item 1045.

h791.action: RESCUE the child in the life support capsule
h791.result:
A young girl is locked into a peaceful, centuries-long cryogenic slumber. As you observe her, the Traveler appears by your side, their holographic visage gesturing toward the chamber. “I’ve wandered this planet as a hologram for far too long. I love this world, but I miss my home. Please don’t risk removing me from this chamber. You are my only hope.” If you have mission 1596, read entry 791 in the Book of Secrets. Otherwise, gain 1 boost and destiny 1605. You may either exit to 732 (this option is recommended if you already have a spaceship or a vehicle you are in the process of upgrading to a spaceship) or continue with a help--REPAIR action to start the rebuilding process in the hopes of rescuing the child (then read the next result only). If you decide to exit, you can return later to perform this action:

Continue

After patching a small portion of the shattered spaceship, you realize just how big of a task you’ve created for yourself. Gain 2 boost. You may either stop or continue with a help--REPAIR action to weld the pieces into something more cohesive yet still nonfunctional (then read the next result only):

Continue

You step back and admire your work. This part of the spaceship is airtight, but the most difficult job remains. For the spaceship to be even semi-operational, you must rewire it and fix the power supply. Gain 1 morale and 1 help. You may either stop or continue with a help--REPAIR action to obtain a partial spaceship (then read the next result):

Continue

The lights flicker on, and your heart sings as the ship hovers off the ground. Gain vehicle 1434, the Traveler safe and sound inside. You don’t know what the future holds for them, but you are hopeful that the esteemed medical crew on your homeworld will help to save them.

h795.action: HONOR the sanctity of the cathedral
h795.result: As you kneel, a metal sentient emerges from the shadows and taps you on the shoulder. “Excuse me,” they say. “What are you doing?” They go on to say that this building has been left to the sands of time, which is ironic given that the stained glass window was designed by ancient sand sentients to honor the interconnected nature of the past, present, and future. The sentient is planning to steal the book, but they let you look at it first. View page 23 of the Book of Vantages, then gain 2 boost and exit to 281.

h799.result: Part of an old ladder leans against the far wall, as if another prisoner attempted to escape but didn’t complete the job. You’re able to make it tall enough to reach halfway up the wall. Gain 3 move and continue.

h801.result: You kneel before the precious shard—surely it must be precious to be hidden on such a remote sky island. As you bow your head, the shard drifts toward you. Perhaps it does not wish to be kept hidden any longer. Gain item 1707.

h1655.result:
Choose one:

Clean some of the gold-like fungal growth from the sentient’s exterior

The gold peels away, but you worry it will return soon. The sentient mentions that a landwalker friend of theirs to the east is developing a cure. Gain 1 morale and 1 boost.

Pay 2 boost from item 865

You apply the antidote to the gold-encrusted areas on the sentient, and within minutes they begin to dissolve into the water. The sentient, free of pain for the first time in ages, thanks you profusely and gives you $10. While they don’t think their fellow water sentients will care about their renewed health, they know their leaf friend will. Rotate and add quest 1655 to your grid.

h1662.action: BREW a stew (requires at least 1 flora)
h1662.result: Sinew sentients are vegetarian, but with limited ingredients you are able to brew stew your grandmother would be proud of. The sentients greedily slurp the soup, and they all have opinions about what you could do to add more depth to the flavor. One even hands you a recipe book (gain item 1223) and encourages you to keep cooking. Rotate quest 1662 and add it to your grid.

h1663.result:
Choose one, depending on your circumstances:

If you’re not on a location with a skeleton

Refresh all challenge dice other than those placed for this action and continue.

If you’re on a location with a skeleton

Randomize animals 1218–1220 not in any player’s grid or reserve and gain 1 at random.

h1669.action: PLACE a flag so it captures the wind
h1669.result: As soon as you place the flag in the ground, the wind tosses it to life, much to the pleasure of the onlooking elder. Place a token on quest 1669 relative to location 180 (where you gained quest 1669).

h1687.action: HEAL yourself (if you already have 5 or 6 health, perform another action)
h1687.result: You tend to your wounds in the safety of home. Gain 2 health.
