h1695.action: TEACH the fire sentient about the science and art of spaceship construction
h1695.result: Gain 1 token on quest 1695, then gain 1 help for each token on this quest. If there are now 3 tokens on this quest, remove them and read 1695 in the Book of Secrets..

h1701.result: You tend to your wounds in the safety of home. Gain 2 health.

h1705.action: PRAISE and appreciate the rescue team for their efforts, ending your adventure
h1705.result: The game ends as you head back to your homeworld, and you achieve an epic victory if you have also completed the mission. Otherwise, it is impressive that you survived long enough to control your destiny, and your knowledge of the planet will benefit you in the future.

l12.action: SEARCH as far into the interior as you dare venture
l12.result: You’re able to reach a pile of coins near the back of the shipwreck (gain $10). Calmly exit to 649.

l13.result: The glowing lamp at the rear of the interior indicates that this hostel may not be as abandoned as it first appeared. You find a mysterious tunnel leading west into the darkness. Gain 2 move and continue.

l19.action: SOLVE the glyph puzzle on the door
l19.result: Your mind sometimes surprises you, and you’re able to trace the glyphs in the correct order. The door slides open. Gain 1 boost and go deeper into the planet to cave 046.

l20.result: After close examination, you determine that there is no option other than to swap out the magnetic rocks with something of similar size and weight, and you scour the cave entrance for the perfect object. Gain 1 take and continue.

l21.result: After close examination, you determine that there is no option other than to leap, and you calculate the perfect angle for an attempt. Before you do, you may pay 1 take or 2 boost to carefully unplug a device near the edge (gain item 988). Gain 1 move and continue.

l22.result: After close examination, you determine that there is no option other than to modify the laser array, and you calculate the perfect angle to redirect the beams. Gain 1 help and continue.

l23.result: After close examination, you determine that there is no option other than to destroy the gate, and you calculate the perfect angle for an attempt. Gain 1 overpower and continue.

l24.result: The barrier is a pitch-black, endless void. Finally you emerge much deeper into the planet; go to cave 084.

l25.result: After close examination, you determine that there is no option other than to destroy the gate, and you calculate the perfect angle for an attempt. Gain 1 overpower and continue.

l26.result: After close examination, you determine that there is no option other than to swap out the widgets with something of similar size and weight, and you scour the cave entrance for the perfect object. Gain 1 take and continue.

l27.result: After close examination, you determine that there is no option other than to modify the laser array, and you calculate the perfect angle to redirect the beams. Gain 1 help and continue.

l28.result: After close examination, you determine that there is no option other than to befriend the sentinel, and you calculate the perfect conversation starter. Gain 1 engage and continue.

l29.result: After close examination, you determine that there is no option other than to modify the laser array, and you calculate the perfect angle to redirect the beams. Gain 2 help and continue.

l30.result: After close examination, you determine that there is no option other than to befriend the sentinel, and you calculate the perfect conversation starter. Gain 1 engage and continue.

l31.result: After close examination, you determine that there is no option other than to befriend the sentinel, and you calculate the perfect conversation starter. Gain 1 engage and continue.

l32.result: After close examination, you determine that there is no option other than to destroy the gate, and you calculate the perfect angle for an attempt. Gain 1 overpower and continue.

l33.result: After close examination, you determine that there is no option other than to leap, and you calculate the perfect angle for an attempt. Gain 1 move and continue.

l34.result: After close examination, you determine that there is no option other than to befriend the sentinel, and you calculate the perfect conversation starter. Gain 1 engage and continue.

l35.result: After close examination, you determine that there is no option other than to swap out the jelly-like substance with something of similar weight, and you scour the cave entrance for the perfect object. Gain 1 take and continue.

l36.result: The barrier is a pitch-black, endless void. Finally you emerge much deeper into the planet; go to cave 096.

l37.result: After close examination, you determine that there is no option other than to destroy the gate, and you calculate the perfect angle for an attempt. Gain 1 overpower and continue.

l38.result: After close examination, you determine that there is no option other than to swap out the stones with something of similar weight, and you scour the cave entrance for the perfect object. Gain 1 take and continue.

l39.result: The barrier is a pitch-black, endless void. Finally you emerge much deeper into the planet; go to cave 099.

l40.result: There are several ways you could approach the artifact, each as difficult as the next. Choose one: Gain 1 random skill and 1 skill of your choice, refresh all challenge dice from a row of your grid, or gain 1 boost on each card in a column of your grid. Continue.

l41.action: NAVIGATE the dark, labyrinthine alleys and arches until you reach a mysterious business
l41.result:
You feel a wave of nausea as you enter a den of dark magic, despite how eager the sentients inside are to share their knowledge with you. Choose one:

Learn the building blocks for controlling memory

Gain lesson 1430.

Learn the foundational elements for transfiguring items

Gain lesson 1432.

l42.result: After comparing each of the images—which appear to be live footage from hidden cameras—you notice that each of the interiors contains a ring with a different gem. One camera appears to be offline. Gain ability 1492 and 5 boost; exit to city 041.

l43.action: OBSERVE the nest from a safe distance
l43.result: The squishy sound of dozens of baby centipedes roiling in the nest makes your skin crawl. You distract yourself by scanning other parts of the cave, and it’s then that you notice a small hole on the right. Gain 1 boost; you may go deeper into the planet to cave 040.

l44.result: The creature places its entire mouth over you and then inhales sharply—it’s smelling you. While you’re inside the jaws of the centipede, you notice a flash of blue on one of its teeth. The beast withdraws, slithering slowly past you. Gain 1 morale and 1 boost; you may continue.

l45.result: The sentient is in full control of the monstrosity, and they seem to be enjoying the ride. Within a few seconds they disappear down the tunnel to the right. It’s then that you notice another tunnel in front of you with a much smaller opening. Gain 1 boost; you may go deeper into the planet to cave 040.

l46.result: From the north you can hear the sounds of sentients shouting and struggling. As you touch the walls of the tunnel, you feel the vibrations of something massive moving to the south. Gain 2 boost and continue.

l47.action: LEARN from the hunters from a safe distance
l47.result: In an incredibly entertaining battle of wills, the sinew sentients eventually drag the beast to the ground. Gain ability 1473.

l48.action: OBSERVE the beast as it exits the cavern
l48.result: As the tip of the creature’s tail disappears down the tunnel, it flicks to the left, poking a hole through the sediment. A beam of light erupts through the tiny gap. Gain 1 boost; you may go deeper into the planet to cave 040.

l49.result: As you look around, you’re convinced that you’re inside a giant animal, not a cave. It must be asleep, though, as it’s not moving. Wedged onto a nearby spike is a beautiful ring covered in saliva, its blue gem glinting in the light of the cavern behind you. Gain item 991 and 1 move.

l50.result: After close examination, you determine that there is no option other than to leap, and you calculate the perfect angle for an attempt. Gain 1 move and continue.

l59.result: There is no tide and no wind, and it requires careful navigation to escape the doldrums. Gain ability 1464 and 1 morale, then roll a skill die and go to where the tides take you: move (062); look (053); engage (431); help (453); take (367); overpower (426).

l61.action: SEARCH for an entrance to the nearby island
l61.result: Upon arriving at a hidden cove, you realize that it’s part of a small archipelago. Gain ability 1515 and go to 512.

l76.result: Roll 3 skill dice. Gain 1 morale for each help result, then gain 1 health. As you listen, you notice another sound—there are people talking inside the building, one level up. Gain 1 move and continue.

l77.result: The sentients are so engrossed in their game that they still don’t notice your presence. Both are armed. You can feel air flowing from another level above, but due to the wind chimes, there’s no way to get up there without alerting the sentients. Gain 2 boost and continue.

l78.result: The lonely sentient is eager to share the mechanics of wind harvesting. Lotuses release a substance into the air, and it can be harvested and processed by devices like this one. The resulting substance is powerful but addictive. The sentient begs you to help them escape. Gain 2 help and continue.

l79.action: FOCUS on the ancient markings on the pillar
l79.result: The tiny runes that form the leyline seem to lift off the pillar and float into your mind. Gain spell 1368.

l80.result: The sentient looks like they could use some help, but they’re also so occupied with their task that they should be easy to sneak around. Gain 1 boost and 1 move; you may continue.

l81.result: Beyond the servers, in the back of the cavern, the sediment is so thin that you can see movement on the far side. Gain either 1 move or 1 overpower; you may continue.

l82.result: You kneel at the edge of the stream, positioning your ear just over the ice to determine its structural integrity. To your surprise, carrying through the frozen water are the voices of several sentients yelling at each other. Gain either 1 move or 1 take; you may continue.

l83.result: You toss a stone through the arch, and while you can’t find it in the back of the cavern, you do discover a partially blocked passage that may lead deeper into the planet. Gain 1 boost and continue.

l84.action: SEARCH for a path that leads to the yellow crystal
l84.result: A blind corner to your right leads to a path that extends around the cavern to a staircase descending directly to the crystal. It’s far too large for you to carry, but a generous piece breaks off into your hand. Gain item 1164 and 1 random skill. You may continue with a move action on this location.

l85.result: You could compete, but it might be easier just to bet on a few fighters instead. Either way, if you’re short on coins, you may need to steal from some nearby spectators. Gain 1 boost, and gain either 1 take or 1 overpower; you may continue.

l86.result: The lava is both a barrier and an abundant resource for you to use as you wish. As your eyes adjust to the bright light, you also see a faint glow in the back of the cavern that could lead even deeper into the planet. Gain 2 boost and continue.

l87.result: There’s a lot to absorb in the busy cavern. The guards are distracted, so you could sneak around them to the back of the cave. You could also talk to the miners about what they’re doing or even rescue one of them, as some are chained to their posts. Gain 1 boost and 1 engage; you may continue.

l88.result: Amidst the endless tangle of roots and crystals is the beginning of a tunnel that is abruptly cut off by glowing sediment: something beyond, something deeper. Based on footprints in the moss, you suspect that there’s even more activity to the north. Gain 2 boost and continue.

l89.result: Vibrant green crystals light the soft soil of the cavern; upon closer examination, you see tiny fruits growing around them. Gain item 1224 and continue.

l90.result: Hidden among the coins and jewelry is a glimmer of something special: A glowing, ethereal key. Gain item 917 and 1 morale.

l91.result: It’s sturdy, with a solid lock and ornate gold trim. Gain 2 boost and continue.

l92.action: EXAMINE the porous exterior of the cavern
l92.result: As you look closely at the gaping holes, you realize that the water abruptly ends in some kind of underwater oxygen bubble, perhaps due to a pressure anomaly. Beyond the cavern you see row upon row of giant, jagged teeth. Gain 1 boost and 1 move; you may continue.

l93.result:
Choose one of the three paths (from left to right: blue, orange, or green):

blue

After following a winding path, you reach a dead end. Etched into the wall are some clues for completing the maze. Gain 1 boost; you may pay 1 morale to try again.

orange

This route ends abruptly, so abruptly that you almost miss the sentient sitting on the ground. They’re mumbling to themselves and drawing lines in the air. You console them until they calm down, at which point they share what they know about the maze. Gain ability 1464; you may pay 1 morale to try again.

green

An endless series of twists and turns leads you to the end of the maze. Go deeper into the planet to cave 043.

l94.result: A door on the western side of the underground city is ajar. You catch a glimpse of an array of computer screens inside. If you enter, go to interior 042. Otherwise, go to city 041 and gain 1 random skill.

l95.result: Each contains a tiny, 8-legged animal. Out of the corner of your eye you see a large creature staring at you. Gain 1 boost and continue.

l96.action: OBSERVE the dragon while it prepares for another strike
l96.result: From the copious amounts of drool dripping from the dragon’s jaw, you gather that it’s hungry. You also notice how thin the air is in this cavern—perhaps the dragon doesn’t need oxygen the way you do? Choose one: Gain 1 random skill and 1 skill of your choice, refresh all challenge dice from a row of your grid, or gain 1 boost on each card in a column of your grid. Continue.

l97.result: Up close, you can see that these devices are ancient—it’s quite possible they’re the original runecasters, first of their kind, enclosed in this cavern so that their radioactive decay doesn’t destroy the world. As compelled as you are to feel the sheer power of activating them, you know the smart move is to turn around or exit through the door in the rear. Gain 2 boost and continue.

l98.result: You find a method to the madness of the underground pathways, and soon you find yourself facing a glowing door that leads deeper into the planet. Go deeper into the planet to cave 044.

l99.result: Something clicks as you study the glyphs, which seem to depict the evolution of the planet from nothing to a thriving world. An asteroid couldn’t have brought so many different elements through the vacuum of space. But a spaceship from an already evolved world could have seeded this planet with the origins of life. Gain 2 boost.

l100.result: As a peculiar scent percolates, an odd sensation fills your mind—the sentient is talking to you through their odor! “Greetings,” they say, “and welcome to the forest. Please take care to not step on any flora. Would you like a guide through these lands?” Gain sentient 1351.

l101.result: As you watch, there is a blur of movement. One second, the animal is chewing on a leaf; the next, it’s holding one of your possessions. It drops it off the rock as if to say, “Take it back so I can have another go.” Gain 1 boost and 1 engage; you may continue.

l102.result: It’s brand new, with a solid lock and ornate gold trim. Gain 2 boost and continue.

l103.result: You sit down and let the animals come to you. You sense a level of intelligence in their eyes as they examine your clothing and chirp to each other. Having deemed you more friend than foe, they climb into your arms and signal for you to carry them across the stream. Through unknown means they open a door hidden in the boulder and hop into the darkness. Go to cave 095.

l104.result: As you reach for the cloak, the animal vanishes into thin air. You have a few seconds to study the details of your current location before there’s a flurry of movement in the grove, then the trap door slams shut. Go to 511 and continue.

l105.result: You can’t be sure without testing it, but this beastly bird might be big enough to carry you short distances in the sky. Gain 1 boost and 1 random skill; you may continue.

l106.result: The runes etched into the ancient stone speak to you as you begin to comprehend them. You’re looking at a portal to other parts of the world. Stepping through it would teleport you to a distant island. Gain 2 boost and 1 move; you may continue.

l107.result: Each player—including you—on a location with any rune (a skill icon within their vantage) gains 1 boost. Then you roll X skill dice and gain all results matching the rune on this location. Also gain quest 1706 if a player doesn’t already have it (add it horizontally to your supply and place the first token on it).

l108.result: You perceptively notice that the mushrooms are planted intentionally close to the shield. Choose one: Gain 1 random skill and 1 skill of your choice, refresh all challenge dice from a row of your grid, or gain 1 boost on each card in a column of your grid. Continue.

l109.result: The sentient seems to understand the hummingbird-like animal, which rapidly darts in all directions. The sentient seems the happiest when the bird flies right past your ear from the south to deliver some news. Gain 1 boost and 2 help; you may continue.

l110.result: Your impressive feat of memory impresses the leaf animals, who welcome you to participate in the trial. Gain 1 help and continue with the help-CREATE action.

l111.result: The orb is made of a shimmering, glasslike substance, so it must have taken immense strength to break it. You notice trampled shrubbery leading to the east. Gain item 1194 and 1 boost; you may continue.

l112.result: The creature eyes you as it slurps the freshwater, and it wags its “tail” eagerly. It’s excited to meet you! Gain 1 boost and 1 engage; you may continue.

l113.result: The lotus smells a bit like coconut. Gain 1 health from the purifying pollen; you may also lose 1 curse.

l114.result: Gain lesson 1432, 2 boost, and 1 look.

l115.action: SPY on the building through a window
l115.result: Through the stained glass you see a room filled with maps, books, and crystals. Gain 2 boost and 1 move; you may continue.

l116.action: LISTEN to the Traveler talk about your mission
l116.result: “If you’re trying to map the world, this is a great place to advance that goal.” Gain 1 boost and continue.

l117.result: You perceptively notice the runes painted on the rocks surrounding the Darkstone. Choose one: Gain 1 random skill and 1 skill of your choice, refresh all challenge dice from a row of your grid, or gain 1 boost on each card in a column of your grid. You may continue with the take-EXTRACT action.

l118.result: The animal saw you well before you saw it, and your unassuming stance motivates it to slow down and drift over to you. It smells your hand and licks it affectionately. Gain animal 804.

l119.result: The sentient, who introduces themselves as a philanthropist, starts by talking about the nearby runes and flowers, then the wishing well to the south, then the Darkstone to the west… you barely have time to introduce yourself. Gain sentient 1353.

l120.result: “It’s bittersweet that both life and death stem from such devastation. Fire sentients are born of volcanoes like this one— you are entering their realm. Those whom I’ve met are fierce and protective, and if you prove that you can endure just like the fire or the sea, they will respect you.” Gain 2 boost and continue.

l121.result: The owner of the boat isn’t far from here, so you could either catch their attention or try to slip away in the boat before they notice. Gain 1 boost, and gain either 1 move or 1 engage; you may continue.

l122.result: You’re surrounded by artifacts and technology. To the north you see a fragment of your ship, and to the east lies an array of futuristic technology. To the south is a large, dark stone that tugs at something deep within you. Gain 3 boost.

l123.result: You feel a surge of wisdom as you study the stone and the rune etched into it. For a brief moment you see a vision from the past—this neutral area of the world was set aside to invite civilizations beyond this world to visit. Gain 1 boost.

l124.result: The only entrance you find is the towering, illuminated front door. Then several metal sentients glide through the energy shield with ease. Gain 1 boost and either 1 engage or 1 take; go to interior 554.

l125.result:
As you face the molten labyrinth, you have a choice. Choose one:

Pay 4 boost to navigate through the lava tunnels to reach the artifact

Ignoring the elaborate puzzle, you simply use your navigation skills to reach the artifact. Gain item 998 and perform no other location actions here.

Attempt to solve the puzzle

Find card 532 (it’s a large card) and place it on the table. You can only bear the heat long enough to venture down one path. The goal is to choose which of the 3 tunnels to enter so that you can follow a continuous path to the artifact in the back left. The first row represents the three tunnel entrances—it is static and correct. After the first row, each square is in the correct row and the correct orientation (i.e., no rotating), though not necessarily in the correct column. Visually rearrange the squares in each row to ultimately declare the tunnel you wish to enter. See entry 125 in the Book of Secrets for the solution.

l126.result: The chest is sturdy (but a little corroded by the sulfuric fumes), with a solid lock and ornate gold trim. Gain 2 boost and continue.

l127.action: LISTEN to the Traveler talk about this passage
l127.result: “This passage is unique because it starts (in the east) with a priceless sword and ends (to the north) with another priceless sword. If you’re trying to collect such artifacts, you’re in the right place.” Gain 1 boost and continue.

l128.result: The sentient, a famous knight, chooses the nearby plain of igneous rock as the dueling grounds for this combat puzzle. Find card 533 (it’s a large card) and place it on the table. Your goal is to force the knight into a pit. As the knight warms up, you notice that they always move in the opposite direction of their opponent (e.g., if their opponent moves east, the knight moves west). When you’re ready, place a red token representing you and a green token representing the knight on the starting spaces on card 533. Start by moving your token 1 square (not into rocks, pits, or off the grounds), then move their token 1 square in the opposite direction (they don’t move if they would move into a rock or off the grounds). Repeat this until you force the knight into a pit or share the same square with the knight. Then read entry 128 in the Book of Secrets.

l129.result: It’s almost as if someone placed a giant puzzle box in the middle of the ocean—you’re confident that there’s something inside to loot. Gain 1 boost and 1 take; you may continue.

l130.result: While both sentients are having fun, the sentient on the left seems to be winning disproportionately often. Gain 1 boost and 1 random skill; you may continue.

l131.action: SPY through an open seam in the tent
l131.result: You’re confident that there’s something inside to loot, and sure enough, you see a circuit board. Gain 1 boost and 1 take; go to interior 550.

l132.result: As you inspect the sword closely, you notice an inscription on the blade. “The Katana of Life. Thou shall cut but not kill; thou shall cleave but not maim.” Choose one: Gain 1 random skill and 1 skill of your choice, refresh all challenge dice from a row of your grid, or gain 1 boost on each card in a column of your grid. Continue.

l133.result: You feel a surge of inspiration as green energy seeps from the spire into your hands. The power to heal advanced technology is contained within these ancient stones, and now it is part of you. Gain spell 1371.

l134.result: Each player—including you—on a location with any rune (a skill icon within their vantage) gains 1 boost. Then you roll X skill dice and gain all results matching the rune on this location. Also gain quest 1706 if a player doesn’t already have it (add it horizontally to your supply and place the first token on it).

l135.action: SCAN the ruins for anything useful
l135.result: You identify a bedroll among the rubble. Gain 1 boost and 1 look; go to interior 541.

l136.action: SCAN the area from the tower
l136.result: View page 45 of the Book of Vantages and gain 2 boost.

l137.result: It looks like the beast died long ago from blunt force trauma. There is a stillness to the air around the skeleton, and you can’t decide whether to use the bones to your advantage or delve underneath. Gain 2 boost and continue.

l138.result: The lotus smells a bit like coconut. Gain 1 health from the purifying pollen; you may also lose 1 curse.

l139.result: You feel a surge of wisdom as you study the stone and the rune etched into it. For a brief moment you see a vision from the not-so-distant past—this confluence is a meeting place between leaf and water sentients. Gain 1 boost.

l140.action: LISTEN to the Traveler talk about your mission
l140.result: “If you’re trying to learn magic, the spires to the northwest and southeast of here might expand your mind.” Gain 1 boost and continue.

l141.result: It looks like the beast died from some sort of projectile, perhaps a hunting weapon. There is a stillness to the air around the skeleton, and you can’t decide whether to use the bones to your advantage or delve underneath. Gain 2 boost and continue.

l142.result: The wreckage in front of you is from your ship, but the Traveler was clearly on this planet before you, so you listen curiously as they explain how your ship could be an older model than theirs. “I’m from the future—around 100 years from now, based on my current calculations. I crashed here after a chronological error caused by a terraforming experiment, so even though I’m from the future, I crashed here in the distant past. Frankly I’m amazed that my body has survived this long—it’s in my ship far to the east of here.” Gain 1 boost and destiny 1605 (place it in the center); you may continue.

l143.result: You shouldn’t have a problem squeezing into one of the escape pod ports. It’s surprising that, despite the plummet from outer space, this part of the ship seems operational. Gain 1 boost and destiny 1605 (place it in the center); you may continue.

l144.action: LEARN the sentient’s area of expertise
l144.result: The sentient is hesitant to share the secrets of the lotus with you, but they acknowledge your good intentions. Lotuses are a source of health and renewal, but they can be highly addictive when brewed and consumed. The sentient offers you a map showing where lotuses can be found, including one to the southwest of here. Gain item 1257 and 1 boost; the sentient highlights your current location on the map (view page 14 in the Book of Vantages; you are in region O).

l145.result: An injured bird perches on the stone, and a splash of energy envelops its body. It flies away in perfect health. Gain ability 1483, 2 boost, and 1 help; you may continue.

l146.result: The runes behind the sentient pulse with an energy similar to that of the sentient. There is both a sadness and a joy to the energy, and you can see that the sentient is carrying a cylindrical parchment. Gain 1 morale, and gain either 1 engage or 1 help; you may continue.

l147.result: For each other player, gain 1 skill matching their character’s leftmost challenge die slot. If you are the only player, gain any 1 skill instead. You may continue.

l148.result: The landscape is peaceful and quiet with not much of note other than the ship wreckage to the south. In the serenity of the moment, you almost miss a bird flying too close to the surface of the sea and getting swallowed whole by an underwater leviathan. Gain 2 boost and continue.

l149.action: INSPECT the ethereal area at the base of the hill
l149.result: As you stand within the green light, you feel a growing sense of connection with and control over the varied forms of life that surround you. Gain lesson 1419.

l150.result: Despite its fiery disposition, the animal actually just seems to want to help. As you watch, it darts behind you and blocks a volcanic fireball from striking this tiny island, saving you from a nasty burn. Gain 1 boost and 1 random skill; you may continue.

l151.result: Each player—including you—on a location with any rune (a skill icon within their vantage) gains 1 boost. Then you roll X skill dice and gain all results matching the rune on this location. Also gain quest 1706 if a player doesn’t already have it (add it horizontally to your supply and place the first token on it).

l152.result: The odor has a hint of sea salt and sword blades. Gain 1 boost and continue.

l153.result: You perceptively notice that the six large birds nearby are all poised to strike anyone who steps foot onto the island. Choose one: Gain 1 random skill and 1 skill of your choice, refresh all challenge dice from a row of your grid, or gain 1 boost on each card in a column of your grid. Continue.

l154.result: The Traveler looks stoically to the north. “Beware of the fire elemental—they will try to trick you into releasing them. It’s a more powerful gesture to lay down your weapons to the east of it.” Gain 2 boost and continue.

l155.result: “East of here you’ll find a true rarity in this world, a portal that sends you to a faraway location. Please be cautious about entering such portals, as it’s a one-way trip.” Gain ability 1498 and 1 boost.

l156.action: LISTEN to the Traveler as they communicate with the large insect
l156.result: The Traveler gently coaxes the fiery insect, which perches on a nearby rock. As scary as it looks, it seems like it’s looking for a way to help. Gain ability 1500 and 1 boost.

l157.result: You toss a pebble through the arch, and it doesn’t splash into the water on the other side. Gain 1 boost and continue.

l158.result: The sentient is distractedly drawing diagrams of a vehicle in the sand. As you watch them, you find yourself fixating on the rune on the rock. Each player—including you—on a location with any rune (a skill icon within their vantage) gains 1 boost. Then you roll X skill dice and gain all results matching the rune on this location. Also gain quest 1706 if a player doesn’t already have it (add it horizontally to your supply and place the first token on it).

l159.result: The scalding lava would instantly wound you, but these creatures seem to be bathing in it. There is something ritualistic about their movements, as if they are simultaneously relaxing in and guiding the lava. One of the sentients sports an elaborate array of tattoos. Gain 2 boost and continue.

l160.result: A pair of burly sentients is guarding the entrance from the shadows. Inside the building, you can hear a constant clanking and the whistle of bellows—you’re pretty sure this is a forge. Gain 2 boost and 1 move; you may continue.

l161.result: The sentient explains that you’re both standing on their mother, a fledgling volcano, and their duty is to release the lava so that the volcano can expand and flourish. It seems like tiring work, so you could violently smash the rock along with them. Gain 1 boost and continue.

l162.action: SEARCH for a back-alley entrance after crossing the inlet
l162.result: A door on the eastern side of the city is propped open to release the intense heat. You hear the clang of metal inside. If you enter, gain 1 look, go to city 525, and continue with the look-NAVIGATE action there. Otherwise, go to city 525.

l163.result: The beast rocks back and forth as if hoping you’ll play with it or give it a treat. Gain 1 boost and either 1 engage or 1 help; you may continue.

l164.action: PREPARE to sneak over to the eye
l164.result: You perceptively notice a large figure lurking below the surface of the lava. Choose one: Gain 1 random skill and 1 skill of your choice, refresh all challenge dice from a row of your grid, or gain 1 boost on each card in a column of your grid. Continue.

l165.result: You find a tight gap in the wreckage that you might be able to squeeze through. It’s surprising that, despite the plummet from outer space, this part of the ship seems operational. Gain 1 boost and destiny 1605 (place it in the center); you may continue.

l166.action: SPY on the house from a safe distance
l166.result: You can see shadows moving around the house, but before you move any closer, you notice the pustules on the tree near you are ready to burst. It’s probably safest to greet the occupants from your current position. Gain 1 boost and 1 engage; you may continue.

l167.result: The sentient is too exhausted to explain much, but they share the basics of smelting with you and warn you of the elemental to the east. Gain ability 1475 and 1 boost.

l168.action: PREPARE to interact with the elemental
l168.result: Choose one: Gain 1 random skill and 1 skill of your choice, refresh all challenge dice from a row of your grid, or gain 1 boost on each card in a column of your grid. Then continue with either the help-RELEASE action or the overpower-SLAY action.

l169.result: You can’t miss the massive elemental to the west of here, entrapped within a barrier nearly identical to the one before you. The Traveler explains that long ago, a fire wizard invented a way to forge new elementals. Their people decided to destroy this knowledge and never use it, as it would cause the end of the world. Gain 2 boost and continue.

l170.action: EXAMINE the rock and the arch
l170.result:
The sight is so completely foreign that you don’t know what the structure does, but you do recognize that the stone would fit perfectly in the concavity on the left side of the arch. Choose one:

Leave the rock alone

Gain 1 boost and continue.

Pay 2 boost or 1 move to push the rock into the concavity

The rock slides seamlessly into place. As it does, a jolt surges up your spine and down your arms. You’ve been endowed with a new power. Gain spell 1367.

l171.result: You avoid the lava while inspecting the orb. The orb is made of a shimmering, glass-like substance, and there are markings on the outside with which you might be able to interact. You don’t see how to access the interior, but there must be a way inside. Gain 1 boost and either 1 engage or 1 take; you may continue.

l172.action: NAVIGATE the boat away from the volcano
l172.result:
None of the leaf sentients on the ship are at the helm when you drag yourself onto the deck, so you take over while they compliment your navigation skills. Choose one:

Guide the boat to the northwest shoreline

In gratitude, the sentients put you on their shoulders and carry you over the ridge. During the trek, they discuss plans for their quest to free some enslaved miners to the north. Gain 1 time and quest 1671 (add it horizontally to your supply), then go to 252.

Guide the boat to the east of the volcano

The sentients grumble that you’ve steered them away from their destination to the northwest, but they’re happy to be alive. Gain 1 morale and $3, then go to 173.

l173.result: Each player—including you—on a location with any rune (a skill icon within their vantage) gains 1 boost. Then you roll X skill dice and gain all results matching the rune on this location. Also gain quest 1706 if a player doesn’t already have it (add it horizontally to your supply and place the first token on it).

l174.result: Your impressive feat of memory impresses the fire sentients, who welcome you to participate in the trial. Continue with the take-ENDURE action.

l175.result: You take a few steps back, which seems to assure the sentient that you don’t want any trouble. A whiff of the sparkling substance somehow both enhances and numbs your senses at the same time, and you’re simultaneously aware of some dancing sentients to the east, a large animal in the south, and an elemental monster to the west. Lose 1 health and gain 3 boost; you may continue.

l176.action: OBSERVE the sentients as they flail in the wind
l176.result: You’re worried at first, but then your concerns turn to laughter as you realize the sentients are dancing around the twister! They might even be creating the funnel of dust with their wings. There is a pattern to their dance, and you quickly memorize it. Gain ability 1469; you may continue.

l177.result: You notice that there are a number of winged sentients in the area, but they all steer clear of this particular patch of land. It is probably sacred to them, and you’re pleased with yourself for figuring that out. Gain 1 morale and 1 boost; you may continue.

l178.result: You pretend not to notice the sentient while you inspect the flowers with care. They’re beautiful, and they give you a sense of appreciation for the life around you, but there is also something sad about them. Gain quest 1629 (add it horizontally to your supply).

l179.result: The sentient is completely absorbed by the flowers, touching them, taking samples, even whispering to them. It’s endearing to see someone so entranced by nature. The smell of the flowers drifts over to you while you watch; the odor has a hint of something you can only describe as empathy or compassion, and you feel more connected to the sentients around you. Gain 1 morale and 1 boost.

l180.result: The elder is a slow but eager teacher. They talk about the wind elemental to the west, a massive, ancient creature that is as revered as it is feared. Only an outsider would dare confront it. Gain 1 boost and 1 overpower.

l181.result: The sentients don’t say a word or acknowledge you, but you can feel tension in the air as you stand nearby. Something very important to them is in that chest. You’re surrounded in almost every direction by similar sentients going about their day in this prairie region, and the sounds of a city come from the north. Gain 1 boost and continue.

l182.result: The sentient flexes as they help you to your feet, clearly pleased to have the upper hand. Pointing to the giant horn to the north, they explain that they’re just doing their job to protect the artifact. With a wink, they suggest that the first note is already in the correct position. Gain 2 boost.

l183.result: At first it’s difficult to discern the sentient’s dance moves, but a distinct pattern emerges and you’re able to memorize it. Gain ability 1469.

l184.result: Your impressive feat of memory impresses the wind queen, who welcomes you to participate in the trial. Continue with the help-ENLIVEN action.

l185.action: SCAN the ruins for anything useful
l185.result: You identify a small snare among the rubble. Gain 1 boost and 1 look; go to interior 542.

l186.result: You follow sweetly scented smoke drifting from an open door. If you enter, gain 2 take, go to city 518, and continue with the take-ACCESS action there. Otherwise, go to city 518.

l187.result: Find card 1140 and place it on the table. You must demonstrate that you know the harmony of the winds by playing the sacred notes on the horn. Discern those notes based on the four previous performers, whose attempts are judged with feathers. The blue feathers represent how many times a correct note was played in the correct place in the melody. The red feathers represent how many times a correct note was played but in the wrong place. All other notes are incorrect. Proceed to study the previous attempts before announcing the four notes you will perform (from among A-G; order matters). See entry 187 in the Book of Secrets for the solution.

l188.result: The old wind sentient, clearly distraught by the broken turbine, paces in front of you. “This has been in my family for generations. Sure, it’s a piece of junk now, but it was one of the first windmills of any kind in these parts. I feel like I’ve let my family down and that it’s too late to fix it.” Seeing that you’re in no rush and that you’re really listening, they stop pacing and start sharing fond memories of their childhood on this little patch of land. Gain ability 1494 and 1 morale; you may continue.

l189.action: NAVIGATE the optimal path across the wetlands
l189.result: As you listen to a rusty turbine creaking to the west, you find a way to leap from one sandbar to the next. Gain ability 1486 and 1 boost; you may continue.

l190.action: EXPLORE the mouth of the cave
l190.result: As your keen eyes adjust to the darkness, you reach a barrier that requires further attention. Go to cave 036.

l191.result: Each player—including you—on a location with any rune (a skill icon within their vantage) gains 1 boost. Then you roll X skill dice and gain all results matching the rune on this location. Also gain quest 1706 if a player doesn’t already have it (add it horizontally to your supply and place the first token on it).

l192.action: SPY on the sentient to the north
l192.result: The sentient is in the process of placing more flags into the ground, pausing to check their calculations before each placement. Gain 2 boost and continue.

l193.result: “Sometimes I miss my childhood home, but I’ve called this planet my home for far too long to use that word reasonably for anywhere else. If anything, I miss feeling the grass beneath my feet or the wind in my hair.” Gain 1 boost and continue.

l194.action: OBSERVE the scene from a safe distance
l194.result: At first you’re unsure what to make of it, but you soon realize that the two sentients are dueling with each other with immense power—they must be using some form of magic—and the tornado is simply a byproduct of the clash. Gain 1 boost and 1 engage; you may continue.

l195.result: The smell of a campfire leads you to a perch among the rocks. There you can see a campsite—a fire and two tents—but no campers. Gain 2 boost and continue.

l196.result: You find a tight gap in the wreckage that you might be able to squeeze through. It’s surprising that, despite the plummet from outer space, this part of the ship seems operational. The Traveler peeks inside and says, “You know, with enough effort you could repair the spaceship and return home.” Gain 2 boost and destiny 1605 (place it in the center); you may continue.

l197.result: The sentient hesitates as you take in the surrounding area. They don’t seem like a threat—rather, you’re pretty sure they just want to place that flag in the right place in the ground. To the west you can see some remnants of your spaceship, and to the east an orb rests precariously between two foothills. Gain 2 boost and continue.

l198.result: The orb is made of a shimmering, glass-like substance, and there are markings on the outside with which you might be able to interact. You don’t see how to access the interior, but there must be a way inside. Gain 1 boost and either 1 engage or 1 take; you may continue.

l199.result: The sentient is quite proud of their trade, speaking of it as an art form. They even offer you an apprenticeship. Gain sentient 1338 and ability 1471.

l200.result: You can’t see anything above as you navigate through the thick clouds, but using clues on the surface you manage to find a route to a structure perched on a cliff. Go to interior 563 and gain 1 morale.

l201.result: The sentient is patrolling a perimeter, but their attention is to the northeast and they don’t notice you. You notice another sentient working with a device to the east and a similar device to the south. Gain 2 boost and 1 engage; you may continue.

l202.result: In addition to the menacing-yet-friendly sentient and the technology they were working on, you see several patches of flowers. The sentient sees you admiring them and explains that they’re called dawnflare, and that certain animals are quite fond of them. Gain ability 1497 and 2 boost; you may continue.

l203.result: From their stance and the motion of their eyes, you have the feeling that they’re guarding something—or someone— important inside the building. They might be susceptible to bribery, or you could probably take them in a fight. Gain 1 boost and either 1 engage or 1 overpower. You may continue.

l204.action: SPY on the house through a window
l204.result: You’re excited to see a nice wok inside the house; gain 1 boost. Unless you’ve already determined whether the house is occupied, roll a challenge die (this die can come from the dice pool or the center; return it afterward). If the result is blank, no one is home. If the result is not blank, someone is home. When you finish your reconnaissance, the Traveler appears at your shoulder. “You know, you could save up money and buy a house like this.” Gain destiny 1600 (place it in the center) and continue.

l205.result: The lotus smells a bit like coconut. Gain 1 health from the purifying pollen; you may also lose 1 curse.

l206.result: You shimmy along the edge of the cliff until you find an open window. Peering inside, you see what appears to be a pawn shop. If you enter, gain 2 engage, go to city 522, and continue with the engage-TRADE action there. Otherwise, go to city 522.

l207.result: Your impressive feat of memory impresses the metal sentient, who welcomes you to participate in the trial. Continue with the take-BYPASS action.

l208.result: The orb is made of a shimmering, glass-like substance, and there are markings on the outside with which you might be able to interact. You don’t see how to access the interior, but there must be a way inside. Gain 1 boost and either 1 engage or 1 take; you may continue.

l209.result: The animal appears to be looking for a fight, and you could escape by leaping south onto some floating islands or veering east to tropical waters. Gain 2 boost and continue.

l210.action: EXAMINE the object at close range
l210.result: Despite blending into the surrounding stones, it’s a solid block of metal. As you approach, you enter its magnetic field, and with a jolt you’re pulled toward the object, crashing hard and sticking to it. Lose 1 health. You can wrest free by paying 1 move or 1 overpower; if you do, go north to 215. Otherwise, you are stuck and must continue with the move-EVADE or overpower-CLEAVE action.

l211.result: At first you assume the brilliant orange glow is the sentient themselves, but you realize it’s actually coming from an item they’re trying to hide. You might be able to steal it, or you could avoid creating a scene and just sneak past the sentient under the bridge. Gain 1 boost and either 1 move or 1 take; you may continue.

l212.result: You remain perfectly still, watching the animal as it watches you. As big as it is, there’s something playful about the beast. You also notice a large lotus behind the animal. Gain 2 boost and 1 engage; you may continue.

l213.result: Several guards patrol the area. The light emanating from the building is so bright that you can’t make out its contents, but it does illuminate a runecaster near the rear of the ruins. Gain 2 boost and 1 random skill; you may continue.

l214.action: EXPLORE the mouth of the cave
l214.result: After crawling over the ledge, you enter the cave. As your eyes adjust to the darkness, you reach a barrier that requires further attention. Go to cave 034.

l215.result: The tavern is full of half-drunk (and fully drunk) sentients. You could have a drink with them or sneak into a side room. The device hovering near the building also intrigues you. Gain 2 boost and 1 random skill; you may continue.

l216.result: You walk past the flowers to join a small tour group gathering near the entrance. One of them tosses a pebble at a gap in the fence, and it’s instantly repelled by a sizzling force field. A security officer guards the front door, but you blend into the group as they enter the museum. Gain 1 boost and go to interior 564.

l217.result: Your keen eyes notice that despite the falling snow, there isn’t a flake of snow on any of the chain links—this must be an electric fence. You could disarm the electricity or find another way up and over the fence: Gain 2 boost and continue.

l218.action: STUDY the properties of the magnetic rock
l218.result: You can see why there is an aura of mystery and power around this place. As you examine the stone, you realize that your feet are no longer touching the ground—you are levitating in orbit around the stone with the other shards. You kick away, falling to the snow, a newfound power surging through you. Gain lesson 1431.

l219.result: The sentient’s eyes never leave the horizon, scanning for non-existent threats while they take you under their tutelage. They explain that their job requires a combination of observation (ability 1477) and defense (ability 1478)—gain one of those abilities.

l220.result: You feel a surge of strength as you study the stone and the rune etched into it. For a brief moment you see a vision from the past—a massive elemental using this shard as a weapon against an army of circuit sentients. Gain 1 boost.

l221.result: The swift, aggressive animal appears to be guarding the cave. It calms when seeing you consider a more circuitous route. Gain 2 boost and continue.

l222.result: It’s difficult to see through the snowstorm, but you hear the sounds of bleating to the far northeast. As scared as the young animal is, you can tell it’s built for fighting, so you may want to gain its trust with kindness. Gain 1 boost and either 1 help or 1 overpower; you may continue.

l223.result: You feel a surge of wisdom as you study the stone and the rune etched into it. For a brief moment you see a vision from the past—this area was the scene of a truce between the circuit and metal sentients. Gain 1 boost.

l224.result: The areas to the north and west are snowy, but a break in the ridge to the east could take you toward a warmer area. The lumpy figures in the distance seem to be moving slowly across the valley—perhaps a herd of animals? Gain 2 boost and continue.

l225.action: SPY through an open seam in the bigger tent, waiting until its occupants take a stroll
l225.result: Your eyes light up when you see a shovel inside. Gain 1 boost and 1 take; go to interior 551.

l226.result: At first you think some sort of intense bonfire was creating the beam of light, but the more you watch it, the more you’re convinced there is some sort of glowing item at the source. Gain 2 boost and continue.

l227.result: It’s a little different from what you pictured from the books you read as an imaginative child, but there’s no mistaking a flying carpet. The device is touch-sensitive, and it counterbalances against your weight. Looking around, you can’t see its owner. Gain ability 1490. If you pay 1 boost, also gain vehicle 985; if not, continue.

l228.result: You wave to the sentient as you walk to the edge of the cliff. It’s a long, steep descent to the bottom, and the cliff extends to the east and west—not too far to the east, though. You could probably even climb the nearby tower to get a better view of the swamp below. Perhaps you could enlist the sentient to show you around? Gain ability 1497 and 1 morale, and gain either 1 move or 1 take. You may continue.

l229.result: Other than Moonstone Mountain itself—which you can imagine that sentients in the valley below might be looking for—you don’t see an end to the cliff in either direction. There is, however, a tower directly to the west that might help. Gain 1 boost and continue.

l230.result: Each player—including you—on a location with any rune (a skill icon within their vantage) gains 1 boost. Then you roll X skill dice and gain all results matching the rune on this location. Also gain quest 1706 if a player doesn’t already have it (add it horizontally to your supply and place the first token on it).

l231.result: Find cards 1137–1139 and place them on the table. As you do, the air around you is filled with different types of energy: thermal, electric, and chemical. To wrest the gauntlet away from its anchor, you must fully understand how the three types of energy fit together. Assemble the cards so they form 3 digits, then speak those digits in ascending order. See entry 231 in the Book of Secrets for the solution.

l232.result: The longer you watch, the more the light begins to resemble an intelligent life form. You realize you’re witnessing the birth of a sentient made of pure energy. The light is the same color as the lanterns that hang all around you—they must be where this type of sentient lives. Gain 1 morale and 1 boost.

l233.action: TRANSLATE a cipher for the judges (only if you have been welcomed as a participant in this trial; otherwise choose another action)
l233.result: Find cards 1147–1149 and place them on the table. An energy sentient points to the lanterns surrounding you on this location (cards 1147 and 1148), each of which is etched with images of sparks, fire, rocks, mountains, blood, and water in various quantities. The sentient also hands you a scroll with four runes written on it (card 1149). Your goal is to translate the scroll, which describes a universal mantra involving two numbers and two words. See entry 233 in the Book of Secrets for the solution.

l234.result: The trio isn’t particularly eager to teach anything to a complete stranger, but they can’t resist the appeal of learning a new language. After you share a few words with them, they teach you some basic spirit magic and recommend that you stay away from the deadly plants in this area of the swamp. Gain lesson 1424, 1 boost, and 1 look.

l235.action: LEARN about the environment from the Traveler
l235.result: “Where we’re standing right now is one of the few places where you could dig, if that’s something you’re into,” the Traveler says. Gain 1 boost and continue.

l236.result: The tower has a number of good footholds and handholds; you could get a great view of the surrounding area if you scaled it or use the tower’s transmission capabilities to contact your homeworld. As you study it, one of the lights on the tower changes to a pink hue, and a head begins to emerge from it. Gain 1 boost and any 1 skill. Continue.

l237.result: The sentient is eager to practice your language, though they seem a bit nervous. “I don’t like to be this close to the elemental,” they say. “These lanterns are offerings—tiny pieces of our souls—to the energy elemental to the north. We fear it as much as we revere it.” They teach you a bit of spirit magic so you can experience what it feels like to draw energy from your soul. Gain lesson 1425 and 1 morale.

l238.result: You find yourself in a busy room with pink sentients rushing in and out. If you enter, gain 2 move, go to city 520, and continue with the move-ENTER action there. Otherwise, go to city 520.

l239.result: Several sentients are admiring a beautiful array of fancy lanterns. You also notice a mysterious green elixir. Gain 1 boost and 1 move; you may continue.

l240.result: The orb is made of a shimmering, glass-like substance, and there are markings on the outside with which you might be able to interact. You don’t see how to access the interior, but there must be a way inside. Gain 1 boost and either 1 engage or 1 take; you may continue.

l241.result: As far as you can tell, this stone acts as a warning for the monstrous elemental to the east. Gain 1 boost and continue.

l242.action: PREPARE to interact with the elemental
l242.result: Choose one: Gain 1 random skill and 1 skill of your choice, refresh all challenge dice from a row of your grid, or gain 1 boost on each card in a column of your grid. Then continue with either the help-RELEASE action or the overpower-SLAY action.

l243.result: Each player—including you—on a location with any rune (a skill icon within their vantage) gains 1 boost. Then you roll X skill dice and gain all results matching the rune on this location. Also gain quest 1706 if a player doesn’t already have it (add it horizontally to your supply and place the first token on it).

l244.result: The orb is made of a shimmering, glass-like substance, and there are markings on the outside with which you might be able to interact. You don’t see how to access the interior, but there must be a way inside. Gain 1 boost and either 1 engage or 1 take; you may continue.

l245.result: Your augsuit goes haywire as you step in the water around the flower. Disoriented, you stumble backwards. Lose 1 morale and gain 1 boost; you may continue.

l246.result: Each player—including you—on a location with any rune (a skill icon within their vantage) gains 1 boost. Then you roll X skill dice and gain all results matching the rune on this location. Also gain quest 1706 if a player doesn’t already have it (add it horizontally to your supply and place the first token on it).

l247.result: The heated discussion is difficult to comprehend fully, but you gather that these three sentients represent major factions. On the left is someone who believes it is the duty of energy sentients to offer their energy to other sentients. On the right is someone who urges other energy sentients to exact revenge on those who sap their energy. In the middle is someone content to simply live out their life in the swamp. Gain ability 1494 and 3 boost; you may continue.

l248.action: TRANSLATE the markings on the tree
l248.result: As you read the runes, they fill your field of vision. Something magical enters your comprehension as if you’ve always known it. Gain lesson 1419.

l249.action: OBSERVE the animal while it observes you
l249.result: The staring contest ends with you blinking, which delights the animal. Gain animal 823 and 1 boost.

l250.result: Despite the cool breeze from the west, you can tell how hot the area to the east and northeast is. You’re curious whether the temperatures bother the sentients walking in the distance. As for more immediate matters, there might be a way to reach the pink box on the ledge, but you risk pricking yourself on the rocky thorns. Gain 2 boost and continue.

l251.result:
Your keen eyes notice two very important details. Firstly, the hole in the ground isn’t a hole at all—it’s a giant, gaping mouth. Secondly, wedged between two of those teeth is a shiny object, some sort of jewelry. Gain 2 boost, then you may choose one or neither:

move--DESCEND into the pit toward the jewelry

The ground lurches beneath you, and all goes black. Go to cave 049.

take--EXTRACT the shiny object

Without leaving your perch on the outer rim, you delicately remove the jewelry. Gain item 991.

l252.action: OBSERVE the sentient on their roost
l252.result: The sentient stares back at you for a moment but doesn’t seem to consider you a threat, so they turn back to their work, which seems to involve the airborne animals. You also notice the gaping mouth of a sand centipede to the west. Gain 1 boost and 1 random skill. If you pay 1 engage, also gain sentient 1331; if you don’t pay, you may continue.

l253.result: The treasure chest is sturdy (but eroded by sand), with a solid lock and ornate gold trim. Gain 2 boost and continue.

l254.result:
You realize that it’s not one but two animals that created these footprints. You can tell from the tracks that the animal to the north is hungry and that the animal to the east is scared. Choose one:

  • Gain 1 boost and go north to 259.

  • Gain 1 boost and go east to 443.

  • Gain 1 random skill and continue.

l255.result: The sentients immediately back away—they were just excited to meet you. They explain that they’re ready to go on a hunt, but they always hunt as a trio, not a duo. Gain sentient 1333, 1 boost, and quest 1649 (add the quest horizontally to your supply).

l256.result: It looks like the beast died from sunstroke. There is a stillness to the air around the skeleton, and you can’t decide whether to use the bones to your advantage or delve underneath. Gain 2 boost and continue.

l257.result: It soon becomes clear that the leaf sentient has stumbled into a trap made of bones. Without your help they will succumb to the elements, to the beasts, or to whoever laid the trap. The question is: Do they deserve to be saved? Gain 1 boost and 1 random skill; you may continue.

l258.action: LISTEN to the peddler’s sales pitch
l258.result: The sentient complains of the cooler temperatures to the southeast. They carry an amazing array of bone-crafted items, including a $3 pair of climbing shoes (item 963), a $4 mace (item 969), a $6 lyre (item 970), and an $8 sword (item 888). You may either buy one of them (gain the card) or gain $1.

l259.result:
The animal acknowledges you with a slight bow before ambling toward a sentient to the west; perhaps it has a kind heart. Gain 1 morale and choose one:

Proceed with a different action

Gain either 1 engage or 1 help, then continue.

Focus on a rune

Your eyes are also drawn to the bottom rune on the rocky column. Each player—including you—on a location with any rune (a skill icon within their vantage) gains 1 boost. Then you roll 4 skill dice and gain all results matching the rune on this location. Also gain quest 1706 if a player doesn’t already have it (add it horizontally to your supply and place the first token on it).

Pay 1 engage and place your hand on a rune

A hidden door opens in the base of the stone spire, revealing a staircase leading into a massive underground cavern. Go to cave 099.

Pay 1 overpower to pluck a spiky desert flora

Gain flora 1053.

l260.action: SCAN the area for any available skeletons
l260.result: You’re happy to see that there are several large, sunbaked skeletons to the southeast. You point the octopod in that direction, and they reward you with a hearty two-tentacle hug. Gain 2 morale. Your act of kindness inspires the Traveler to offer you some advice. “With enough money, you can buy pretty much anything, including a new ship. Maybe visit the casino to the northeast?” Gain 1 boost and destiny 1607 (place it in the center).

l261.result: Your impressive feat of memory impresses the sinew sentients, who welcome you to participate in the trial. Continue with the overpower-HUNT action.

l262.result:
Your search yields several interesting results. Choose one:

Behind the city is the mouth of a cave; enter it

Go to cave 027.

A gateway on the northern end of the city is decorated with a variety of bones; enter the city there.

Gain 1 engage, go to city 524, and continue with the engage-TRADE action there.

Enter the city through the main gate.

Go to city 524.

l263.result: The odor has a hint of fresh water and vitality to it. Just as you inhale the tempting odor, a hard object smashes you in the head. Then another. Then another. It’s the plant—its bulbous roots are attacking you! Gain 1 boost. Roll 2 skill dice, and gain all overpower results, then lose 1 health unless you pay 1 overpower. You may continue.

l264.action: SCAN the ruins for anything useful
l264.result: You identify some dusty barrels among the rubble. Gain 1 boost and 1 look; go to interior 543.

l265.result: From what you hear, the lead sentient is a bounty hunter who has captured a hacker from the cold west. You also notice a hulking elemental far in the distance. Gain 1 boost and 1 help; you may continue.

l266.result:
Your keen eyes notice several intriguing targets. Choose one:

Spy on the building

The bustling casino seems to be a major attraction, especially in this heat. The employees are inviting anyone and everyone inside. As you get closer, you notice a shiny coin on the ground. Gain $X and 1 boost; you may continue.

Smell the lotus to the right

It smells like coconut. Gain 1 health; you may also lose 1 curse. You may continue.

Focus on the rune

Each player—including you—on a location with any rune (a skill icon within their vantage) gains 1 boost. Then you roll X skill dice and gain all results matching the rune on this location. Also gain quest 1706 if a player doesn’t already have it (add it horizontally to your supply and place the first token on it).

l267.result: You watch the sentient for a few minutes, and it quickly becomes clear that they’re maintaining the oasis in the middle of the desert—perhaps even trying to expand it. Gain 1 boost and 1 help; you may continue.

l268.action: LISTEN to the Traveler explain the situation
l268.result: The Traveler shakes their head. “Historically, the sinew and leaf sentients haven’t gotten along, but in modern times they’ve kept an uneasy peace. This spoiled prince could ruin everything with his repeated attacks, though fortunately most sinew people don’t listen to him.” Gain 2 boost and continue.

l269.result: Your keen eyes notice that the funnel, while dangerous and growing in size, isn’t veering from its current position. You may go northwest to 273 or northeast to 447, or continue.

l270.result: The chest is sturdy (but a little weatherworn), with a solid lock and ornate gold trim. You have a bad feeling about opening it with anything other than near-perfect execution. Gain 2 boost and continue.

l271.result: Among the gleaming ivory you find an impressive sword. Gain item 892; you may continue with any action other than take-SCAVENGE.

l272.result: At first the blobs appeared solid to you, but upon closer inspection you realize that they’re constantly twisting, shifting, and changing. Passing sentients keep a safe distance from them, some of them heading to cooler climates to the northeast and northwest. Gain 2 boost and 1 take; you may continue.

l273.result: You find a tight gap in the wreckage that you might be able to squeeze through. It’s surprising that, despite the plummet from outer space, this part of the ship seems operational. Gain 1 boost and destiny 1605 (place it in the center); you may continue.

l274.result: The odor has a hint of dry bone. Gain 1 boost and continue.

l275.result: The lotus smells a bit like coconut. Gain 1 health from the purifying pollen; you may also lose 1 curse.

l276.action: LEARN how to play the game
l276.result: The sentients take a break to explain basic information about the world’s oldest game. They roll a few dice, then each player selects 1 card from their collection for a brief duel against their opponent. Gain ability 1499, and gain either 1 engage or 1 overpower; you may continue.

l277.result: The beast’s rage is more of a response to its chains than its natural demeanor. While there surely is a way to pass through without harm, you could also free the animal. Gain 1 boost and either 1 move or 1 help; you may continue.

l278.action: SEARCH for a gap in the wall
l278.result: There are a few dark windows in the wall that could branch into deeper tunnels. As you draw close to one of them, several cloaked figures jump out of it and surround you. Gain 1 boost and read entry 278 in the Book of Secrets.

l279.result: The orb is made of a shimmering, glass-like substance, and there are markings on the outside with which you might be able to interact. You don’t see how to access the interior, but there must be a way inside. Gain 1 boost and either 1 engage or 1 take; you may continue.

l280.result: The sentient advises you to explore the desert to the east if you’re looking for a crystal that will improve your ability to help and create. You sense there is something else they want to say, but they trail off. Gain 1 boost and continue.

l281.result: The main entrance to the building—which appears to be the only entrance—is wide open, and the campfire indicates to you that someone is already inside. You arm yourself with a torch from the fire before proceeding. Gain item 1087 and 1 boost; you may continue.

l282.result: It looks like the beast died from thirst. There is a stillness to the air around the skeleton, and you can’t decide whether to use the bones to your advantage or delve underneath. Gain 2 boost and continue.

l283.result: Each player—including you—on a location with any rune (a skill icon within their vantage) gains 1 boost. Then you roll X skill dice and gain all results matching the rune on this location. Also gain quest 1706 if a player doesn’t already have it (add it horizontally to your supply and place the first token on it).

l284.result: As you prepare to extract the crystal, you perceptively notice the three treasure chests conspicuously at the base of the rock. Why so many chests all in one place? Choose one: Gain 1 random skill and 1 skill of your choice, refresh all challenge dice from a row of your grid, or gain 1 boost on each card in a column of your grid. Continue.

l285.result: You find a tight gap in the wreckage that you might be able to squeeze through. It’s surprising that, despite the plummet from outer space, this part of the ship seems operational. Gain 1 boost and destiny 1605 (place it in the center); you may continue.

l286.result: Your eyes don’t fool you—these really are three separate sentients merged into one. They don’t seem to notice you or care about their valuables, as they’re busy bickering among themselves. Gain 1 boost and 1 take; you may continue.

l287.action: NAVIGATE a route to the peak
l287.result: It is a treacherous ascent, but you find a well-worn route leading to a sprawling room inside the mountain. Go to interior 592 and gain 1 morale.

l288.result: The tiny creature seems incredibly nervous. Whenever it starts to move to your left, they look up at you expectantly. Gain 1 boost and 1 move; you may continue.

l289.result: The outcropping provides a nice foundation for you to build a bridge, though it may be easier simply to get the attention of the passing balloon. Gain 2 boost and continue.

l290.result: It looks like the beast was eaten by a sand centipede. There is a stillness to the air around the skeleton, and you can’t decide whether to use the bones to your advantage or delve underneath. Gain 2 boost and continue.

l291.result: Even in the dark, you can sense small tremors of movement in the sand near the spiky protrusions. You might be safest moving somewhere other than north. Gain 1 boost and 1 move; you may continue.

l292.action: EXPLORE the mouth of the cave
l292.result: As your keen eyes adjust to the darkness, you reach a barrier that requires further attention. Go to cave 025.

l293.result: Each player—including you—on a location with any rune (a skill icon within their vantage) gains 1 boost. Then you roll X skill dice and gain all results matching the rune on this location. Also gain quest 1706 if a player doesn’t already have it (add it horizontally to your supply and place the first token on it).

l294.action: SPY through an open seam in the bigger tent, waiting for its occupants to get some fresh air
l294.result: Your eyes light up when you see some climbing gear inside the tent. Gain 1 boost and 1 move; go to interior 552.

l295.result: The sentient gestures for you to join them. As they work, they explain the basics of creating and manipulating glass. They guide you through the process of making a glass trinket (gain item 1091).

l296.result: You feel a surge of wisdom as you study the stone and the rune etched into it. For a brief moment you see a vision from the past—this area was the scene of a truce between the sand sentients to the south and gold sentients to the north, where it looks a bit warmer. Gain 1 boost.

l297.action: LISTEN to the silence of the expanse
l297.result: As soon as you become fully aware of the quiet, you realize that the desert isn’t entirely silent. A muffled roar emerges from deep underground. Gain 1 boost and continue.

l298.result: You feel a surge of wisdom as you study the stones and the rune etched into them. For a brief moment you see a vision from the distant past—this area was a meeting place between friendly gold, metal, and energy sentients. Their discussion focused on the area to the east that would one day host the towers you now see there, as well as their concerns about some corrupted runecasters that were causing some issues to the southeast. The vision also indicates warmer temperatures to the north. Gain 2 boost.

l299.result: The tower has a number of good footholds and handholds; you could get a great view of the surrounding area if you scaled it or use the tower’s transmission capabilities to contact your homeworld. As you study it, one of the lights on the tower changes to a pink hue, and a head begins to emerge from it. Gain 1 boost and any 1 skill. Continue.

l300.result: It’s hard to see at first, but when the beast pauses for breath, you can see a large thorn irritating its eye. It may be difficult to heal the animal without first calming or subduing it. Gain 1 boost and either 1 take or 1 overpower; you may continue.

l301.result: Ducking behind a rock, you scan the valley. In the middle of the circle, a blue sentient is tied to a rock. Pink energy flows from them into the surrounding sentients; some of it even reaches you. Soon the sentient grows limp, and the ceremony ends. Gain ability 1483, 1 morale, and 1 boost.

l302.action: LISTEN to the Traveler talk about the birds
l302.result: “These birds are almost biologically identical to those found on your world, and they’re trained to deliver messages. In many places you can simply relax to birdsong, and they might even inspire you to send a signal to your home planet using a tower.” Gain 2 boost and destiny 1598 (place it in the center).

l303.result: As you trace the lines on the stone, three distinctly colored icons emerge. You may choose to focus on one of the three. If you choose the green icon, gain spell 1236. If you choose the pink icon, gain spell 1237. If you choose the blue icon, gain spell 1238.

l304.result: A one-eyed guard stands on the edge of the cliff, anxiously watching the approaching pirate ship. Gain 1 boost and 1 move; you may continue.

l305.result: As far as you can tell, the lighthouse is currently unoccupied. You hear a sentient humming to themselves to the west; perhaps that’s the lighthouse keeper. The door is locked, but the hinge looks weak. Gain 2 boost and 1 overpower; you may continue.

l306.result: You perceptively notice that the 5 nearest floating islands are all positioned in clear view of the shard. Choose one: Gain 1 random skill and 1 skill of your choice, refresh all challenge dice from a row of your grid, or gain 1 boost on each card in a column of your grid. Continue.

l307.result: It looks like the goliath died from loneliness. There is a stillness to the air around the skeleton, and you can’t decide whether to use the bones to your advantage or delve underneath. Gain 2 boost and continue.

l308.action: INSPECT either the animal or the orb
l308.result:
Choose one:

Inspect the animal

You wade around the animal, looking it up and down for the source of its pain. You find it—a large fishhook has left a long gash in its back and is still wedged there. Gain 1 boost and either 1 help or 1 overpower; you may continue with the help-HEAL or overpower-RELIEVE action.

Inspect the orb

The orb is made of a shimmering, glass-like substance, and there are markings on the outside with which you might be able to interact. You don’t see how to access the interior, but there must be a way inside. Gain 1 boost and either 1 engage or 1 take; you may continue.

l309.action: LISTEN to the Traveler talk about your mission
l309.result: “If you’re on a treasure hunt, there may be no better partners than these pirates.” Gain 1 boost and 1 engage; you may continue.

l310.result: When you look closely at the rainbow, you notice that it’s more than just a refraction of light—it’s composed of crystal dust. Gain ability 1492, 1 morale, and 1 boost; you may continue.

l311.result:
You find that the path leads underwater by design. You follow the steps until you’re fully submerged. Choose one:

Suffer 1 hypoxia damage to proceed even deeper

After inhaling too much water, you emerge dripping wet in an underground cave. Go to cave 089.

Return to the surface

Gain 1 boost and continue.

l312.result: The footprints in the sand suggest that the owner of the boat isn’t far from here, so you could either catch their attention or try to slip away in the boat before they notice. Gain 1 boost and continue.

l313.result: You get the feeling that the animal is watching you with just as much curiosity as with which you’re watching it. Perhaps it’s your imagination, but you think you see tiny flames atop the bird’s crest. Gain 1 boost and 1 random skill; you may continue.

l314.result: The owner of the boat is nowhere to be seen, but you hear a voice inside the nearby cave. Either take the boat (gain vehicle 1014) or venture into the cave (go to cave 037).

l315.action: TRANSLATE a few pages of the book
l315.result: Look at page 26 of the Book of Vantages to learn about flora; gain 1 boost and continue.

l316.result: Even up close, the animal is nearly indistinguishable from a large mushroom, albeit one that can walk and make sounds. It seems to have a friendly disposition. Gain 1 boost and 1 engage; you may continue.

l317.result: The terrified animal stumbles forward and blends into the trees near the lotus. As you watch, another animal—a giant lizard—emerges from the brush and is immediately entranced by the sweet-smelling lotus. Gain animal 851.

l318.result: Set aside 6 cubes representing water. Roll exactly 10 skill dice and randomly arrange 9 of them into a 3x3 grid. Use the extra die to push a row or column so that the extra die enters the grid; a new extra die will emerge from the other end. When it does, you may reroll the new extra die once by spending a water cube. Proceed to push the extra die into the grid, repeating the process. The goal is for each row or column to have 3 identical icons (e.g., the first row has 3 orange icons, the second row has 3 green icons, and the third row has 3 blue icons). Succeed if you accomplish this goal; gain item 1008 and perform no other location actions here. If you spend all water tokens and can’t reroll to make the goal possible, you fail and lose 1 morale.

l319.result: The creature seems to have no issue with you watching it work. It’s using the rocks as a canvas for a gold fluid secreted by its claws. You can’t make any sense of it, and this could be an easy opportunity to capture or even kill the animal. Gain 1 boost and either 1 take or 1 overpower; you may continue.

l320.result: The tower has a number of good footholds and handholds; you could get a great view of the surrounding area if you scaled it or use the tower’s transmission capabilities to contact your homeworld.
