l321.result: The sentient is distracted by an onrush of young sentients; they say that they’ll teach you soon if you get in line. Go to interior 600.

l322.result: The eager sentient explains the meaning of the various positions of petals in their flower arrangement, for which they used the tropical arecaceae flora. Gain ability 1465.

l323.action: LEARN along with the other students
l323.result: It takes you a few minutes to catch up, but fortunately this is a beginner class. The instructor is explaining the sacrifice required to tap into life mana. Gain lesson 1419.

l324.result: Through the swirling energy that forms the animal’s body, you see the glimmer of a bright orange crystal and an angry flare around a metal spike in its leg. Gain 1 boost and 1 help; you may continue.

l325.result: The netting is similar to a spider web’s, but the strands are thick as a rope and razor-sharp. Gain 1 boost and 1 help; you may continue.

l326.result: The arachnoid creature waits patiently for unwitting prey… or a reason to defend itself. You could placate it if you provide a meal for it instead of serving yourself as the meal. Gain 1 boost and 1 help; you may continue.

l327.result: It’s a sturdy treasure chest featuring a solid lock and ornate gold trim. Concerning, though, is the alarm embedded in its base. Gain 2 boost and continue.

l328.result: The sentient refuses to let you pass. Instead, they recommend that you take a whiff of the nearby lotus and then be on your way. Gain 1 boost; you may also lose 1 curse.

l329.result: In the hope of finding a way to untether their people from this planet, the sentient sought the legendary elder dragon, but they failed to find their mark. Gain quest 1670 (add it horizontally to your supply).

l330.result: Each player—including you—on a location with any rune (a skill icon within their vantage) gains 1 boost. Then you roll X skill dice and gain all results matching the rune on this location. Also gain quest 1706 if a player doesn’t already have it (add it horizontally to your supply and place the first token on it).

l331.result: The tree is oddly odorless, which would indicate that its composition is pure gold. You’ve never seen anything like it, and you suspect this tree is sacred to those who live in the area. Gain 1 boost and continue.

l332.result: With the wind pressing you against the village walls, you find a hidden door. Inside you see a dark hallway capped by a door with a band of light at eye level. If you enter, gain 2 take, go to city 530, and continue with the take-ACCESS action there. Otherwise, go to city 530.

l333.action: SCAN the inside of the building
l333.result: There’s an elaborate welding device nearby that you could probably grab if the store owner were distracted. It’s just you and them on this quiet plateau—no one would know if you rob or even accost the owner. Gain 2 boost and continue.

l334.result: The sentient’s biological matter seems to be the gold fluid itself, the outer husk a vessel or exoskeleton. They are in dire need of help. Gain 1 boost and 1 help; you may continue.

l335.result: It looks like the peddler—who is conveniently absent—specializes in equipment for explorers, as you see a compass and a climbing axe among the supplies there. Gain 2 boost and continue.

l336.result: This caravan is a merchant procession, and their main feature seems to be large husks. Gain 1 boost and continue.

l337.result: Based on the impenetrable armor and lack of trust from the driver, you will be hard-pressed to hitch a ride or to raid the vehicle. You spot a weakness, however, in the “belly” of the transport that you could use to steal a few coins. Gain 2 boost and continue.

l338.result: This playground for the rich isn’t the type of place you can just walk into (figuratively or literally). Wealthy sentients lounge about while they’re served by an overly attentive staff. You overhear one of the guests mention suspiciously that they hope the staff won’t steal the ring they left in their room. Gain 2 boost and 1 help; you may continue.

l339.result: The sentients invite you to join their boisterous game. You will try to create the best poker-style hand of dice compared to 2 competing sentients. For this game, roll 2 skill dice for yourself, set aside 4 skill dice for the sentients (2 dice each; you don’t know their results yet), and reserve 3 shared skill dice. Roll 1 shared die. With that knowledge, you may reroll one or both of your dice simultaneously. Then roll the second shared die. Again, you may reroll one or both of your dice. One final time, roll the third shared die, then you may reroll one or both of your dice. Now roll both of the other gamblers’ dice to see their final results (two sets of 2 dice each). The order of possible results from worst to best are one of a kind, one pair, two pairs, three of a kind, full house, four of a kind, and five of a kind. See entry 339 in the Book of Secrets.

l340.result: The owner of the boat isn’t far from here, so you could either catch their attention or try to slip away in the boat before they notice. Gain 1 boost and either 1 help or 1 overpower; you may continue.

l341.result: Your impressive feat of memory impresses the gold sentients, who welcome you to participate in the trial. Continue with the engage-TRADE action.

l342.result: While looking through the brush, you find a hidden tunnel leading directly into the city embassy. If you enter, gain 2 help, go to city 529, and continue with the help-OFFER action there. Otherwise, go to city 529.

l343.result: The structures to the north appear to be vacant, perhaps deserted in lieu of the newer city to the west. Just because this society decided not to live here any longer doesn’t mean you couldn’t build something on the river bank. Gain 1 boost and 1 help; you may continue.

l344.action: STUDY the city from various angles
l344.result: Your suspicions are confirmed—the “city” in the distance is a well-crafted mirage. When you point this out to a local, they offer you a mischievous glance. Depending on who you ask, they say, the illusion was either created to confuse invaders or to make the land of the gold sentients appear more opulent than it really is. Impressed at your perception, the sentient teaches you a spell-related lesson. Gain lesson 1426.

l345.result: The animal’s big eyes blink in fear. Your choice to watch instead of act is a death sentence for the animal. Lose 1 morale and gain 1 boost.

l349.result: The sounds of civilization trickle in from the south, while the smell of healthier flowers wafts from the north. Gain 1 boost and 1 random skill; you may continue.

Also gain quest 1706 if a player doesn’t already have it (add it horizontally to your supply and place the first token on it).

l353.result: The air gets colder as you approach the tower, which is attempting to manipulate the mild climate through a combination of technology and something you can best describe as magic. Your close examination results in some of that magic merging with you. Gain spell 1377.

l354.result: The odor reminds you of formaldehyde, which makes you squirm a bit. You’re glad no one is around to see you. Gain 1 boost and continue.

l355.action: SEARCH the wreckage and surrounding area
l355.result: You find a tight gap in the wreckage that you might be able to squeeze through. It’s surprising that, despite the plummet from outer space, this part of the ship seems operational. Gain 2 boost. You also find a sweet-smelling lotus nearby. Gain 1 health; you may also lose 1 curse. You may continue.

l356.action: OBSERVE the disturbance in the water
l356.result: As you watch, a massive tongue flicks out of the spiky circle and grabs a bird out of the air. You might be wise to distract the underwater creature before moving north. Gain 1 boost and 1 take; you may continue.

l357.result: As you watch what looks at first like an act of destruction, you realize that the sentients inside the house seem to appreciate the fire—they’re basking in it. Gain 1 boost and 2 engage; you may continue.

l358.result: The sentient nods, then continues their conversation with the Traveler. They speak of the embarrassment of the sinew elemental to the southwest and that they would offer riches to anyone who freed the elemental. Gain quest 1633 (add it horizontally to your supply).

l359.result: The sentient’s attention remains on the fishing rod, but they talk slowly about various methods of catching fish (gain ability 1461).

Then you roll X skill dice and gain all results matching the rune on this location. Also gain quest 1706 if a player doesn’t already have it (add it horizontally to your supply and place the first token on it).

l365.result: Despite the salty water splashing into your eyes, you notice two important details: Firstly, the water is curiously calm under the surface. Secondly, the lights in the distance seem to be emanating from the same, unmoving position. Gain 1 boost and 1 random skill; you may continue.

”I’m here to make an offering.”

”I’m here to fight.”

The sentient punches your shoulder affectionately and leads you far north to 647

l651.result: The animal is close enough that you can count its teeth, meaning it’s either very angry or very hungry. Gain 1 boost and 1 help; you may continue.

l656.action: EXPLORE the mouth of the cave
l656.result: As your keen-but-waterlogged eyes adjust to the darkness, you reach a barrier that requires further attention. Go to cave 032.

l663.result: You feel a surge of wisdom as you study the stone and the rune etched into it. As you study it, you can’t help but smell the nearby lotus. Gain 1 health and 1 boost; you may also lose 1 curse.

l664.result: The surface of the gateway is covered with an opaque, nebulous substance that you can’t see beyond, so you slowly stick your head into it. Gain 1 boost and destiny 1600 (place it in the center); you may continue.

l668.result: Given its posture, the animal is more curious than afraid. It doesn’t seem dangerous, though all the cockroaches you’ve ever encountered have been notorious thieves. Gain 1 boost and 1 take; you may continue.

l675.result: The chest is sturdy (but a little weatherworn), with a solid lock and ornate gold trim. Gain 2 boost and continue.

l676.result:

Offer to help

Accompany the sentient

Gain sentient 1350.

Venture into the embassy

Go to interior 585.

Open the chest to gain item 1018.

l721.action: CALCULATE the paths of the boulders (only if you have been welcomed as a participant in this trial; otherwise choose another action)
l721.result: You must choose a single place to stand while boulders are rolled down the surrounding hills. Find card 534 (it’s a large card), place it on the table, and begin. Each of the arrows represents a single boulder teetering at the peaks of the valley. When the trial begins, each boulder will simultaneously tumble in a straight line—the direction indicated by its arrow—one hex at a time until it either exits the other side of the valley or it disintegrates by smashing into another boulder. There exists exactly 1 hex in the valley that will be safe for the duration of the trial (it will never be hit by a boulder). You may use tokens to simulate the tumbling boulders until you are ready to choose the hex where you will stand for the trial. See entry 721 in the Book of Secrets for the solution.

The sentient descends to the ground and guides you to the east, allowing the smaller sentients to hurry away to the north. Go to 410, where the house becomes occupied upon your arrival.

Life

Gain spell 1236.

Spirit

Gain spell 1237.

Mind

Gain spell 1238.

l734.result:
You look through the rift to see that it is a rift in time, not space—it’s the same place, just in the distant past or future when water covers this area of the world. Choose one:

Touch the rift

Interact with the area in a different way

Gain 1 boost and continue.

l735.action: SPY on the sentient as they work

l737.result: You’re excited to see a beautiful sword hanging from a pole inside; gain 1 boost.

l739.result: You perceptively notice that there are three lookouts posted around the island. Choose one: Gain 1 random skill and 1 skill of your choice, refresh all challenge dice from a row of your grid, or gain 1 boost on each card in a column of your grid. Continue.

l745.result: The owner of the boat is probably in one of the buildings, so you could either catch their attention or try to slip away in the boat before they notice. Gain 1 boost and continue.

l747.result: The tiny animal could not have chosen a worse location to avoid predators: It’s a vast expanse empty aside from the oddly shaped bush on your left. You have a hunch that if the animal were to join you willingly, the big-eared creature could be an effective thief. Gain 2 boost, and gain either 1 move or 1 help; you may continue.

l748.result: You find a door leading into a shop filled with goggles and eyeglasses. If you enter, gain 2 look, go to city 531, and continue with the look-NAVIGATE action there. Otherwise, go to city 531.

l749.result: The lotus smells a bit like coconut. Gain 1 health from the purifying pollen; you may also lose 1 curse.

l750.result: You stand your ground, making it clear to the kraken that you condemn its attacks just as you condemn any antagonism by the residents of the seaside village. The beast calms down and heads back to the depths. The villagers give you a generous offering in appreciation for your courage. Gain item 899, 1 morale, and 1 look.

l751.action: LISTEN to the child talk to their pet
l751.result: The child is telling the animal all the things they hope to do, including a face-off with the elemental to the north, a race against a sand centipede, and dinner with their parents for the first time in months. Gain 1 boost, 1 random skill, and quest 1643 (add it horizontally to your supply).

l752.action: PREPARE to interact with the elemental
l752.result: Choose one: Gain 1 random skill and 1 skill of your choice, refresh all challenge dice from a row of your grid, or gain 1 boost on each card in a column of your grid. Then continue with either the help-RELEASE action or the overpower-SLAY action.

l753.result: The sentients’ diction is easy to understand. Several sentients discuss a race up ahead, which they’re hoping will keep the sand sentients distracted while they join an invasion to the northeast. Gain 1 boost and quest 1694 (add it horizontally to your supply). You may continue.

l754.result: Your impressive feat of memory impresses the sand sentients, who welcome you to participate in the trial. Continue with the move-SPEED action.

l755.action: LISTEN to the sentient share their woes
l755.result: “I spent years building a magnificent ship, and the first time I sailed through these waters from the northwest, a kraken dashed it against the rocks. I’m ruined!” You know that sometimes the best way to support someone in pain is simply to sit with them. So you do. Gain ability 1494, 1 morale, and 1 boost.

l756.result: The chest is sturdy (but quite weather-worn), with a rusted lock and ornate gold trim. Gain 2 boost and continue.

l757.result: Sure enough, there is a cave behind one of the waterfalls. As your keen eyes adjust to the darkness, you reach a barrier that requires further attention. Go to cave 023.

l758.action: OBSERVE the animal from a safe distance
l758.result: Judging by the size of the bone stuck in its throat, it may be best to steer clear of this creature. Gain 1 boost and 1 move; you may continue.

l759.result: The sentient with the yellow shawl finds you to be a more receptive student, as you quickly pick up the basics of time magic. Gain lesson 1433.

l760.result: Chaos engulfs the castle. The invaders are desperate to breach the walls and may accept your help, and the defenders seem helplessly trapped and might be persuaded to hire your services. With the castle’s guards likely distracted, you could sneak inside the castle from the cliffside. Gain 2 boost and 1 move; you may continue.

l761.result: Your keen eyes notice a rope that you could climb as well as a small gateway guarded by a single sentry. Gain either 1 move or 1 overpower; you may continue.

l762.result: The sentient has just come from Founder’s Temple to the near north. They are frantic with worry—an important egg was mistakenly offered to the Founder, and they need you to raid the temple to retrieve it. They suggest that you bring an item to offer to the temple, and they give you a small vial of energy as an option for the donation. Gain item 1211 and quest 1637 (add it horizontally to your supply).

l763.result: It appears that the sentients who are granted entry are those carrying tangible offerings. Gain 1 boost and 1 random skill; you may continue.

l764.result: As much fun as the sentients are having, you’re more comfortable watching. There are a few tipsy sentients who could use your help and a belligerent drunk who should be subdued. You can also hear the sounds of dockside workers to the east. Gain 1 boost and 1 random skill; you may continue.

l765.action: MEMORIZE a map near the departure area
l765.result: The map highlights the cities and towns of the world. Gain item 1251 and continue.

l766.result: You don’t have much time to act, so you quickly survey your options. You can leap for the balloon and have a slim chance of catching it, or you could persuade, coerce, or even force the sentient to act in your favor. Gain 1 boost and either 1 engage or 1 overpower; you may continue.

l767.result: The city wall stretches as far as you can see in either direction, and while there may be weak points in it, the gate in front of you appears to be the easiest way to enter. The city is bustling with activity—you wonder whether you can buy a map from any of the vendors at the entrance, though you’ll need to move closer to find out. Gain 1 boost and continue.

l768.action: SCAN the scene for your options
l768.result: The vendor on the left is selling maps and refreshments, while the sentient on the right looks a little lost. The smell of stables and animals wafts from inside the city, while some smoke drifts from the industrial district to the east. Gain 2 boost and continue.

l769.result: Each sentient who approaches the building from the side has an animal, while those entering the front hand coins to the bouncer. Gain 2 boost, and gain either 1 move or 1 engage; you may continue.

l770.result: The owner of the boat is talking to the owner of the port nearby, so you could either catch their attention or try to slip away in the boat before they notice. Gain 1 boost and continue.

l771.action: NAVIGATE the ship away from the city
l771.result: Fair winds sail you to your choice of a quiet cove to the northwest (490), the prairie to the northeast (347), or to the western outskirts of the city (459). From there you must leave the ship behind.

l772.result: At first glance it looks like the sentient is bullying the ship, but from their posture and demeanor, you start to think that they might be patrolling these waters in an official capacity. You could seek to defuse the conflict, aid the ship, use the opportunity to commandeer the vessel, or even fight the sentient. Gain 1 boost and 1 random skill; you may continue.

l773.result: The solid but uneven stone of the wall offers an opportunity for a skilled climber. The small gateway is a tempting way to pass north, but you would most likely get stuck inside unless you first dug your way in. There are also a few sentients on the wall to whom you could appeal for help. Gain 1 move, 1 engage, or 1 overpower; you may continue.

l774.result: The sentient already has several apprentices, but they agree to show you some basic blacksmithing techniques on an old practice machete, which they let you keep. Gain item 920.

l775.result: The sentient remains in the middle of the path—maybe it’s your imagination, but you’re pretty sure they flex as they intentionally bump against you. Your carefully organized possessions go flying in all directions. Gain 1 boost; you may rearrange your card grid.

l776.result: In addition to a variety of robes and outfits, the vendor also has a package awaiting delivery. Gain 1 boost. When they notice you looking at the package, there is a glint in their eyes as they ask if you are a courier. If you say yes, gain item 1034 and quest 1638 (add it horizontally to your supply). Otherwise, continue.

l777.result: Clear signage in several languages seems to indicate that the council here includes representatives from 12 different cultures. People attend the council meetings either as members of the audience (the sentry should be able to tell you more about attending) or as a speaker (which requires a formal offer of assistance). Gain either 1 engage or 1 help; you may continue.

l778.result: The fruit on the ground is soft and overripe. In the tree, the freshest fruit appears to be high up in the branches. Gain 2 boost and continue.

l779.result: For each other player, gain 1 skill matching their character’s leftmost challenge die slot. If you are the only player, gain any 1 skill instead. You may continue.

l780.result: You find a bar of soap neatly wrapped in wax paper. Perhaps someone has covertly been bathing in the fresh water nearby. Gain item 1207.

l781.result: From what you can gather, the sentient on the right stole a precious object crafted by the sentient on the left, though they claim theft was a valid transfer of ownership in their culture. Gain 1 boost and continue.

l782.result: Just as your eyes can see that a purple sentient is lurking nearby, your nose picks up the scent of fear from the green sentient. They need your help. Gain 1 boost and 1 help; you may continue.

l783.result: The sentient works at the central bank, which they identify by gesturing to the golden-domed building in the rear. They mention offhandedly that the bank’s cavernous vaults store a considerable amount of treasure. Gain 1 boost and 1 look; you may continue.

l784.action: SCAN the ruins for anything useful
l784.result: You identify a barrel among the rubble. Gain 1 boost and 1 overpower; go to interior 548.

l785.action: LISTEN to the sentients on the bridge
l785.result: You hear the voices of guards, the conversation alternating between gathering tolls from incoming travelers and concerns about the need for a more robust night shift due to the increase in bandits crossing the bridge in the evening. Gain 2 boost and continue.

l786.result: Several cables stretch from the wall up to the palace; it would be quite a challenge to scale them, but the view is probably spectacular. Perhaps the three guards are susceptible to the powers of persuasion? Gain 2 engage and continue.

l787.result: The sentient keeps repeating that they “need to get to the museum.” You could follow them (gain 1 boost and 1 move) or stay here to clear your head (gain 1 boost and 1 help) Either way, you may continue.

l788.result: The metal sentient is planning to steal from the vendors in this pavilion, and they brag that you’ll learn a thing or two if you watch them do what they do best. Gain ability 1482; you may continue.

l789.result: The sentient is proud to showcase the various weapons they have for sale and to share the stories of how they stole them. It seems that theft is considered a form of art for metal sentients, though given the close proximity of this vendor, you’re better off trading with them or seeing if you could do them a favor. Gain 2 boost and continue.

l790.action: TRANSLATE a few pages of the book
l790.result: The book describes the various elementals of the world. It’s currently open to a page about a metal elemental, which you can see over the city wall to the east. Look at page 24 of the Book of Vantages, then gain 1 boost and continue.

l791.result: You find a number of oddities throughout the ship, including 12 compartments labeled in your language with the name of 12 elements, a barely functional radio, and, most curiously, a young girl in a cryogenic sleep. The readings on the chamber indicate that she’s been there for centuries and that waking her would almost certainly kill her. As you observe her, the Traveler’s holographic visage appears at your side and gestures toward the chamber. “I love this world, but I miss my home. You are my only hope.” Gain 2 boost and continue with the help-RESCUE action.

l795.result: You perceptively notice a guard lurking in the shadows to the right. You could avoid detection by moving no farther than the amulet hanging above the guard’s hiding place, or you could attack the guard before they attack you. Gain either 1 move or 1 overpower; you may continue.

l799.action: SEARCH the dark pit for anything of use
l799.result: You’re elated to find a grappling hook wedged into the wall on the left. Gain item 905 and continue.

l801.result: You soak in the view from the sky island hovering above a vast sea before studying the shard for any sign of danger. There are no traps or surprises, and the shard is yours. Gain item 1707.

l1110.action: LISTEN to the elder dragon (this action can be performed at most once per game)
l1110.result: You open your mind to the thoughts of the elder dragon, who speaks to you telepathically. “You are safe with me, my dear alien. I will protect you just as well among the clouds as under the ocean, and even into the great beyond, from which my ancestors came to this world when the origins of life were just beginning to bloom.” Gain 1 boost and destiny 1602 (place it in the center).

l1265.action: REFLECT on the joys of home ownership
l1265.result: You sip contentedly on some tea as you appreciate the view. Gain destiny 1600 (place it in the center; you have completed it and may end the game when you’re ready) and 1 boost on your character.

l1267.action: STUDY the art of creating armor

l1268.action: STUDY the art of brewing medicine

l1270.result: Gain the “create” ability (1465) or the “navigate” ability (1464).

l1272.action: STUDY viticulture and the art of winemaking

l1274.action: TRANSLATE between two sentients (you may pay 1 boost from this structure to reduce this cost to 1)
l1274.result: In an effort to establish diplomatic relations, you bridge the language gap between two sentients, one of whom communicates through a digital interface and the other with a verbal language that sounds like boiling soup. Both walk away pleased with the outcome. Gain either circuit sentient 1314 or gold sentient 1324.

l1275.action: WISH for wisdom (pay 1 boost from this structure; perform this action at most once per game)
l1275.result: Gain spell 1376 and 1 boost on this structure.

l1276.action: SCOUT the area for fans of theater
l1276.result: On a nearby path you find a sentient who loves the performing arts. Gain sentient 1360.

l1278.action: STUDY the art of creating garments

l1285.action: STUDY the process of hatching eggs
l1285.result: Gain 1 help and 1 overpower.

l1287.result: You learn more information about the cave that you can use for guided tours. Gain 1 boost on this structure.

l1288.result: One of the perks of owning a garden is having a vast array of flowers to enjoy at any time. Gain 1 morale. If you have 3 boost on this structure, also gain ability 1466, which you learn from dodging through the dangerous flora.

l1289.result: You sip contentedly on some tea as you appreciate the view. Gain destiny 1600 (place it in the center; you have completed it and may end the game when you’re ready) and 1 boost on your character.

l1290.result: You sip contentedly on some tea as you appreciate the view. Gain destiny 1600 (place it in the center; you have completed it and may end the game when you’re ready) and 1 boost on your character.

l1292.result: Gain 1 boost on your character, then find the region where this structure is located (see look storybook entry for the structure’s location) and use page 2 of the Book of Vantages to determine the page where your view is portrayed (look at that page).

l1293.result: If there is 1 boost on this structure, gain ability 1498. If 2 boost, gain ability 1514. If 3 boost, gain ability 1502. All boost remain on this structure.

l1316.result: The sentient patiently teaches you how to make structures. Gain either the “assemble” ability (1506) or the “build” ability (1488).

l1324.result: The sentient patiently teaches you how to attack without leaving yourself vulnerable. Gain ability 1474.

Gain ability 1492.

Learn about the beginning of life on this planet

The sentient is happy to explain that the world was a blank slate until the Great Collision, which seeded the planet with the origins of life. Gain 1 boost.

Gain 2 look.

l1345.result: The sentient patiently teaches you how to transmit signals to far-away recipients. Gain 2 engage.

Learn to climb trees and cliffs

Gain ability 1468.

Learn to climb towers

Gain ability 1503.

l1577.action: RESEARCH how you can complete the mission (this action can be performed at most once per game)
l1577.result: You’ve always had a flair for the dramatic, perhaps even a touch of a savior complex. Even though no one has asked for your help, this world is new to you, so it must be your job to save it, right? Elementals are massive beasts, often seen from a distance. Slaying an elemental isn’t easy, so be prepared when you take on this challenge. Gain the Map of Elementals (1262).

l1578.action: RESEARCH how you can complete the mission (this action can be performed at most once per game)
l1578.result: You’ve formed a common bond with your crewmates over the question, “Why are we here?” There are a few different places with visual clues for the origins; if you see something historical, talk to the people there to learn more. To help find locations where you can answer this question, gain the Map of Interiors (1256).

l1579.action: RESEARCH how you can complete the mission (this action can be performed at most once per game)
l1579.result: As a fledgling member of the Academy, you need a combination of experience and knowledge to pass your survival training test and reach your full potential. Choose a player to gain the results of their character’s look-MASTER action.

l1580.action: RESEARCH how you can complete the mission (this action can be performed at most once per game)
l1580.result: You’re collecting flowers for the royal greenhouse on your world. A variety of flora are scattered across the world, ready to be plucked! To help find locations where you can find flora, gain the Map of Flora (1263).

l1581.action: RESEARCH how you can complete the mission (this action can be performed at most once per game)
l1581.result: The blight has ravaged your world, destroying millions of lives. You have hope for an antidote in this new world. Gain the apothecary (1268).

l1582.action: RESEARCH how you can complete the mission (this action can be performed at most once per game)
l1582.result: First contact is an important moment for any world, and you have the opportunity to share the stars with these cultures. Each sentient has unique preferences for convincing them to join you (and keeping them with you), and you can draw them to you by activating runecasters. Gain the Book of Sentients (1044).

l1583.action: RESEARCH how you can complete the mission (this action can be performed at most once per game)
l1583.result: You fancy yourselves enterprising adventurers, traveling the galaxy to find the rarest of treasures, animals, and vehicles. Gain the Map of Treasure (1260).

l1584.action: RESEARCH how you can complete the mission (this action can be performed at most once per game)
l1584.result: On behalf of an interplanetary conservation fund, you’re here to collect and protect a variety of animal species. Most wild animals can be convinced to join you, especially if you treat them well. Training can take a little time. Gain the Book of Animals (1043).

l1585.action: RESEARCH how you can complete the mission (this action can be performed at most once per game)
l1585.result: As members of the Galactic Cartographers Guild, your primary goal is to chart as much of the planet as possible, viewing the world from new perspectives. Look for towers to scale so you can see the surrounding area from above. Gain the Map of Towers (1259).

l1586.action: RESEARCH how you can complete the mission (this action can be performed at most once per game)
l1586.result: As part of a year-long sabbatical from your job, you’re here to enhance the lives of complete strangers. Many sentients will share ways you can help if you offer your assistance to them, and some sentients post “help wanted” ads on the exterior of wayfinder orbs. Gain the Map of Orbs (1258).

l1587.action: RESEARCH how you can complete the mission (this action can be performed at most once per game)
l1587.result: Born and raised in poverty, you’ve managed to scrape together the funds to strike it rich on an alien planet. Many of the things you accumulate (items, flora, animals, etc) have a monetary value; you can sell them at markets around the world. You could also pickpocket or dig your way into a pretty penny. Gain the Map of Cities (1251).

l1588.action: RESEARCH how you can complete the mission (this action can be performed at most once per game)
l1588.result:
After struggling through dead-end jobs and relationships, you signed up for a week-long self-care retreat. Find inspiration— and your first objective—in your character’s personal item. Gain that item (or gain any 2 skills if you already have your personal item):

  • Captain: Gain item 1299.
  • Navigator: Gain item 1300.
  • Scholar: Gain item 1301.
  • Medic: Gain item 1302.
  • Engineer: Gain item 1303.
  • Marine: Gain item 1304.

l1589.action: RESEARCH how you can complete the mission (this action can be performed at most once per game)
l1589.result: After securing the kraken on a different planet, you were transporting it back home to collect a massive bounty. Now it’s wreaking havoc on this world. Seek it wherever there is water and use fishing equipment to capture or kill it. Gain item 913.

l1590.action: RESEARCH how you can complete the mission (this action can be performed at most once per game)
l1590.result: After some ill-advised choices in the undercity on your home planet, you’re on the run. This uncharted planet can provide refuge, but only if you find the source of the signal that helped you find this world in the first place. Based on the decryption, it seems to come from a ship not entirely unlike your own, perhaps related to the mysterious Traveler. The closest your incoming ship was able to pinpoint the signal was somewhere in the middle of the southeastern region of the world (view page 5 of the Book of Vantages).

l1591.action: RESEARCH how you can complete the mission (this action can be performed at most once per game)
l1591.result: Your planet is no longer able to sustain life, and you’re tasked with building a new colony from the ground up with permission from the sentients who were here first. You lucked into finding a planet that’s already well populated, so you could earn money to buy an existing home. Alternatively, you could find the right place to build a home of your own. Gain the Map of Interiors (1256).

l1592.action: RESEARCH how you can complete the mission (this action can be performed at most once per game)
l1592.result:
As elite members of the armed forces, you’re here to shoot first and ask questions later. This mission requires that you find a city location (a type of vertical location card that notes the name of the city/town/village on the card) and perform multiple overpower actions there. Gain the Map of Cities (1251).

The capital city is not eligible to be conquered, as it is too big.

l1593.action: RESEARCH how you can complete the mission (this action can be performed at most once per game)
l1593.result: You are here on behalf of a cohort of ambassadors seeking alliances with new worlds. The best way to form strong bonds is to prove your worth to the cultures on this planet. Gain the Map of Trials (1261).

l1594.action: RESEARCH how you can complete the mission (this action can be performed at most once per game)
l1594.result: You work for a mega-corporation, Calligraph Corp, and you’ve been tasked with locating and gathering precious minerals from various planets. Your ship’s sensors indicated that powerful crystals are abundant in this world, some in constant motion in the bodies of animals, others remaining in one place under skeletons. Gain the Map of Skeletons (1254).

l1595.action: RESEARCH how you can complete the mission (this action can be performed at most once per game)
l1595.result: A dangerous dictator rules your homeworld with an iron fist, and you managed to escape the blockade there to seek allies, weapons, and skills. Any card with an overpower slot—even a specific ability— counts toward this goal. Some of these items are found in treasure chests. Gain the Map of Treasure (1260).

l1596.action: RESEARCH how you can complete the mission (this action can be performed at most once per game)
l1596.result: This planet appeared on your radar because of a signal received from the mysterious Traveler. Finding the source of the Traveler’s signal is key, and its encryption seems similar to that used by your ship’s own comm systems. The closest your incoming ship was able to pinpoint the signal was somewhere in the middle of the southeastern region of the world (view page 5 of the Book of Vantages).

l1597.action: RESEARCH how you can complete the mission (this action can be performed at most once per game)
l1597.result: You swore to your family that your heisting days will be behind you… if you complete one last job with the help of your old team. While there are plenty of things to steal on this planet, a heist isn’t petty theft: You can offer your help to sentients to gain and complete a heist quest, or you can earn a precious artifact by passing a test. Gain the Map of Artifacts (1264).

l1598.action: RESEARCH how you can complete the destiny (this action can be performed at most once per game)
l1598.result: When combined, the towers on this planet are advanced enough to transmit a powerful signal. Gain the Map of Towers (1259), and each player gains 1 engage.

l1599.action: RESEARCH how you can complete the destiny (this action can be performed at most once per game)
l1599.result: Communication is crucially important in trying to track down your crewmates. Climbing towers to get a view from above may also help. Your cats love trees, so you’re most likely to find them in the forest canopy. Each player gains 1 random skill.

l1600.action: RESEARCH how you can complete the destiny (this action can be performed at most once per game)
l1600.result: There are quite a few houses scattered across the world, but they are occupied by sentients—you could save up enough money to buy one of them. Or you could seek opportunities to build your own structure and make it a liveable space. Gain $5, and each player gains 1 help.

l1601.action: RESEARCH how you can complete the destiny (this action can be performed at most once per game)
l1601.result: In such a vast world, there are quite a few patches of land where you might build a business. But you could also seek out employment in cities, taking over an existing shop. Gain the Map of Cities (1251), and each player gains 1 help.

l1602.action: RESEARCH how you can complete the destiny (this action can be performed at most once per game)
l1602.result: You hear rumors of a dragon living in a mountain just north of the windswept grasslands. You also learn that not all elder dragons are old—legend tells of a special egg that, when hatched, will bring a new elder dragon into this world. Gain the Map of Caves (1252), and each player gains 1 random skill.

l1603.action: RESEARCH how you can complete the destiny (this action can be performed at most once per game)
l1603.result: On this world, it seems that no greater glory can be achieved than in the card and dice game, Skirm. Seek out duels whenever you can, and try your luck in opening treasure chests to find more Skirm cards. Gain the Map of Treasure (1260), and each player gains 1 overpower.

l1604.action: RESEARCH how you can complete the destiny (this action can be performed at most once per game)
l1604.result: Teleportation blurs the line between science and magic; in this world, using a spell to bridge great distances isn’t unheard of. Gain the Book of Spells for Spirit magic (1214), and each player gains 1 move.

l1605.action: RESEARCH how you can complete the destiny (this action can be performed at most once per game)
l1605.result: Your spaceship shattered into several pieces across the planet during the crash. Be prepared for an extensive repair process. Gain 2 help; each other player gains 1 help.

l1606.action: RESEARCH how you can complete the destiny (this action can be performed at most once per game)
l1606.result: The people of this world traverse the planet in a variety of ways, and almost any vehicle can be upgraded into something better. If you repeat this process enough times, you’ll find yourself in a motley but fully functional spaceship. Gain 2 help; each other player gains 1 help.

l1607.action: RESEARCH how you can complete the destiny (this action can be performed at most once per game)
l1607.result: The spaceship that brought you to this planet was a modern marvel of technological wizardry. It would take dozens of years to rebuild it from scratch. Fortunately, there are some time anomalies on this planet that may reduce the time you need to have a ship built. You may need to hire someone to oversee the job. Gain $5, and each player gains 1 engage.

l1608.action: RESEARCH how you can complete the destiny (this action can be performed at most once per game)
l1608.result: Time travel may be a fictional concept where (and when) you come from, but some sentients of this planet shift through the sands of time on a daily basis. Learn from their wisdom to undo this terrible crash. Gain the Book of Spells for Mind magic (1215), and each player gains 1 look.

l1645.action: INSPECT the scene of the crime
l1645.result: The victim is wrapped in sailcloth, and their partner hesitantly allows you to take a closer look, saying that no one has seen the body but them. They haven’t discussed it with anyone. Despite the volume of blood on the floorboards, the wound is narrow and shallow, about the length of your forearm—a clean cut.

l1680.action: SCAN the bridge for sneaky intruders
l1680.result: In the dim lantern light, every shadow is a suspect. Your eyes grow heavy as the night wears on, but you’re alert enough to catch several street rats shimmying along the side of the bridge. Add 1 token to quest 1680.

l1687.action: REFLECT on the joys of home ownership
l1687.result: You sip contentedly on some tea as you appreciate the view. Gain destiny 1600 (place it in the center; you have completed it and may end the game when you’re ready) and 1 boost on your character.

m41.action: ENTER a concealed door in the shadows
m41.result:
A door is labeled with a symbol depicting a centipede biting its own tail. The door slides open, revealing a very small, dark room with no other exit. Choose one:

Enter the room and push the “up” button

The door shuts behind you, and the entire room begins to move toward the surface of the planet, but not straight up. It finally opens into a small room. Go to interior 563.

Enter the room and push the “down” button

The door shuts behind you, and the entire room begins to move deeper into the planet. It finally opens into a gaping tunnel. Go deeper into the planet to cave 043.

Ignore the room and instead walk over to the well-trafficked market

Continue with the engage-TRADE action.

m42.action: PUSH some buttons on the console
m42.result: Nine of the screens are instantly filled with a map that pinpoints each of the images on the screens. View page 7 of the Book of Vantages and gain 1 boost.

m43.result: You rush out of the tunnel. When you pause to catch your breath, you find yourself at the beginning of a maze. Go to cave 093.

m44.action: EXIT the passage toward the surface
m44.result: You walk aimlessly across a series of bridges. Go to cave 098.

m45.action: EXIT the tunnel toward the surface
m45.result: To your surprise, as you climb upward the intermittent rumbling doesn’t stop—but it does change frequency. Go to cave 096.

m46.action: EXIT the passage toward the surface
m46.result: The intermittent rumbling in the tunnel gives way to the irregular crashing of rocks. Go to cave 079.

m47.action: EXIT toward the surface through a mine
m47.result: As you near the end of a long, abandoned mineshaft, you see glowing yellow lights and hear the steady clanking of metal against rock. Go to cave 087.

m48.action: EXIT the tunnel toward the surface, using your dexterity to cross a narrow gap
m48.result: At the end of the tunnel, amber-colored light pours up from underneath a ledge. Go to cave 084.

m50.result: Even with a running start, you barely manage to clear the gap. Move deeper into the planet to cave 079.

m76.result: From the top of the column, you can hear voices from above, and you contort your body to fit into the circular chimney. Go to interior 077.

m77.result: You try to be as quiet as possible to avoid detection, but the wind chimes give away your presence. The sentients pull you from the rafters and toss you into a pit below the ground level. Go to interior 799.
