m78.result: With a yelp, the sentient tumbles from the tower, leaving you alone at the top with nothing to do but admire the view. View page 35 of the Book of Vantages and gain 1 boost.

m79.action: DODGE boulders as you proceed down toward the central pillar
m79.result: Inside the pillar is a narrow, dark staircase that leads you even deeper into the planet. Go to cave 046 and gain 1 morale.

m80.action: SNEAK around the sentient to the back of the cavern
m80.result: You find a small pile of coins and a dead end that might lead deeper if you push through it. Gain $3 and 1 move; you may continue.

m81.action: PUSH through the soft layer of glowing sediment in the back of the cavern
m81.result: The soft soil gives way, and you collapse into another passage. Advance deeper into the planet to dungeon 015; keep this location for reference.

m82.result: Confident on the ice, you break off a piece of the crystal as you glide past it. Gain item 1160. The frozen stream slopes downward, leading you deeper into the planet. Go to cave 047.

m83.action: ENTER the gateway, bracing against the blaze of energy around it
m83.result: The energy seems to resist you, but you manage to push into the gateway. There’s a blinding light, and, when your vision clears, you find yourself on the surface. Go to 106.

m84.action: BALANCE across the rope to the left
m84.result: Your nimble balancing act gives you confidence for more feats of agility in the future (gain ability 1501). The staircase leads you deeper into the planet to cave 048.

m85.action: PUSH through the throng toward a narrow exit
m85.result: The crowd is fixated on the fight happening in a small arena, and no one notices you slip out of the rear of the cave. Gain 1 boost and advance deeper into the planet to dungeon 019; keep this location for reference.

m86.result: If you aim your long leap at the crystal perfectly by paying 1 look or 1 boost, you land on top of it, breaking off a piece (gain item 1162). Either way, you follow the passage on the far side of the magma, barely avoiding increasingly large shards that protrude from the cave walls. Advance deeper into the planet to cave 049.

m87.result: Darting from one shadow to the next, the closest the guards ever come to seeing you is when you almost knock over a discarded pickaxe. Gain item 896. You find a narrow, unguarded passage that leads even deeper into the planet. Go to cave 049.

m88.action: DASH through the cavern, grabbing a crystal as you run
m88.result: Despite the serenity of the cave, you never know when someone is watching. As you pocket a crystal, your foot catches on a root and you tumble into the darkness. Gain item 1161 and go deeper into the planet to dungeon 017; keep this location for reference.

m89.result: The soil breaks away easily, revealing a deeper area to explore. Advance deeper into the planet to dungeon 018; keep this location for reference.

m90.action: WANDER aimlessly through the vault’s many treasures
m90.result: As you’re about to scoop up some nondescript golden coins, you see it: a glowing, ethereal key. Gain item 917.

m91.result: As you crouch in the shadows, the body of the serpent slowly passes by, taking much longer than you would like to disappear. Finally it’s gone—for now—and you can use the opportunity to try to see what’s in the treasure chest. Gain either 2 engage or 2 take; continue.

m92.action: SURFACE to catch your breath, emerging at the whim of the ocean currents
m92.result: Gain 1 random skill and go to the ocean location matching that skill: move/look/engage (052); help/take (055); overpower (061).

m93.action: DESCEND into the areas between the maze
m93.result: With oversized wires and bulbs everywhere, it’s as if you’re inside the world’s biggest microchip. You tear off some circuitry as you venture forward; gain item 1190. Finally you emerge deeper in the planet; go to cave 043.

m94.action: BALANCE across wires and floating steps to enter the mysterious city
m94.result: Your tai chi lessons serve you well as you gracefully walk along the wires. Gain ability 1501 and go to city 041.

m95.action: SQUEEZE through the nest, avoiding contact with the eggs
m95.result: You gingerly tiptoe between the pulsating sacs and manage not to disturb them. Proceed deeper into the planet to dungeon 596; keep this location for reference.

m96.action: APPROACH the dragon with an offer
m96.result:
Choose one:

Pay $10 to earn the loyalty of the greedy dragon

The dragon can’t resist its greatest weakness; gain animal 807.

Don’t pay, but assure the dragon you won’t hurt them

The dragon lets out a mighty laugh. To your surprise, it gestures for you to pass. Advance deeper into the planet to cave 045.

m97.action: PUSH a button on a device
m97.result: Your skin briefly glows the color of the runecaster, and you feel intensely sick afterward. Gain any 2 skills and lose 1 health. You stumble out of the chamber, advancing deeper into the planet to dungeon 598; keep this location for reference.

m98.action: TREK through the labyrinth of roots and doors
m98.result: You delight in the puzzle of moving from one hollow trunk to the next, and eventually you emerge in the rear of the cavern, where a glowing door awaits. Go deeper into the planet to cave 044 and gain 1 morale.

m99.result: You become the third wheel to a pair of sentients listening to a tour guide describe the meaning of the cave paintings, which indicate that the origins of life on this planet were the result of highly advanced aliens visiting from the future. The guide then leads the three of you to a narrow entrance leading deeper into the planet. Go deeper into the planet to dungeon 599 and do not lose health upon arrival; keep this location for reference.

m100.action: APPROACH the sentient, careful not to spook them
m100.result: The sentient cringes as you step on a small pile of leaves, and you pay them the respect of removing your foot. “Thank you,” they say, communicating through an airborne scent. “Let me guide you through these woods to prevent any further incidents.” Gain sentient 1351.

m101.action: CHASE away the animal to clear a path north (if the animal is no longer an obstacle, reduce this cost to 1)
m101.result: You make yourself big, spooking the animal. Gain 1 morale; you may go north to 106.

m102.result: You find an old skeleton in the sand that yields some craftable ivory. Gain item 1186.

m103.result:
After their initial freeze, the animals relax and let you follow them around the camp. They seem impressed by your height. One of the animals chirps nervously near the edge of the stream while the other rummages around the tent. Choose one:

Pick up the animal by the stream

The animal guides you toward a hidden door in the boulder. Go to cave 095.

Enter the tent

Go to interior 549.

m104.result: As you reach for the ladder, the animal vanishes into thin air. You have a few seconds to study the details of your current location before there’s a flurry of movement in the grove, then the trap door slams shut. Go to 511 and continue.

m105.result: The creature doesn’t seem to mind as you climb onto its feathery back, but it refuses to fly you anywhere. Instead it just wanders around the tree, hunting for grubs. Gain 1 boost and 1 help; you may continue.

m106.action: ENTER the hole in the stone
m106.result: As your foot breaks the plane of the hole, you feel a distinct tug. There’s something on the other side that you can’t see. You may either resist to stay here (gain 1 boost) or climb through the hole (go to 157).

m107.action: PUSH a button on the device
m107.result: Your skin briefly glows the color of the runecaster, and you feel invigorated. Gain 2 skills matching the rune.

m108.result: You accidentally kick a mushroom free from the soil. A nearby sentient sees what you’ve done and smites you. Gain flora 1082 and curse 1388.

m109.action: PUSH the animal into the clearing
m109.result: The animal, caught unawares, stumbles forward into the leaf sentient. You use the distraction to steal from the sentient (gain flora 1075) and slip away (go north to 114, east to 433, south to 104, or west to 108).

m110.result: Your spirited performance delights the judges, and they welcome you to participate in the trial. Continue with the help-CREATE action.

m111.result: As you wander, keeping an eye on the glass in the shrubbery, you realize that glass could come in handy. Gain item 1194.

m112.action: CHASE away the animal (if the animal is no longer an obstacle, reduce this cost to 1)
m112.result: The animal, a blur of spindly appendages, skitters awkwardly into the forest to the east. With them out of the way, you can clearly see the massive cliff looming to the north. It will probably be easier to head west through the forest. Gain 1 move and continue.

m113.result: As your keen eyes adjust to the darkness, you reach a barrier that requires further attention. Go to cave 035.

m114.result: Lose up to 2 curses, and gain item 1172 and 1 move.

m115.action: ENTER the building through the front door
m115.result: Go to interior 553. Several sentients glance at you before returning to their work.

m116.action: LEAP across the gap in the bridge directly into the keep
m116.result: You manage to jump across the gap gracefully enough that you’re a little disappointed no one witnessed the feat. Go to interior 553.

m117.action: CLIMB onto the pinnacle of the crystal
m117.result: The crystal never wavers as you climb it—some unseen force apparently locks it into place. From your perch on the top, you clearly see the stones around it marked with various runes. You probably need those skills to extract the crystal. Gain 1 boost; you may continue with the take-EXTRACT action.

m118.result: You run after the creature, which leads you to a wishing well, where it pauses. Gain 1 morale and go southeast to 114.

m119.action: FOLLOW the sentient around the area
m119.result: The sentient welcomes your company and is full of advice. Gain sentient 1353.

m120.action: STEER the boat into the current
m120.result: The Traveler doesn’t resist as you take control of the rowboat. Gain vehicle 1014 and $4.

m121.action: STEER the boat into the current
m121.result: You feel at home at the helm of this fine vessel. Unfortunately, it’s technically not your vessel, and the owner curses you from the shore. Gain curse 1388 and vehicle 1014.

m122.action: SCALE the tower after swimming across the strait to look around from above
m122.result: The view from above is cloudy, but you can see a few points of interest in the area. View page 41 of the Book of Vantages and gain 2 boost.

m123.result: You feel a source of energy whenever you get close to the lorestones. You sense there is something inside of them. Gain 1 overpower; you may continue with the overpower-CLEAVE action.

m124.result: Your feet sink into the tall grass around the skeleton, and you notice something glowing just inside the massive skull. You unearth a red crystal; gain item 1165 and continue.

m125.result: You quickly realize that you chose the wrong path. The mystery of the artifact remains unsolved; you return to the entrance to try a different way. Gain 1 boost.

m126.action: PUSH the treasure chest away from the lava
m126.result: You avoid touching the scalding-hot chest with exposed skin as you shift its position. Gain any 1 skill and continue, ignoring any further heat damage you would suffer on this location until you leave.

m127.result: Your wanderings don’t unlock the secrets of the stones, but you do find a discarded flag among them. Gain item 1188; you may continue.

m128.action: DASH away with the sword in hand
m128.result: In a blur of motion, you swipe the sword, but it disappears when your feet touch the water. The sentient calls to you, waving the weapon: “Looking for this?” The mystery of the artifact remains unsolved; gain 1 boost.

m129.result: The salt-encrusted handholds are just barely wide enough for you to pull yourself over the crest of the spire, from where you can see the spire is hollow. Go to interior 555.

m130.action: APPROACH the sentients in a non-threatening way to get a closer look at the game they’re playing
m130.result:
The sentients, particularly the sentient on the left, seem eager to include you in the game. Place card 798 on the table (it’s a large card) and follow its instructions.

Variant: Quick Skirm (ignore card 798).

m131.result: The occupant weakly shoves you back outside. Roll 2 skill dice and gain all take results. If you pay 1 take, pocket a pair of pliers (gain item 882) as you tumble out of the tent.

m132.action: LEAP up to the stone to grab the sword
m132.result: With both hands on the sword and your feet providing leverage against the stone, the blade slides out with little resistance. Gain item 889.

m133.result: The green cracks in the spire serve as excellent grips and footholds as you make your way up the tower. The view from above is illuminating. View page 45 of the Book of Vantages and gain 2 boost.

m134.action: PUSH a button on the device
m134.result: Your skin briefly glows the color of the runecaster, and you feel invigorated. Gain 2 skills matching the rune.

m135.action: ENTER the ruins, gingerly avoiding rubble and debris
m135.result: A cool breeze blows off the water and through the tall grass as you clamber up the hill. Go to interior 541.

m136.action: SCALE the tower to look around from above
m136.result: To the south a vast archipelago of glowing volcanic islands dominates the horizon. The view might be even more spectacular at night. View page 45 of the Book of Vantages and gain 2 boost.

m137.action: HIDE among the bones in case a predator appears
m137.result: The beast that killed this creature must have been massive, and you’re worried it will return. Fortunately, after you wait a few minutes, it seems that the coast is clear. Gain 1 morale and continue.

m138.action: SCALE the tower to get a better view of the surrounding area
m138.result: The volcanic archipelago to the south is ruggedly beautiful in its way. View page 45 of the Book of Vantages and gain 2 boost.

m139.result: As you land, your feet dig deep into the soft grass. As you lift them, you notice a green glow underneath. Gain item 1163.

m140.result: Other than the small critters who have made this cliffside area their home, this seems like an excellent place to build a business. Gain 1 help and continue.

m141.action: HIDE among the bones in case a predator appears
m141.result: Just as you tuck yourself away in the long grass, a massive shape darkens the sky. A whale-like creature hovers over the skeleton and then scratches its belly on the ribcage, humming in delight. Before you can act, the animal flies away to the west. Gain 1 boost and continue.

m142.action: SCALE the rusty structure, which is at risk of crumbling at any moment
m142.result: The view is spectacular, and for a moment you forget how unsafe your vantage is. View page 45 of the Book of Vantages and gain 2 boost.

m143.action: SQUEEZE into the ship through an empty escape pod port
m143.result: The inside of the wreckage is in shambles, and you barely have enough room to turn around and move back outside. The good news is that the locker containing your power armor is still intact. The bad news is that you’ll need to cleave the wreckage in half to get to it. Gain 1 boost and 1 overpower; you may continue.

m144.action: FOLLOW the sentient far to the north
m144.result: Go to 475, where the sentient warns you of the elemental to the east before departing.

m145.action: APPROACH the sentient with extreme caution
m145.result: The power emanating from the sentient is palpable, and the last thing you want to do is startle them. You circle around to the front where you think their face is, and to your delight they seem happy to meet you. They explain that they belong to a special sect of energy sentients who can distribute their energy across great distances to specific targets. It’s up to you whether to help others or to take energy for yourself. Gain either 1 help or 1 take; you may continue.

m146.result: The sentient seems to be in a meditative state, making it easier for you to sneak around them. From your vantage on the shore, you see a similar sentient to the west and a current that may make it easier for you to swim north. Gain 2 move.

m147.result: The vastness of the calm sea makes you wonder if you could swim that far north, though you worry about the shadows lurking under the surface to the east. You scoop up some of the sand, sifting it between your fingers. Gain item 1194.

m148.action: APPROACH the Traveler at the water’s edge
m148.result: Without turning to you, the Traveler speaks. “Most of the ancient beasts of this world went extinct long ago, their sun-bleached skeletons all that remain. But there are a few beasts that remain, including one believed to be fictional where we come from.” Gain 1 boost and destiny 1602 (place it in the center).

m149.action: DANCE within the ethereal area at the base of the hill
m149.result: As you dance, you feel a growing sense of connection and control over the many varied forms of life that surround you. Gain lesson 1419.

m150.result: You rush toward the animal, and it soars into the sky. Gain 1 morale.

m151.action: CLIMB the arch up to the rune
m151.result: When you reach the rune, you realize that the stone is etched with hundreds of pairs of names. This appears to be a place for lovers to declare their eternal affection, something you did as a teenager. Gain 1 morale and 1 boost. Also soak in the view around you by viewing page 37 of the Book of Vantages.

m152.result: The lush vegetation on the tiny island is beautiful from a distance, but up close the flora are barbed with sharp spikes. Plucking them could be dangerous. Gain 1 boost and continue.

m153.result: Just in case there’s a guard you can’t see, you hold your breath as long as possible before emerging in the shadows and bagging the amulet. Gain item 1176.

m154.result: You think you can find part of the shore that is protected from lava. Go to 159.

m155.result: Crossing lines dominate the northern sky. Are those contrails from other ships? Go to 160.

m156.action: CHASE away the animal hovering above the Traveler
m156.result: The Traveler doesn’t seem perturbed as you shoo away the giant insect, but you feel brave for doing so. Gain 1 morale and continue.

m157.action: ENTER the gateway after swinging up onto the rock
m157.result: As your hand touches the surface, the surface also reaches out to you, pulling you forward. You may resist to stay here and gain 1 boost or proceed into the gateway (go to 664).

m158.action: SNEAK past the sentient (if the sentient is no longer an obstacle, reduce this cost to 1)
m158.result: The sentient either doesn’t notice or doesn’t care as you sneak around the boulder. Just behind the sentient is a cave. As your eyes adjust to the darkness, you reach a barrier that requires further attention. Go to cave 039.

m159.result:
The sentients turn toward you and ask if you’re seeking the services of a smelter or tattoo artist:

Smelter

If you pay $3, the sentient shakes off some lava and joins you (gain sentient 1316 and quest 1695; add the quest horizontally to your supply). If you don’t pay, they recommend that you earn your keep in the City of Fire to the west of here (gain 1 boost and continue).

Tattoo Artist

The sentient volunteers to accompany you. Gain sentient 1317.

m160.action: SCALE the building to find a rooftop entrance
m160.result: As you hoped, there is a large vent on the roof. It’s quite hot, and you suffer a few burns as you slide inside. Suffer 1 heat damage and go to interior 562.

m161.action: DODGE the lava bursts, making your way north
m161.result: You’re sweating profusely, but you make it through with only minor singed spots on your clothes. Go to 166.

m162.action: ENTER the city by wading through the warm waters
m162.result: You can’t wait to get a closer look at a civilization so integrated with nature. Go to city 525.

m163.result: The animal seems delighted to have a companion willing to guide them. Gain animal 813.

m164.result: Luckily, no one seems to be guarding the source of the lava; either that or you’re just an exceedingly clever rogue. Gain item 1177.

m165.action: SQUEEZE into the ship through a small hole in the side
m165.result: The inside of the wreckage is in shambles, and you barely have enough room to turn around and move back outside. The good news is that the locker containing your power armor is still intact. The bad news is that you’ll need to cleave the wreckage in half to get to it. Gain 1 boost and 1 overpower; you may continue.

m166.result: As you walk by the tree toward the house, one of the sizzling boils bursts open, burning your shoulder. Suffer 1 heat damage. The commotion alerts the owner of the house to your presence, and they chase you away. Go either east to 167 or west to 165.

m167.action: FOLLOW the sentient into their home
m167.result: You linger at the doorframe while the sentient opens a tap of scalding liquid and collapses onto a stool, their many legs jutting outwards. They notice you and invite you inside for a drink. Gain 1 morale and 1 boost; you may continue.

m168.result: You tap into the enormous power emanating from the elemental, summoning aid from your crewmates. Their visages are projected across the planet to your location. Each player who has a fire composition card (in their grid or reserve) or pays 2 boost is considered summoned. If this is a solo game, you may select one unused starting character card (1435–1440) to act as a summoned player. Summoned players may temporarily place challenge dice in their grid as if they were on your location, but only you suffer penalties from the elemental. Summoned players remain summoned until you perform any action other than overpower-SLAY. Continue.

m169.action: APPROACH the sacred monument with a sacrifice in mind
m169.result:
As onlookers and the Traveler watch, you choose an object (a coin or an item) to lose in the lava. Choose one:

Lose $1

Sentients look a bit confused, but they appreciate the gesture. Gain 1 morale and 1 move.

Lose a weapon from your grid or reserve

Sentients applaud your participation in their tradition; gain spell 1367 and 1 move.

Neither

Gain 1 move.

m170.action: PUSH the rock into the cavity
m170.result: After a struggle, the rock slides seamlessly into place. As it does, a jolt surges up your spine and down your arms. You’ve been endowed with a new power. Gain spell 1367.

m171.result: As you wander, careful to avoid the lava, you notice a sailboat to the east and a strange archway to the west. You also detect a gap in the tide to the north. Gain 1 boost and 1 move.

m172.action: WADE into the waves to the wayward boat
m172.result: High-stepping over the waves, you reach the boat and take the helm. The leaf sentient crew members express their gratitude and invite you either to join them on their northward journey (gain 1 morale and quest 1671; add it horizontally to your supply) or to take the entire boat after dropping them off on the northern shore (gain vehicle 1156).

m173.action: PUSH a button on the device
m173.result: Your skin briefly glows the color of the super-charged runecaster, and you feel invigorated. Gain 2 skills matching the rune and continue.

m174.result: Your spirited performance delights the judges, and they welcome you to participate in the trial. Continue with the take-ENDURE action.

m175.action: EVADE north past the swift sentient (if the sentient is no longer an obstacle, reduce this cost to 1)
m175.result: You’re probably not fast enough to outrun the winged sentient, but you bolt through the plains to the north until you spot a breezier sentient relaxing in another tent. Go to 180; if this action’s cost was not reduced to 1, also gain 1 morale.

m176.action: PUSH a sentient away from the twister
m176.result:
The sentient lands awkwardly on the ground, their wing bent at a painful angle. Choose one:

Walk away

Go east, south, or west.

Grab their purse

Gain $4.

Lose 1 time, pay 2 boost, or pay 1 help to heal their wing

They accept your apology and your aid, and they teach you to dance. Gain ability 1469 and 1 morale.

m177.action: DASH away with a flag in hand
m177.result: The people in the surrounding area are furious that you would steal one of these flags. Gain item 1188 and curse 1387.

m178.action: DANCE in place as the sentient draws near
m178.result: The sentient pauses… and then mimics the same dance move. You’ve stumbled upon some kind of party or ceremony among the flowers! Other sentients join the revelry. When you’re done, they offer you one of the flowers as a gift. Gain flora 1076; you may go north to 183.

m179.action: SNEAK north past the blissfully unaware sentient (if the sentient is no longer an obstacle, reduce this cost to 1)
m179.result: The flowers looming overhead are downright Seussian. Go to 184.

m180.action: APPROACH the sentient, intentionally making noise so you don’t surprise them
m180.result: The elder responds well to your approach, and they ask you to join them in the shade for a refreshment. Gain 1 health. They mostly talk about flags, one of the ways wind sentients can see wind patterns from a distance. If you’re interested, you could place some flags in the surrounding grasslands (gain quest 1669; add it horizontally to your supply). If not, gain 1 boost and continue.

m181.action: APPROACH the sentients, bowing as you draw close
m181.result:
One of the sentients cautions you to stay away from the sacred seed. Choose one:

Heed their warning

When they see that you heed their warning, they offer you a token of their people. Gain item 1212.

Ask for more details about the sacred seed

They share that the chest contains an extremely rare seed. They have been tasked with guarding it until the day comes for the seed to blossom and spread Spor across the world. Gain 2 boost.

m182.action: EVADE north past the sentients, jumping to your feet and racing ahead (if the sentients are no longer an obstacle, reduce this cost to 1)
m182.result: You dodge the sentients and sprint north across the open prairie. Go to 187; if this action’s cost was not reduced to 1, also gain 1 morale.

m183.result: At first it’s difficult to discern and copy the sentient’s dance moves, but a distinct pattern emerges. Gain ability 1469. Eventually, the dancer acknowledges you and asks if you’d like to accompany them to the Trial of Life. If you agree, gain sentient 1305 and go east to 184.

m184.result: Your spirited performance delights the queen, and she welcomes you to participate in the trial. Continue with the help-ENLIVEN action.

m185.action: ENTER the ruins, gingerly avoiding rubble and debris
m185.result: Birds coast on the dry air above you as you climb up the rocky hill, watching your footing as you go. Go to interior 542.

m186.result: The path leads directly into the town. Go to city 518.

m187.action: DASH away with the artifact in hand
m187.result: In a blur of motion, you swipe the artifact and leave pursuers cursing you in your wake. Gain curse 1387. If you pay 4 boost, your attempts to use the artifact are successful (gain item 1003 and perform no other location actions here). If not, the mystery of the artifact remains unsolved, and it vanishes from your grasp; gain 1 boost.

m188.result: From the top of the turbine, you get a better look at the rusty gears and the surrounding area. View page 35 of the Book of Vantages and gain 1 help; you may continue.

m189.result: You pick up a family of leeches from the muck, but you eventually arrive at the far shore. Lose 1 health and go north to 194.

m190.action: SQUEEZE blindly into the pitch-black of the cave
m190.result: Despite the impressive width of the cave mouth, you’re increasingly overwhelmed by claustrophobia as you move deeper and deeper inside. Just when you can’t take it any longer, a cavern opens before you. Lose 1 morale and go to cave 036.

m191.action: PUSH a button on the device
m191.result: Your skin briefly glows the color of the runecaster, and you feel invigorated. Gain 2 skills matching the rune.

m192.result: How often do you let yourself twirl around in the wind? The breeze lifts your lonely spirits. Gain 2 morale.

m193.action: WANDER around the hill, looking for inspiration
m193.result: The grass on the hill is soft, but the soil is a mix of pebbles and earth—it may be difficult to dig into, but the ground would soundly support a building here. Gain 1 help or 1 overpower; you may continue.

m194.action: EVADE the twister as you head north (if the twister is no longer an obstacle, reduce this cost to 1)
m194.result: The gale-force winds leave you unsteady on your feet at first, but you sprint without stopping until you reach (much more tranquil) foothills to the north. Go to 199 and gain 1 morale.

m195.action: ENTER the gate to the north; you may pay $2
m195.result: Green lights scan your body as you pass through the gateway. If you paid $2, gain 2 health—the gateway provides a health benefit for those willing to pay. Whether or not you paid, go to 225.

m196.action: SQUEEZE into the ship through a small hole in the side
m196.result: The inside of the wreckage is in shambles, and you barely have enough room to turn around and move back outside. The good news is that the locker containing your power armor is still intact. The bad news is that you’ll need to cleave the wreckage in half to get to it. Gain 1 boost and 1 overpower; you may continue.

m197.action: APPROACH the sentient, showing that you mean no harm
m197.result: The sentient requests that you wait until they place the final flag in the ground, then they turn to you. “Looking for company?” they ask. Gain sentient 1307.

m198.action: PUSH the orb off the cliff
m198.result: The orb shatters on the rocks below, exposing a pink sentient. They were looking for work, but now they can’t read any job postings on the orb. They begrudgingly latch onto you. Gain sentient 1327 with a “when placed” benefit of only 1 boost (instead of 2).

m199.action: SNEAK north past the oblivious sentient (if the sentient is no longer an obstacle, reduce this cost to 1)
m199.result: A circular rock formation in the distance looks like a window to the sky. Go to 229.

m200.action: TREK north through the misty valley
m200.result: You descend into the opaque fog below, where the poor visibility and rugged terrain together make navigation all but impossible. Roll 6 skill dice and gain all look results. You may pay 2 look to go to interior 563. Otherwise, go to 205. Either way, also gain 1 morale.

m201.result: The sentient swivels in midair, surprised by your sudden appearance. “State your name and intent!” they demand. Unable to find you in their database, they explain that they patrol the area around the King of Thieves to the northeast, and they don’t want any trouble from you if you head there. Gain 1 boost.

m202.result: After the sentient flies away in frustration, you find yourself in a colorful flower patch. You unearth a particularly beautiful flower, shaking dirt from its roots. Gain flora 1075.

m203.result: The narrow staircase doesn’t leave you with much room to maneuver, but a well-timed spin move leaves the guard grasping at air. Inside the building you find a hostage, whom you free, much to the disdain of their captor. Gain sentient 1349 and curse 1391.

m204.result:
The result of you entering the building is based on whether anyone is inside. Proceed if you already know this status; if not, roll a challenge die to determine the status randomly (this die can come from the dice pool or the center; return it afterward):

No one is home (blank challenge die)

Go to interior 556; on your next turn, you may not perform the engage-TRADE action on interior 556 before you go to another location.

Someone is home (non-blank challenge die)

The startled family shoves you back outside and locks the door. Roll 3 skill dice and gain all take results. If you pay 1 take, gain item 1040 as you avoid the slammed door.

m205.action: CLIMB up to the higher lotus
m205.result: This hard-to-reach lotus is thriving despite the chilly temperatures. It would be a beautiful specimen to pluck. Gain 1 overpower and continue.

m206.action: ENTER the city through the primary gates
m206.result: A departing sentient brushes against you as you saunter through the main entrance, and you realize they pinched a coin from your pocket. Lose $1 and go to city 522.

m207.result: Your spirited performance delights the king, and he welcomes you to participate in the trial. Continue with the take-BYPASS action.

m208.result: On the inside of the orb is a map of this region, and it pinpoints your current location. Look at page 3 of the Book of Vantages; your current area is NW-3. They also mention that you can leave messages to other travelers on the orb exterior. Gain 1 boost and continue.

m209.action: CHASE away the animal (if the animal is no longer an obstacle, reduce this cost to 1)
m209.result: You make yourself big, spooking the animal. Gain 1 morale; you may go north to 214.

m210.action: EVADE the magnetic pull of the object
m210.result: You dart around the giant orestone, evading its magnetic grasp. A metal sentient compliments your dexterity, asking with a wink if you’re one of the infamous bandits who hide in the clouds south of here. You may go north to 215 or south to 205.

m211.action: APPROACH the collector to see what they want
m211.result: “Thank you for asking, little one. The item I covet is the Eye of the Ancient. I know exactly where it is—far northeast of here—but all my attempts to acquire it have failed.” Gain 1 boost and quest 1658 (add it horizontally to your supply).

m212.result: You make yourself big, spooking the animal. Gain 1 morale. As the beast rumbles away, you catch a hearty whiff of the large lotus on the right. Gain 1 health; you may also lose 1 curse.

m213.result: You exploit a blind spot in the sentinels’ predictable route. Either go north to 218, or suffer 1 heat damage and go to interior 513.

m214.action: BALANCE north precariously across the narrow path
m214.result: You have to think about every step (gain ability 1501), but you make it safely to cave 034.

m215.action: SCALE the eastern side of the building until you reach an open window
m215.result: Before you enter, you hear the hum of the angular device hovering within reach. As you place your palm against it, your skin briefly glows the color of the runecaster, and you feel invigorated. Gain 2 skills matching the rune. Gain 1 morale and go to interior 557.

m216.action: ENTER the building through the front door
m216.result: The museum docent charges you a small fee to walk around the exhibits. If you pay $1, go to interior 564. Otherwise, gain 1 boost and continue.

m217.action: CLIMB north up and over one of the rocky outcroppings that break up the fence
m217.result: The fence is relatively easy for you to bypass… but is that a good idea? Go to 222.

m218.result: As you encircle the stone, you realize that your feet are no longer touching the ground—you are levitating in orbit with the other shards. You kick away, falling to the snow, a newfound power surging through you. Gain lesson 1431.

m219.action: APPROACH the Traveler about escaping this planet
m219.result: The Traveler’s tone grows somber. “There are several ways you could leave, but they require a power source like that controlled by the metal sentients.” Gain 1 boost and destiny 1607 (place it in the center).

m220.result: The cold stone digs into your fingers as you ascend, but the view from the top is worth it. View page 36 in the Book of Vantages and gain 2 boost.

m221.action: EVADE the mechanical hydra (if the animal is no longer an obstacle, reduce this cost to 1)
m221.result:
You bend and twist to avoid the beast; choose one:

Go to cave 022

if this action’s cost was not reduced to 1, also gain 1 morale.

Climb north to location 602

gain 1 boost and 1 move when you notice that the hydra only really cares about guarding the cave.

m222.action: GUIDE the animal through the blizzard
m222.result: The pup leans against you for comfort, trusting your presence. It seems particularly happy to head northeast. Gain animal 810 and 1 morale.

m223.action: WANDER around the deep snowdrifts surrounding the lorestones
m223.result: You think you hear the jangling of coins at your feet at one point, and at another you see a golden glow within the stones. Gain either 1 take or 1 overpower; you may continue.

m224.result: You press against the ridge, as far from the sheer drop as you can get. Go to 420.

m225.result:
Choose a tent to enter:

The smaller tent

There’s no one inside, so you bundle up the tent quietly. Gain item 1032.

The bigger tent

The occupants shove you back outside. Roll 2 skill dice and gain all take results. If you pay 1 take, pocket an item as you tumble out of the tent (gain item 908).

m226.result: Your legs ache from the long descent, but your curiosity about the source of the glimmering helix of light below sustains your motivation. Gain ability 1491 and 1 morale; go to 231.

m227.action: STEER the vehicle into the air
m227.result: You ease yourself onto the carpet, which adjusts itself automatically for your volume and waits for a command. Gain vehicle 985.

m228.action: SCALE the tower to get a better view of the surrounding area
m228.result: To the north, warm amber-colored lights in the vast swamp below glimmer among the dense trees. View page 31 of the Book of Vantages and gain 2 boost.

m229.action: DESCEND north down the steep cliff
m229.result: The slope of the rocky cliff face on the north side of the curiously shaped mountain is unforgiving, but eventually you make your way into a dense swamp punctuated by glowing lights. Gain ability 1491 and 1 morale; go to 234.

m230.action: PUSH your palm into the nearby rune
m230.result: With your hand blocking the rune, nothing happens. Gain 1 boost and continue.

m231.action: DASH away with the artifact in hand
m231.result: In a blur of motion, you swipe the artifact and leave pursuers cursing you in your wake. Gain curse 1395. If you pay 4 boost, your attempts to use the artifact are successful (gain item 1001 and perform no other location actions here). If not, the mystery of the artifact remains unsolved, and it vanishes from your grasp; gain 1 boost.

m232.result: As you wait in the shadows, the light begins to resemble an intelligent life form. You realize you’re witnessing the birth of a sentient made of pure energy. The light is the same color as the lanterns that hang all around you—they must be where this type of sentient lives. Gain 2 boost.

m233.result: Your spirited performance delights the judges, and they welcome you to participate in the trial. Continue with the look-TRANSLATE action.

m234.result: You begin to step forward, but they demand that you stop. “The springblade lilies in this swamp have a taste for landwalkers like you. We advise that you walk around them, not over them.” Gain 1 boost and continue.

m235.action: WANDER around the moss of the swamp
m235.result: The Traveler talks to you while you roam. “You’ll find the entire swampland to the east to be quite difficult to traverse, whether you’re wading through the muck or trailblazing through tight clusters of trees.” Gain 1 boost.

m236.action: SCALE the tower to view the surrounding area
m236.result: Soft yellow lights the color of old sodium lamps dapple the swamp all around you. View page 31 of the Book of Vantages and gain 2 boost.

m237.action: SNEAK into the orb after the sentient leaves
m237.result: The orb displays a partial map of the world. Look at page 3 of the Book of Vantages; your current area is NW-1. Gain 1 boost.

m238.action: ENTER the city through the primary gates
m238.result: An eerie-yet-welcoming light draws you into the city. Go to city 520.

m239.action: CLIMB a tree to covertly enter the treehouse
m239.result: The misty air and the rugged wooden construction remind you of the pirate ships you built in your grandparents’ backyard when you were young. Go to interior 565.

m240.result: You surprise the current occupant of the orb. Fortunately, they’re curious about you, and there’s enough room for two inside. They show you that the orb is a map of this region, and it pinpoints your current location. Look at page 3 of the Book of Vantages; your current area is NW-1. Gain 1 boost.

m241.action: PUSH the crystal from the grip of the stone
m241.result: The crystal resists moving, but you manage to wrest it from the stone’s influence. Gain item 1161.

m242.result: You tap into the enormous power emanating from the elemental, summoning aid from your crewmates. Their visages are projected across the planet to your location. Each player who has an energy composition card (in their grid or reserve) or pays 2 boost is considered summoned. If this is a solo game, you may select one unused starting character card (1435–1440) to act as a summoned player. Summoned players may temporarily place challenge dice in their grid as if they were on your location, but only you suffer penalties from the elemental. Summoned players remain summoned until you perform any action other than overpower-SLAY. Continue.

m243.action: PUSH a button on the device
m243.result: Your skin briefly glows the color of the runecaster, and you feel invigorated. Gain 2 skills matching the rune.

m244.action: HIDE while you wait for the sentient to exit the orb
m244.result: The sentient finally finishes their business inside the orb, and you enter it to find a map of the area. Look at page 3 of the Book of Vantages; your current area is NW-1. Gain 1 boost.

m245.action: CLIMB a tree to get a better look at a lantern
m245.result: You tap on the glass, and a tiny sentient inside is irate that you would disturb them in their home. The angrier they are, the more light the lantern casts. Gain item 1187 and curse 1395.

m246.action: PUSH a button on the device
m246.result: Your skin briefly glows the color of the runecaster, and you feel invigorated. Gain 2 skills matching the rune.

m247.action: SNEAK north around the sentients (if they are no longer an obstacle, reduce this cost to 1)
m247.result: You stay behind the runestones, just in case. Go to 663.

m248.action: STEER the boat into the stream
m248.result: Careful not to attract attention, you set the boat adrift and climb aboard. Gain vehicle 1014 and $4.

m249.result: The animal recognizes that you’re looking for navigational help. Gain 1 morale; you may go either north to 665 or south to 244.

m250.result: You find a way to reach the glowing box without impaling yourself on any of the spiked rocks. Gain item 952.

m251.result: The ground lurches beneath you, and all goes black. Go to cave 049.

m252.action: APPROACH the Traveler or the sentient
m252.result:
Approach the Traveler about the possibility of escaping this planet

“Is your home really that much better than this planet? There are vibrant cities to the north and south of here where you can make a new home.” Gain 1 boost and destiny 1601 (place it in the center).

Approach the sentient about their profession

The sentient boasts that they are a falconer—they control marrow vultures who scout the surrounding area. The bones they wear reflect their craft. You may either gain a marrow vulture (animal 826) with 1 boost on it, or gain sentient 1331.

m253.action: PUSH the treasure chest into the pit
m253.result: When you push the chest off the ledge, it smashes onto the scalding rocks in the pit and bursts into flames. Luckily, one of the contents of the chest—a blue crystal—falls within reach. Gain item 1160.

m254.action: FOLLOW the source of the tracks
m254.result:
You realize that it’s not one but two animals that created these footprints. You can tell from the tracks that the animal to the north is hungry and that the animal to the east is scared. Choose one:

  • Gain 1 boost and go north to 259.

  • Gain 1 boost and go east to 443.

  • Remain here to gain 1 boost and continue.

m255.action: EVADE north around the sentients (if the sentients are no longer an obstacle, reduce this cost to 1)
m255.result: The sentients make a halfhearted attempt to snag you, but you’re much faster than them. Go to 260.

m256.result: You find a lotus defying the odds in the dry heat. The lotus smells a bit like coconut. Gain 1 health from the purifying pollen; you may also lose 1 curse.

m257.result: The birds fly away, leaving you alone with the sentient. “Thank you for doing that,” they say, their eyes downcast. “I came to this arid land with the hope of planting seeds with a friend to the north, but I stumbled into this trap. I could really use some company.” Gain sentient 1354.

m258.action: DASH away with one of the peddler’s wares
m258.result: You grab the mace dangling from the peddler’s arm and run away. Gain item 969 and go to an adjacent location (either a listed location, where you’ll find cooler temperatures, or the hot desert to the north (263) or west (257).

m259.result: It doesn’t take much to scare away the animal, but you trip over a spiky plant, uprooting it. Gain flora 1053.

m260.action: GUIDE the animal in the direction of a skeleton
m260.result: Unsure as to your intentions, the animal doesn’t blink as you lead it away. Gain animal 825.

m261.result: Your spirited performance delights the judges, and they welcome you to participate in the trial. Continue with the overpower-HUNT action.

m262.action: DESCEND into the arid town, which appears to be made entirely from the skeletal remains of gargantuan beasts
m262.result: Though a little unsettling, the bone-based architecture of the city is surprisingly functional. Go to city 524.

m263.action: APPROACH the flower with caution in case it’s a trap
m263.result: As you tiptoe toward the flower, the soil around it bursts to life, the stone-like bulbs pummeling you from all sides. Roll 4 skill dice and gain all move results. Lose 1 health unless you pay 1 move. You’re caked in sweat and sand by the time you put the flower to rest. Gain flora 1052.

m264.action: CLIMB up to the ruins, gingerly avoiding rubble and debris as you enter
m264.result: Before you enter the ruins, you can’t resist pushing the large rune on the device levitating on the far side of the plateau. Your skin briefly glows the color of the runecaster, and you feel invigorated. Gain 2 skills matching the rune and go to interior 543.

m265.action: HIDE until the coast is clear, then move north (if you interacted with the sentients, reduce this cost to 1)
m265.result: The path of scraped dirt from the dragged sentient extends as far as you can see. Go to 270.

m266.action: ENTER the building through the front door
m266.result: Eyeing your purse, a greeter eagerly welcomes you inside. Go to interior 558.

m267.action: FOLLOW the swift sentient north (if you already interacted with the sentient, reduce this cost to 2)
m267.result: Gain 1 health as you pass through the oasis. Go to 272.

m268.action: APPROACH the Traveler with the possibility of escaping this planet
m268.result: “If you must leave, with enough effort you could repair your spaceship. There is wreckage directly to the north of here.” Gain 1 boost and destiny 1605 (place it in the center).

m269.action: PUSH north against the increasing wind
m269.result: You’re able to move through the sandstorm to 274, but not before the sand leaves hundreds of shallow gashes in your skin. Lose 1 health.

m270.action: PUSH the chest off the ledge
m270.result: The chest bursts open upon impact, and all you can find among the mud is a bright red crystal. Gain item 1165.

m271.result: You’re rewarded with a breathtaking view of the surrounding area. View page 33 in the Book of Vantages and gain 2 boost; continue.

m272.result: You can’t make much sense of the blobs, but you’re amazed by the sheer scale of the skeleton, which yields some craftable ivory. Gain item 1186.

m273.action: SQUEEZE into the ship through a small hole in the side
m273.result: The inside of the wreckage is in shambles, and you barely have enough room to turn around and move back outside. The good news is that the locker containing your power armor is still intact. The bad news is that you’ll need to cleave the wreckage in half to get to it. Gain 1 boost and 1 overpower; you may continue.

m274.action: LEAP from one horn-shaped rock to the other
m274.result: Despite the simplicity of the act, it is satisfying in the same way as any arbitrary accomplishment or dare from your childhood. Gain 2 morale and continue.

m275.result: The view at the top of the old structure gives you a new perspective of the severe beauty of this corner of the world. View page 38 in the Book of Vantages and gain 2 boost.

m276.result:
The sentients wave you over to join the next game. Place card 798 on the table (it’s a large card) and follow its instructions.

Variant: Quick Skirm (ignore card 798).

m277.action: EVADE north under the beast (if the animal is no longer an obstacle, reduce this cost to 1)
m277.result: The animal grabs at you, finding only air where you were seconds before. Go to 282; if this action’s cost was not reduced to 1, also gain 1 morale.

m278.result: As you approach the wall, you’re swarmed from all sides by cloaked sentients bearing shields covered in tiny mirrors. The sun’s reflection off the shields blinds you. Gain 1 boost and read entry 278 in the Book of Secrets.

m279.action: PUSH the orb off the cliff
m279.result: The orb shatters on the distant rocks below. The sentient is so fast that they’re able to run diagonally along the edge of the cliff instead of falling. Gain curse 1390 and 1 boost.

m280.result: “With this sentient’s knowledge of time travel, there’s a fool’s hope that I could see my family again.” Gain 1 boost and destiny 1608 (place it in the center). You may continue.

m281.action: ENTER the building through the front door
m281.result: The main entrance is wide open, so you walk right inside. Go to interior 795.

m282.action: HIDE behind some rocks in case the predator is still in the area
m282.result: You realize after a few minutes that whatever killed this beast is long gone. The swirling sand reveals a glimmer of green under the skeleton; gain item 1163.

m283.action: PUSH a button on the device
m283.result: Your skin briefly glows the color of the runecaster, and you feel invigorated. Gain 2 skills matching the rune.

m284.result: You can feel the crystal’s power as you draw near. You remove it from the rock, and as you do, the three treasure chests on the ground below burst open. Fierce guardians emerge from each and surround the rock. Roll 4 skill dice and gain all overpower results. Then lose 1 health unless you pay 1 overpower. Gain item 1162.

m285.action: SQUEEZE into the ship through a small hole in the side
m285.result: The inside of the wreckage is in shambles, and you barely have enough room to turn around and move back outside. The good news is that the locker containing your power armor is still intact. The bad news is that you’ll need to cleave the wreckage in half to get to it. Gain 1 boost and 1 overpower; you may continue.

m286.action: SNEAK north past the multi-headed sentient as the sun lowers in the sky (if the sentient is no longer an obstacle, reduce this cost to 1)
m286.result: The sentient is too busy debating something untranslatable with itself to notice you slipping behind a rock outcrop. Go to 291; if this action’s cost was not reduced to 1, also gain 1 morale.

m287.action: CLIMB to the peak of the mountain
m287.result: It is a treacherous ascent, but you find a well-worn route to the top. First, view page 38 of the Book of Vantages and gain 2 boost as you look down at the world below. Then, go to interior 592 and gain 1 morale.

m288.result: The mouse-like creature chirps excitedly as it leads you away from the overly convenient gateway before scampering away. Go west to 287.

m289.result: You take a running start and leap off the bridge to the other side. Go to 294 and gain 1 morale.

m290.action: SCALE the tower to get a better view of the surrounding area
m290.result: Patches of fog obscure parts of the rugged terrain below. View page 38 of the Book of Vantages and gain 2 boost.

m291.result:
As you walk past the pit, the sand under your feet gives way and a massive centipede bursts upward. Choose one:

Pay 1 move

Go north to 296.

Get swallowed by the centipede

Go to cave 049.

m292.action: SQUEEZE blindly into the pitch-black of the cave
m292.result: You’re increasingly overwhelmed by claustrophobia as you move deeper and deeper inside. Just when you can’t take it any longer, a cavern opens before you. Lose 1 morale and go to cave 025.

m293.action: ENTER the narrow, dark hole on the side of the cliff
m293.result: You crawl through the hole, and it dumps you into a crowd of people inside the mountain. Go to cave 085.

m294.result: The occupants wake up from the intrusion and shove you back outside. Roll 2 skill dice and gain all take results. If you pay 1 take, pocket an item as you tumble out of the tent. Gain item 884.

m295.result: The sentient shifts before your eyes, moving faster than you can imagine. They relax when they see you aren’t an intruder in the night. They return to their work, sharing that the orbs they create are wayfinders for travelers to know where they are. They’re made of glass, but the glass liquifies upon touch to let you enter. Gain 1 health and 1 boost.

m296.result: The lorestones glow from within. Gain 1 overpower and continue.

m297.result: Daylight should give some relief from the chill of night. Go to 327.

m298.action: LEAP from one lorestone to the next
m298.result: You jump onto the highest lorestone and soak in the view, illuminated by millions of stars and the northern dawn. View page 34 in the Book of Vantages and gain 2 boost.

m299.action: SCALE the tower to view the surrounding area
m299.result: The dry mesas and rocky sands of the desert give way to a blue ocean to the north. View page 34 of the Book of Vantages and gain 2 boost.

m300.action: BALANCE northwest across the natural bridge
m300.result: You’re baffled that such a large animal could traverse such precarious terrain. Go to 383.

m301.result: The sentient flies away, leaving you alone on the hillside. Gain 1 morale and 1 move; you may continue.

m302.action: SNEAK quietly into one of the buildings so as not to disturb the birds
m302.result: You are surrounded by nests of various shapes, sizes, and compositions—bowl, cavity, ground, platform, and even some more unusual shapes. Of the birds inside, most are sleeping, though a few chirp at you. You pocket a few eggs and leave (gain item 1213); as you do, you see an exit directly through the mountain. You may go north to 307.

m303.action: PUSH one of the stones into the sea
m303.result: The large stone hits the water with a very satisfying “plunk!” Gain 2 morale.

m304.result: The only guard you can see is distracted by the pirate ship. Go to interior 566.

m305.action: SCALE the exterior of the building
m305.result: It’s quite a vertical ascent, but fortunately the wood is old and warped. Go to interior 597 and gain 1 morale.

m306.result: Just in case there’s a guard you can’t see, you sneak along the shoreline, the waves spraying you with saltwater. Having made it to the base of the shard, you may pay 2 boost to extract it (if so, gain item 1216). If not, gain 1 take and continue.

m307.action: CLIMB to the peak of the island
m307.result: The lush hill is easy to climb, and soon you’re treated with a resplendent view. Look at page 44 in the Book of Vantages and gain 2 boost; you may continue.

m308.action: GUIDE the animal to the shallows nearby so you can inspect it for injuries
m308.result: The animal winces and cries as it settles in the sand at your feet. Gain 1 help and 1 overpower; you may continue with the help-HEAL or overpower-RELIEVE action.

m309.action: GUIDE the pirates to a nearby treasure chest
m309.result: The pirates cheer you from above and toss you a flagon of ale, though they don’t invite you aboard—they probably don’t want to share the spoils with you. Gain item 856.

m310.result: As you saunter around the shoreline, you notice an abundance of beautiful flowers. You unearth a particularly pretty patch, shaking dirt from its roots. Gain flora 1067 and continue.

m311.action: DESCEND into the water, following the steps
m311.result:
You find that the path leads underwater by design. You follow the steps until you’re fully submerged. Choose one:

You may suffer 1 hypoxia damage to proceed even deeper

After inhaling too much water, you emerge dripping wet in an underground cave. Go to cave 089.

Return to the surface

Gain 1 boost and continue.

m312.action: STEER the boat into the current
m312.result: You feel at home at the helm of this fine vessel. Unfortunately, it’s technically not your vessel, and the owner—whose footprints are in the sand—curses you from the shore. Gain vehicle 1014 and curse 1386.

m313.action: CHASE away the animal as you wade north (if the animal is no longer an obstacle, reduce this cost to 1)
m313.result: You make yourself big, spooking the animal. Gain 1 morale and go north to 318.

m314.action: STEER the boat into the current
m314.result: You feel at home at the helm of this fine vessel. Gain vehicle 1014 and $4.

m315.action: DASH away with the book in hand
m315.result: It’s more difficult that it looks to wrestle the book free from its stand, but with a sharp tug it’s in your arms. You scamper into the forest. Gain item 1192.

m316.action: CHASE away the animal by waving a freshly plucked mushroom in its face
m316.result: The creature shrieks and skitters away. Gain item 1136.

m317.action: GUIDE the animal into the trees before turning to find its hunter
m317.result: The creature blends in perfectly with the trees, to the point that you can’t even locate it. Gain 1 morale and 1 overpower; you may continue.

m318.action: DASH away with the artifact in hand
m318.result: In a blur of motion, you swipe the artifact and leave pursuers cursing you in your wake. Gain curse 1388. If you pay 4 boost, your attempts to use the artifact are successful (gain item 1008). If not, the mystery of the artifact remains unsolved, and it vanishes from your grasp; gain 1 boost.

m319.action: CHASE the animal away from the rocks
m319.result: The skittish animal is frightened by your aggressive approach, and it skitters into the brush. Gain 1 move.

m320.action: SCALE the tower to view the surrounding area
m320.result:
This tower sits where several regions meet. Choose one:

Look northwest

View page 39 of the Book of Vantages and gain 2 boost.

Look northeast

View page 40 of the Book of Vantages and gain 2 boost.

Look southeast

View page 44 of the Book of Vantages and gain 2 boost.

Look southwest

View page 43 of the Book of Vantages and gain 2 boost.

m321.result: The stoic sentient welcomes you inside, where you find rows of classrooms along a main hallway. One is filling with young sentients in three queues; the other is empty. If you would like to join a line, go to interior 600. If you would like to be alone in a room, go to interior 567.

m322.action: APPROACH the sentient, letting them know of your presence
m322.result: The little sentient shyly shows you their creation, a special flower arrangement. They mention that their focus at the academy is life magic, which gives them a slight advantage when working with flora. They share a basic lesson with you. Gain lesson 1419.

m323.action: HIDE in the back of the class, hoping the teacher won’t notice you
m323.result: The instructor is explaining the sacrifice required to tap into life mana. Gain lesson 1419.

m324.action: SCALE the tower to get a better view of the surrounding area
m324.result: The unruly terrain to the north must be a product of perverse and often baffling geological processes. View page 40 of the Book of Vantages and gain 2 boost.

m325.action: DASH away from the golden predators with the tiny animal in hand
m325.result: Your surprise tactic pays off, and the golden spiders don’t have time to react. The animal is trembling with fear. Gain animal 817.

m326.result: It only takes a moment for the animal to realize that you’re the predator in this situation, and with a spin of their web they’re rappelling down the canyon. Gain 1 morale.

m327.action: PUSH the chest off the ledge onto the path
m327.result: The chest lands with a thud, disarming the trap set underneath. Gain either 1 engage or 1 overpower; you may continue.

m328.action: EVADE north around the slow sentient
m328.result: The sentient makes a feeble attempt to catch you, but you easily evade them. As you do, you’re drawn to the sweet smell of the nearby lotus. Gain 1 health; you may also lose 1 curse. Go north to 333.

m329.result: Clearly exhausted, they mumble something about falling off course while looking for a legendary cave. With one of their arms in your reassuring grasp, you gather what information you can and head east to 467. Gain sentient 1313 and quest 1670 (add the quest horizontally to your supply).

m330.action: PUSH the button on the device
m330.result: Your skin briefly glows the color of the runecaster, and you feel invigorated. Gain 2 skills matching the rune.

m331.result: You’re intimidated by the large gaps to the north and south, but the lotus has a calming effect on you. Gain 1 health; you may also lose 1 curse. You may continue.

m332.action: ENTER the city through the primary gates
m332.result: If you pay 1 engage or $1, the guards make way for you to enter city 530. Otherwise, the guards refuse to let you pass; gain 1 boost and continue.

m333.action: ENTER the shop through the front door
m333.result: The proprietor is happy for the opportunity to sell to you. Go to interior 568.

m334.action: ENTER the orb to see if it contains anything to aid the sentient
m334.result: The orb shows your current position in the world, but it offers no insights into gold sentients. Look at page 4 of the Book of Vantages; your current area is NE-2. Gain 1 boost.

m335.result: No one stops or notices you as you covertly enter the stall. Go to interior 569.

m336.action: DESCEND into the depths of the gap
