m719.result: The crisscrossing gorges and the impossible rocky towers here look even stranger from above. View page 40 of the Book of Vantages and gain 2 boost.

m720.action: PUSH the button on the device
m720.result: Your skin briefly glows the color of the runecaster, and you feel invigorated. Gain 2 skills matching the rune.

m721.result: Your spirited performance delights the judges, and they welcome you to participate in the trial. Continue with the look-CALCULATE action.

m722.result: Clearing this particular gap ignites in you an unexpectedly strong sense of satisfaction. Go to 723 and gain 1 morale.

m723.action: SCALE the tower to get a better view of the surrounding area
m723.result: The peculiarly low gravity of this part of the world has wrought a fantastical (but dangerous) landscape. View page 40 of the Book of Vantages and gain 2 boost.

m724.action: CHASE the glowing beast away from the treasure chest
m724.result: The beast is not easily intimidated, but they finally skitter into the shadows, leaving the chest for you to open. Continue with the engage-PICK action at a cost reduced by 2.

m725.result:
You can’t read the sign, but you find a footpath leading from the dot on the nearby tuft of earth over to the line to the left. It then leads north. Gain 1 morale, then choose one:

Go north

You catch up with a sentient heading the same way. Before you outpace them, you learn that you’re on the Pilgrim’s Path. Gain quest 1673 (add it horizontally to your supply) and go to 726.

  • Continue on this location.

m726.action: GUIDE the pair of sentients away from the aggressor (if the massive creature is no longer an obstacle, reduce this cost to 1)
m726.result: The sentients give you a small token of their appreciation (gain item 876) before scampering away. Go north to 727, east to 410, south to 725, or west to 720.

m727.action: ENTER the city through the primary entrance
m727.result: You’re worried that one haphazard step on the path into the city will send you sprawling into the misty depths, but some unseen force pulls you into the front gate. Go to city 523.

m728.result: The sentient grins as they grab your hand and leap; you’re surprised to find that the lower gravity in the area results in you drifting comfortably to the ground. “Now for the real thing!” the sentient exclaims. You may gain sentient 1347 and go west to 722.

m729.result: You tap into the enormous power emanating from the elemental, summoning aid from your crewmates. Their visages are projected across the planet to your location. Each player who has a stone composition card (in their grid or reserve) or pays 2 boost is considered summoned. If this is a solo game, you may select one unused starting character card (1435–1440) to act as a summoned player. Summoned players may temporarily place challenge dice in their grid as if they were on your location, but only you suffer penalties from the elemental. Summoned players remain summoned until you perform any action other than overpower-SLAY. Continue.

m730.action: SNEAK past the guards into the cave
m730.result: Taking full advantage of the dim lighting, you manage to avoid drawing the guards’ attention. Go to cave 020.

m731.action: SQUEEZE into the ship through a small hole in the side
m731.result: The inside of the wreckage is in shambles, and you barely have enough room to turn around and move back outside. The good news is that the locker containing your power armor is still intact. The bad news is that you’ll need to cleave the wreckage in half to get to it. Gain 1 boost and 1 overpower; you may continue.

m732.result: You gingerly avoid rubble and debris as you enter the wreckage. Go to interior 791.

m733.action: CLIMB up the towering boulder to reach the Pearl
m733.result: A sentient is walking down a much easier-to-use staircase on the back of the boulder when you arrive, and they encourage you to touch the Pearl. When you do, your mind goes blank, save for three glowing symbols. Choose one and gain the corresponding spell: life (gain spell 1236), spirit (gain spell 1237), or mind (gain spell 1238).

m734.result:
At the edge of the bridge, you attempt to climb into the rift, but the energy radiating out of it is too strong for you to push through. Choose one:

Soak in the energy of the rift

Gain lesson 1433.

Grab something from the watery side of the rift

Gain flora 1061.

m735.action: APPROACH the sentient without startling them
m735.result: You step out into the heat to ensure the sentient sees you before you tap on the glass (suffer 1 heat damage). Seeing your skin wilt in the sun, the sentient ushers you inside the protective dome, where they tell you that they’re working on a new type of orb that just isn’t working the way they hoped. Instead of displaying your location on a map, they’re trying to create an orb that lets you talk face to face with anyone inside any other orb. They give you a pair of goggles linked to their own to give you an idea of what they’re trying to do (gain item 941).

m736.result: Despite your careful steps, several wedges of glass slice your skin. Lose 1 health and go to 486.

m737.result: The resident tries to warn you, but you don’t listen. Inside you find blood-soaked floorboards. Go to interior 588.

m738.action: ENTER the city through the primary gates
m738.result: The residents of the city seem very friendly to travelers. Go to city 527.

m739.action: SNEAK close to the island, remaining hidden in the water
m739.result: Just in case there are guards among the brush, you hold your breath as long as possible before emerging close to shore. Suspended from a rusty chain you find a large mech suit, presumably stolen. Gain vehicle 984.

m740.action: APPROACH the Traveler about escaping this planet
m740.result: The Traveler’s tone grows somber. “Leave? You are on the cusp of one of the greatest mysteries— time travel is within your grasp!” Gain 1 boost and destiny 1608 (place it in the center).

m741.result: Your skin tingles as you cross an invisible barrier. Suddenly the clear blue sky is replaced by an orange haze. Go to 515.

m742.action: APPROACH the Traveler about escaping this planet
m742.result: Their tone grows contemplative. “If you must leave, you could find the Aegis and master the art of time travel.” Gain 1 boost and destiny 1608 (place it in the center).

m743.action: SQUEEZE into the mouth of the cave, ignoring the sentients
m743.result: As your eyes adjust to the darkness, you reach a barrier that requires further attention. Go to cave 031.

m744.action: SCALE the tallest point on the island
m744.result: Clouds cover most of the ocean as far as you can see, but there are some interesting sights from this vantage nonetheless. View page 42 in the Book of Vantages and gain 2 boost.

m744.action: SNEAK around the island to an unoccupied hut
m744.result: With most sentients gathered on the shore, their attention to the east, you easily sneak around them to a ramshackle hut. Go to interior 587.

m745.action: STEER the boat into the current
m745.result:
You feel at home at the helm of this fine vessel. Gain vehicle 1156 and choose one:

Steer east or south

Go either east (751) or south (744) and gain curse 1386.

Steer north or west

Go either north (746) or west (739) and gain 1 random skill.

m746.result: The owners of the vacation home aren’t there, but the space is almost empty anyway. If you pay 1 look, gain item 1018. Otherwise, gain item 955.

m747.result: You chase away the animal, but in the process you slice your forearm on the glass-like foliage on the left. Lose 1 health. In anger, you tear the flora from the sand. Gain flora 1046; you may go north to 748.

m748.action: ENTER the city through the primary gates
m748.result: Dash past security to city 531 and gain 1 morale.

m749.action: WANDER around the area looking for resources
m749.result: The lush island around the lotus is bursting with natural resources. Gain your choice of wood (1180), leaves (1181), water (1183), or sand (1194).

m750.action: DODGE the kraken (if the kraken is no longer an obstacle, choose a different action)
m750.result: You dart this way and that until the kraken is tied up in knots. It sinks into the sea, where the tides may untangle it. The villagers reward you; gain item 899, 1 morale, and 1 move.

m751.action: APPROACH the child in such a way that you don’t startle or scare them
m751.result: You splash in the water as you approach the shore, but you keep some distance between you and the child, giving them a chance to size you up. Seeing that you mean no harm, the sentient says that they’re going on a grand quest before dinnertime, and they could protect you if you decide to join their adventuring party. Gain 1 move and quest 1643 (add it horizontally to your supply).

m752.result: You tap into the enormous power emanating from the elemental, summoning aid from your crewmates. Their visages are projected across the planet to your location. Each player who has a sand composition card (in their grid or reserve) or pays 2 boost is considered summoned. If this is a solo game, you may select one unused starting character card (1435–1440) to act as a summoned player. Summoned players may temporarily place challenge dice in their grid as if they were on your location, but only you suffer penalties from the elemental. Summoned players remain summoned until you perform any action other than overpower-SLAY. Continue.

m753.result: The members of the caravan don’t seem to mind you bringing up the rear; “bandit bait,” one of them mutters. Go to 754.

m754.action: SPEED through the racetrack (only if you have been welcomed as a participant in this trial; otherwise choose another action)
m754.result: The Trial of Speed will soon begin. Gain card 540 (it’s a large card), place it on the table with 1 token of each corresponding color on the starting spaces, and begin. Each token represents a different racer; yours is the token that matches your character color. Roll 6 skill dice and proceed to move the matching tokens forward (orthogonally or diagonally) in any order, completing the movement for each color (if possible) before moving another token. Only one token can be on a space at any time. When you’ve used all 6 dice, roll them and repeat the process until a token crosses the finish line. The goal is to have your token win the race. See entry 754 in the Book of Secrets for the solution.

m755.action: GUIDE the sentient away from the wreckage
m755.result: The sentient doesn’t resist as you lead them away from the wreckage. They give you a hug and thank you for helping them break out of a cycle of self-destruction. Gain 1 morale and 1 move.

m756.action: CLIMB north over the slippery rocks
m756.result: As you climb, you reach another treasure chest tucked into the cliff. It easily opens. Gain item 1252, then go to 757.

m757.action: SQUEEZE behind one waterfall after another, the water stinging your eyes
m757.result: Behind the third waterfall you find the entrance to a cave. Lose 1 health and go to cave 023.

m758.action: HIDE from the beast under the skeleton
m758.result:
The sand centipede sniffs around the edge of the grove before disappearing into the sand dunes. Choose one:

Move north

Go to 759.

Move east or west

Go east to 458 or west to 752.

Pay 1, 2, or 3 boost to dig into the soft soil under the skeleton

If you paid 1 boost, gain 1 morale. If you paid 2 boost, gain item 1163 and 1 morale. If you paid 3 boost, gain item 1163 and 1 morale, and go to cave 083.

m759.result: The sentient is startled by your approach, and they drop their staff and dart away. With their student gone, the instructor offers you a choice: Gain the staff (934), their pupil (sentient 1343), or a taste of magic (lesson 1433).

m760.action: ENTER the building through a sewage drain along the cliff
m760.result: The stench is terrible, but at least no one else dares to use this passage. Go to interior 561.

m761.result: Thanks to a rope, the wall is relatively easy to overcome. When you reach the top of the wall, you feel a tug on the rope—someone else is hoping to climb up. You can either take the rope for yourself and leave them stranded down below (gain item 903 and lose 1 morale) or leave the rope for the sentient to climb slowly (gain 1 morale). Either way, go north to 762.

m762.action: FOLLOW either the path or the sentient
m762.result:
Choose what to follow:

Follow the sentient south

Go to 761 and gain sentient 1328 with a “when placed” benefit of only 1 boost (instead of 2).

Follow the path north

The path leads into the capital city. Go to 763.

Follow the path east

The path leads to the front gate of the capital city. Go to 768.

m763.action: ENTER the building through the front door
m763.result: If you have at least 1 item, go to interior 589. Otherwise, the guards turn you away for not having anything to offer the Founder; gain 1 boost and continue.

m764.result: In their drunken revelry, the sentients don’t notice your awkward dance moves. Soon you find joy in the rhythm and flow of the party. Gain ability 1469 and 1 morale; you may continue.

m765.result: You find some craftable leaves amidst the bushes. Gain item 1181 and continue.

m766.action: LEAP and grab the dangling rope
m766.result: You pull yourself into the basket with the help of the sentient. The Traveler introduces them as an old friend, a cartographer well-versed in steering this balloon. Gain sentient 1307 and go north to 345.

m767.result: You amble along the road, seeing no reason to make entering the city any more difficult than it needs to be. Go north to 768.

m768.action: GUIDE the sentient into the city
m768.result: As you guide them, the sentient chats with you about how they tried to climb these city walls in their youth in preparation for the Trial of Trees. They offer to accompany you to the alpha tree to the southeast if you decide to give it a try. Gain sentient 1360 and go north to 769.

m769.action: ENTER the building through the front door
m769.result:
A broad-shouldered bouncer halts you from proceeding unless you pay $1. Choose one:

Pay the bouncer

Either go inside the tavern to share a drink with the locals (gain 1 morale and 1 health) or go to the stables (interior 590).

Don’t pay the bouncer

The disgruntled bouncer points to the north and proceeds to rant about some wind sentients who didn’t pay for their birthday party. If you can find them, you can keep the fee they should have paid. Gain quest 1653 (add it horizontally to your supply).

m770.action: STEER the boat out of the harbor
m770.result: You feel at home at the helm of this fine vessel. Unfortunately, it’s technically not your vessel, and the owner curses you from the shore. Gain vehicle 1156 and curse 1390.

m771.action: SNEAK aboard the ship as a stowaway
m771.result: You fall asleep in the cabin, and when you wake up, the surly crew is depositing you on the sand to the west of the city. Gain 1 health and go to 459.

m772.action: APPROACH the sentient, putting the boat between you and them
m772.result: While awkwardly treading water, you talk to the sentient about why they’re preventing the ship from passing. They explain that the contraband Spor has been entering the city at escalating rates, and they’re suspicious of landwalker ships like this one. With the ship’s captain assuring you that they’re not involved, you promise the sentient that you’ll track down the source. Gain 1 look and quest 1666 (add it horizontally to your supply).

m773.result: You manage to squeeze into the gate, but it’s even narrower than it first appeared. You’re stuck. You may either pay 1 overpower to dig forward (go north to 774) or wiggle your legs until someone pulls you back out (lose 1 morale, gain 1 random skill, and continue).

m774.action: EVADE north around the fiery sentient (if the sentient is no longer an obstacle, reduce this cost to 1)
m774.result: Sentients or no sentients, flames are everywhere in this district, and you barely manage to avoid catching fire as you head north. Go to 775.

m775.action: HIDE in the bushes until the sentient passes (reduce this cost to 1 if the sentient is no longer an obstacle)
m775.result: You feel like a little kid again as you hide in the bushes. Go north to 776.

m776.action: DASH away with the closest item in hand
m776.result: You weave among the tents and lose the vendor in the crowd, but not before they spit a curse at you. Gain item 966 and curse 1389; go north to 777.

m777.action: SNEAK up the path while the sentry is on the other side of the building
m777.result:
The path leads to a majestic building. Choose one:

Enter the building

Go to interior 583.

Proceed north around the building

Go to 778.

m778.action: CLIMB high into the tree to find more fruit
m778.result: You have a good chance at finding fresh fruit up here. Roll 3 skill dice up to 3 times. If the results include at least 1 help, gain item 1224 and 1 health. Otherwise lose 1 health from eating a rotten piece of fruit.

m779.result: The ivy makes the wall quite easy to climb. Go to 780.

m780.action: WANDER through the many tiers of the garden
m780.result: As you stroll, you’re amused by the sprinkle of fresh water that dances from the aqueduct onto your brow. Something in the bushes also catches your eye. Gain 1 look, 1 take, or 1 overpower; you may continue.

m781.result: As soon as you put yourself in between the sentients, their anger at each other refocuses on you. “How dare you interject?” one yells. The other sentient agrees, saying that this matter is none of your business. Both sentients walk away with each other, commiserating about “the nerve of some people.” Gain 1 boost.

m782.action: SNEAK north around the sentients (if the sentients are no longer an obstacle, reduce this cost to 1)
m782.result: You slip through the dense greenery to an open street to the north. Go to 783.

m783.result:
Before the Traveler can speak, you choose the topic:

Request an introduction to the sentient

“This is my friend, the banker. They work in the building directly to the north. They’re having a hard day and needed a break.” Gain 1 help and continue.

Beg for a way to escape this planet

“Instead of leaving, why not earn your keep here and start a new life? There are ruins just north of here that could use some helping hands.” Gain 1 boost and destiny 1601 (place it in the center).

m784.action: BALANCE across the narrow walkway to the ruins, gingerly avoiding rubble and debris
m784.result: As you carefully balance along the catwalk, you’re puzzled that the denizens of the capital city would let buildings decay on this prime real estate. Go to interior 548.

m785.action: SCALE the bridge toward the voices
m785.result:
As you pull yourself up to the bridge, several guards immediately spot you. Choose one:

Gesture provocatively at the guards (perform an overpower--DEFEND action)

The guards sense your intent as hostile and attack. Afterwards, gain item 891 and enter the city (go northwest to 780).

Bow deeply to the guards

Sensing that you mean no harm, the guards request either $2 to enter the city (go northwest to 780) or your help in guarding the bridge from invasive vagrants (gain quest 1680; add it horizontally to your supply).

You pull yourself up to the entrance of the city, just behind a group of armed guards. You can either proceed into the city to the northwest (go to 780) or follow the guards north atop the wall surrounding the city (go to 786).

m786.action: SCALE a cable leading to an open window
m786.result: While you place hand over hand, you admire the view of gardens to the west and north, a narrow section of the moat to the east, and a bridge to the south. Go to interior 591 and gain 1 morale.

m787.result: The sentient moves through the streets at such speed that it’s difficult to keep pace, but fortunately they don’t go far. They disappear into an elaborate building. Gain 1 boost; you may go north to 788.

m788.result: Go to 789, grabbing what you think is a piece of fruit as you go. Gain item 1021.

m789.result: You dash past and find yourself in a park that feels, for lack of a better word, magical. Go north to 790.

m790.action: DASH away with the book in hand
m790.result: Before anyone notices, you tuck the book under your arm and scamper away. Gain item 1045.

m791.result: As you settle into the captain’s chair, you realize that the ship is very similar to yours… except more advanced, which makes no sense, because this ship has been here for centuries. In any case, it isn’t going anywhere in its current condition. Gain 1 boost and continue.

m795.result: Avoiding the watchful eyes of the red-eyed sentient to the right, you stay close to the wall and reach up to unhook the amulet hanging there. Gain item 1157 and exit to 281.

m799.action: SCALE the sheer walls of the dome using a bone as leverage
m799.result: The vertical walls are pocked with dents and holes—you’re not the first person to escape this way. Gain item 1186 and 1 morale; go to interior 076.

m801.result: You carefully approach the glowing shard, bracing against the wind that blows across this sky island. It feels as if the shard is reaching out to you as much as you are reaching out to it. Gain item 1707.

m957.action: STEER (use only if you are at the top of a tower; if not, choose a different action)
m957.result: Pair your current region (see look storybook) with its sky location (page 48 in the Book of Vantages), then go to that location.

m1017.action: RIDE the flying ship (if on a land location)
m1017.result: You’ve flown on plenty of craft in your life, but this one might be the most exciting. Pair your current region (see look storybook) with its sky location (page 48 in the Book of Vantages), then go to that location.

m1033.action: RIDE the spaceship (if on a land location)
m1033.result: The thrusters hum as you fly your ship through the clouds above. Pair your current region (see look storybook) with its sky location (page 48 in the Book of Vantages), then go to that location.

m1110.result: As you ride the Elder Dragon, you realize that you can breathe perfectly even at heights and depths where you would normally experience hypoxia, and you remain warm even in the coldest reaches of the mountains. If all crewmembers are together with you and you have destiny 1602, you may proceed to escape the planet. Otherwise, gain destiny 1602 (place it in the center).

m1122.result: Your cats wind between your legs, sometimes stopping to groom or demand affection. For a moment they seem to forget where they wanted to lead you, but then they remember and trot forward. They finally arrive at their destination. Gain 1 morale and go to 672.

m1253.action: RIDE the jet pack into the sky (if on a land location)
m1253.result: Pair your current region (see look storybook) with its sky location (page 48 in the Book of Vantages), then go to that location. Ignore hypoxia damage upon arrival.

m1265.result: Transfer any number of cards with coin values on them between your grid to your reserve.

m1266.action: BALANCE your personal and professional goals
m1266.result: You take a deep look at your aspirations, motivations, and priorities, and you see a path forward just running your own business here. Gain destiny 1601 (place it in the center; you have completed it and may end the game when you’re ready) and 1 boost on your character.

m1273.result: You scale the windmill and are rewarded with a vast view of the surrounding area. Gain 2 boost on your character, then find the region where your windmill is located (see the look storybook) and use page 2 of the Book of Vantages to determine the page where your view is portrayed (view the resulting page).

m1274.action: HIDE a troubled sentient within the embassy
m1274.result:
A sentient rushes into the embassy seeking asylum from the people of this planet. Choose one:

Welcome the sentient into the embassy (if there is already a sentient granted asylum in the embassy and choose this option, lose them)

You invite the sentient inside and hide them in the most secure room. Keep this sentient in your supply with its dice slots tucked under the embassy. You may not place challenge dice on the sentient, and you may only perform their actions and use their boost ability when you are on the embassy’s location. Roll 1 skill die and gain the resulting sentient: move (sentient 1309); look (sentient 1327); engage (sentient 1323); help (sentient 1312); take (sentient 1339); overpower (sentient 1330).

Steer the sentient toward another safe hiding place

The sentient gives you an appreciative nod and rushes away. Lose 1 morale and gain 1 boost.

m1275.action: WISH for beauty (pay 1 boost from this structure; perform this action at most once per game)
m1275.result: Lose up to 2 curses, and gain item 1172.

m1276.result: You dance like no one’s watching, and you realize that you have more rhythm than you thought. Gain ability 1469.

m1287.action: GUIDE tourists through the attached crystal cave
m1287.result: The geological wonders of your cave awe the tourists and open their wallets. Gain $X (X is the number of boost on this structure), then pay 1 boost from this structure.

m1675.action: CLIMB up to one of the floating stones (on location 438)
m1675.result: When you reach the stone, you cautiously put your hand underneath, wary of the weight of the rock crushing every bone in your arm. But nothing happens. o40.action: FORCE the artifact free of its axis
o40.result: You reach out to the crystal, and it snaps off into your hands. You blink, and when your eyes open, you’re back on the surface with the crystal in your hands. Gain item 1000 and go to 157; if you have a previous location card for reference, return it to the box.

o41.result:
The door to a surveillance center is ajar. Choose one:

Force your way inside

Go to interior 042.

Duel a nearby sentient in a card and dice game

The sentient’s red eyes light up at the prospect of playing their favorite game, and they promise not to cheat much. Place card 798 on the table (it’s a large card) and follow its instructions, using card 1523 as the opponent’s card.

Variant: Quick Skirm (ignore card 798).

o42.action: FORCE a returning sentient to explain the contents of the monitors
o42.result: Upon returning to the room and finding you inside, the sentient reaches for a hidden alarm. You spring into action, pinning their metallic hand to the desk and daring them to try again. They explain that they’re hired by wealthy sentients to monitor their homes, discouraging thieves and bandits. This particular array shows sentients who own the 6 most powerful magical rings in the world… well, technically 5 now, as a sand centipede ate the sixth and disappeared deep into the planet. The watchman begs for you to help them recover the missing ring. Gain sentient 1323 and quest 1704 (add the quest horizontally to your supply), then exit to city 041.

o43.result: The worms are too young to fight back, so instead they scatter in all directions. You happen to notice a few of them slip into a small hole to the right. If you want to follow them, go deeper into the planet to cave 040. Otherwise, gain 1 boost.

o44.result: You are at a huge disadvantage against such a heavily armored leviathan, but you somehow manage to kill it. Gain item 1186 from the carcass. If you pay 2 boost, also gain item 991.

o45.action: ATTACK the sentient or the beast
o45.result:
Choose one:

Attack the sentient

Anyone riding such a vile creature must be evil themselves. You strike swiftly, before they have time to prepare. The sand centipede slithers away into the tunnel after the sentient slides from its steed. You find a purse on the body and a business card advertising an underground taxi service—the sentient was just trying to give you a ride. Gain $7 and lose 1 morale.

Attack the beast

You slice through the beast’s tail, sending the sentient tumbling to the ground. You celebrate and wait for your reward, but the sentient is furious—you just cut off their primary mode of transportation and income! They skulk away, leaving you with the still-writhing tail. Gain item 1194 and curse 1390.

o46.result: You patch together an axe. Gain item 872.

o47.action: HUNT the sand centipede while the hunters hold it at bay
o47.result: The hunters commend you on finishing the task, and they invite you to join them on the next hunt. They also show you how to harvest the best bones from the animal, leaving the carcass and its soulstone behind out of respect for nature. Gain item 1186 and sentient 1333 (the other sentient scouts ahead).

o48.result: You dash down the passage and just barely manage to grab a spike and jam it into a crack in the rocks. The animal jerks to a halt. It can’t turn around in such a tight space, so you act quickly, opening a long gash along its belly. If you pay 2 boost, gain item 991 from inside the carcass. If not, gain item 1160.

o49.result: As you do, you hear a great cry of agony, and the entire cave starts to move. This is no cave—you’re inside an animal! You hack desperately at any vital organs you can find while avoiding the dangerous spikes, and finally the beast goes limp. Roll 3 skill dice and gain all move results. Lose 1 health unless you pay 1 move. Gain item 1160 and go to cave 043.

o50.action: SMASH boulders to try to form a crude stairway toward the barrier
o50.result: Your attempts at brute force are fruitless. Gain 1 boost and continue.

o57.action: DEFEND against a titanic alien kraken
o57.result: The monstrosity is as vile a beast as you’ve ever met, and you simply will not stand for it to continue to terrorize this planet. After a great battle, the kraken goes limp on the surface of the water, and you wipe bile and slime from your brow. Gain item 1232, ability 1478, and 3 morale, then roll a skill die and go to where the tides take you: move (056); look (059); engage (429); help (480); take (448); overpower (362).

o63.action: FISH for a fresh catch in fertile waters
o63.result:
The fish are so abundant that they’re practically jumping into your arms. Roll 5 skill dice up to 5 times (always rolling all dice); roll 1 extra die if you pay a maximum of 1 boost from a food or flora. Based on number of overpower in the final results, gain the following:

0

You don’t catch anything other than a brief glimpse of fish. Gain 1 boost.

1

Catch a small but savory fish; gain 1 health.

2

Catch a medium-sized fish; gain 1 health and 1 boost.

3

Catch a large fish; gain item 1226.

4+

Catch a monstrosity; gain item 1232.

After you fish, roll a skill die and go to where the tides take you: move (054); look (062); engage (479); help (449); take (363); overpower (430).

o76.action: PLUCK a wind chime from the ceiling
o76.result: You feel an odd sense of control over the air within the chime. Gain item 1212 and continue.

o77.action: DUEL the sentients in one of two ways
o77.result:
Choose your dueling method:

Attack the sentients

You strike quickly before the sentients have much time to react. When the dust clears, you’ve knocked one sentient and their weapon down to the level below, and you have the remaining sentient’s crossbow. They offer to accompany you to the top level if you return their weapon. Either gain item 1152 and exit to 346, or gain sentient 1309 and go to interior 078.

Duel the sentients in a card and dice game

The sentients are alarmed to find you in the room, but when they see your interest in their game, they usher you over and deal you in. Place card 798 on the table (it’s a large card) and follow its instructions, using card 1518 as the opponent’s card. If you win, the sentients grant you access to the top level of the building (go to interior 078). If you lose, exit to 346 and continue.

Variant: Quick Skirm (ignore card 798).

o78.result: You wrestle the sentient to the ground, nearly burning your hands on their scalding hot husk. The sentient begs for mercy, asking you to rescue them from captivity. Gain 3 help and continue.

o79.action: SHOVE a boulder from its axis
o79.result: The boulder crashes into another boulder, causing a domino effect of destruction. When the dust clears, you have a clear path to the base of the pillar. Go deeper into the planet to cave 046.

o80.result: You wrestle the sentient to the ground, knocking the blowtorch from their grasp. The molten gold is too hot to touch, so you claim the tool instead. Gain item 870.

o81.action: DIG through the glowing dead end in the rear of the cavern
o81.result: Advance deeper into the planet to dungeon 015; keep this location for reference.

o82.result: Wielding a cold stalagmite, you shatter the ice, brittle shards spraying across the cavern. The crystal breaks free, but the stream is no longer passable. Gain item 1160; you may no longer move north from this location.

o83.action: DIG through the glowing dead end in the rear of the cavern
o83.result: Advance deeper into the planet to dungeon 016; keep this location for reference.

o84.action: TARGET a small yellow crystal growing on the ceiling of the cavern
o84.result: Your aim rings true, and you catch the crystal as it falls. Gain item 1164 and 1 random skill. You may continue with the move-BALANCE action.

o85.result: Find card 797 (it’s a large card), which shows a bracket of 8 fighters. You will take the place of the fighter in the bottom right (use X instead of 1; ignore the coin multipliers). The numbers in hexes represent each fighter’s strength (the number of skill dice the fighter will roll in each head-to-head bout). Run the tournament by rolling skill dice for each fighter and comparing the results. The winner of each bout is the fighter with more overpower results (the fighter with the lower strength breaks ties thanks to crowd support). If you lose a bout, you’re out of the tournament. When the tournament ends, win or lose, read entry 085 in the Book of Secrets.

o86.action: DISLODGE the crystal from the magma stream
o86.result: You knock the crystal free of the deadly magma, and it floats over to you. Gain item 1162.

o87.result: With a mighty roar, you slash your way through the mine, cutting free bewildered workers and upending guards. You grab a pickaxe and follow a group of miners deeper into the planet. Gain item 896 and go deeper into the planet to cave 049.

o88.action: DIG through the glowing sediment to the right
o88.result: Advance deeper into the planet to dungeon 017; keep this location for reference.

o89.action: DIG through the glowing dead end in the rear of the cavern
o89.result: The soil breaks away easily, revealing a deeper area to explore. Advance deeper into the planet to dungeon 018; keep this location for reference.

o90.action: DIG through the piles of treasure
o90.result: As you scoop aside jewelry and coins, you find a hidden doorway. You may open it; if you do, advance deeper into the planet to dungeon 593; keep this location for reference.

o91.result:
The chest bursts open; gain item 1036 and 1 boost. Unfortunately, the noise attracts the attention of the nearby serpent, which slithers toward you at breakneck speed. You must immediately perform one of these actions:

move--DASH out of the cave

Go to cave 031.

overpower--SLAY the serpent

When you defeat the monster, you find a large seed (gain item 1020) gleaming from the broken chest nearby. As you pick it up, you notice a passage leading deeper into the planet. You may go to dungeon 594 (keep this location for reference) or go back to cave 031.

o92.result: Crystal shards float free of the pedestal. Gain item 1165.

o93.action: CLEAVE your way through the maze
o93.result: You proceed through the maze, cleaving open any barriers that get in your way. Go deeper into the planet to cave 043.

o94.action: DIG through a crumbling rock wall on the outskirts of the city
o94.result: Move deeper into the planet to dungeon 595; keep this location for reference.

o95.action: BURN the eggs before they hatch
o95.result:
You guiltily admit that the smell of fried eggs makes your stomach growl. Then you realize it’s not just your stomach that’s growling—a massive animal has emerged from the cave. You must immediately perform one of these actions:

move--DASH out of the cave

Go to cave 035.

overpower--SLAY the beast

The fleshy, long-limbed animal collapses to the cavern floor, and you grab a yellow crystal from its carcass (item 1164). The light from the crystal reveals a passage leading from the back of the cave. Proceed deeper into the planet to dungeon 596; keep this location for reference.

o96.result: An epic battle ensues, and a part of you feels bad for the creature of legend as you strike the final blow. You’re excited about the treasure you find deep in the cave, though; gain item 1045. If you pay 1 boost, also gain item 1160 from the carcass.

o97.result: With reckless abandon, you unleash fury onto the devices, leaving behind a trail of circuits, panels, and wires. The toxic energy subsides, replaced with a far more powerful substance. Gain item 865 and 1 morale. Ignore further hypoxia damage on this location from now on.

o98.action: CUT a vine free and swing forward
o98.result: You skip the labyrinth and create your own route through the cavern, swinging from vine to vine. Proceed deeper into the planet to cave 044.

o99.action: FLEX to the group by standing under the boulder and pretending to hold it above your head
o99.result: The sentients laugh at your antics, but soon everyone is trying to do the same thing. Gain 1 morale and continue.

o100.result: You’re not entirely sure that the sentient will participate in the duel until you make your first move, at which point they dodge just in time, using only the faintest of energy. They compliment your form before allowing you to attack again. This insightful-yet-infuriating process continues until they finally yield, offering you a special map as a prize. Gain item 1263; the sentient highlights your current location (view page 20 in the Book of Vantages; you are in region K).

o101.result: The beast is quite nimble for its size, but you overcome it. If you pay 1 boost, gain item 1164 from the carcass. If not, gain item 1180.

o102.result: After great resistance, the lock snaps open. Roll 5 skill dice; you may reroll each die once. If you have at least 3 of a kind, gain item 1169. Instead, if you have at least one pair, gain item 1207. Otherwise, the chest snaps shut on your finger; lose 1 health and gain 1 boost.

o103.result: The animals scatter in fear as you rampage through their camp. Gain ability 1467 and go to interior 549.

o104.result: As you reach for your weapon, the animal vanishes into thin air. You have a few seconds to study the details of your current location before there’s a flurry of movement in the grove, then the trap door slams shut. Go to 511 and continue.

o105.result: The beast’s chirps turn to shrieks as it defends itself with massive talons, but you overcome it. If you pay 1 boost, gain item 1160 from the carcass. If not, gain item 1186.

o106.result: You unearth the vegetation, shaking dirt from its roots. Gain flora 1082.

o107.result: You begin to raze the device, and soon you find yourself in a scrap heap of metal and circuitry. The runecaster is now useless, but you’re impressed with how its creators took a naturally occurring phenomenon—runes— and produced a superior synthetic version. Gain 1 boost and your choice of a metal scrap (item 1184) or a circuit board (item 1190).

o108.result: Just in case the shield is booby trapped, you rampage through the grove, slashing at everything within reach. While you do, the remaining mushrooms target you with jets of lava. Roll 5 skill dice and gain all move results. Lose 1 health unless you pay 1 move. Gain item 939.

o109.result: Despite surprising the sentient, they reply as if you’re moving in slow motion, giving you combat tips as you parry. Eventually they collapse in faux defeat, complimenting your success while they falter. Gain flora 1075 and ability 1474.

o110.result: The animals are horrified as you pluck a sacred flower from the ceremonial display. Gain flora 1081 and curse 1388.

o111.action: SHATTER what remains of the orb
o111.result: The orb has little structural integrity after being broken, and you easily break off some useful pieces. Gain item 1194.

o112.result: Caught out in the open, the beast is an easy target. If you pay 1 boost, gain item 1162 from the carcass. If not, gain item 1181.

o113.action: PLUCK the lotus, careful not to damage the roots or petals
o113.result: You pluck the impressive flower. Gain flora 1159.

o114.result: Gain structure 1275, 2 health, and 1 overpower.

o115.result: You knock the remaining shards to the floor and slip inside. Go to interior 553.

o116.result:
You notice movement in the brush, so you set a basic trap and wait for it to spring. Set 1 challenge die to time, morale, or health to represent the trap (read options below). Then roll 3 other challenge dice; if any of them match the set die, gain the resulting benefit once (if none match, gain 1 overpower instead). These dice can come from the dice pool or the center; return them afterward.

TIME (try to study an animal’s behavior)

You observe the critter for a little while before setting it free. Gain 1 boost on your character and 1 boost on each leaf card.

MORALE (try to gain an animal companion)

The animal is scared but complacent. You will have to work to gain its trust. Gain animal 845.

HEALTH (try to kill and eat an animal)

The trap instantly kills the animal. Gain item 1217.

o117.result: You crash into the crystal in an attempt to dislodge it, but it doesn’t budge. Gain 2 random skills; you may continue with the take-EXTRACT action.

o118.result: You have only a few seconds to aim before the animal is gone. If you pay 1 boost, gain item 1161 from the carcass. If not, gain item 1212.

o119.result: You unearth the vegetation, shaking dirt from the roots. The nearby sentient sees what you’ve done and smites you. Gain flora 1080 and curse 1388.

o122.result: The Traveler actually seems relieved that you’re not using the station for its intended purpose, though they’re also a bit concerned that you’ve created a tool for destruction. Gain item 1038.

o123.result: Despite the water, you manage to cause the lorestone to fall onto its side. Embedded into the bottom half is a purple crystal. Gain item 1161.

o124.result: Lose 1 health and go to interior 554.

o125.result: As you suspected, even with the first tunnel cut off as an option, the artifact is still accessible via one of the other two tunnels. If you pay 3 boost, you discover a path to the artifact (gain item 998 and perform no other location actions here). If not, the mystery of the artifact remains unsolved, and the labyrinth vanishes; gain 1 boost.

o126.result: After great resistance, the lock snaps open. Roll 5 skill dice; you may reroll each die once. If you have at least 3 of a kind, gain item 1164. Instead, if you have at least one pair, gain item 895. Otherwise, gain $4.

o127.result: The stone breaks from its base and comes to a rest against the wall, providing a stepping stone should you decide to climb west. Gain 1 move and continue.

o128.result: The bulky sentient nods in appreciation of your courage, but they easily block your best charge. They declare themselves the keeper of the blade and invite you to solve a combat challenge to see if you’re worthy. Gain 1 look and 1 overpower.

o129.result: You strike deep into the base of the spire, and your blow reveals that the stone is hollow. Go to interior 555.

o130.action: DUEL the sentients in their game
o130.result:
The sentient on the right is relieved to take a break after losing several times in a row. Place card 798 on the table (it’s a large card) and follow its instructions, using card 1520 as the opponent’s card.

Variant: Quick Skirm (ignore card 798).

o131.action: CUT a few of the cords attached to the tent
o131.result: When the occupant of the tent stumbles outside to repair the cords, you slip inside; go to interior 550.

o132.result: With a mighty blow you smash the stone to bits, leaving only the sword in your hands. Gain item 889.

o133.result: You slice into a green crack, forcing it wider and wider until the spire crashes down. Embedded into the bottom half is a green crystal. Gain item 1163.

o134.result: You begin to raze the device, and soon you find yourself in a scrap heap of metal and circuitry. The runecaster is now useless, but you’re impressed with how its creators took a naturally occurring phenomenon—runes— and produced a superior synthetic version. Gain 1 boost and your choice of a metal scrap (item 1184) or a circuit board (item 1190).

o135.result: The stone crashes to the ground, much to the dismay of sentients in the area. Despite the disrespectful act, you’re happy to see that a torch detached from the column. Gain item 1085 and curse 1394.

o136.result: You take possession of the hunting tower. Gain structure 1286.

o139.result: You manage to cause the lorestone to fall onto its side. Embedded into the bottom half is an orange crystal. Gain item 1162.

o142.action: WEAPONIZE a trap from scrap metal
o142.result: The wreckage is an abundant source of scrap metal, and you twist it into something useful for catching little critters. Gain item 923.

o143.action: CLEAVE the rusty wreckage in half
o143.result: Sparks fly as you carve a large gash in the ship, revealing precious cargo—your power armor. You may replace your character with the corresponding card (captain: 1447; navigator: 1448; scholar: 1449; medic: 1450; engineer: 1451; marine: 1452); transfer all boost from your original character onto the new card. If you already have your power armor, instead gain 3 boost.

o144.result: The sentient nods appreciatively of your honorable approach. They maintain an erect posture throughout the duel, darting forward to prod but not hurt. Eventually they concede, deeming you worthy enough to accompany them to the northeast to wrest control of the elemental there. Gain sentient 1352.

o145.result: The sentient crashes to the ground, flowers springing to life everywhere they touch. “Why would you do this?” they gasp. “You could have helped your friends.” You shrug, grab a flower, and walk away. Gain flora 1080 and curse 1395.

o146.action: DUEL the sentient in a card and dice game
o146.result:
The energy sentient eagerly reveals a vast collection of cards. Place card 798 on the table (it’s a large card) and follow its instructions, using card 1519 as the opponent’s card.

Variant: Quick Skirm (ignore card 798).

o147.result: One of the creatures sadly falls lifeless along the shore. Gain item 1186 and continue.

o150.result: The tiny fireballs the animal shoots at you would be cute if you weren’t the target. If you pay 1 boost, gain item 1163 from the carcass. If not, gain item 1182.

o153.result: You destroy the claw-shaped rock to break the amulet free. As you do, the nearby large birds dive toward you, talons outstretched. Roll 3 skill dice and keep all move results. o158.result: The sentient offers no resistance, acting as if they deserve the pain. You can’t bear to continue, so you ease them to the ground. Gain 1 boost and continue.

o159.result: The odds are stacked against you, and even without weapons the sentients fight with reckless abandon. Finally you pin them in the shallow water and they surrender. Gain item 882 and 1 morale.

o160.result: The guards seem excited to have a challenger, but you (barely) manage to overwhelm them. Go to interior 562.

o161.action: SMASH the rock alongside the sentient
o161.result: The sentient grunts their appreciation. After a few minutes, they gesture for you to stand back as scalding lava bursts through the crust. They guide you down to the water and ask if you’d like some company on your journey. Gain sentient 1315.

o162.action: FORCE your way into the city
o162.result: Intimidating guards try to stop you at the main entrance, but you push them aside. Go to city 525.

o163.result: Their shell not only protects them, but it also bursts into flame whenever you get too close. You wait for the right moment and find its weak spot. If you pay 1 boost, gain item 1163 from the carcass. If not, gain item 1182.

o164.result: You destroy the eye, and an amulet falls out of it. A furious sentient crashes into you, defending their mother. Roll 3 skill dice and gain all overpower results. Lose 1 health unless you pay 1 overpower. Gain item 1177.

o165.result: Sparks fly as you carve a large gash in the ship, revealing precious cargo—your power armor. You may replace your character with the corresponding card (captain: 1447; navigator: 1448; scholar: 1449; medic: 1450; engineer: 1451; marine: 1452); transfer all boost from your original character onto the new card. If you already have your power armor, instead gain 3 boost.

o166.result: You cautiously cut down the tree, avoiding the large pockets of lava under its thin bark. As you do, the occupant of the house runs outside, shouting at you. Apparently they were using the tree to guard against trespassers. Gain flora 1077 and curse 1394.

o167.result: The sentient accepts your challenge even though it seems like all they actually want to do is lie down. They wield an impressive flamethrower, forcing you to choose carefully your moments to strike. Roll 3 skill dice and gain all move results. Suffer 1 heat damage unless you pay 1 move. Gain item 962.

o168.result: The fire elemental paces before you with mild curiosity. First, gain curse 1394. Then find elemental combat cards 1541–1544 and compile them into a cohesive image. Choose one of those cards and continue to perform an action on it.

o169.action: DESTROY a weapon or a coin in the sacred lava
o169.result:
As onlookers and the Traveler watch, choose an object (a coin or item) to lose in the lava. Choose one:

If you choose $1

Sentients look a bit confused, but they appreciate the gesture. Gain 1 morale and 1 move.

If you choose a weapon

Sentients applaud your participation in their tradition; gain spell 1367 and 1 move.

If you choose neither

Gain 1 move.

o170.result: The rock is incredibly strong for how light it is. You stick a metal rod in it and give it a worthy name. Gain item 950.

o171.result: The orb is weakened by exposure to the lava and shatters across the ground, much to the chagrin of the stone sentient who was inside. Gain item 1194 and curse 1389.

o172.result: You pull yourself onto the deck, expecting to meet at least a little resistance for your piracy. However, the leaf sentients aboard seem excited by the opportunity to empty their pockets, each offering more than the next before they drop you off on the far shore. Gain $9; you may pay 1 move or 1 look to go northwest to 251.

o173.result: You begin to raze the device, and soon you find yourself in a scrap heap of metal and circuitry. The runecaster is now useless, but you’re impressed with how its creators took a naturally occurring phenomenon—runes— and produced a superior synthetic version. Gain 1 boost and your choice of a metal scrap (item 1184) or a circuit board (item 1190).

o174.result: The judges gasp and welcome you to participate in the trial. Continue with the take-ENDURE action.

o175.action: DEFEND yourself against the aggressive sentient
o175.result: Luckily, the sentient is all style and no substance, and you have no problem halting their attack. They weakly offer you $5 if you agree to go away (go to an adjacent location; north is 180). If you reject their offer, gain item 867 and continue.

o176.action: FORCE a sentient out of the twister
o176.result: The sentient crashes to the ground, their wing pinned beneath your knee. “You caught me!” they exclaim. “We shouldn’t have dined and dashed, but wind people like us use the barter system. Here, I’ve transferred credits to the tavern to cover the party. That’s why you’re here, right?” Gain 2 boost.

o178.action: PLUCK a flower in defiance of the sentient
o178.result: You unearth the towering vegetation, shaking dirt from its roots. The sentient is furious. Gain flora 1076 and curse 1387.

o179.result: You unearth the vegetation, shaking sand from the roots. A nearby sentient sees what you’ve done and smites you. Gain flora 1076 and curse 1387.

o180.result: You quickly realize that for this elder, dueling is more of a dance battle than a physical altercation. They take joy in your awkwardness but commend you on being a good sport. Gain sentient 1308.

o181.result: In a swift, well-practiced motion, the sentients adopt a defensive stance between you and the treasure chest. They’re not strong, but they’re incredibly fast. Gain item 1021.

o182.result: For all their posturing, the sentient is an inexplicably weak fighter. They’re fast, though, and it takes a few minutes to strike the winning blow. When you do, you empty their pockets for a reward. Gain item 867 and $2.

o183.action: FIGHT the sentient in a dance-off (you may not use weapons)
o183.result: Weapons have no place on the dance floor. Even though the sentient is a far better dancer than you, they appreciate the effort and give you some pointers. Gain 1 morale and 1 boost; continue.

o184.result: The queen gasps and welcomes you to participate in the trial. Continue with the help-ENLIVEN action.

o185.result: The stone crashes to the ground, much to the dismay of sentients in the area. Despite the disrespectful act, you’re happy to see that a flute detached from the column. Gain item 949 and curse 1387.

o186.action: FORCE your way into the city
o186.result: No one tries to stop you—the town is open to outsiders. Calm down and go to city 518.

o187.action: RAID the area of the artifact

If not, the mystery of the artifact remains unsolved, and it vanishes from your grasp; gain 1 boost.

o188.result: There’s a sense of relief amidst the sentient’s tears. They get a fresh start, and you get some scrap metal. Gain item 1184 and 1 morale.

The runecaster is now useless, but you’re impressed with how its creators took a naturally occurring phenomenon—runes— and produced a superior synthetic version. Gain 1 boost and your choice of a metal scrap (item 1184) or a circuit board (item 1190).

o713.result: Sparks fly as you carve a large gash in the ship, revealing precious cargo—your power armor. You may replace your character with the corresponding card (captain: 1447; navigator: 1448; scholar: 1449; medic: 1450; engineer: 1451; marine: 1452); transfer all boost from your original character onto the new card. If you already have your power armor, instead gain 3 boost.

o714.result: You instantly find yourself knocked off your feet by a giant mace made of clouds. While the sentient gathers more white billows, you strike, upending your opponent on the grass. They yield and offer you the secret to their magic if you’ll leave them alone. Gain spell 1379.

o715.action: DUEL the sentient in a card and dice game
o715.result:
The sentient welcomes the challenge and awes you with their shuffling skills. Place card 798 on the table (it’s a large card) and follow its instructions, using card 1525 as the opponent’s card.

Variant: Quick Skirm (ignore card 798).

o716.result: In the pitch-black darkness of the cave, you crash into a solid stone wall. Lose 1 health and gain 2 look; go to cave 024.

o717.result: You unearth the vegetation, shaking dirt from its roots. A nearby sentient sees what you’ve done and smites you. Gain flora 1047 and curse 1389.

o718.result:
Seeing your first strike, the sentient holds up their arms as if to say, “This isn’t what I intended,” but it’s too late. You land the perfect blow, striking them backwards off the cliff. The sentient dangles from the edge with one hand. Choose one:

Smash their hand

They fall to their death, making eye contact the entire way. Lose 2 morale.

Extend your hand

They nearly wrench your arm from its socket as you drag them to safety. Lose 1 health and gain sentient 1345.

o719.action: WEAPONIZE the abundant strings at the peak
o719.result: You cut free the strings, braiding them into a thick rope. Gain item 905.

o720.result:
Several meters underground, you feel a sense of satisfaction and strength. Gain 1 health and 1 boost. You may either stop or continue with an overpower--DIG action to go deeper (then read the next result only):

Continue

A solid material halts your progress, and you excavate a large crystal. Gain item 1160. You may either stop or continue with an overpower--DIG action to go deeper (then read the next result):

Continue

The earth beneath your feet gives way, sending you tumbling into the depths. Go to cave 097.

o721.result: The judges gasp and welcome you to participate in the trial. Continue with the look-CALCULATE action.

o722.action: DUEL a passing sentient in a card and dice game
o722.result:
Their eyes light up at the prospect of playing their favorite game. Place card 798 on the table (it’s a large card) and follow its instructions, using card 1525 as the opponent’s card.

Variant: Quick Skirm (ignore card 798).

o723.action: CLEAVE the tip of the lorestone
o723.result: You manage to cleave the lorestone from its levitating perch. Embedded into the bottom half is an orange crystal. Gain item 1162.

o724.result:
After great resistance, the lock snaps open. Unfortunately, the commotion awakens the nearby stoneskin lizard. It pounces on you, scattering the chest’s contents across the crag. Lose 1 health, roll 5 skill dice, and gain all overpower results. Choose one:

You may pay 1 overpower to fight back

Gain the glowing crystal found in the attacker’s carcass (item 1164).

Run away

Gain 1 boost and go to an adjacent listed location.

o725.result:
You notice movement in the tall grass, so you set a basic trap and wait for it to spring. Set 1 challenge die to time, morale, or health to represent the trap (read options below). Then roll 3 other challenge dice; if any of them match the set die, gain the resulting benefit once (if none match, gain 1 overpower instead). These dice can come from the dice pool or the center; return them afterward.

TIME (try to study an animal’s behavior)

You observe the critter for a little while before setting it free. Gain 1 boost on your character and 1 boost on each energy card.

MORALE (try to gain an animal companion)

The animal is scared but complacent. You will have to work to gain its trust. Gain animal 822.

HEALTH (try to kill and eat an animal)

The trap instantly kills the animal. Gain item 1211.

o726.result: You withstand blow after blow until you find the creature’s weakness, striking it from above until it surrenders. The sentients applaud your courage and give you some gifts. Gain item 876 and 1 morale.

o727.action: PLUCK a flower on your way into the city
o727.result: You unearth the vegetation, shaking dirt from its roots. A nearby sentient sees what you’ve done and smites you. Gain flora 1056 and curse 1389.

o728.action: SUBDUE the sentient, preventing them from jumping
o728.result: The sentient grunts in frustration as you pin them to the ground. They explain that they’re training for a “leap of faith” to the west to honor their lost pet—it’s an act that requires courage, but the low gravity of the cloudy canyon ensures their safety. Gain 1 morale, 1 boost, and quest 1650 (add it horizontally to your supply).

o729.result: The stone elemental paces before you with mild curiosity. First, gain curse 1389. Then find elemental combat cards 1561–1564 and compile them into a cohesive image. Choose one of those cards and continue to perform an action on it.

o730.result:
You barrel through several guards and crash into a pedestal. Boulders tumble around you, and you have to make a split-second decision. Choose one:

  • Exit the cave and go east (414) or west (724).

  • Lose 1 health and gain 1 take; go to cave 020.

o731.result: Sparks fly as you carve a large gash in the ship, revealing precious cargo—your power armor. You may replace your character with the corresponding card (captain: 1447; navigator: 1448; scholar: 1449; medic: 1450; engineer: 1451; marine: 1452); transfer all boost from your original character onto the new card. If you already have your power armor, instead gain 3 boost.

o732.result: You could be at home right now with your family and your cats, but instead you are here, trapped on this planet because of this accursed signal. This is the source of the signal that brought you to this planet in the first place, and you take out your frustrations on the antenna. You have successfully cut off the signal that led you to this planet. Gain 2 morale.

o733.result: You take aim at the pearl and try to knock it off its levitating axis. While you are perfectly accurate, the pearl itself is immune to your weapons, and your destructive act only serves to anger nearby sentients. Gain 1 boost and curse 1388.

o734.result: You toss a flaming coconut through the rift and see it land on a bridge similar to the one you’re standing near. Suddenly, your bridge vanishes into thin air. You may not move west from this location. Gain 1 boost.

o735.result: The sentient doesn’t fight back, but the interruption clearly annoys them. Gain $3 and curse 1390.

o736.action: TARGET a low-flying bird-like creature as it drifts over the glass
o736.result: Your aim rings true and the bird plummets to the sand nearby. The combination of the sun and reflective glass cook the bird, sizzling like fried chicken. Gain 1 morale and 1 health; continue.

o737.result: The resident is too distraught to stop you. Gain ability 1467 and go to interior 588.

o738.action: FORCE your way into the city
o738.result: You attract some glares from the tourists, but no one tries to stop you. Go to city 527.

o739.result: You bash your way onto the island, cutting through the dense jungle until you reach a stolen mech. Three pirate guards attack you with glee. Roll 3 skill dice and gain all overpower results. Lose 1 health unless you pay 1 overpower. Gain vehicle 984.

o740.action: DIG into the grassy patch at your feet
o740.result:
Several meters underground, you feel at peace. Gain 1 health and 1 boost. You may either stop or continue with an overpower--DIG action to go deeper (then read the next result only):

Continue

A solid material halts your progress, and you unearth some coins. Gain $5. You may either stop or continue with an overpower--DIG action to go deeper (then read the next result only):

Continue

A rich, dark layer of sediment is prime for deep fungus. Gain item 1136. You may either stop or continue with an overpower--DIG action to go deeper (then read the next result):

Continue

The earth beneath your feet gives way. Go to cave 091.

o742.result:
Their eyes light up at the prospect of playing their favorite game. Place card 798 on the table (it’s a large card) and follow its instructions, using card 1524 as the opponent’s card.

Variant: Quick Skirm (ignore card 798).

o743.result: Fighting wasn’t the sentient’s intent, but they shrug and nonchalantly fight back. They have a huge advantage in the water, so you work your way closer to the shore and finally overcome them. They actually seem happy about the outcome, congratulating you as a peer. Gain sentient 1359 and 1 morale.

o744.action: SUBDUE the sentients so you can do as you wish to their hut
o744.result: Gain curse 1386 and go to interior 587.

o745.result:
Roll 3 skill dice up to 3 times (always rolling all dice); roll 1 extra die if you pay a maximum of 1 boost from a food or flora. Based on number of overpower in the final results, gain the following:

0

You don’t catch anything other than a brief glimpse of fish. Gain 1 boost.

1

Catch a small but savory fish; gain 1 health.

2

Catch a medium-sized fish; gain 1 health and 1 boost.

3

4+

o746.result: Vacation homes like this don’t come cheap, so you have high hopes for your plunder. If you pay 1 look, gain item 1018. Otherwise, gain item 955.

o747.result: The tiny beast darts this way and that as you strike, baring sharp teeth in fear as you strike the killing blow. If you pay 1 boost, gain item 1164 from the carcass. If not, gain item 1194.

o748.action: FORCE your way into the city
o748.result: The guards try to stop you, but you easily push them aside. Go to city 531.

o749.action: PLUCK the lotus, careful not to damage the roots or petals
o749.result: You pluck the sizable flower. Gain flora 1159.

o750.action: DEFEND the archipelago from the kraken
o750.result: You position yourself between the locals and the kraken, and you fight as if you had eight arms. The kraken, defeated but alive, slinks away. The locals cheer the victory and reward you handsomely. Gain item 899, 1 morale, and 1 overpower.

o751.action: FIGHT the young sentient playfully, using a stick as your “weapon”
o751.result: You playfully pull every punch and exaggerate every blow they land, finally falling to the sand in mock defeat. The child dances triumphantly with their pet before declaring you their squire. Gain 1 morale and quest 1643 (add it horizontally to your supply).

o752.result: The sand elemental paces before you with mild curiosity. First, gain curse 1390. Then find elemental combat cards 1557–1560 and compile them into a cohesive image. Choose one of those cards and continue to perform an action on it.

o753.result: An alarm sounds, and several riders fan out in a well-practiced formation around you while the others scatter. You’re clearly not the first bandit they’ve had to fight. The riders retreat, leaving a well-crafted skiff as your prize. Gain vehicle 1022 and curse 1390.

o754.result: The judges gasp and welcome you to participate in the trial. Continue with the move-SPEED action.

o755.action: DUEL the sentient in a card and dice game
o755.result:
The wood sentient wipes away tears and welcomes the distraction. Place card 798 on the table (it’s a large card) and follow its instructions, using card 1528 as the opponent’s card.

Variant: Quick Skirm (ignore card 798).

o756.result: After great resistance, the lock snaps open. Roll 4 skill dice; you may reroll each die once. If you have at least 3 of a kind, gain item 1189. Instead, if you have at least one pair, gain item 1162. Otherwise, gain $4.

o757.result: Stumbling through the waterfall and scraping against the wet tunnel walls, you crash into a solid metal gate, leaving a slight dent. Lose 1 health, gain 1 overpower, and go to cave 023.

o758.action: RELIEVE the animal from its misery
o758.result: You can’t help but take pity on the creature, and it sighs in relief when you demonstrate what you will do. Its carcass tumbles to the sand. You notice a red glow in its soft underbelly, and after a slight incision, a large crystal plops into your outstretched arms. Gain item 1165.

o759.result: After the younger sentient gains approval from their instructor, they face off with you. As fierce as they look, they’re not an experienced warrior, and you easily defeat them. The elder sentient offers you a choice of rewards: The staff (gain item 934), their tutelage (gain sentient 1343), or a taste of magic (gain lesson 1433).

o760.action: FORCE your way into the castle
o760.result: You haven’t chosen a side, so you plow through until you find yourself alone in a quiet room. Go to interior 561.

o761.action: FORCE your way into the city
o761.result: A lone guard tries to stop you, but you push them aside. Go north to 762.

o762.action: SUBDUE the sentient, finding that they are less ghost-like than they appear
o762.result: The sentient struggles, but they’re not a fighter. They beg for mercy, citing their responsibility to the egg-hatching community. Gain $3; you may refresh up to 3 challenge dice from your cards.

o763.result: Your aggression leaves confused and angry sentients in your wake. Gain curse 1395 and go to interior 589.

o764.action: SUBDUE a large sentient who’s had too much to drink
o764.result: The other sentients express their gratitude by carrying you on their shoulders down the street. Gain 2 morale and go north to 765.

o765.action: FORCE an airship captain to fly you out of the city
o765.result: “Where to, sir?” they ask, trembling. “Three clicks should be safe.” You may land exactly 3 locations away in any direction: north (175), east (783), south (762), or west (753).

o766.result: Air gushing from a large hole, the vessel spirals downward and wedges into a narrow alley. You realize they don’t know who shot them down, so you appear at the crash site as a savior. Gain sentient 1307.

o767.result:

o768.result:
The wood sentient’s eyes light up at the prospect of playing their favorite game. Place card 798 on the table (it’s a large card) and follow its instructions, using card 1528 as the opponent’s card.

Variant: Quick Skirm (ignore card 798).

o769.result: The sentient almost immediately pins you to the ground, and you just barely wiggle free to put up a proper fight that eventually results in the surprised sentient tied to a stone column. With grudging respect, they ask that you not tell any of their friends inside the tavern and instead proceed to the stables, where you’re welcome to help yourself to a machete. Gain 1 morale and go to interior 590.

Rather, you’re earning the respect of the sentient and that of the ship’s crew. At long last the sentient backs away, grinning. “If it means that much to you, the ship can pass and you can join them,” they say. “Or I can join you.” Choose the ship (gain vehicle 1015) or the sentient (gain sentient 1355).

o773.action: DIG under the wall near the tiny gate
o773.result: You can’t fit through the gateway, but the soft soil underneath is easily scooped away, and you crawl forward into the city. Go north to 774.

o774.result: The world seems to slow as the sentient reaches for an axe. Before they arm themselves, you’ve pinned them to the ground, burning your arm in the process. Suffer 1 heat damage and gain item 872.

o775.result: You have the upper hand at first, but the broad-shouldered sentient seems more amused than bothered. When you tumble to a stop, they chuckle and help you to your feet. It seems that it isn’t often that someone pokes the beast, and they ask whether you’d like to accompany them on a dangerous quest. If you accept, gain sentient 1334 and quest 1635 (add the quest horizontally to your supply).

o776.result: The vendor cowers in the corner as you tear outfits from the rafters. You stumble over a heavy package and pick it up as you walk away. Gain item 1034 and curse 1389.

o777.result:
The big sentient makes for an easy target, though a force field deflects the blow. They swoop over to you and ask for identification. You introduce yourself as they scan you. Choose one:

If you have any metal composition cards or you pay $2

The guard escorts you as a speaker to the Council of Elders. Go to interior 583.

If you don’t have any metal composition cards (or choose to hide them) and do not pay

The guard nudges you off the path to make room for “more dignified attendees”. Gain 1 boost.

o778.result: The fruit has a chance of tasting good. Roll 2 skill dice up to 2 times. If the results include at least 1 help, gain item 1224 and 1 health. Otherwise lose 1 health.

o779.action: WEAPONIZE the vines growing along the wall
o779.result: The rushing water reminds you of fishing trips back home. There are no fish in the waterfall, but you weave the nearby vines into a fishing net to use later. Gain item 911 and continue.

o781.action: SUBDUE the offensive sentient on the right
o781.result: As you pin them down, the other sentient plucks a large metal plate from their grasp. They thank you with hefty reward and heaps of praise. Gain $10 and 1 morale.

o782.result:
Choose the sentient to attack:

Attack the green sentient nearby

The sentient is easily overcome. Gain $5.

Attack the purple sentient on the ledge

They are focused on the green sentient, and you catch them off guard. They promise to leave the other sentient alone, and you send them dashing away in fear. Relieved, the green sentient communicates to you in a series of scents that somehow make sense to you. They were being chased, and you saved them. They offer to join you as a friend. Gain sentient 1353.

o783.action: DUEL the sentient in a card and dice game
o783.result:
The gold sentient’s eyes light up at the prospect of playing their favorite game. Place card 798 on the table (it’s a large card) and follow its instructions, using card 1521 as the opponent’s card.

Variant: Quick Skirm (ignore card 798).

o784.result: The stone crashes to the ground, much to the dismay of sentients in the area. Despite the disrespectful act, you’re happy to see an ornate wand shining from the dust. Gain item 981 and curse 1388.

o785.action: TARGET the sentients on the bridge
o785.result: The crowded bridge makes for an easy target… though so do you. You’re pelted with stones from above. Roll 4 skill dice and gain all move results. Lose 1 health unless you pay 1 move. You dart under the bridge and find a quiet path running along the base of the city wall. Go northeast to 389.

o786.action: CHARGE past the guards and don’t stop until you can no longer hear them
o786.result: The guards apparently rely on intimidation and not on speed. Go to interior 591.

o787.action: SHOVE the sentient as they zoom by
o787.result:
You send the sentient sprawling over the cobblestone street, and they skid to a stop against a building. They glare at you, but they seem to have dislocated something, as they make no move to defend themselves. Choose one:

Rip a device off their belt

Gain item 860 and curse 1391.

Apologize and reset their dislocated joint

They thank you profusely and offer to share a copy of the map they’re planning to steal. They rush away to the north, and a few minutes later they return with a map. Gain item 1264; the sentient highlights your current location (view page 21 in the Book of Vantages; you are in region I).

o788.result: The sentient is not impressed with your use of brute force, but you still gain item 1264.

o789.result: A merchant like this isn’t trained in the art of combat, and you quickly overwhelm them. “Please,” they beg, “take these coins and leave me be.” Gain $8.

o790.result: A nice rope on the tree caught your eye, and now it’s yours. Gain item 901.

o791.result: The vines wrap around every inch of the ship, including the blinking radio and the cryogenic chambers. You slice through the radio, and the signal goes dead. You have cut off the signal that led you to this planet. Gain item 1181 and exit to 732.

o795.result: You smash through the glass to your right, grabbing the sentient and slamming them to the ground. Caught completely off guard, they surrender and beg for mercy, offering you their weapon in return. Gain item 1153 and exit to 281.

o799.action: DIG out from under the building
o799.result: You dig through bones, sand, and water to reach safety. Gain 1 health and exit to 346.

o801.action: RAID the sky island of the shard
o801.result: You swagger across the island as if you own the place and grab the shard. Gain item 1707.

o870.result: Choose one: Refresh 1 challenge die from your grid, gain 1 look, or add 1 boost to an egg. Also, if you have a wood resource (1180), you may lose it to gain a bramble torch (1084).

Then roll 3 other challenge dice; if any of them match the set die, gain the resulting benefit once (if none match, gain 1 overpower instead). These dice can come from the dice pool or the center; return them afterward.

TIME (try to study an animal’s behavior)

You observe the critter for a little while before setting it free. Gain 1 boost on your character and 1 boost on each animal card.

MORALE (try to gain an animal companion)

The animal is scared but complacent. You will have to work to gain its trust. Gain animal 819, 825, or 827, then lose the trap card unless you pay 1 help.

HEALTH (try to kill and eat an animal)

The trap instantly kills the animal. Gain item 1217.

0

You don’t catch anything other than a brief glimpse of fish. Gain 1 boost.

1

Catch a small but savory fish; gain 1 health.

2

Catch a medium-sized fish; gain 1 health and 1 boost.

3

Catch a large fish; gain item 1226.

4+

Catch a monstrosity; gain item 1232.

o1674.result:
The knight has the upper hand throughout the tussle, but you finally get them to submit after cornering them against the rock wall. Choose one:

Let the knight plead their case

The knight explains that despite living a life of violence, they are trying to reform the ways of their warmongering brethren. That’s why they left the deep sea with the Blue Blade. If you agree not to collect the bounty, they pledge their loyalty to you (lose quest 1674, gain sentient 1357, and go north to 133). If you disagree, read the next option instead.

Turn in the knight to collect the bounty

The knight shouts that you’re making a huge mistake as they’re taken away by water soldiers. Gain $15 and go either east to 129 or west to 127. Then rotate quest 1674 and add it to your grid.

The outside was your home, yet sometimes you’d catch yourself lingering too long at the windows of a warm bakery or home, wanting the comfort of walls and a roof. Lose objective 1613, then gain 1 morale and objective 1619 (add it horizontally to your supply).
