Despite your linguistic aptitude and a wide spectrum of friends, you still struggle with the confidence to make romantic connections. Rotate this card and add it to your grid, then gain objective 1623 (add it horizontally to your supply).

s1618.result: Several years after you became a certified doctor, your father told you that he had intestinal lymphoma. You were halfway across the system at the time, but you talked through his options for treatment and called some doctors in the area to discuss any recent advances. A week later, you were by your father’s side when he entered surgery, a book of pressed flowers in hand. Rotate this card and add it to your grid, then gain objective 1624 (add it horizontally to your supply).

s1619.result: As you grew up, you aged past the stage of petty theft and moved on to contract work. Hack jobs, heists, churn and burn: You tried it all, and you never made the same mistake twice. This led to a new rule, learned the hard way after two members of your crew betrayed you: Always work alone. Rotate this card and add it to your grid, then gain objective 1625 (add it horizontally to your supply).

s1620.result: You grew up big, strong, and broad shouldered. When marine recruiters visited your settlement, you stood out. After spending your entire life with stars as your ceiling, you were suddenly living among them. You never forgot your roots, though. Whenever you’d drop onto a planet, you’d use your off hours to experience that world’s wild side, the places where nature was still in charge. Rotate this card and add it to your grid, then gain objective 1626 (add it horizontally to your supply).

s1621.result: The greatest day of your life was when you became the captain of your ship. You applied your natural and learned leadership skills to the academy, where you proudly walked the halls on prosthetic legs that you helped to design. Your ship was an extension of you and everything you achieved, so it is with great joy that you are now at the helm of a new vessel. Rotate this card and add it to your grid, replacing objective 1615.

s1622.result: This journey has helped you realize a few things about yourself: One, it’s okay that you find happiness in solitude, books, and research. Two, you need people in your life, just not all the time. And three, you can’t keep waiting for people to approach you. You have to make the first step, and you’re excited to try—and sometimes fail—in this city. Rotate this card and add it to your grid, replacing objective 1616.

s1623.result: You finally made the first move! Sure, it required you to crash land on a completely alien planet, but you did it! And they reciprocated! For all the connections you’ve felt speaking with people in a variety of languages over the years, this new connection trumps them all. Rotate this card and add it to your grid, replacing objective 1617.

s1624.result: Your father’s battle against cancer turned into an extended war. He lost his appetite and seemed thinner every time you saw him. Your confidence in modern medicine dropped, and you started to seek answers elsewhere, even in the arcane. One day you got the call you dreaded: The time had come to say goodbye. You were by his side at the end, holding his frail hand, telling him that you loved him unconditionally and that you were so grateful for him. Surrounded by flowers, he breathed his last breath. Rotate this card and add it to your grid, replacing objective 1618.

s1625.result: Despite your rule to work alone, you accepted a job on the ship. At first you viewed your crewmates as disposable—you wished them no ill will, but you vowed not to rely on them. After all, you’re here to steal the ship. So you watched from the outside as they became friends during the journey, eating together and playing games in the evening. Winning this duel made you realize that you could enjoy both worlds—within the context of a game, you can indulge your sneaky side while still connecting with the people around you. You didn’t have to stand outside anymore, hoping to be invited in. Rotate this card and add it to your grid, replacing objective 1619.

s1626.result: Whether you were hunting wild boars or corrupt warlords, you were perfectly comfortable with your bare hands. Yet something awakened in you the day you put on power armor for the first time. You felt whole. Conversely, when you took it off, you felt naked. That’s how you’ve felt since crashing on this world, and you’re overjoyed to be back in the armor. Rotate this card and add it to your grid, replacing objective 1620.

s1627.result: The Runekeeper rushes to their beloved dust mouse, gently stroking it between the ears. In gratitude, they offer to accompany you. Gain sentient 1329 with 3 boost on them, gain $3, then rotate this quest and add it to your grid.

s1628.result: Their dignity restored by the victory, the Racer thanks you profusely and pledges their loyalty to you. Gain $2 and fill the Racer with boost, then rotate this quest and add it to your grid.

s1629.result: The bandit hideout (interior 563) is vacant, and you find a hidden drawer under the bed. Inside is a small vial containing a golden substance. This substance is the cure the wind sentients were looking for. Gain item 865, then rotate this quest and add it to your grid.

s1630.result: You are at an extreme elevation, able to see far around you in all directions. View page 38 of the Book of Vantages and gain 2 boost as you look down at the world below, then rotate this quest and add it to your grid.

s1631.result: You have successfully charted a small part of a vast ocean, and the Cartographer is pleased (yet even more curious than before). They give you a map of the various towers across the world. Gain item 1259 and $2; the sentient highlights your current location (find your region in the look storybook, then view page 16 in the Book of Vantages). Then rotate this quest and add it to your grid.

s1632.result: A local thanks you for providing a safe option for travel to the north, and they press a few coins into your palm. Gain $10, then rotate this quest and add it to your grid.

s1633.result: The sinew elemental tears away from the tether, roaring in pleasure. Sinew sentients cower in embarrassment; it is their responsibility to keep their elemental tethered, and the fire sentients have made a mockery of them. Rotate this quest and add it to your grid.

s1634.result: The fisherman is elated to find the treasure chest intact. They produce a key, and from the chest they eagerly extract… a frying pan. Eyeing you with a mix of suspicion and appreciation, they hand over an egg as a reward and slowly backs away. Gain item 977, then rotate this quest and add it to your grid.

s1635.result: As life leaves the body of the stone sentient, you feel a wave of energy wash over you. Soon after, the sentient who gave you this quest gives you an appreciative hug. Gain sentient 1334 (if you don’t already have them) and 1 morale, then rotate this quest and add it to your grid.

s1636.result: Busy with patrons, the exhausted tavern owner ushers you behind the bar. Before you know it, you’re serving a variety of fruit-based cocktails and oak-aged whiskey to various wood sentients. At closing time, the owner hands you the keys and gives you a big hug. Gain structure 1277, then rotate this quest and add it to your grid.

s1637.result: As you leave the Founder’s Temple, the energy sentient thanks you profusely. Their warmth immediately accelerates the hatching process; add 1 boost to the egg. Seeing that the egg is in good hands with you, they request that you care for it until it hatches. Gain quest 1679 (add it horizontally to your supply), then rotate this quest and add it to your grid.

s1638.result: Seeing you holding the package at the harbor (location 771), a merchant sidles next to you and furtively hands you a bag of coins. Lose item 1034 (if you have it) and gain $10, then rotate this quest and add it to your grid.

s1639.result: The inventor is incredibly grateful for your rescue efforts; gain sentient 1356 with 3 boost on them. The sentient’s eyes fill with salty tears when they hear that you came at the behest of their friend. They were imprisoned after learning that one of their inventions—a device that allowed water sentients to walk on land—was to be used for war instead of diplomacy. Rotate this quest and add it to your grid.

s1640.result: You are delighted to solve the mysteries of the Tools of Creation. Gain 1 morale, then rotate this quest and add it to your grid. If you are on location 666 in the future and you still have the Tools of Creation, you may perform the overpower-CUT action.

s1641.result: The sentient wrenches the barrel from your grasp. They weigh it carefully in silence. For each boost token on the barrel, gain $5. Lose item 1158, then rotate this quest and add it to your grid.

s1642.result: The quick progress they’ve made with your assistance has elated the water sentients, and they promise to remember the favor. Rotate this quest and add it to your grid.

s1643.result: The child rushes into their parents’ arms, regaling them with stories from their adventure. Their mother and father express their appreciation for you and insist that you join them for dinner. Gain $3, 1 morale, and 1 health, then rotate this quest and add it to your grid.

s1644.result: When you present the item to the fire sentients, they are in awe of your crafting skills and insist that you keep the item. Rotate this quest and add it to your grid.

s1645.result: If you accused the fisherman of murdering Timber the repairman, you are correct! Timber had dominated the local fishing contest in recent years, unknowingly embarrassing the fisherman. To eliminate their top competitor, the fisherman used Timber’s own pike to slit their throat quietly. The other two suspects’ alibis involved loud activities, and Timber’s partner hadn’t told anyone what the fatal wound looked like. The fisherman’s key mistake was revealing that they knew the murder weapon. If you made an accurate accusation, gain either of the innocent sentients (the recruiter is 1359 and the shipwright is 1364); if you already have either of them, fill them with boost. Whether or not you solved the mystery correctly, rotate this quest and add it to your grid.

s1647.result: You overcome the tyrant, telling them that their actions have consequences. No longer will they siphon from unwilling energy sentients. Gain 1 boost, then rotate this quest and add it to your grid.

s1648.result: The metal sentient is somewhat surprised to see you. “You stole the aether lantern and actually came back to give it to me? I’m impressed by your ethical flexibility!” They give you a pulse gun (gain item 1038) in appreciation for the lantern. Then rotate this quest and add it to your grid.

s1649.result: The sinew hunters celebrate the successful hunt with hugs that almost crush you, declaring you a lifelong friend. If you still have sentient 1333, you may either keep them or lose them to gain a skullhammer (item 950). Either way, rotate this quest and add it to your grid.

s1650.result: The stone sentient emerges from the mist, bounding toward their beloved hovertail. “The Leap of Faith worked!” they exclaim, referring to the ritual of honoring something or someone important to you (often with a wish attached to the daring act). They press some coins into your palm and insist that you visit them again someday. Gain $5, then rotate this quest and add it to your grid.

s1651.result: The three-headed sand sentient appears beside you as you gaze upon the constellation, taking turns to explain the significance of this location. “These three stars are very important to us. Our parents, who have long since gone into the sands of time, named each of us after one of these stars. They said that even though these stars remain close, every star is a sun, unique and individual in its own way. Thank you for leading us back here.” Gain 1 time and 1 morale, then rotate this quest and add it to your grid.

s1652.result: The newly freed sentient collapses into your arms, sobbing in relief and gratitude. Gain 1 boost on sentient 1349 and gain 1 morale. Then rotate this quest and add it to your grid.

s1653.result: With the credits successfully transferred to the tavern, the quest is complete. They even pay you a small bounty out of appreciation. Gain $4, then rotate this quest and add it to your grid.

s1654.result: The stone sentient, drawn to the blue crystal, bounds toward you and embraces you in a massive hug. Lose the blue crystal, and gain sentient 1345 and $2. Then rotate this quest and add it to your grid.

s1656.result: Whether through skill, ingenuity, fate, or fortune, you now have a friggin’ mech suit! Rotate this quest and add it to your grid.

s1657.result: The portals spring to life. Four of them show glimmers of distant locations; the center portal seems programmable for a small sacrifice. Gain destiny 1604, then rotate this quest and add it to your grid, which adds an ENTER action that you can use only on location 690 (if you do, read entry 1657 in the move storybook).

s1658.result:
The metal sentient is overjoyed to see that you procured a one-of-a-kind item, but you have second thoughts about giving it to them. Choose one:

Keep the Eye of the Ancient

Lose this quest.

Hand over the Eye of the Ancient

Lose item 1012 and gain $15. Then rotate this quest and add it to your grid.

s1659.result: You are successful in driving away the invaders. The sand sentients rejoice in the victory, declaring you their hero. As a reward, they give you $5 and offer you a choice of a time sieve (item 980) or goggles of futures past (986), then they escort you from the premises. Go north to 490, then rotate this quest and add it to your grid.

s1660.result: The fisherman slowly claps as they admire your catch. “Impressive, very impressive,” they say. “But is it bigger than this?” With a great flourish, they reveal a fish tucked inside their shirt. If you caught a large fish (1226), you win the competition and gain 2 morale. Otherwise, you lose. Either way, rotate this quest and add it to your grid.

s1661.result: The gold sentient is elated to have access to such an incredible husk. They explain the significance: “Gold sentients aren’t born with a husk; rather, they all start off more like a golden slug seeking a shell. It’s a coming-of-age process to find the right husk, and it can take multiple husks to get it right. Sometimes it’s a brand-new husk; other times it’s the husk worn by your father and their father before them.” Fill the gold sentient with boost; you also gain $4 and gain 2 boost on your character. Then rotate this quest and add it to your grid.

s1663.result: As you combine the two shards, you wince as they make contact. When you open your eyes, you find that the shards remain separate, but there is a green energy dancing between them. Rotate this quest and add it to your grid.

s1664.result: The sight of you carrying food brings hope to the fire sentients’ gaunt faces. For each boost you remove from a food card to give to the villagers, gain $1 and 1 morale. If you remove at least 4 boost in this way, the sentients give you item 993. Rotate this quest and add it to your grid.

s1665.result: The leaf sentient is relieved and grateful to have arrived at their destination, assuring you that they’re safe from their pursuer here. They give you $5 and a hug (gain 1 morale). Lose sentient 1353, then rotate this quest and add it to your grid.

s1666.result: You have found the source of Spor, the contraband substance created from the pollen released into the air by lotuses, collected and processed in this facility. Gain 2 boost on your character, then rotate this quest and add it to your grid.

s1667.result: With the blight eradicated, it is as if you can hear the earth itself exhale a great sigh of relief. Gain 1 health, then rotate this quest and add it to your grid.

s1668.result: You are elated to be reunited with your cats! The last time you saw them, they were with you in the spaceship as it approached the planet. The kittens act aloof to your advances, but you can tell from the deep rumble of their purrs that they’re happy to see you too. Gain 2 morale, then rotate the quest and add it to your grid.

s1669.result: Upon placing the third flag into the ground, you are approached by the elder, assisted by two younger sentients. The elder’s face is running with dusty tears. “Thank you, dearest alien,” they say. “I look forward to watching the wind from the comfort of home while my time on this world comes to an end.” Gain 1 morale, then rotate this quest and add it to your grid.

s1670.result: As you stare down the dragon, you know that you have fulfilled your promise to the circuit sentient. What comes next is up to you. Inspired by the legendary creature before you, return 1 challenge die (from anywhere) to the box for the rest of the game (it can be regained later if needed). Then rotate this quest and add it to your grid.

s1671.result: The enslaved miners quietly rejoice at their freedom, slipping out into the daylight for the first time in ages. Gain 2 morale, then rotate this quest and add it to your grid.

s1672.result: You report back to the lighthouse keeper that the box appears to be some sort of portal, possibly a trap. You encourage them to stay away from it. They thank you with a gift of binoculars (gain item 972) and $2. Then rotate this quest and add it to your grid.

s1673.result: Your journey to enlightenment is complete! For each token on this quest, gain 1 random skill. Then rotate this quest and add it to your grid.

s1677.result: Water sentients gather while you climb, and they cheer when you reach the top before disappearing below the waves. Rotate the quest and add it to your grid.

s1678.result: You’re filled with a sense of calm as you gaze upon Moonstone Mountain. Gain 1 morale, then rotate this quest and add it to your grid.

s1679.result: After much time and effort, you are the proud parent of a dragon! Rotate this quest and add it to your grid.

s1680.result: The fire merchants are grateful for your help. Not only did you save them from yet another raid, but you also proved to the city watch that they need to increase their security efforts. The merchants give you a custom machete and coins for your service. Gain item 920 and $5, then rotate this quest and add it to your grid.

s1681.result: Fending off the pirate onslaught requires a variety of tricks and maneuvers, but you successfully send every raider back to the sea. The other protectors of the area lead you up a secret staircase and encourage you to touch the Pearl. When you do, your mind goes blank, save for three glowing symbols. Choose life (1236), spirit (1237), or mind (1238). Then rotate this quest and add it to your grid. You may not perform any location actions on 733.

s1682.result: Freed from the burden of their debt and ready to make good choices moving forward, the gold sentient pledges their loyalty to you. Gain sentient 1321 with 3 boost on them. Then rotate this quest and add it to your grid.

s1683.result: As you weave the spell into motion, you direct it toward the ailing circuit sentient to the west. The ground reverberates, and a short time later the sentient comes bounding toward you, filled with vigor. Gain sentient 1314 and $3. Then rotate this quest and add it to your grid.

s1684.result: The captain is impressed by your range of skills. They trust that their ship is in good hands with you, and share their confidence with the crew. Gain vehicle 1015. Then rotate this quest and add it to your grid.

s1685.result: You emerge into the forest, hovershoes in hand, where the jealous shoemaker grabs the shoes from you. They marvel at the craftsmanship of the shoes, and you sense that their envy grows to new heights. Muttering to themselves about the future of footwear, they toss you a bag of coins and scamper away. Gain $10. Then rotate this quest and add it to your grid.

s1686.result: You have managed to find one of the most elusive, mysterious, and secret areas on this planet. Rotate the quest and add it to your grid.

s1693.result: The landlord, a wood sentient themselves, acts aghast in public at the slaying of their ancestral icon. In private, however, they thank you profusely, elated about the positive impact on housing prices. They say that you’re welcome at any time to take them up on their offer to buy a hill house; in fact, they’ll offer it to you for a discounted price. If you accept, pay $15 and gain structure 1701. If you reject their offer, they give you some coins as a show of gratitude (gain $10). Rotate this quest and add it to your grid.

s1694.result: You are successful in breaking through the castle’s defenses, and a wave of water sentients take over the castle. As a reward, they offer you a choice between coins and a fully trained kelp wyrm. Gain animal 1134 or $20. Go east to 460, then rotate this quest and add it to your grid.

s1695.result: The fire sentients now have a clear understanding of how the spaceship operates, and they even have some ideas for improvements. They estimate that they can have a brand-new ship ready for you in—they check their numbers— around 100 years. Seeing your shock at that timeframe, they recommend that you head to the desert (southeast of where most fire sentients live), enter the gateway, then trudge a little farther east. It’ll seem like no time at all, they promise. Rotate this quest and add it to your grid; also gain destiny 1607.

s1697.result: A discussion ensues between the sentient in the palace and the sentient with whom you’re traveling, then they turn to you to explain the procedure. As far as you can understand, the sentient’s memories and soul will transfer to your body, and yours to theirs. If you have it, you may not gain the benefit of your experience card while Reborn. The change can be reversed later if it isn’t a good fit for either or both of you. If you accept the swap, replace your character card with 1453. Either way, rotate this quest and add it to your grid.

s1699.action: Based on the status of the tree, read one
s1699.result:
You already cut down the tree

The sentient thanks you for making their job easier, and they proceed to build a boat. Gain vehicle 1015 and keep sentient 1364. The location actions on 516 are no longer available.

The tree is still standing

The shipwright is elated and relieved to see the fully grown sea tree. Then they immediately cut it down, chisel it into planks, and start to build a boat. Rotate this quest and add it to your grid. If you lose 1 time, also gain vehicle 1015 and keep sentient 1364 (otherwise, lose the sentient). The location actions on 516 are no longer available.

s1700.result: The metal sentient is elated that you found the legendary enchanted forest. They give you a warm meal and some tips on siphoning power before they head into the forest to explore it. Gain 1 health and 1 take, then rotate this quest and add it to your grid.

s1702.result: The exhausted farmer is so happy for their blossom hulks to be back home where they belong, and the beasts don’t seem to care either way. In gratitude, the farmer offers you a choice between an untrained blossom hulk (gain animal 841) or a saddle (gain item 958). Then rotate this quest and add it to your grid.

s1703.result: You’ve seen other rainbows, but they always disappeared into the horizon—you didn’t realize that any of them had distinct endings. Gain 1 help, then rotate this quest and add it to your grid.

s1704.result: The watchman is overjoyed and relieved to have found the ring. Their job was on the line, and they have a number of goldlings to feed back home. They trust that the ring is in good hands with you if you promise to keep it. Lose sentient 1323 (if you still have them), then rotate this quest and add it to your grid.

s1705.result:
The roar of engines fills the sky as a rescue-class vessel from your fleet enters the planet’s atmosphere. You figured they would eventually find you. Choose a player to become the active player and perform one of the following actions (view the corresponding storybook for the results):

  • move--HIDE from the rescue team so you can pursue your new life on this planet (the game does not end).

  • look--NAVIGATE the rescue vessel toward your location, ending your adventure.

  • engage--GREET the rescue team with gratitude and open arms, ending your adventure.

  • help--PRAISE and appreciate the rescue team for their efforts, ending your adventure.

  • take--HIJACK the vessel so you can continue your adventure on this planet (the game does not end).

  • overpower--TARGET the rescue ship as it attempts to land so you can achieve victory on your own terms (the game does not end).

t12.action: STEAL the shiny pile of coins
t12.result: You can’t resist the glimmer of gold. Gain $10 and exit to 649.

t13.action: STEAL the most beautiful item from the hostel
t13.result: The nicely crafted flint catches your eye; gain item 1128. Then exit to 719.

t15.result: Despite the solid construction of the chest, some of the wood has warped from being waterlogged. Soon you’ve dismantled enough of the chest’s exterior to reach inside. Roll 4 skill dice; you may reroll each die once. If you have at least 3 of a kind, gain flora 1062. Instead, if you have at least one pair, gain 1 random card from the Skirm spoiler pack (place it in your reserve, where your entire Skirm collection counts as only 1 reserved card. You can use this type of card from your reserve during overpower-DUEL actions, which have further instructions). Otherwise, the chest shocks you—suffer 1 heat damage and gain 1 boost; continue.

t20.action: SWAP the magnetic rocks with crystals of equal size
t20.result: With the magnets in hand, the barrier slides aside. Proceed deeper into the planet to cave 080.

t21.action: LOOT the device from the ledge
t21.result: You carefully unplug the device so it remains functional. Gain item 988; you may continue.

t22.result: You realize that the laser array has only a few sources that you can modify to drop the barrier. For your next action this turn, decrease the cost by X. Continue.

t23.result: The gate is solid, but you detect a few weak points around the edges. For your next action this turn, decrease the cost by X. Continue.

t24.result: You toss a few glowing stones into the darkness to gauge the width and depth. For your next action this turn, decrease the cost by X. Continue.

t25.result: The gate is solid, but you detect a few cracks in the supporting stones. For your next action this turn, decrease the cost by X. Continue.

t26.action: SWAP the widgets with pieces of cooling lava of identical size
t26.result: With the widgets removed, the barrier disappears before your eyes. Proceed deeper into the planet to cave 086.

t27.result: You realize that the laser array has only a few sources that you can modify to drop the barrier. For your next action this turn, decrease the cost by X. Continue.

t28.result: You realize that as dangerous as the sentinel appears, they present a rare type of barrier that you can actually talk to. For your next action this turn, decrease the cost by X. Continue.

t31.result: You realize that as dangerous as the sentinel appears, they present a rare type of barrier that you can actually talk to. For your next action this turn, decrease the cost by X. Continue.

t32.result: The gate is solid, but you detect some rust around the hinges. For your next action this turn, decrease the cost by X. Continue.

t33.result: You deduce the optimal landing area for a mighty leap. For your next action this turn, decrease the cost by X. Continue.

t34.result: You realize that as dangerous as the sentinel appears, they present a rare type of barrier that you can actually talk to. For your next action this turn, decrease the cost by X. Continue.

t35.action: SWAP the gelatinous bulbs with stones of identical size
t35.result: With the bulbs in hand, the barrier vanishes before your eyes. Proceed deeper into the planet to cave 095.

t36.result: You toss a few pebbles into the darkness to gauge the chasm’s width and depth. For your next action this turn, decrease the cost by X. Continue.

t37.result: The gate is solid, but you detect decay around it. For your next action this turn, decrease the cost by X. Continue.

t38.action: SWAP the stones with a branch of equal weight
t38.result: With the stones in hand, the barrier dissolves before your eyes. Proceed deeper into the planet to cave 098.

t39.result: The markings on the wall provide a rough guide through the void. For your next action this turn, decrease the cost by X. Continue.

t40.action: EXTRACT the crystal from the center of the planet
t40.result: With great effort you pry the crystal loose as energy surges through your body. You blink, and when your eyes open, you’re back on the surface with the crystal in your hands. Gain item 1000 and go to 157; if you have a previous location card for reference, return it to the box.

t41.result:
The rogue’s gallery is covered in sketches of suspicious-looking sentients. Choose one:

Grab a wanted poster of a water sentient

Gain 1 boost, 1 overpower, and quest 1674 (add it horizontally to your supply).

Gather intel from the parchments

You learn of several lost sentients who were last seen searching underground for the Cave of Souls. Gain 2 boost and 1 look.

t42.result: A map of the world appears on the screen, and you send it to a nearby printer. Gain item 1037 and 1 boost, then go to city 041.

t43.result: The slippery beasts are tough to hold onto. Gain animal 832.

t44.result: You almost immediately regret the decision, as the sand centipede is twenty times your size. But as your father always said, if you can wrangle a horse, you can wrangle anything. Gain animal 832.

t45.action: ROB the sentient as they zoom past
t45.result: You didn’t know what to expect from the impromptu theft, but an oddly shaped flora wasn’t among your top guesses. Gain flora 1051 and $1.

t46.result: This deep in the planet, the stones have a slightly different composition than those found on the surface. Gain item 1179.

t47.action: ROB the hunters while they’re helplessly fighting the sand centipede

t48.action: GRAB the tail and hang on for the ride
t48.result:
The sand centipede first slows down in a cavern to the north. Do you dismount?

Yes

Go to cave 043.

No

The sand centipede turns toward a hole in the ceiling and darts upward at great velocity. It bursts into daylight, and you’re tossed upward, landing on the edge of a cliff. Go to 400.

t49.action: EXTRACT a ring caught on a nearby spike
t49.result: Gingerly avoiding the other spikes, you remove the ring. Gain item 991.

t50.result: You recognize a pattern in the airflow through the cave. For your next action this turn, decrease the cost by X. Continue.

t53.action: CATCH a massive animal gliding along the ocean surface
t53.result: You track the beast as it slithers just above and just below the water. At the right moment, you jump onto its neck and grab the kelp-like substance sprouting there. Gain animal 855, then roll a skill die and go to where the creature takes you: move (052); look (061); engage (477); help (452); take (367); overpower (381).

t56.action: ENLIST the sentient to join you
t56.result:
You catch the sentient off guard with your offer. In a moment of vulnerability, they reveal that they’ve spent their life recruiting others, but no one has ever tried to recruit them. They agree to join you. Gain sentient 1359, who presents you with a few options for destinations across the ocean:

t734.result: You reach into the rift and grab blindly at anything you can remove. Your fingers grasp something wet and slimy, and you find yourself holding a giant piece of seaweed from the past. Gain flora 1061.

t735.result: The creature is so focused on their task that they don’t notice you reaching into the transparent orb and removing their few possessions. Gain item 941 and $2.

t736.action: EXTRACT a shard of glass from the sand
t736.result: As you take the shard, you realize just how many tiny pieces of glass are in the sand. They are unavoidable if you travel north. Gain item 1194 and curse 1390.

t737.action: ROB the house when the owners are asleep
t737.result: You creep into the home (go to interior 588 and lose 1 morale).

t738.result: You quietly push off into open water without anyone noticing. Gain vehicle 1014 and $4.

t739.action: EXTRACT the first precious item you find on the island
t739.result: You nimbly-yet-quietly swing from a tree to the east onto the island and land on top of a rusted, vine-covered mech. Suddenly, 3 pirate guards attack from above. Roll 3 skill dice and gain all overpower results. Lose 1 health unless you pay 1 overpower. Gain vehicle 984.

t740.result: The sentient is frantic with concern regarding a tree that was in this grove the last time they checked. For your next action this turn, decrease the cost by X. Continue.

t741.result: You recognize a pattern in the masonry—this isn’t an entirely natural arch. For your next action this turn, decrease the cost by X. Continue.

t742.result: The sentient indulges you as if you are a child, rolling their eye and giving you their purse. They predict you will soon lose the money at the casinos to the north. Gain curse 1390, $5, and 1 boost.

t743.action: PICKPOCKET the sentient as you greet them
t743.result: The sentient’s thrashing gives you ample cover for a quick act of pilfering. Gain item 1251.

t744.action: ACCESS the building while the sentients are distracted by a large creature to the east
t744.result: The building is open-air, so you walk right in. Go to interior 587.

t745.result: You quietly set sail into open water without anyone noticing. Gain vehicle 1156 and $3.

t746.action: BATHE in the calm, clear water
t746.result: The water feels great as it flows over you, washing off the grime. Gain 1 health.

t747.result: The creature is quite nimble—it doesn’t have the legs to outrun you, but it avoids your grasp for a while and bares sharp teeth if you catch it from the wrong angle. Gain animal 834 and 1 boost.

t748.action: PICKPOCKET a sentient leaving the city
t748.result: You bump against a sentient whose hands are full of clocks, pocketing their loose change. Gain $X; you may continue.

t749.result: The taste of the petal reminds you a bit of raw artichoke. Roll 3 skill dice. For each move/look/help result, gain 1 boost/morale/health (respectively). Then, for each engage/take/overpower result, lose 1 boost/morale/health (respectively).

t750.result: Rarely is “disarm” taken so literally as with this beast. With a mighty swing, you slice cleanly through one of its eight arms, the tentacle writhing on the surf. The kraken takes to the sea while the residents prepare a feast using the meat as the main course. They present you with a gift. Gain item 899, 1 health, and 1 take.

t751.result: The naive youngster doesn’t know any better, agreeing to give you their sole possession for one of yours. Lose 1 card to gain animal 834.

t752.action: SIPHON some of the elemental’s power
t752.result: You get close enough to grab onto the elemental for several seconds, during which you can feel some of its power transfer to you. Gain spell 1381 and continue with the overpower-SLAY action.

t753.action: STEAL a blue vial from the rider in the back
t753.result: The sentient is on high alert, but you seem to find yourself in the exact best position every time they glance around. Gain item 862 and continue.

t754.result: The judges wink and welcome you to participate in the trial. Continue with the move-SPEED action.

t755.action: SCAVENGE the wreckage for spare parts
t755.result: You find some climbing gear. Gain item 904.

t756.result: Despite the solid construction of the chest, some of the wood has warped from exposure to the elements. Soon you’ve dismantled enough of the chest’s exterior to reach inside. Roll 4 skill dice; you may reroll each die once. If you have at least 3 of a kind, gain item 1189. Instead, if you have at least one pair, gain item 1162. Otherwise, gain $4.

t757.result:
Amidst the rubble near a cave, you find an excellent stone. Choose one:

Keep the stone

Gain item 1179.

Throw the stone into the cave

The stone strikes a nearby target—perhaps the cave isn’t nearly as deep as you thought. If you dare, you may gain 1 look and continue with the look-EXPLORE action.

t758.result: You climb just above the animal’s snout and hang on for dear life, all the while steering it into the jungle until it calms down. Gain animal 832.

t759.action: DISARM the sentient of its staff
t759.result: One second you have the staff in your hands as you spring away, and the next you’re back where you started. You try it again with the same result. Finally you grab the staff and wave it around instead of running. You can’t explain the result, but both sentients disappear. Gain item 934.

t760.action: ACCESS the building via a side window
t760.result: You pull yourself through a second-level window. Go to interior 561.

t761.result: With a deft flick of the wrist, you dislodge the rope from the wall. Gain item 903.

t762.action: ENLIST the sentient to join you
t762.result: The sentient is happy to join you, but only if you exit the city to the west or south. If you agree, gain sentient 1328. Otherwise, if you prefer to travel elsewhere, gain 1 boost.

t763.action: GRAB a tree branch and hold it as if were a precious item as you walk toward the entrance
t763.result: The guards nod appreciatively at your offering and open the doors for you. Go to interior 589.

t764.result: In their drunken revelry, they don’t notice your hands in their purses. Gain $X; you may continue.

t765.action: LOOT some of the cargo in the landing zone
t765.result: You whistle nonchalantly while dragging away a large crate. Gain item 1034.

t766.action: COERCE the captain to let you board the balloon, threatening to otherwise shoot it down
t766.result: This isn’t a good start to your relationship, but you make up a sad story to gain their sympathy. Choose for them to drop you off either in the northwest (461), north (345), or northeast (346).

t767.result: You embrace the sentient as if they’re an old friend, pocketing a few coins from their purse as you do. Gain $X; you may continue.

t768.action: STEAL a map from the vendor
t768.result: While the sentient is distracted, you snatch a map from the stand and stick it under your shirt. Gain item 1154.

t769.action: ACCESS the building via a side window
t769.result: The window creaks open and you slip inside. Go to interior 590.

t770.result: You furtively reach into the boat and take a rolled-up parchment before whistling to yourself and walking away. Gain item 1258 and continue; if you pay 1 take, you can loot the boat itself (gain vehicle 1156).

t771.result: Through a series of clever social and legal maneuvers, you wrest control of the ship away from the captain. Gain vehicle 1016 and $8.

t772.action: HIJACK the vessel and dock it away from the sentient
t772.result: Seeing that you’re not leaving the city, the sentient disappears underwater. The captain of the ship is just relieved that they avoided the coast guard. Gain vehicle 1015 and $5.

t773.result: You recognize a pattern in the stones and potential in the tiny gateway. For your next action this turn, decrease the cost by X. Continue.

t774.action: STEAL the axe when the sentient isn’t looking
t774.result: The sentient is preoccupied by their blacksmithing or too trusting or both. Gain item 872.

t775.action: STEAL a parchment from the sentient as you pass on the path
t775.result: When the sentient is out of sight, you open the parchment to find instructions to assassinate the King of Souls. Gain 1 boost, 1 overpower, and quest 1635 (add it horizontally to your supply).

t776.result: You weave a web of lies about who you are and the poor quality of the garments. You don’t feel good about it (lose 1 morale), but your sharp tongue results in a deep discount on a warm coat; you may pay $2 to gain item 922.

t777.action: COERCE the guard let you enter the building
t777.result: The guard admires your tactics and takes you on a shortcut inside. Gain 1 time and go to interior 583.

t778.result: The fruit looks good on the outside, and you take a risky bite. Roll X dice. If the results include at least 1 help, gain item 1224 and 1 health. Otherwise lose 1 health and gain 1 boost.

t779.action: FORAGE for some strong vines along the wall
t779.result: You find some healthy, sturdy vines. Gain item 1181.

t780.action: BATHE in the calm, clear water
t780.result: The water feels great as it flows over you, washing off the grime. Gain 1 health.

t781.action: DISARM the sentient on the right
t781.result:
With a well-calculated gesture, you tear away what at first appears to be a weapon but is actually some sort of metal sieve. Choose one:

Return it to its owner

They thank you profusely and offer you a reward (gain $10) or their services as a guide (gain sentient 1336).

Keep it

Its owner yells at you as you walk away. Gain item 980 and curse 1390.

t782.action: ROB the sentient in their moment of weakness
t782.result: The sentient puts up no resistance. Gain $5.

t783.action: COERCE the sentient into granting you access to the bank vault
t783.result:
The Traveler is helpless to intervene as you bully the sentient. The sentient leads you into a hidden cave-like entrance to the bank. Choose one:

Pay 1 overpower to force the sentient to provide a secret phrase to the guardian

Go to cave 090.

Release the sentient as you face the guardian alone

Go to cave 030.

t784.action: LOOT the ruins of any items they contain
t784.result: You slip deftly into the ruins. Go to interior 548.

t785.action: STALL until you can’t hear anyone on the bridge
t785.result: While you wait, you may pay 1 boost to gain any 2 skills. You may then go into the city to the northwest (780) or follow north atop the wall surrounding the city (786).

t786.action: DISTRACT the guards and slip inside behind them
t786.result: The guards fall for your tomfoolery; go to interior 591.

t787.result: It takes guts and guile to pickpocket a metal sentient, but you manage to catch this one off guard. Gain item 860 and $3.

t788.result: It takes all of your cunning to steal a map from the sentient, and they’re so impressed that they offer to accompany you if you give it back. You may gain sentient 1339; if not, gain item 1264 (the sentient highlights your current location [view page 21 in the Book of Vantage; you are in region I]).

t789.action: ROB the sentient of their most expensive weapon
t789.result: The sentient shakes their head sadly as you hold them at bay. “There is no glory in this type of theft,” they say. “I’d respect you if you stole something without me seeing you, but this… this is barbaric.” Gain item 1038 and curse 1391.

t790.result: Before anyone notices, you tuck the book under your arm and walk away. Gain item 1045.

t791.result: As you rifle through the ship, you realize that it has all the signs of a scouting vessel for a colony ship, except with one key difference: The ship features 12 compartments, each labeled with a different element, the origins of life on this planet. Gain 2 boost and continue.

t795.action: LOOT the conspicuously empty room, staying on alert
t795.result:
As you enter the room, a sentient springs from their hiding place to the right. Gain 1 random skill and choose one:

Pay 1 move

Dodge the sentient and exit the cathedral to 281.

Pay 1 overpower

You hogtie the intruder and steal the book (1044), the rifle (1153), or the talisman (1157) then exit to 281.

Do nothing

The sentient crashes into you, knocking you unconscious with the butt of their rifle. Lose 1 health and exit to 281.

t799.action: LOOT the pit of any treasure left behind by less fortunate sentients
t799.result: A wealthy sentient fell to their doom here, leaving behind a purse full of coins. Gain $13 and continue.

t801.action: LOOT the shard from the sky island
t801.result: Just in case someone is watching, you wait for clouds to enshroud the area and take the shard. Gain item 1707.

t917.result: Your instincts lead you to reach into the energy flowing through the key. When you do, all goes black. You wake up with a throbbing headache, but also a newfound potential. Lose 1 health, gain lesson 1428, and gain 1 boost on your character.

t988.result: Your instincts lead you to reach into the portal generator. When you do, all goes black. You wake up with a throbbing headache, but also a newfound potential. Lose 1 health, gain lesson 1428, and gain 1 boost on your character.

t1034.result:
You open the package, eager to see what’s inside. Roll a skill die to determine the contents of the package:

move

A large insect leaps out of the package, its talons slashing into your shoulder before attempting to scamper away. Lose 1 health. Then roll 3 skill dice and gain all move results. If you pay 1 move, you dash after the beast and capture it (gain animal 1221). Otherwise, the insect escapes and you gain 1 boost.

look

Gain a jet pack (1253).

engage

Gain 1 random card from the Skirm spoiler pack (place it in your reserve, where your entire Skirm collection counts as only 1 reserved card. You can use this type of card from your reserve during overpower-DUEL actions, which have further instructions).

help

Gain a turvy fir (1056).

take

Gain curse 1387 and $5.

overpower

Gain a glass arrow (1413).

After you have dismantled the package, lose item 1034.

t1046.action: CONSUME a tiny taste of the flora
t1046.result: The future flashes in your mind’s eye. Roll 2 challenge dice (these dice can come from the dice pool or the center). You may continue; if you do, count those 2 dice against the total dice to be rolled for the new action. Otherwise, place the dice in the center (ignore the results) and gain 1 boost on this flora.

t1047.action: CONSUME a tiny taste of the flora
t1047.result: You burst into uncontrollable, contagious laughter. You may continue; if you do, gain 1 engage. Otherwise, gain 1 morale.

t1048.action: CONSUME a tiny taste of the flora
t1048.result: You feel energized beyond what you would call natural. Gain lesson 1424. You may continue; if you do, gain 1 look.

t1049.action: CONSUME a tiny taste of the flora
t1049.result: A few seconds after eating the petal, you look down at your hands to see that they’re translucent—you can see right through them! You may continue; if you do, ignore 1 challenge die result. Otherwise, gain 1 boost on this flora as a result of your deepened understanding of its nutritional properties.

t1050.action: CONSUME a tiny taste of the flora
t1050.result: You feel something awaken deep inside of you, like one of your organs was operating suboptimally and now it’s reawakened. You may continue with a help action, ignoring any health results on challenge dice. Otherwise, gain 1 boost on this flora as a result of your deepened understanding of its nutritional properties.

t1051.action: CONSUME a tiny taste of the flora
t1051.result: As the petal melts in your mouth, the absurd tangle of bones casts a shadow that tells of possible futures. Roll 3 skill dice. Gain all skills of 1 type from the results. You may continue with an action matching the selected skill.

t1052.action: CONSUME the contents of a bulb
t1052.result: The brown bulb bursts open to reveal at least a liter of cool, clear water. You may continue with an overpower action, ignoring any health results on challenge dice. Otherwise, gain 1 boost on this flora as a result of your deepened understanding of its nutritional properties.

t1053.action: CONSUME a tiny taste of the flora
t1053.result: Your mind springs to life, opening to possibilities previously beyond your comprehension. Gain lesson 1419. You may continue; if you do, gain 1 engage.

t1054.action: CONSUME a tiny taste of the flora
t1054.result: Your body becomes buoyant enough to walk briefly on water. You may continue with a move action across water, reducing the cost to 1. Otherwise, gain 1 boost on this flora as a result of your deepened understanding of its nutritional properties.

t1055.result: You avoid the razor-sharp petals, pinching free a berry and tossing it in your mouth. You may continue with a different take action, reducing the cost by half (round up the new cost). Otherwise, gain 1 boost on this flora as a result of your deepened understanding of its nutritional properties.

t1056.action: CONSUME a tiny patch of soft needles from the bush
t1056.result:
You discover that the turvy fir is crawling with insects—that’s why so many birds are attracted to it. Choose one:

Swallow the needles, insects and all

Once you get past the earthy taste, you find that the insects are full of protein. You’re proud of yourself for trying something different. Gain 1 health; you may continue with a take action, ignoring all morale results on challenge dice.

Spit it out

Gain 1 boost.

t1058.action: CONSUME a tiny taste of the flora
t1058.result: Even the slightest nibble sends the tree into a blind rage. Refresh all challenge dice from adjacent cards and lose 1 health.

t1059.result: The berry is plump and delicious, and you immediately feel a surge of adrenaline. You may continue with an overpower action, ignoring any time results on challenge dice. Otherwise, gain 1 boost on this flora as a result of your deepened understanding of its nutritional properties.

t1060.action: CONSUME a tiny taste of the flora
t1060.result: As you chew on the torch grass, a warm sensation spreads from your mouth throughout your body. You may continue, ignoring cold damage during your next action. Otherwise, gain 1 boost on this flora as a result of your deepened understanding of its nutritional properties.

t1061.action: CONSUME a tiny taste of the flora
t1061.result: The kelp tastes strongly of blood. You fight through the flavor, hoping that you don’t develop vampiric tendencies. You may remove a boost from a sentient in your grid; if you do, gain 1 health and 1 overpower. Otherwise, gain 1 boost on this flora as a result of your deepened understanding of its nutritional properties.

t1062.action: CONSUME a tiny taste of the flora
t1062.result: Your entire body begins to glow, illuminating the surrounding area with perfect clarity. You may continue with a look action, changing the result of 1 challenge die to another die face. Otherwise, gain 1 boost on this flora as a result of your deepened understanding of its nutritional properties.

t1063.action: CONSUME a tiny taste of the flora
t1063.result: The flower has a salty, acidic taste, and it leaves welts on your tongue. Gain 1 boost; unless you continue, lose 1 health.

t1064.action: CONSUME a tiny taste of the flora
t1064.result: As you chew on the petal, you feel an instant boost to your memory. You may continue; if you do, gain 1 boost on your character and 1 random skill. Otherwise, gain 1 boost here.

t1065.action: CONSUME a tiny taste of the flora
t1065.result: If you’re on a location with a cold arrival penalty, suffer 1 cold damage. Otherwise, you may either continue and ignore heat damage during your next action, or gain 1 boost on this flora as a result of your deepened understanding of its nutritional properties.

t1066.action: CONSUME a tiny taste of the flora
t1066.result: Your sense of sight is temporarily heightened. You may continue with a move action; if you do, first look at all adjacent listed locations. Otherwise, gain 1 boost on this flora as a result of your deepened understanding of its nutritional properties.

t1067.action: CONSUME a tiny taste of the flora
t1067.result: The vibrant flower creates the sensation of tiny fireworks in your mouth. You’re overwhelmed with a passion for life and a desire to connect. You may continue with an engage action, ignoring all time results on challenge dice. Otherwise, gain 1 boost on this flora as a result of your deepened understanding of its nutritional properties.

t1068.action: CONSUME a tiny taste of the flora
t1068.result: You feel a surge of strength from the spicy flower. You may continue with an overpower action; if you do, you may reroll any challenge dice once. Otherwise, gain 1 boost on this flora as a result of your deepened understanding of its nutritional properties.

t1069.action: CONSUME a tiny taste of the flora
t1069.result: As you chew on the molten petals, your skin temporarily grows a solid-yet-flexible crust. You may continue, ignoring all health results on challenge dice. Otherwise, gain 1 boost on this flora as a result of your deepened understanding of its nutritional properties.

t1070.action: CONSUME a tiny taste of the flora
t1070.result: The golden leaf melts on your tongue, and for at least a few moments you feel 10 years younger. You may continue; if you do, first refresh all dice from your character card. Otherwise, gain 1 boost on this flora as a result of your deepened understanding of its nutritional properties.

t1071.action: CONSUME a tiny taste of the flora
t1071.result: You instantly regret the choice—this is not an edible flower. Lose 1 health and gain 1 boost; you may continue.

t1072.action: CONSUME a tiny taste of the flora
t1072.result: You conceive the spark of an idea. You may continue; if you do, choose 1 skill, roll 4 skill dice, and gain all results matching the chosen skill. Otherwise, gain 1 boost on this flora as a result of your deepened understanding of its nutritional properties.

t1073.action: CONSUME a tiny taste of the flora
t1073.result: A strong sense of courage surges through you, and you’re ready to throw caution to the wind. You may continue, ignoring all morale results on challenge dice. Otherwise, gain 1 boost on this flora as a result of your deepened understanding of its nutritional properties.

t1074.action: CONSUME a tiny taste of the flora
t1074.result: You avoid the sizzling ends of the flora and eat one of the dark purple flowers. You may continue with a look action, on the initial roll ignoring all time results and rerolling all morale results. Otherwise, gain 1 boost on this flora as a result of your deepened understanding of its nutritional properties.

t1075.action: CONSUME a tiny taste of the flora
t1075.result: The flower gives the inside of your mouth a small static shock from its stored energy. Gain 1 boost. You may continue; if you do, you may first move any number of boost from here to your other cards.

t1076.action: CONSUME a tiny taste of the flora
t1076.result: You’re overwhelmed with a strong sense of empathy for the world around you. You may continue with a help action; if you do, decrease the cost by up to 2 available help skills (without anyone spending them). Otherwise, gain 1 boost on this flora as a result of your deepened understanding of its nutritional properties.

t1077.action: CONSUME a tiny taste of the flora
t1077.result: The bark tastes like the burnt end barbecue pork your grandfather claimed to make, even though you knew he was buying it from a local restaurant. It explodes with flavor. You may continue; if you do, roll 3 skill dice, and if there are any engage results, keep them and roll 3 skill dice again (repeat until you don’t roll any engage). Otherwise, gain 1 boost on this flora as a result of your deepened understanding of its nutritional properties.

t1078.action: CONSUME a tiny taste of the flora
t1078.result: As soon as the flower touches your lips, you know it was a bad idea. Your lips and mouth become numb and your vision grows blurry. You collapse on the ground. Lose 1 time and gain 1 boost.

t1079.action: CONSUME a tiny taste of the flora
t1079.result: As you chew the crisp leaf, you feel your fingers and feet grip your surroundings in a remarkable way. You may continue with a move action; if you do, before you roll, choose a type of result to ignore. Otherwise, gain 1 boost on this flora as a result of your deepened understanding of its nutritional properties.

t1080.action: CONSUME a tiny taste of the flora
t1080.result: Your eyes lose focus for a moment, and after you blink a few times, you realize that you can see exponentially farther than before. Before the effects wear off, you may look at an adjacent location (you may reference the depart storybook). Continue.

t1081.action: CONSUME a tiny taste of the flora
t1081.result: The leaf melts on your tongue, and suddenly you feel your body rise a few centimeters off the ground—you’re levitating! You may continue with a move action, ignoring all morale results. t1082.action: CONSUME a tiny taste of the flora

Otherwise, gain 1 boost on this flora as a result of your deepened understanding of its nutritional properties.

t1136.result: Eating strange mushrooms is always a roll of the dice, so roll 2 skill dice. If either result is overpower, lose 1 health. For any other result, gain 1 health. Also, if the result is a pair (other than overpower), you may refresh all challenge dice and continue.

t1224.action: CONSUME some fruit (pay 1 boost from this card)
